title: 曾押寶墨西哥，緯創為何急轉赴美設廠？林憲銘首揭美國設廠祕辛
summary: 其實，若把時間倒轉到去（2025）年1月，當時，川普重回白宮、開始醞釀貿易戰，而包括緯創在內的電子五哥，在北美洲僅在墨西哥有工廠。有一次，林憲銘被商周詢問是否考慮赴美建廠，他曾嚴肅表示，這是一個需要「審慎思考」的布局。而今，18個月過去，緯創第一座美國工廠開幕，而它的競爭對手鴻海、英業達、和碩、廣達的美國新廠，也將陸續開幕。究竟是什麼原因，讓電子五哥們從一開始的觀望、到爭先恐後進軍「美國製造」？林憲銘首度對此釋疑。他說，第一個原因，是資源配置，以緯創去年與今年的生產量、營業額，動輒1倍的成長速度，「我們要在台灣拿更多的土地跟電，確實有困難，因此就想說，既然我們是全球公司，工廠就要有全球足跡。」
title_zh: 曾押寶墨西哥，緯創為何急轉赴美設廠？林憲銘首揭美國設廠祕辛

title_en: Once betting on Mexico, why did Wistron suddenly switch to the United States to set up a factory? Lin Xianming reveals the secret of setting up a factory in the United States for the first time
summary_en: In fact, if we turn the time back to January 2025, when Trump returned to the White House and began to brew a trade war, the top five electronics companies in North America, including Wistron, only had factories in Mexico. Once, Lin Xianming was asked by Shang Zhou whether he would consider building a factory in the United States. He seriously stated that this was a layout that required "careful thinking." Now, 18 months later, Wistron's first U.S. factory has opened, and its competitors Hon Hai, Inventec, Pegatron, and Quanta's new U.S. factories will also open one after another. What is the reason that caused the five electronics buddies to go from waiting and watching at the beginning to rushing to enter "Made in the United States"? Lin Xianming clarified this for the first time. He said that the first reason is resource allocation. With Wistron's production volume and turnover last year and this year, the growth rate is almost doubled. "It is indeed difficult for us to acquire more land and electricity in Taiwan, so we want to say that since we are a global company, our factories must have a global footprint."

title_en: Rising memory costs affect the PC market; global PC shipments fell 4% year-on-year in the second quarter
summary_en: The latest preliminary PC shipment statistics from Counterpoint Research show that global PC shipments in the second quarter of 2026 will be approximately 65 million units, a 4% decrease from the same period last year. This is also the first annual decrease since the first quarter of 2025 after five consecutive quarters of growth. Counterpoint Research pointed out that the current demand for enterprise replacements driven by Windows upgrades and the continued popularity of AI PCs still provide support for the market. However, the rise in memory prices has pushed up the cost of PC components, which has also begun to affect OEM production planning and end market demand. title: 一場科技業「笑裡藏刀」職場悲劇：看清「笑面虎」真面目，察覺四種人格特質
summary: 科技業曾發生過一起震驚社會的「笑裡藏刀」職場悲劇，受害者是一位擁有專業職能的技術長，施暴者則是親自延攬他至公司的董事長。最初幾年兩人關係良好，然而隨著公司規模擴大，遇到客訴危機與新產品的研發瓶頸，雙方管理理念的分歧逐漸浮現。技術長認為產品的技術品質與長期穩定性才是公司核心，但董事長更關心市場策略，時常以「外行領導內行」的方式干涉技術決策，技術長在專案推動上屢屢受挫，還在高層會議上常被當眾數落，感覺自己被羞辱、被霸凌，離職的念頭越來越強烈。最終，技術長決定離職，離職前一天，他在社群媒體上發表感言，寫下他在公司內部的掙扎與困難，點出管理層面的問題。離職當天，董事長特地安排了最後一次會面，在會議中感謝技術長的貢獻，並再度請他刪除這篇離職文章，技術長僅說「我再想想」，沒有明確答應。

title_en: A workplace tragedy in the technology industry where "a smile hides a knife": see clearly the true face of the "smiling tiger" and detect four personality traits
summary_en: There has been a workplace tragedy in the technology industry that shocked society. The victim was a technical chief with a professional function, and the perpetrator was the chairman of the company who personally recruited him to the company. In the first few years, the two had a good relationship. However, as the company expanded and encountered customer complaint crises and new product development bottlenecks, differences in the management philosophies of the two parties gradually emerged. The chief technology officer believes that the technical quality and long-term stability of the product are the core of the company, but the chairman is more concerned about market strategies and often interferes in technical decisions in a "layman leads an expert" manner. The chief technology officer has been repeatedly frustrated in project promotion and is often scolded in public at high-level meetings. He feels humiliated and bullied, and the idea of ​​​​resigning is getting stronger and stronger. In the end, the chief technology officer decided to resign. The day before his resignation, he posted a speech on social media, writing about his struggles and difficulties within the company, and pointing out management-level problems. On the day of his resignation, the chairman specially arranged a last meeting. During the meeting, he thanked the technical chief for his contribution and once again asked him to delete the resignation article. The chief technical officer only said "I will think about it again" without explicitly agreeing.

title_en: Financial Focus/Taiwan Cement Heping Power Plant's contract renewal stuck, 4.8 million people in Yilan, New Taipei, may be in crisis of power outage
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi hit Taiwan a few days ago, causing power outages to more than 240,000 households across the country. Taipower mobilized more than 16,000 people for emergency repairs. In addition to the threat of natural disasters, Northern Taiwan Electric Power is actually entering a new power outage crisis. This publication’s investigation revealed that the most important heart of Taipower’s Northeast Power Grid, which supplies New Taipei and Yilan, is the Heping Power Plant in Hualien, a subsidiary of TCC. The contract with Taipower will expire in the middle of next year, but it has not been renewed yet. "In the past, the contract renewal was completed a year ago. If the two parties failed to renew the contract, about 4.8 million people in Yilan and New Taipei may be plunged into a new wave of power outage crisis." A person familiar with the matter said.

title_en: Wang Dawei was involved in loan sharking fraud, and the mastermind and business manager were detained and banned from public viewing
summary_en: Kaohsiung's "Wangdao International Financial Consulting" company falsely claimed that it could apply for low-interest loans from banks on its behalf. Many people mistakenly believed that it was a company affiliated with Wangdao Bank. After applying, they found out that they were charged a high 20% "consultancy fee". A disguised form of loan sharking, with nearly 100 million yuan in illegal funds. The prosecutor searched and arrested 20 people. After the trial, they found that they were involved in extinguishing evidence. They banned the mastermind Lin Yucun, business managers Zheng Rujun, Zhong Wenhao, and Lin Lirong from meeting. The court ruled in the evening that they should be detained.

title_en: Hongxia flights were disrupted, 22 Taoyuan aircraft were diverted, Songji and Kaohsiung airports were full, and ground operation time may be extended.
summary_en: Typhoon Hongxia only swept through the southern waters of Taiwan, but it has already caused chaos in flights at Taoyuan Airport and Kaohsiung Airport. Gusty winds blew up in Taoji at night, causing 22 flights to be diverted to other airports. Songji, Taichung and Kaohsiung airports were once full and refused to accept any more, so the flights had to be diverted to Hong Kong and Macau. The three airports in the western region have absorbed many transfer flights, so the ground operations can be tight, and passengers can only wait in the carousel area.

title_en: Shareholders of Zoomlion 3 apologized and announced reforms to remove all oil products produced from April to June.
summary_en: The food safety scandal of Zoomlion Oil has been spreading for nearly a month. The chairman of Taishan, Fushou and Fumao Oil announced for the first time yesterday (24th) that they jointly explained and apologized, announcing that they would promote the reform of the board of directors and corporate governance of Zoomlion Oil, and advocated that Zoomlion Oil should not resume work until food safety concerns are resolved and reviewed by the competent authorities. The oil products produced from April to June will also be completely removed from the shelves and will not be resumed.

summary_en: Farglory Circulation has accelerated the expansion of its distribution territory. title_en: Happy corporate birthday/Baoling Fujin from hospital to family
summary_en: Baoling Fujin Biotech, a well-known domestic pharmaceutical company, celebrated its 50th birthday in January this year. Founder and general manager Jiang Zongming, who is over 80 years old this year, said that he works at the company every day, 365 days a year, except during the Spring Festival. He and other members of the "Banyou Group" who graduated from the Department of Peking Medicine, have pulled Baoling Fujin from a small pharmaceutical factory for half a century to build one of the few listed companies in Taiwan that spans new drug research and development, in vitro diagnostics, and innovative medical aesthetics.

title_en: 16 stocks with two highs and one low have received heavy investment from investors in the past week, with high revenue growth and low price-to-earnings ratio, making them a safe haven.
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have struggled to break through under significant monthly counter-pressure in recent days. As geopolitical risks in the Middle East intensified, bull confidence was undermined. The index fell more than a thousand points again yesterday (24th). The legal person suggested that foreign investors turn to oversellers, and under the leadership of domestic investors, screen out "double high and one low" stocks with large overbuys, high revenue growth, and low price-to-earnings ratios, such as 16 stocks such as Grand United and Wistron. summary_en: When it comes to the shareholders of Baoling Fujin Biotech, the most talked-about story is the story of "nine heroes in one class" of Banyou Group. In 1974, nine seniors and juniors from the Department of Medicine at Peking University jointly formed Banyou Company. It has developed for more than 50 years. title_en: U.S. Section 301 Investigation: Political Yuan: This time the treatment is more advantageous
summary_en: In response to the "forced labor" determination under Section 301, the U.S. Trade Representative's Office has implemented a "10% non-superimposed Most Favored Nation (MFN) tariff" on Taiwan and has an exemption list for Taiwan. Vice President of the Executive Yuan Cheng Li-jun said yesterday (24th) that the United States affirmed Taiwan's commitment to the import policy of forced labor goods in the "Taiwan-US Reciprocal Trade Agreement (ART)". Compared with the previous "10% additional MFN" temporary tariff in Article 122, Taiwan's treatment this time is more advantageous.

title_en: Happy corporate birthday/Baoling Fujin develops multi-functional reagents, a new tool for preventive medicine
summary_en: Jiang Zongming, general manager of Baoling Fujin, said that in the 50 years since the company was founded, its development orientation has shifted from extending human lifespan to focusing on improving the quality of life. The way to prolong life is to use drugs to treat internal diseases of the human body. To improve the quality of life, we start from the outside. We use medical beauty products to improve the quality of the human body's appearance. title: 青安3.0婚育加碼「離婚怎麼辦」？財長：婚姻關係消滅或監護權變動就停補
summary:
青安3.0將於8月1日正式上路，新增新婚及育兒加碼優惠。不過，若貸款人在6年利息補貼期間內離婚，或子女監護權異動，利息補貼是否受影響，引起關注。對此，財政部長莊翠雲昨（22日）於立院備詢表示，離婚後，新婚加碼200萬元貸款額度的利息補貼將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止；若屋主未取得未成年子女監護權，育兒加碼500萬元額度的利息補貼也將停止。
立法院財政委員會22日審查相關議題，民進黨立委李坤城指出，青安3.0將新婚夫妻最高貸款額度提高至1200萬元，若有未成年子女（含持有媽媽手冊的懷孕婦女），最高可貸1500萬元，「離婚後利息補貼如何認定？」

莊翠雲表示，離婚後，新婚加碼200萬元貸款額度的利息補貼將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止；若屋主未取得未成年子女監護權，育兒加碼500萬元額度的利息補貼也停止。圖／國會頻道
對此，莊翠雲回應，若夫妻沒有子女，在6年利息補貼期間內離婚，原本因新婚增加的200萬元額度，將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止利息補貼。不過，未持有房屋的一方，若未來仍符合資格且未曾使用過新青安貸款，不論維持單身或再婚，仍可重新申請最高1000萬元的青安貸款。

title_en: Qing'an 3.0 focuses on marriage and childbearing: "What to do if you get divorced"? Finance Minister: Compensation will be suspended if the marriage relationship is terminated or the custody rights are changed.
summary_en:
Qing'an 3.0 will be officially launched on August 1st, with newly added discounts for newlyweds and childcare. However, if the borrower divorces or changes child custody during the six-year interest subsidy period, whether the interest subsidy will be affected has caused concern. In this regard, Finance Minister Zhuang Cuiyun stated at the Legislative Yuan yesterday (22nd) that after divorce, the interest subsidy for the newlywed loan limit of 2 million yuan will cease from the date of the termination of the marriage; if the homeowner has not obtained custody of the minor children, the interest subsidy for the childcare loan limit of 5 million yuan will also stop.
The Finance Committee of the Legislative Yuan reviewed relevant issues on the 22nd. DPP legislator Li Kuncheng pointed out that Qing'an 3.0 will increase the maximum loan limit for newlyweds to 12 million yuan. If there are minor children (including pregnant women with mother's handbooks), the maximum loan amount can be 15 million yuan. "How to determine the interest subsidy after divorce?"

Zhuang Cuiyun said that after divorce, the interest subsidy for the additional loan amount of 2 million yuan for newlyweds will stop from the date of the termination of the marriage; if the homeowner has not obtained custody of the minor children, the interest subsidy for the additional 5 million yuan for childcare will also stop. Picture/Congress Channel
In response, Zhuang Cuiyun responded that if the couple has no children and divorces within the six-year interest subsidy period, the interest subsidy of the 2 million yuan that was originally increased due to the new marriage will cease from the date of the termination of the marriage relationship. However, if the party who does not own a house is still eligible in the future and has never used a new Qingan loan, regardless of whether he remains single or remarries, he can still reapply for a Qingan loan of up to 10 million yuan.

summary_en: ITRI ​​stated on the 24th that in the face of the demand for home medical care brought by Japan's super-aged society, with the support of the Industrial Technology Department of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, ITRI organized the "2026 Hokkaido Sapporo Home Medical Technology Exchange Group" and led eight Taiwanese smart medical companies to participate in the 8th Japan Joint Society for Home Medical Care Conference and officially signed a memorandum of cooperation (MOU) with the Japan Joint Society for Home Medical Care.

summary_en: The Rooftop XOXO Bistro on the top floor of Moxy Hotel in Taichung, a subsidiary of Fengyi Group, has launched a new and upgraded "Taste Bud Escape Plan" from now until September 30. summary_en: On the 24th, global shoemaking leader Baocheng Industrial (9904) announced a profit warning on behalf of its subsidiary Yue Yuen Industrial. title_en: The benefits of transformation emerged. Its profit in May increased by more than 8 times year-on-year, and three major new materials took over.
summary_en: In the first quarter of 2026, Taihong (8039)'s revenue was 2.415 billion yuan, an annual increase of 8.46%. The growth rate was not eye-catching, but its operating profit increased by about 78%, and its net profit after tax nearly doubled, with earnings per share of 0.65 yuan. The main reason is that the company proactively reduced low-margin orders and raised product selling prices to reflect copper prices and other raw material costs. After one year of adjustments, the Thai factory has caught up with the Taiwanese factory in yield rate and production efficiency. Therefore, the gross profit margin in the first quarter reached 22.03% and the operating profit margin was 6.06%, indicating that the improvement in product mix has begun to be reflected in profits. Second-quarter revenue was 2.696 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 11.62%, but an annual decrease of 2.4%. The main reason is that the demand for consumer electronics is flat, but it has gradually entered the peak season. The net profit after tax in May was 69.45 million yuan, an annual increase of more than 8 times, and the earnings per share was 0.26 yuan, which is equivalent to earning 40% of the profit in the first quarter in a single month. This once again proves that the company is not relying on revenue, but on high-margin products to increase profits.

title_en: Zhu Chengzhi: Will the listing of Kimi K3 affect AI stocks? How are Taiwan stocks doing in August?
summary_en: The Korean stock Kospi index fell by a maximum of 31% this week. Highly leveraged ETFs placed heavy bets on the second leading Korean semiconductor stocks. 460,000 investors were cut off. Foreign investors cut leeks and retail investors wailed. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix account for 53-60% of the weight of the index, and TSMC accounts for 43.5% of the Taiwan stock market. The reason why the Taiwan stock index fell less is because foreign investors sold 84,000 TSMC shares last year. However, as of July 22 this year, TSMC will bear the burden. Foreign investors sold more than 784,000 shares, and it can still hold on to the quarterly support. The lowest is only 2,290 yuan. It is relatively resistant to decline and has risen 10% more than last year. Therefore, it is estimated that it will be relatively resistant to rising prices in the future. Therefore, buying TSMC’s performance is not as good as buying its surrounding beneficiary stocks. In the past, the world did not pay attention to the Korean stock market. Now, this US$4 trillion stock market has become an early indicator of market risk appetite, and it is also the target of Trump's big investment and establishment of factories in the United States. Since the launch of the single-stock leveraged ETF on May 27, Korean retail investors have net purchased approximately 14 trillion won (approximately US$9.5 billion), which is much higher than that of foreign investors. Hynix dropped 44% from a sky-high price of 2.987 million won on June 25 and fell below the quarterly line to a low of 1.678 million won on July 14. Hynix Double Leverage ETF has fallen by 70% since its high point in June, so Korean retail investors were seriously injured. Korean stocks fell sharply eight times from June to July this year, and foreign investors oversold Taiwanese and Korean stocks for four consecutive weeks. Since the beginning of this year, foreign investors have only bought US$2.14 billion over Thailand’s emerging Asian stocks, sold more than US$103 billion into Korean stocks, followed by US$38.9 billion over Taiwanese stocks.

title_en: Where will CNR Shopping Mall go after Shin Kong takes over? Expert: Operate with a department store mentality, not a food court
summary_en: The CNR Mall has officially changed hands, and Shin Kong has signed a short-term contract with 90% of the counters for a minimum of three months. It is expected to submit a complete renovation plan to the Taiwan Railway Company for review by the end of August, and all renovations will be completed by the end of 2028 at the earliest. But how will the blueprint for the future CNR shopping mall be drawn up? Experts put forward suggestions based on the current situation. Shin Kong cannot be like Breeze and operate CNR shopping malls with the concept of a food street. Instead, it should think about the future from the perspective of a "department store."

title_en: ASUS announces the launch of a new generation of AMD EPYC servers to accelerate enterprise-level AI applications
summary_en: ASUS, a global brand of server and data center solutions, announced today (24th) the launch of a new series of servers, all equipped with the next-generation AMD EPYC 9006 processor. Zhu Peilan, senior global vice president of ASUS, said, "In the face of the wave of large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) applications, infrastructure flexibility and scalability have become the key to success; ASUS's new server series equipped with 6th generation AMD EPYC has both, and will provide enterprises with unprecedented powerful computing power. This is a crucial new milestone for both the brand and its customers around the world."

summary_en: Bank of Taiwan Life announced that general manager Liu Qisheng will be relieved of his duties as director and general manager on July 26. title_en: Central City Industrial Policy Association invited former representative to India Weng Wenqi to give a lecture and proposed the concept of "Taiwan-India Industrial TIM Strategic Alliance"
summary_en: Faced with the trend of global supply chain reorganization and corporate overseas expansion, the Taichung City Industrial and Commercial Development Investment Promotion Association held the "Ambassador's Lecture - Taiwan-India Relations and Opportunities and Challenges for Taiwanese Businessmen" on the 24th. Weng Wenqi, the former representative of the Republic of China in India, was invited as the speaker to provide an in-depth analysis of India's investment environment, industrial trends and Taiwanese business deployment strategies, helping Taichung companies seize the opportunities of global supply chain restructuring and reduce investment risks, attracting many business representatives to actively participate in the exchange.

title_en: Draft prerequisites for Asian investment laws at the end of the year. Financial Supervisory Commission: Tax incentives are planned to focus on foreign investment
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Kaohsiung, 24th) Taiwan promotes an Asian capital center, and the Financial Supervisory Committee discusses the special law for the development of financial markets and asset management, and evaluates the draft version of the year-end prerequisites. The outside world is paying attention to tax incentives. The Financial Supervisory Commission pointed out that this part involves a large level of cross-department division of labor, and tax fairness must be considered. Currently, it plans to focus on the foreign capital part, but it cannot allow Taiwan to become a haven for tax burdens.

title_en: CSP giants smash AI infrastructure, server manufacturers accelerate North American factory expansion to meet the challenge
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Wu Jiahao, Taipei, 24th) Although the market has doubts about the excessive capital expenditures of cloud service giants, the artificial intelligence (AI) computing power arms race has not stopped. Analysts pointed out that the combined capital expenditures of the five largest cloud service providers (CSPs) in North America will increase by nearly 90% in 2026. Benefiting from the huge demand for infrastructure construction, the order visibility of major Taiwanese AI server manufacturers has been extended to 2027, and they are accelerating production expansion in North America and globally.

title: 輝達AI-RAN卡位6G　基地台變身AI伺服器 榮群、互動、智邦迎商機
summary:
榮群擔任了Infinera產品在台灣的第一線運維保固代表，當電信商回報問題時，由榮群的在地工程師先進行除錯與搶修。如果遇到底層PIC晶片或核心韌體問題，再向Infinera美國總部申請最高層級的技術支援(Tier 3 Support)。

當Infinera與諾基亞的產品線合二為一後，榮群在台灣Pre-6G與高階光通訊局端建設的專案金額將會顯著拉高。2026年EPS預估約0.65元、2027年約1.75元，受限於專案時程，處於營收調整期。

台灣電信業經歷了台灣大併台灣之星，與遠傳併亞太的龐大網路整合作業。互動主攻電信網路的局端布建工程，協助電信商將不同頻段、不同世代的舊設備，與諾基亞的新世代5G/5GA設備進行無縫合網。

互動本身就是Infinera在台灣的端到端WDM解決方案的夥伴，當Infinera納入諾基亞旗下後，互動等於同時掌握了諾基亞的無線通訊(RAN)與Infinera的超高階光傳輸兩大武器，能為電信商或大型企業資料中心(DCI)提供更完整的網算一體解決方案。

title_en: Huida AI-RAN card slot 6G base station transformed into AI server Rongqun, Interactive, Zhibang welcome business opportunities
summary_en:
Rongqun serves as the front-line operation and maintenance representative for Infinera products in Taiwan. When telecom operators report problems, Rongqun's local engineers first perform debugging and repairs. If you encounter problems with the underlying PIC chip or core firmware, apply for the highest level of technical support (Tier 3 Support) from Infinera's US headquarters.

When the product lines of Infinera and Nokia are merged into one, Rongqun's projects in Taiwan's Pre-6G and high-end optical communication central offices will increase significantly. The EPS is estimated to be about 0.65 yuan in 2026 and about 1.75 yuan in 2027. It is limited by the project schedule and is in the revenue adjustment period.

Taiwan's telecommunications industry has experienced the massive network integration operations of Taiwan's merger with Taiwan Star and Far EasTone's merger with Asia Pacific. Interactive focuses on the central office deployment project of telecommunications networks, assisting telecommunications companies in seamlessly connecting old equipment of different frequency bands and different generations with Nokia's new generation 5G/5GA equipment.

Interactive itself is Infinera's end-to-end WDM solution partner in Taiwan. When Infinera becomes a subsidiary of Nokia, Interactive has mastered both Nokia's wireless communications (RAN) and Infinera's ultra-high-end optical transmission. It can provide telecom operators or large enterprise data centers (DCI) with more complete integrated network and computing solutions.

While data centers around the world are frantically computing AI, the backend data transmission network is facing a serious "big traffic jam." In order to solve this global problem, Hon Hai Research Institute (HHRI), a subsidiary of Hon Hai (2317) Group, teamed up with National Yang-Ming Chiao Tung University to successfully develop the latest "high-capacity silicon photon emitter" technology. title: 愛吃飯又怕胖？醫揭這種澱粉不只不長肉，還能幫助燃脂防癌
summary:
對於熱愛白飯、麵條與馬鈴薯的人來說，「澱粉」兩個字常常伴隨罪惡感。但如果有一種澱粉，不僅不容易讓你發胖，還能餵養腸道益菌、提升胰島素敏感性，甚至可能降低大腸癌風險，你會不會重新愛上碳水化合物？「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，對於喜歡吃澱粉的人來說，一個聰明的解套方式，就是選擇抗性澱粉。

抗性澱粉的特別之處，在於它獨特的消化路徑。曾嶔元說明，一般澱粉會在小腸中被分解成糖類，但抗性澱粉能完整通過小腸，直到抵達大腸。在那裡，它不會被人體的消化酵素分解，而是成為結腸中數十億益生菌的「食物」。這個過程稱為發酵，也讓抗性澱粉成為一種天然的益生元。益生菌藉此大量繁殖，優化腸道菌群，進而提升消化與免疫功能。對於進行高強度訓練的人而言，健康的腸道更是恢復與表現的關鍵。

當腸道微生物分解抗性澱粉時，會產生一類稱為短鏈脂肪酸（縮寫為SCFAs）的代謝物，其中最重要的是丁酸鹽。這些SCFAs本身就具有調節新陳代謝與免疫力的潛力。更值得一提的是，抗性澱粉帶來的益處，並不需要像某些益生菌飲品那樣付出高昂的代價，卻能自然地支持腸道與整體健康。

title: 讓老鼠在糖水和古柯鹼二選一，94%都選了糖，原來比毒品更難戒的是「甜」
summary:
明明不餓，手卻已經伸向那塊巧克力；明明吃飽了，卻仍抗拒不了下一口甜點。這種「明知不該、卻停不下來」的渴望，真的只是嘴饞和意志力薄弱嗎？「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，甜食不僅能顯著提升血清素和多巴胺的數值，還能刺激大腦釋放內源性鴉片類物質。

這些物質會引發一種被稱為「渴求（craving）」的感覺，進而促成享樂性飢餓（hedonic hunger），這是一種純粹為了滿足味覺享受而進食的欲望，即使在並未感到生理飢餓的情況下，也會驅使人們進食。簡單來說，這意味著我們可能僅僅因為甜食的美味而進食，完全無關飢餓的需求。如果反覆滿足這種甜食渴求，可能會逐漸演變為成癮行為，其機制與物質成癮的生理基礎非常相似，包括不可控的強迫性行為。

最令人震驚的證據，來自一項讓老鼠在糖水和古柯鹼之間做選擇的研究：結果有94％的老鼠選擇了糖水，而非古柯鹼注射。這項研究表明，甜味的吸引力甚至超越了古柯鹼這類具有強烈成癮性的毒品。這樣的結果強調了甜味不僅是一種感官愉悅，更是一種能夠深度觸發大腦獎賞迴路的刺激，比常規成癮性物質更具吸引力。

title: 刺青只是跟風？心理師：選什麼圖案，早就暴露你的內心狀態
summary:
刺青究竟只是流行，還是一個人內心狀態的外顯訊號。有人刺花朵、蝴蝶、心型，只是想讓身體更好看，也為生活增添趣味；也有人把神魔靈獸、宗教符號，甚至一句話、一個名字，長久留在身上。看似只是圖案選擇，背後往往藏著情緒、防衛、信仰，甚至說不出口的人生經驗。

專業諮商心理師林萃芬在其著作《從裝扮洞察人心》中指出，從一個人選擇刺青的圖案，多少能夠看出他的動機和喜好。一般來說，刺花朵、蝴蝶、心型等可愛圖案的人，目的大都是為了嘗鮮，想要增加身體的美感，或增添生活的趣味性。像很多女明星刺青的圖案都屬於可愛型，圖案較小，部位也較不明顯，多在手臂、腳踝、股溝等部位。

如果觀察小賈斯汀的刺青圖案、大小、時間軸就會發現，一開始的時候，他都選擇很小的圖案。他的第一個圖案是家族圖騰，部位在左側腰際，非常不明顯，但意義卻很深遠。圖案來源是他曾與家人一起讀過《天地一沙鷗》，故事內容描述海鷗超越自我的遠大抱負，他透過刺青鼓勵自己要有遠大的抱負。隨著年齡增長，他刺青的圖案越來越大型、明顯，而且都與內在勇氣的追尋、刻骨銘心的感情有關。

title: 心理師：光從一個人戴不戴錶，就能洞察很多訊息
summary:
手錶看似只是計時工具，很多時候也是造型的一部分。但一個人戴不戴錶，戴什麼樣的錶，透露的可能不只是品味，還包括責任感、自我管理能力，甚至對時間的掌控感與焦慮程度。看起來只是日常選擇，背後其實藏著不少心理訊息。

專業諮商心理師林萃芬在其著作《從裝扮洞察人心》中指出，身邊喜歡收集手錶的朋友不少，手錶不只是計時工具，也是造型的一部分。研究顯示，男性和女性對手錶的選擇有明顯差異，男性傾向選擇技術性和大錶盤的手錶，或許反映出他們對力量、功能性和製錶工藝的講究。女性則偏愛設計性和珠寶款的手錶，著重搭配造型時的完美呈現，當然也有不少女生喜歡戴男性錶款，從行事風格到性格特質都較為中性。

她認為，除了偏愛不同的錶款外，光從一個人戴不戴錶，就能洞察很多訊息，特別是對成功的企圖心，以及對時間的掌控感。

林萃芬分析，從一個人是否選擇戴手錶，可以進一步了解對方的責任感高不高、自我管理能力好不好，以及焦慮指數的高低。不少心理學研究都顯示，配戴手錶的人往往更具時間意識，自律性和責任感也較高。由於配戴手錶會讓人不斷提醒自己時間的流逝，這種時間管理的自律性，也反映了配戴者對秩序、精確和控制的心理需求。

title_en: Psychologist: Just from whether a person wears a watch or not, you can gain insight into a lot of information
summary_en:
The watch seems to be just a timekeeping tool, but in many cases it is also part of the style. But whether a person wears a watch and what kind of watch he wears may reveal not only his taste, but also his sense of responsibility, self-management ability, and even his sense of control over time and his level of anxiety. It may seem like just a daily choice, but there is actually a lot of psychological information hidden behind it.

Professional counseling psychologist Lin Cuifen pointed out in her book "Insights into People's Hearts through Dressing Up" that there are many friends around me who like to collect watches. Watches are not only timekeeping tools, but also part of the style. Research shows that there are significant differences between men and women in their choice of watches, with men tending to choose technical and large dial watches, perhaps reflecting their emphasis on strength, functionality and watchmaking craftsmanship. Women prefer watches with design and jewelry styles, focusing on perfect presentation when matching with the style. Of course, many girls also like to wear men’s watches, which are more neutral in terms of style and personality.

She believes that in addition to preferring different watch models, a lot of information can be discerned just from whether a person wears a watch, especially his ambition for success and his sense of control over time.

Lin Cuifen analyzed that whether a person chooses to wear a watch can further understand the other person’s sense of responsibility, self-management ability, and anxiety index. Many psychological studies have shown that people who wear watches tend to be more time-conscious and have a higher sense of self-discipline and responsibility. Since wearing a watch will constantly remind oneself of the passage of time, this kind of self-discipline in time management also reflects the wearer's psychological needs for order, precision and control.

title_en: The red clouds are approaching and the walrus is bad. The coast patrol drives away 33 commercial cargo ships stranded near the coast.
summary_en: Typhoon Hongxia is approaching, and the walrus situation in the southern and eastern seas has become worse. The Coast Guard stated today that in cooperation with the Port Bureau, starting from 12:00 on the 23rd, ships sailing in the 12-mile warning zone on the southern and eastern coasts are required to stay away from the wind. As of 12:00 noon today, the Coast Guard has assisted in driving away 33 commercial cargo ships stranded near the coast. It will continue to assist in the control of relevant sea areas to avoid maritime accidents.

summary_en: The Tainan City Government today participated in the 115th Annual Private Participation in Public Construction Investment Promotion Conference organized by the Ministry of Finance and launched 9 projects to promote participation and investment, which are expected to attract more than 20 billion yuan in private investment. title_en: The amount of points used on the Respect for the Elderly Card cannot be compared with supermarket purchases. New Taipei City Social Affairs Bureau explains
summary_en: The points of the New Taipei City Respect for the Elderly Card were increased from 480 to 600 points in July this year, and the first 30 minutes of the newly added YouBike 2.0E e-bike are free, but the usage method is confusing to many elderly people. Director of Social Affairs Li Meizhen made a special report to the parliament today, emphasizing that in the first half of next year, the elderly card will be expanded to include hot springs, rehabilitation buses, and health examinations at municipal joint medical and health centers (including health examinations for elderly driver license renewal); in the second half of the year, up to 300 points per month will be opened for shopping at farmers' associations, pharmacies, and supermarkets. The points accumulation system is expected to be implemented after the replacement of the second-generation card in 2029.

Among them, Shenyun Technology displayed its latest agent-based AI (Agentic AI) infrastructure at the AMD Advancing AI exhibition. title_en: The market fell thousands of points, but Li Ke bucked the trend and rose, once soaring more than 9% during the session.
summary_en: Taiwan stocks fell under selling pressure on the 24th, with the weighted index plunging more than a thousand points and falling below the 44,000-point mark. The stock price of LED packaging manufacturer Liqi (8111) bucked the trend and resisted the decline. It reached a high of 62 yuan during the session, an increase of 9.15%. The stock price pulled back slightly in the afternoon. As of 13:15, it was temporarily trading at 59.1 yuan, an increase of 2.30 yuan, or about 4.05%. The trading volume increased to more than 18,000 contracts, showing a strong performance relative to the broader market.

summary_en: Yageo (2327) will hold a press conference on the 29th. Foreign Citigroup Securities released the latest report stating that Yageo's mid- to long-term operating pattern is stable. title: 威強電攜手AMD 搶攻機器人商機
summary: 工業電腦廠威強電（3022）搶攻機器人商機，於7月21至22日在美國舊金山舉行的AMD Advancing AI 2026大會中，展示全新NANO-X100 4吋單板電腦及其邊緣AI推論應用。NANO-X100搭載AMD Ryzen AI嵌入式X100系列處理器，為具備邊緣AI推論能力的自主移動機器人（AMR）控制器提供精巧的嵌入式運算平台。現場亦同步展示威強電AiEi軟體平台，呈現其在邊緣視覺監控應用中的影像分析、事件偵測與集中管理能力。

title_en: IEI joins hands with AMD to seize robot business opportunities
summary_en: Industrial computer manufacturer IEI (3022) is seizing the robot business opportunity and will showcase the new NANO-X100 4-inch single board computer and its edge AI inference application at the AMD Advancing AI 2026 conference held in San Francisco, USA from July 21 to 22. NANO-X100 is equipped with AMD Ryzen AI embedded X100 series processors, providing a sophisticated embedded computing platform for autonomous mobile robot (AMR) controllers with edge AI inference capabilities. The IEI AiEi software platform was also showcased at the scene, demonstrating its image analysis, event detection and centralized management capabilities in edge visual surveillance applications.

summary: 根據衛生福利部107年死因統計，心臟病是國人第二號殺手，平均每24分鐘就有1人死於心臟病，如果再加上腦中風、高血壓、糖尿病及腎臟病等血管性疾病，每年造成5.4萬人死亡，超過頭號殺手癌症奪走的人命。好消息是，8成心臟病與中風造成的早死是可以預防的。心臟病與中風的主要危險因子包括缺乏規律運動、不健康飲食所引起的三高（高血壓、高血糖及高血脂），過重、肥胖、吸菸及過量飲酒等等。如果你沒體力一天運動3小時，也沒辦法每天只吃魚和蔬食，也不用太擔心。專家指出，你可以做一件簡單的事，那就是趕快開始避免或嚴格限制3種對心臟特別不好的食物。

昨日盤勢
GOOGL盤後公布財報亮眼並調高資本支出，然因自由現金流轉差，盤後股價下跌。週四台股早盤在台塑集團帶領下衝高，然月線附近仍遭遇套牢賣壓，指數一度下殺失守10日線，所幸尾盤台積電神龍擺尾拉高，終場指數收漲。因國際油價上漲，台塑集團持續受到資金青睞。除此之外，IPC受惠邊緣AI應用，相關個股研揚、凌華亮燈漲停表現強勢。
權值股方面，台積電上漲0.21%，鴻海上漲2.39%，聯發科上漲0.65%，廣達上漲2.13%，台達電收平盤。盤面強勢股，台虹、立碁、凌華、研揚、聯亞、嘉碁等17檔個股漲停；台塑化、貿聯-KY、奇鋐、華星光、聯一光、宇瞻、艾訊、雙鍵、全新、健策等漲幅6%以上；盤面弱勢股，環球晶、台勝科、和成、力山、揚博、冠西電、聯友金屬-創、安碁等跌停；臻鼎-KY、磐亞、晶心科、為升、強茂、中美晶等跌幅8%以上。
終場台灣加權指數上漲25.03點，以44850.81點作收，成交量為8925.16億元。觀察盤面變化，三大類股漲跌互見，電子上漲0.14%、傳產下跌0.42%、金融下跌0.13%。在次族群部份，以油電燃氣、電腦及週邊設備、其他電子表現較佳，分別上漲8.39%、2.24%

However, in order to compete for the leading position in AI infrastructure, Google's capital expenditures increased to US$44.9 billion, causing free cash to turn negative for the first time. It became the focus of the long-short war on AI prospects. After the financial report was released, the stock price fell by more than 4%.

title_en: Hot Stocks》The war pushed up oil prices and Formosa Plastics surged in volume
summary_en:
The U.S.-Iran conflict and the surge in international oil prices have the opportunity to push up plastic quotations. After the Taiwanese stock market opened yesterday, the stock price of Formosa Plastics (1301) once hit the daily limit of 69.8 yuan, setting a new high in the band. title_en: Oil prices, U.S. debt, and U.S. stocks fell, Tesla’s market value evaporated by US$200 billion
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Liao Hanyuan, Washington, 23rd) U.S. stocks fell today due to the escalating war situation in the Middle East, oil prices soaring again and the slowdown in artificial intelligence (AI) investment. Tesla’s last quarter financial report did not meet expectations, its stock price fell nearly 15%, and its market value evaporated by approximately US$200 billion. Intel, a major chipmaker that announced its results after the close, reported earnings per share that were much higher than analysts' estimates and surged in after-hours trading.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Liao Hanyuan, Washington, 23rd) The rising war situation in the Middle East and international oil prices have soared again, driving U.S. Treasury bond yields higher. The 20- and 30-year bond yields both exceeded 5%, which was higher than during the U.S.-Iraq war and when reciprocal tariffs were announced last year. Oil prices exceeded US$100 and long-term bond yields exceeded 5%, once again impacting the financial market and the global economy.

summary_en: The Taichung City Food and Drug Safety Department continues to investigate the whereabouts of the problematic oil from Zhonglian Oil and Fat. summary: 過去提到Hi-End音響，許多人聯想到大型喇叭、繁複線材與高昂價格，但隨著小宅、租屋族增加及年輕世代消費習慣改變，高音質體驗正從少數發燒友走向日常生活。即將於8月6日至8月9日在台北君悅酒店登場的2026 TAA國際Hi-End音響大展，展出內容也反映音響市場朝生活化、智慧化、個人化發展，耳機、主動式書架喇叭、串流音響與Soundbar成為近年新崛起的趨勢之一。

title_en: Small homes, streaming, and headphones drive the transformation of Hi-Fi, and the audio market is launching a new trend of mini and integrated devices
summary_en: In the past, when Hi-End speakers were mentioned, many people thought of large speakers, complicated wires and high prices. However, with the increase in small houses and renters and the changing consumption habits of the younger generation, the high-quality experience is moving from a small number of audiophiles to daily life. The upcoming 2026 TAA International Hi-End Audio Exhibition will be held at the Grand Hyatt Hotel in Taipei from August 6 to August 9. The exhibition content also reflects the development of the audio market towards life, intelligence, and personalization. Headphones, active bookshelf speakers, streaming speakers, and soundbars have become one of the emerging trends in recent years.

summary: 台北海洋科技大學海訓部主任林威志今天在網路節目「政治狠狠問」中表示，無人載具不只是國防裝備，也能廣泛應用於物流、農業、勘災、巡檢、通訊及公共建設，技職教育機構若能持續結合企業，建立完整培育機制，再搭配政府穩定政策與長期投資，無人載具發展將成兼具國防韌性、人才價值與經濟效益的下一座護國神山。

title_en: Will unmanned vehicles become the next sacred mountain to protect the country? Scholars focus on three key issues: policy, industry and talent
summary_en: Lin Weizhi, director of the Maritime Training Department of the Taipei University of Marine Science and Technology, said in the online program "Political Questions" today that unmanned vehicles are not only national defense equipment, but can also be widely used in logistics, agriculture, disaster survey, inspections, communications and public construction. If technical and vocational education institutions can continue to integrate enterprises and establish a complete training mechanism, coupled with the government's stable policies and long-term investment, the development of unmanned vehicles will become the next sacred mountain that protects the country with both national defense resilience, talent value and economic benefits.

summary_en: The soybean salad oil produced by China United Oils and Fats Co., Ltd. has recently been found to have excessive levels of the carcinogen benzene pyrene, and the storm continues to expand. Costco, an American-style store, issued an announcement on July 23, announcing that it would cooperate with the instructions of the competent authorities and launch a return mechanism for 12 affected products. Costco apologized for the trouble this incident caused to its members, and emphasized that returns will be handled in accordance with the principles of leniency, priority, speed, and simplicity, and will fully cooperate with subsequent handling.

title_en: Affecting 590,000 households’ water use! In conjunction with the construction of the Kaohsiung MRT Yellow Line, water supply in Fengshan and other 6 districts will be suspended for 7 hours tomorrow.
summary_en: In conjunction with the relocation of the water pipeline at the Y4 station on the Yellow Line of the Kaohsiung MRT, the Taiwan Water Supply Company is scheduled to carry out the branch installation and internal inspection of the 2000 mm diameter steel pipe on Dapi Road in Niaosong District starting from 0:00 tomorrow (24th) Depending on the operation, due to the impact of the project, 6 districts including Fengshan and Lingya will implement a 7-hour water cut-off, while 7 districts including Sanmin and Yancheng will reduce water pressure for water supply. title_en: Don’t let the land crab mother die. Kenting Taiwan Route 26 will start three waves of crab protection traffic control at the end of July.
summary_en: The peak breeding period for land crabs in Kenting is from June to October of the lunar calendar every year. Mother land crabs go to the coast to release their young on full moon nights to fulfill their mission. However, their life journey is full of dangers, and they are often killed by roadkill while crossing the road. The Office of Reclamation and Management today announced that during the land crab breeding season, crab traffic management will be started on Route 26 from Banana Bay to Shadao. It will be divided into three stages from the end of July to the end of September. It calls on the public to slow down, be courteous to land crabs, and protect the precious ecology.

summary_en: With the rise of diverse lifestyles, modern living rooms are shifting from the "display type" in the past to the "participation type" that emphasizes interaction. From now on, it is open for reservation and experience at 21 HOLA stores in Taiwan. When you make a reservation and experience, you will receive a "Four-piece Eco-friendly Straw Set". The quantity is limited and while stocks last.

title_en: Zhun Hongxia issued a coast guard warning as "unnamed", which will most obviously affect Taiwan from Friday night to Saturday
summary_en: The Meteorological Administration issued a maritime typhoon warning late at night in response to Typhoon Hongxia. The first warning range included the Bashi Channel and the sea surface of Dongsha Island. This is the first time in six years that Taiwan has issued a warning for an "unnamed" typhoon after Typhoon Mikra, which is quite rare. Because the internationally recognized time for Hongxia to become Taiwan is probably very close to the time it affects Taiwan, the Meteorological Administration warned in advance that there may be heavy rain or torrential rain in the southern and eastern Huadong areas due to the influence of external circulation.

title_en: Looking at the peak season freight rates for sea freight, the increase is moderate. Prices are expected to remain relatively high in the third quarter.
summary_en: After rising sharply for ten weeks, freight rates in the global container shipping market have fallen back for two consecutive weeks, and the rush for shipments has subsided. The latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index (SCFI) will be released today (24th). Domestic shipping and logistics industry players generally believe that the current market is in a high-end consolidation rather than a reversal of the economy. It is predicted that the peak season market in the third quarter is expected to continue, but the increase will be moderate compared with the first half of the year.

title: 工紙三雄迎庫存回補潮 下半年營運估逐步回暖
summary: 進入第3季傳統備貨旺季，在供給端無虞、出口需求穩健及內需逐步復甦等因素帶動下，工紙市場可望迎來新一波庫存回補。市場看好，工紙三雄正隆、榮成與永豐餘今年營運表現有望優於去年，下半年營運可望逐步回暖。

title_en: Industrial Paper Sanxiong welcomes the wave of inventory replenishment, and its operating estimates gradually recover in the second half of the year
summary_en: Entering the traditional peak stocking season in the third quarter, the industrial paper market is expected to usher in a new wave of inventory replenishment, driven by factors such as stable supply, solid export demand, and gradual recovery in domestic demand. The market is optimistic. The operating performance of the three industrial paper companies Zhenglong, Rongcheng and Yongfengyu this year is expected to be better than last year, and operations are expected to gradually pick up in the second half of the year.

summary_en: Taiwan stocks opened higher and lower yesterday (23) and closed in the red at the end of the day. 45,000 points gained and lost, and ended up 0.06%, continuing to digest the upper selling pressure. Investors are currently in a wait-and-see mode, with volume shrinking, and expects the broader market to volatilize between the quarter and monthly lines to await more news, including financials for heavyweight technology stocks, Federal Reserve (Fed) policy and and foreign investment movements, the company said.

CEO Musk predicted: "This year will be a huge year of capital expenditures," and it will sprint towards new businesses such as humanoid robots and self-driving cars.

The industry is optimistic that Google's hardware investment will continue to grow, which will be beneficial to the market outlook of third-party manufacturers such as TSMC, MediaTek, Hon Hai, and Quanta.

summary_en: In order to promote offshore wind power, the Ministry of Economic Affairs has drawn up a policy blueprint. Yesterday (23rd), it announced for the first time the business selection plan for the 3-4 and 3-5 phases of block development. The companies will be selected in 2027 and 2029 respectively, and the grid connection will be for a period of four years, releasing a policy with great benefits.

title_en: Offshore wind power development 3-3 bidding with guaranteed minimum purchase price
summary_en: The selection of companies for Phase 3-3 of offshore wind power block development has started and will close on September 30. The Ministry of Economic Affairs announced the contents of the 3-3 administrative contract yesterday (23rd), including a one-year flexible grid connection mechanism. Contracting companies can apply to the Ministry of Economic Affairs to postpone the completion of grid connection for one year if certain conditions are met. The administrative contract also clearly stipulates a guaranteed purchase price of 2.29 yuan per unit to facilitate the calculation of development risks.

title_en: Legislators are calling for an increase in the employer’s retirement contribution rate. Employers’ representatives: It may increase the burden on traditional industries and small and medium-sized enterprises.
summary_en: Legislators from both the ruling and opposition parties proposed the 11th version of the "Labor Pension Regulations" to amend the law, advocating that the compulsory contribution rate for employers under the new system be increased from the current 6% to 8% to 9%.

title_en: Transcend made a huge profit of 20 billion in the first half of the year, with EPS of 46.63 yuan, a new chapter
summary_en: Memory module manufacturer Transcend (2451) yesterday (23rd) announced its second quarter after-tax net profit of 11.897 billion yuan, a single-quarter high, a quarterly increase of 46.5%, an annual increase of 2,728%, and a net profit per share of 27.7 yuan. summary_en: (Central News Agency, London, comprehensive foreign news report on the 23rd) The Iran-backed Yemeni rebel youth movement (Houthi) attacked Red Sea shipping, and US President Donald Trump threatened retaliatory strikes. Oil prices rose above US$100 per barrel today, and the stock market fell sharply. All three major European stock markets closed in the black.

title: 大同進軍日本儲能市場
summary: 大同（2371）集團衝刺能源布局，旗下大同智能扮先鋒，首度揮軍日本儲能市場，與當地夥伴合資成立SPV項目公司，首站鎖定九州建置2MW／10MWh儲能案場，並透過大同日本子公司（TOJ）帶動集團變壓器、配電盤等重電設備外銷，發揮集團效益並挹注中長期營收。

title_en: Datong enters Japanese energy storage market
summary_en: Datong (2371) Group is sprinting towards the energy layout, and its subsidiary Datong Intelligent is playing a pioneering role. It enters the Japanese energy storage market for the first time. It jointly establishes an SPV project company with local partners. The first stop is to build a 2MW/10MWh energy storage site in Kyushu. It also drives the export of the group's transformers, switchboards and other heavy electrical equipment through Datong Japan Subsidiary (TOJ), leveraging the group's efficiency and focusing on medium and long-term revenue.

title_en: 10 stocks that stand firm on the monthly chart and are pioneers in breaking through
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have recently retested the quarterly line, and the market has shown a box-shaped consolidation pattern between the monthly line and the quarterly line. As the distance between the monthly line and the quarterly line gradually gathers, it indicates that the market will usher in a key directional breakthrough. The legal person pointed out that some stocks were the first to stand firm on the monthly line and the trading volume this week was significantly larger than last week, showing strong technical patterns and having the opportunity to become the pioneers leading the market to break through upward.

summary: 立法院昨（23）日舉行「勞退新舊制相關修法」公聽會。淡江大學風險管理與保險學系副教授郝充仁認為，如果強制提高雇主提繳比例，視企業規模、員工年資而定，只要設定條件就很容易產生不公平，建議先以財政部的租稅優惠來做鼓勵。

title_en: Employer retirement contribution rate Scholar: Encourage enterprises with tax incentives
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan held a public hearing yesterday (23rd) on the "Revision of Laws Related to the Old and New Labor Retirement System". Hao Chongren, associate professor of the Department of Risk Management and Insurance at Tamkang University, believes that if the employer's contribution ratio is forced to increase, it will depend on the size of the company and the seniority of the employees. As long as conditions are set, unfairness will easily occur. He recommends using tax incentives from the Ministry of Finance as an incentive.

title: 隱匿食安事件 最重罰3,000萬
summary: 行政院會昨（23）日通過《食品安全衛生管理法》修正草案，將送立法院審議。修法針對業者隱匿、延遲通報等重大違規，最重可罰3,000萬元，為現行的十倍；若發生重大或突發食安事件，中央可成立食安指揮中心。
title_zh: 隱匿食安事件 最重罰3,000萬

title_en: Concealing food safety incident leads to maximum fine of RMB 30 million
summary_en: The Executive Yuan passed the draft amendment to the Food Safety and Hygiene Management Act yesterday (23rd) and will be sent to the Legislative Yuan for review. The revised law targets major violations such as concealment and delay in reporting by operators, with a maximum fine of 30 million yuan, ten times the current amount. If a major or unexpected food safety incident occurs, the central government can establish a food safety command center.

title_en: The new coronavirus has entered the epidemic period. Don’t just treat it as a cold. “This wave has claimed 5 lives.” If you have “these symptoms,” seek medical attention immediately!
summary_en: The new crown has entered the epidemic period! The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention stated on the 21st that the domestic COVID-19 epidemic continues to show an upward trend and has entered an epidemic period. Last week, there were 4,766 COVID-19 outpatient and emergency visits, an increase of 66.5% from the previous week. Updated from 7/14 to 7/20 with the addition of 25 local severe cases and 5 local deaths. CDC spokesperson Zeng Shuhui said that the COVID-19 epidemic should not be underestimated. According to statistics, since October last year, 161 local cases of severe COVID-19 complications have been reported, including 23 deaths. The largest number of severe cases are elderly people over 65 years old and those with chronic medical history, and 92.5% of severe cases have not received this season’s COVID-19 vaccine. The clinical manifestations of infection with the new coronavirus are mostly upper respiratory tract symptoms, including sore throat, cough, nasal congestion, runny nose, fever, fatigue, headache and muscle aches. In rare cases, temporary loss or dullness of smell or taste occurs. The CDC pointed out that the current global circulating mutant strains are mainly NB.1.8.1 (accounting for 58.76%), followed by XFG (accounting for 19.07%) and JN.1 (accounting for 15.46%). In the past four weeks, the variant strains of local cases in China have been dominated by NB.1.8.1.

title_en: Offshore wind power development adds financial support Ministry of Economic Affairs: Bank financing amount reaches 638.9 billion
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Xie Yixuan, Taipei, 23rd) The Presidential Office held the 8th committee meeting of the National Climate Change Countermeasures Committee today. Undersecretary of the Ministry of Economic Affairs Lai Jianxin said at the press conference after the meeting that the development of offshore wind power will strengthen public-to-public administrative efficiency and integrate the establishment and review of wind farms. The Executive Yuan will also have an offshore wind power task force to coordinate inter-ministerial affairs. In addition, as of the end of March this year, banks have completed contract financing for offshore wind power projects totaling NT$638.9 billion, showing that the financial industry provides financial support for wind power.

title: 30歲前明明不會這樣！小心四種「暈碳」飲食地雷 天天都在踩
summary: 不要以為健康檢查時看到「空腹血糖」正常就可以高枕無憂。英國利物浦大學（University of Liverpool）分析35萬人的基因與健康大數據的結果令人震撼：真正威脅大腦與血管健康的隱形殺手，並不是空腹血糖，而是「飯後2小時的血糖波動」。而且「飯後血糖波動幅度較大」的人，罹患血管性失智症的風險比飯後血糖穩定的人，增加約七成。此外，國際期刊《Science Advances》的一項研究也指出，假期與節慶通常是血糖最容易失控的時段。數據顯示，在聖誕節（通常都會大吃大喝）過後短短2天，受試者的平均血糖上升5.59％，而代表「一天血糖維持在健康標準區間內的時間比例」的指標（TIR）明顯變差、下降7.02％。意味在狂歡聚餐後，身體更長時間處於高血糖失控狀態，而這正是引發「暈碳」與身體慢性發炎的罪魁禍首。不只是狂歡的節慶大餐，平時的一日三餐中，也處處藏著讓人「暈碳」的飲食地雷。而這四大地雷區，幾乎每個人天天都在踩，很難避開。

title_en: It obviously won’t be like this before the age of 30! Beware of the four “carbon halo” dietary mines that you step on every day
summary_en: Don’t think that you can sit back and relax if you see that your “fasting blood sugar” is normal during a health checkup. The University of Liverpool in the UK analyzed the genetic and health big data of 350,000 people and the results are shocking: the real hidden killer that threatens the health of the brain and blood vessels is not fasting blood sugar, but "blood sugar fluctuations 2 hours after a meal." Moreover, people with "larger blood sugar fluctuations after meals" have about a 70% greater risk of developing vascular dementia than people with stable blood sugar after meals. In addition, a study in the international journal "Science Advances" also pointed out that holidays and festivals are usually the times when blood sugar is most likely to get out of control. Data show that just 2 days after Christmas (usually a day of heavy eating and drinking), the average blood sugar of the subjects increased by 5.59%, and the indicator (TIR) ​​representing "the proportion of time in a day that blood sugar is maintained within the healthy standard range" significantly worsened and dropped by 7.02%. This means that after a carnival dinner, the body will be in a state of high blood sugar and out of control for a longer period of time, which is the main culprit of "carbon halo" and chronic inflammation of the body. Not only the carnival feasts, but also the three meals a day are full of food mines that can make people "carb". And these four major minefields are stepped on by almost everyone every day and are difficult to avoid.

title: 國軍志願役寧賠錢也要「回到人間」！逾4,000人提前離營，違約金逼近10億元

title_en: Volunteers in the National Army would rather lose money than "return to the world"! More than 4,000 people left the camp early, and liquidated damages approached 1 billion yuan
summary_en: In June 2025, the Legislative Yuan passed the amendment to the "Military Personnel Benefit Ordinance" on the third reading. The revised article stipulated that the total salary of active-duty military personnel shall not be less than the minimum wage stipulated in the "Minimum Wage Law". The Ministry of National Defense explained that in conjunction with this year's military and civil education salary increase, the current monthly salary of compulsory soldiers is NT$22,000, and the overall salary after insurance exceeds NT$30,000. However, according to statistics from the Ministry of National Defense, between 110 and 114 of the Republic of China, a total of 4,267 people were required to pay compensation, with a cumulative compensation amount of 929 million yuan. Currently, 342 million yuan has been paid back, and about 589 million yuan is still unrecovered. Among them, the compensation amount for 3 people exceeded 20 million yuan. In response to the wave of early discharges from the Chinese military, statistics from the Ministry of National Defense showed that from 2010 to the end of 2014, a total of 6,315 people applied for early discharge, of which 4,267 required compensation and 3,817 had completed compensation payments. Another 594 people applied for installment payment, accounting for 14% of the number of people who should pay compensation, with the largest number of people claiming compensation of 1 million to 1.5 million yuan, a total of 92 people. In addition, three people were required to pay compensation exceeding 20 million yuan, three people were required to pay compensation between 10 million and 20 million yuan, and 10 people were required to pay compensation between 5 million and 10 million yuan. However, the Ministry of National Defense did not disclose their military service, position and rank. If we look at it yearly, the largest number of people applied for early retirement in 2013 was 1,589, of which 1,076 were required to pay compensation, with a payable amount of NT$259.55 million. Currently, 951 people have completed compensation and paid back NT$77.13 million.

title_en: There is also benzene and pyrene in the air. Peng Qiming: Additional control standards will be added this year
summary_en: As the carcinogenic oil incident spreads, Ring Group pointed out that benzenepyrene (BaP) is the most toxic member of the polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon family (PAHs). It adheres to fine suspended particles in the air. Inhaled BaP has a higher risk of cancer than the poisonous oil BaP eaten. Environment Minister Peng Qiming said yesterday that the allowable value of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in Taiwan's large industrial areas is far lower than the EU's 1 nanogram/cubic meter; however, the Ministry of Environment still attaches great importance to it and will increase the air quality control standards for benzopyrene this year.

summary_en: High-speed rail has become an important means of transportation for Chinese people to commute, do business, return home, and travel. According to Taiwan High-Speed ​​Rail statistics, the average daily transport volume in the first half of 2026 exceeded 230,000 passengers, and even during false peaks, it exceeded 300,000 passengers. In response to the continued growth in travel demand, Taiwan High Speed ​​Rail has introduced 12 sets of new-generation N700ST trains. The first train is expected to arrive in Taiwan in August and will be put into operation starting next year. After all trains are put online in 2028, the fleet will be expanded to 46 sets, and peak transportation capacity can be increased by approximately 25%.

title_en: Semiconductors, high-end packaging and testing, and servers increased production. The manufacturing production index increased by 24% year-on-year in June, increasing for 28 consecutive months.
summary_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs announced on the 23rd that the industrial production index in June was 139.44 and the manufacturing production index was 142.0, both setting new monthly highs in the past. The annual growth rates were 22.95% and 24.34% respectively, both showing positive growth trends for 28 consecutive months. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that benefiting from the investment in AI infrastructure by international technology giants, it will inject abundant momentum into China's advanced semiconductor manufacturing process, high-end packaging and testing, and server-related supply chains, supporting China's manufacturing production momentum in the second half of this year.

title_en: Tainan's "Canal Coffee Street" is expected to come true! The city government plans to invite investment to build a new waterfront landmark
summary_en: On the 100th anniversary of the opening of the Tainan Canal, relevant commemorative activities were questioned by legislators as lacking overall planning. In order to revitalize the space along the canal, the Tainan City Government launched the "Tai Yuan Shengchang Base Project", planning to develop a base of more than 2 hectares on the south bank of the canal in a low-density manner, connecting Hele Plaza, Anping Old Street, Anping Port and other attractions to create a waterfront living area that combines leisure, tourism, culture and night-time economy. City Councilor Li Qiwei believes that the canal has unique waterfront resources, but its long-term development has been fragmented and integration should be accelerated to create a representative city sightseeing highlight.

title_en: Tainan Canal Tour BOT private investment of 120 million, 2 piers will be renovated by the end of the year to add sightseeing highlights
summary_en: The Tainan Canal River Cruise Private BOT project has been launched. Private operators will invest approximately 120 million yuan to build three piers, waiting spaces, passenger service centers and related ancillary facilities in Hele Plaza, Waterscape Park and Lin Moniang Park to create a complete river cruise service system. The Tainan City Government stated that operators are currently preparing for the start of construction. It is expected to prioritize the renovation of the two piers at Hele Plaza Station and Shuijing Park Station by the end of this year, allowing the Central and Western Districts and Anping District to be the first to open to navigation. By then, the number of river cruise operators will increase from the existing one to at least two, which is expected to inject new momentum into Tainan's tourism.

summary: 34歲的科技業員工布萊恩特（Sean Anthony Bryant）某天因受不了社群媒體上的負能量，拍了一支短影音呼籲大家「既然世界已經一團糟，不如做點俏皮的事，比如去蓋個秘密基地吧！」該影片迅速爆紅，迄今累積超過400萬次觀看。在朋友鼓勵下，布萊恩特開始販售印有「再俏皮一點」（Be More Whimsy）的T恤和帽子。面對賣衣服算不算是資本主義的質疑，他大方承認這確實具有商業成分，但他認為「每個人都有保持俏皮與童心的方式」。保持童心並不代表逃避責任，而是在看清生活的無奈後，依然選擇好好過生活。對年輕世代而言，當他們試著用溫柔的眼光看待日常，生活或許不會一夕變好，但世界卻會多一些可愛。

title_en: Sending postcards, building a secret base...what is the "playful trend" that is popular among Generation Z?
summary_en: Sean Anthony Bryant, a 34-year-old technology industry employee, couldn't stand the negative energy on social media one day, so he made a short video urging everyone, "Since the world is in such a mess, why not do something playful, like build a secret base!" The video quickly became a hit and has been viewed more than 4 million times so far. Encouraged by friends, Bryant began selling T-shirts and hats with the slogan "Be More Whimsy." Faced with the question of whether selling clothes is considered capitalism, he generously admitted that it does have commercial elements, but he believed that "everyone has a way of maintaining playfulness and childlike innocence." Maintaining a childlike innocence does not mean escaping responsibility, but choosing to live a good life after seeing clearly the helplessness of life. For the younger generation, when they try to look at daily life with a gentle eye, life may not get better overnight, but the world will become more lovely.

title_en: Is the coldest winter in the bicycle industry over? Behind the daily limit of Huge and Merida, a store manager reveals the truth about the industry
summary_en: Abstract: Bicycle concept stocks such as Giant and Merida, which have been silent for a long time, have surged, and the capital market has raised their ratings. Has the industry boom reversed? The three major markets of China, Europe, and the United States are gradually recovering, driving the operations of related companies to recover. Moderate growth is expected in the second half of the year. However, industry players and analysts caution that although the bicycle industry has emerged from the coldest winter, it is not a rapid V-shaped rebound, and we should not be overly optimistic. Author: Cosmin, Merida, Guimeng, Aidia and Richi. These bicycle concept stocks that had been dormant for a long time all hit their daily limit on July 16. Does this mean that Taiwan’s bicycle industry is about to rejuvenate? Let’s start with the financial statements. In May and June this year, Huge ended 13 consecutive months of revenue decline and ushered in two consecutive months of growth. Merida’s revenue in June declined year-on-year, but its cumulative total sales in the first half of the year also increased slightly by 0.4%, marking the first positive growth in the past two years. Capital markets also raised their ratings. "Completely exceeded expectations." A Uni-President Investment Consulting analyst emphasized that Europe's recovery was due to inventory destocking, but sales in the Chinese market have continued to be sluggish since the end of 2024, but now they suddenly surged. Even a huge price increase in April did not affect buying sentiment, driving a huge 30% growth in private label business in June this year. "China" demand has reversed, and mid-to-low-end models have become the mainstay. Yongfeng Investment Consulting analyst Lin Qimei explained that the three major markets of Europe, the United States and China were not good in the past year, but now seeing the buying momentum in Europe returning, China has also stopped falling and rebounded, so she expects revenue to grow moderately in the second half of the year. title_en: More than NT$4 million in cables stolen from TSMC’s Chiayi plant; the main suspect sentenced to 4 years and August in prison
summary_en: A cable theft case occurred at the construction site of TSMC's Chiayi plant. After hearing the case, the Chiayi District Court found that a man named contractor Zhuang, together with men surnamed Xue and men surnamed Hong, committed crimes continuously from December last year to March this year. Taking advantage of their status as having free access to the construction site, they repeatedly stole cables and sold them for profit, with a total illegal gain of more than 4 million yuan. The court today sentenced Zhuang Nan to four years and eight months in prison, Xue Nan to four years and April, and Hong Nan to four years for the crime of ganging up with three or more people to steal with a weapon. The whole case can still be appealed.

title_en: As the COVID-19 epidemic heats up, Ping County Health Bureau urges people to get vaccinated to strengthen protection
summary_en: The COVID-19 epidemic continues to rise, and it is the summer vacation. There are more opportunities to travel and participate in large-scale activities. The Pingtung County Government Health Bureau reminds you to implement epidemic prevention measures when going out, including washing hands frequently, getting vaccinated, and paying attention to cough etiquette. When going to medical institutions, crowded or poorly ventilated places, and in contact with the elderly and people with low immunity, it is recommended to wear a mask on your own. If you feel unwell, you should rest at home and avoid going to work, classes, and attending parties to reduce the risk of virus transmission.

summary_en: AI has driven the technology manufacturing industry to receive orders vigorously, and the economic growth rate this year is estimated to be 10%. However, the service industry generally does not feel the dividends of high economic growth momentum and is still facing the pressure of labor shortage. The Taiwan Chain Store and Franchise Association (TCFA) held a dinner for distribution operators on the 23rd. Chairman Cai Dezhong said that labor shortage is an operating problem that the chain industry cannot escape. title_en: Ministry of National Defense: 1.25 trillion special budget has been deleted, special regulations on drones are proposed to make up for the gap in combat capabilities
summary_en: The Economic Committee of the Legislative Yuan held a public hearing on the "Special Law on Unmanned Vehicles" today. Chen Wenxing, Deputy Minister of National Defense, pointed out at the meeting that the 1.25 trillion yuan special budget proposed by the Executive Yuan at the end of last year originally included various drones and counter-drone systems, but in the end only 780 billion yuan was purchased for the U.S. military, which was unable to meet the urgent combat needs of the national army. This year's 210 billion yuan "Special Regulations on the Procurement of Autonomous Unmanned Vehicles for National Defense" is to make up for the combat capability gap caused by the deleted 1.25 trillion yuan project.

title_en: To build four 90-minute railway networks around the island, Zhuo Kui approved the high-speed railway extension of 60.6 kilometers in Yilan.

title: 301調查即將出爐？ 政院：台美溝通持續朝正面發展
summary: 美國祭出的122關稅即將在24日到期，301調查後續也尚未公布。對此，行政院發言人李慧芝今（23）日表示，目前台美之間持續保持密切溝通，雙方溝通方向也持續朝正面發展，若美方有任何宣布，我國政府將第一時間向國人說明，希望在美方最終決定關稅待遇時，能充分反映台美既有談判成果，確保我國獲得最優惠待遇，維護國家利益與產業利益。

title_en: Is the 301 investigation coming soon? Political Yuan: Taiwan-U.S. communication continues to develop positively
summary_en: The Section 122 tariff imposed by the United States is about to expire on the 24th, and the follow-up to the Section 301 investigation has not yet been announced. In this regard, Executive Yuan spokesperson Lee Hui-chi said today (23rd) that Taiwan and the United States continue to maintain close communication, and the direction of communication between the two sides continues to develop in a positive direction. If the United States makes any announcement, our government will explain it to the people as soon as possible. We hope that when the United States finally decides on tariff treatment, it will fully reflect the existing negotiation results between Taiwan and the United States, ensure that my country receives the most preferential treatment, and safeguard national and industrial interests.

summary_en: The Korean stock market rose 5.5% at noon today (23rd). Guo Xiucheng, head of the quantitative investment department of UOB Investment Trust Index and manager of UOB Korea KOSPI50 (009829), said that the Korean stock market has recently experienced violent fluctuations and technical downward revisions, and the market sentiment once fell into panic. However, according to the latest market observations, the deleveraging liquidation process for Korean retail investors and individual stock leveraged ETFs has been significantly advanced, and about 75% of the chip clearance progress has been completed. As overheated short-term leveraged funds gradually precipitate, technical pressure has been significantly released, and market fundamentals are once again playing a supporting role on the downside.

title_en: Lianjing Camellia Oil's benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard. Food and Drug Administration: More than 900 cans are still on the shelves, and 5 samples were brought back for examination
summary_en: Lianjing Green Technology Co., Ltd. reported to the New Taipei City Health Bureau last night that its "Lianjing Camellia Oil" was found to contain 2.9 ppb of benzopyrene, which is higher than the legal limit of 2ppb. The Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare pointed out that personnel from the department and the New Taipei City Health Bureau went to the Lianjing Company for inspection today and randomly inspected a total of 5 camellia oil specimens on site. The central government will be responsible for the inspection. This time, there are still 939 cans of the suspected camellia oil products on the shelves in Cotton Field and Uni-President 2 Road, and 5,024 cans were produced with the same batch number. The number of unshipped products is still being counted.

title: 黃仁勳喊AI晶片不夠用 資料中心用量是過去十倍
summary: 輝達執行長黃仁勳21日出席緯創德州新廠開幕典禮時指出，AI市場正快速成長，AI相關應用晶片供給量遠遠不足，且每年成長約25％；現在的AI資料中心所需晶片數量，至少是過去資料中心的十倍。

title_en: Jen-Hsun Huang claims that there are not enough AI chips and the data center usage is ten times that of the past
summary_en: Huida CEO Jen-Hsun Huang attended the opening ceremony of Wistron's new factory in Texas on the 21st and pointed out that the AI ​​market is growing rapidly, and the supply of AI-related application chips is far from enough, and is growing by about 25% every year; the number of chips required by current AI data centers is at least ten times that of past data centers.

title: 金融共好論壇 金管會主委提點經營方向 彭金隆：信任金融 核心策略
summary: 金管會主委彭金隆昨（22）日表示，金融機構不能只計較當年度營收與獲利，更應把如何爭取、深化社會信任，列為核心經營活動，提升到公司最高決策層級，甚至成為董事會優先討論事項，「信任金融」要從口號走進董事會。

title_en: Financial Forum for Common Good, Chairman of the Financial Supervisory Commission proposes business direction Peng Jinlong: Trust in finance core strategy
summary_en: Peng Jinlong, chairman of the Financial Supervisory Commission, said yesterday (22nd) that financial institutions should not only care about the current year's revenue and profits, but should also list how to win and deepen social trust as a core business activity, elevate it to the company's highest decision-making level, and even become a priority discussion matter for the board of directors. "Trust in finance" must move from a slogan to the board of directors.

title: 台股外資回頭 點火AI股 法人：指數大漲小回 朝月線45,360邁進
summary: 美股、韓股同漲，台股昨（22）日在外資終結連13賣、轉為買超173.4億元之下，帶動指數開高收高，終場大漲592點、收44,825點，連二漲，成交量則擴增至1.02兆元，呈現「價漲量增」的有利格局。法人預期，台股近期將大漲小回，持續朝向月線約45,360點邁進。

title_en: Foreign investors in Taiwan stocks turn back, igniting AI stocks. Legal person: Index rises sharply, retreats slightly, and moves towards the monthly line of 45,360
summary_en: U.S. stocks and Korean stocks both rose. On the 22nd, Taiwan stocks ended 13 consecutive sales and turned to buying of over 17.34 billion yuan, driving the index to open higher and close higher. It ended with a sharp rise of 592 points and closed at 44,825 points, rising for the second consecutive time. The trading volume expanded to 1.02 trillion yuan, showing a favorable pattern of "increased prices and increased volumes". Legal experts expect that Taiwan stocks will rise sharply in the near future and continue to move towards the monthly line of about 45,360 points.

title: 券商上半年大賺1,440億
summary: 臺灣證券交易所昨（22）日公布，全體證券商6月稅後淨利達265.72億元，因自營評價及承銷業務下滑，較5月減18.4%；累計前六月全體證券商稅後淨利衝達1,440.9億元，年增率高達324.5%，創下歷史新高紀錄。

title_en: Brokerage firms made huge profits of RMB 144 billion in the first half of the year
summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced yesterday (22nd) that the net profit after tax of all securities firms in June reached 26.572 billion yuan, a decrease of 18.4% from May due to the decline in self-operated evaluation and underwriting business. The cumulative net profit of all securities firms after tax in the first six months reached 144.09 billion yuan, with an annual growth rate of 324.5%, setting a new record.

summary_en: Samsung, a major mobile phone brand, held a new product launch event in London, England yesterday (22nd). In addition to new wearable devices, it also launched three new foldable phones, including the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8 and Flip8, breaking the past practice of launching two models. Among them, the flagship models Fold8 Ultra and Fold8 processors use Qualcomm processors, and TSMC has won OEM orders.

title_en: Apple i18 mass production scheduled to debut in autumn Foxconn is hiring
summary_en: According to news from the mainland supply chain, Foxconn is entering the peak recruitment period of the peak season. As Apple's new generation iPhone 18 series mobile phones entered the mass production stage in July and are currently in the process of ramping up production capacity, Foxconn has launched peak season recruitment. The new iPhone will be released this fall as usual.

summary_en: U.S. President Trump plans to impose high tariffs on generic drugs starting in August 2028. summary_en: Yin Weiying, chairperson of the Public Affairs Committee of the Generic Drug Association, said yesterday (22nd) that in response to U.S. President Trump’s plan to impose tariffs on generic drugs, it is urgent to implement “national medicines made in China and for national use”. The Ministry of Health and Welfare should invite industry representatives to a meeting as soon as possible, with the goal of protecting the resilience of Chinese people’s drug use within two years.

title: 集中市場週三資增券減，店頭市場則資券均增加

It will also introduce more advanced Vera Rubin platform-related product production in the future, creating a new milestone for Taiwan's AI industry in the United States.

title_en: 2026 Financial Common Good Forum/Financial Supervisory Commission Bank Director Tong Zhengzhang: AI finance presents the triple-A realm
summary_en: Tong Zhengzhang, Director of Banking at the Financial Supervisory Commission, said yesterday (22nd) that AI finance will present three A's, including Anywhere (anytime and anywhere), Anyone (shared by all) and Any Need (active service). The Financial Supervisory Commission is happy to see the introduction of AI in the financial industry and will use "responsible AI, trustworthy AI, and people-oriented AI" as the three core supervision cores. However, it must guard against three counter-effects such as algorithmic discrimination, digital disparity and consumer loss of voice. "Behind innovation must be responsibility and commitment."

title: 規劃「體育強國」，中國提出至2030年體育產業規模突破人民幣7兆元
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】經中國國務院批准同意，國家體育總局週三正式發布《體育強國建設「十五五」規劃》，明確提出到2030年，中國體育產業總規模將突破人民幣7兆元。這項政策為中國首個以「體育強國」為主題的國家級專項規劃，標誌著體育產業升級已正式提升至國家戰略高度。《規劃》指出，到2030年，中國體育產業的整體發展品質與效益將顯著提升，綜合價值與多元功能充分彰顯，使體育成為國家發展與社會建設的標誌性事業基礎。政策將重點推動體育消費升級，深化「體育+」跨界融合，並加快體育設施與產業鏈的數位化轉型，以激發龐大的內需市場潛能。為確保發展目標落實，《規劃》設定五項主要發展指標，包括人均體育場地面積達到約4平方公尺、經常參加體育鍛鍊的人口比例達到約40%，並大幅提升國民體質合格率與頂尖賽事綜合表現。官方預計透過優化場地供給與賽事活動，帶動體育裝備製造、戶外運動及體育旅遊等相關產業鏈快速擴張。市場分析人士指出，隨著「十五五」規劃細則逐步落地，政策利多將為運動服飾、體育器材及賽事營運等相關產業鏈帶來實質訂單與長線成長動能。

title: 升息押注升溫，美國公債週三延續跌勢，殖利率全線走高
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】美國公債價格週三在清淡交投中走低，引領殖利率上揚，因聯準會升息押注升溫。根據債券交易報價，2年期公債價格下跌，殖利率上揚3.63個基點，報4.2978%；5年期公債價格下滑，殖利率上揚3.41個基點，報4.4036%。10年期公債價格下降，殖利率上升2.64個基點，報4.6545%；30年期公債價格則是滑落，殖利率揚升1.36個基點，報5.1448%。美國公債價格週三延續跌勢，雖沒有明顯誘因，但卻顯示出市場對聯準會升息預期升溫的影響。由於美國沒有重要經濟數據公佈，且聯準會決策者在7月29日利率決議前進入慣例緘默期，交易員仍繼續押注聯準會到2027年中至少將升息兩次、每次25個基點。對於下週的利率決議，市場計入約8個基點的升息預期，相當於約三分之一的25個基點升息幅度，較上週四增加約2個基點。美國財政部續發行的130億美元20年期國債得標殖利率為5.163%，是該期限債券自2020年恢復發行以來第二高的水準，得標殖利率高於紐約時間下午1點投標截止時5.158%的發行前殖利率。

title: 漢康-KY創新藥HCB101二線結直腸癌最新數據，展現拓胃腸道腫瘤應用潛力
summary: 【財訊快報／記者何美如報導】漢康-KY創(7827)22日公布主力產品HCB101最新臨床觀察，顯示其以巨噬細胞為核心的腫瘤免疫策略逐步成形，並由既有的二線胃癌／胃食道交界癌定位，延伸至更多胃腸道腫瘤應用。HCB101透過抑制CD47–SIRPα訊號軸，恢復巨噬細胞辨識與吞噬腫瘤細胞的能力。漢康同步評估其與各類標準治療聯合使用的臨床潛力，希望建立可搭配多種治療方式的巨噬細胞免疫治療基礎。在二線結直腸癌試驗方面，目前共有11位患者可進行療效評估，最新數據顯示，有6人達部分緩解（PR），客觀緩解率（ORR）為54.5%；其餘5人為疾病穩定（SD），疾病控制率（DCR）達100%，初步數據支持HCB101拓展至更多胃腸道腫瘤的應用潛力，具指標意義，並顯示透過活化巨噬細胞，HCB101有機會與現有治療搭配使用，進一步提升腫瘤免疫反應。漢康指出，HCB101-201臨床試驗在多種二線結直腸癌聯合治療組合中，均觀察到患者腫瘤縮小。台灣醫師發起臨床研究（IIT）亦觀察到初步且持續的疾病控制訊號，其中一位患者接受HCB101治療已超過一年；另一位患者維持疾病穩定超過48週後才出現疾病進展。整體結果仍屬

title_en: CPI growth rate is estimated at 2.02% by the Chinese Academy of Economics
summary_en: The China Academy of Economics and Economics released its latest economic forecast yesterday (22nd), significantly raising this year's economic growth rate to 10.35%, the highest forecast value among major domestic economic think tanks. It also revised upward the annual growth rate of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) to 2.02%, making it the first domestic think tank forecast value to exceed the 2% inflation warning line.

summary_en: Sinosteel (2002) announced a pre-tax profit of 1.46 billion yuan in June, the highest this year; the cumulative pre-tax profit in the first half of the year was 2.33 billion yuan, turning a loss into a profit compared with a pre-tax loss of 1.56 billion yuan in the same period last year. title: AI兆元資本支出噴發 先進封測外溢的大時代
summary: 台積電在第三季最新法說會上表示，由於ＡＩ基礎設施對先進製程需求很強，宣布將今年資本支出由原本的五二○～五六○億美元上調到六○○～六四○億美元，並同步調升全年美元營收成長率到四○％以上。掃除市場對ＡＩ需求能否持續的疑慮，更確立次世代二奈米製程與先進封裝的強勁訂單能見度。台積電的資本支出在全球半導體景氣與ＡＩ產業的發展深具指標性，回顧近年台積電資本支出的變化。在二○二○年（含）以前，台積電資本支出主要因應５Ｇ智慧型手機和高效能運算（ＨＰＣ）需求所推動；二○二一到二二年進入五奈米與三奈米量產階段，此時資本支出快速攀升；二三年因全球消費性電子需求疲弱而短暫調整，但隨著生成式ＡＩ爆發，二四年半導體產業景氣重新成長，二五年至今，更因ＡＩ需求遠超市場預期而大幅提高。
