title_en: AI capital expenditures burst into trillions of dollars, leading to an era of overflow from advanced packaging and testing
summary_en: TSMC stated at its latest earnings conference in the third quarter that due to the strong demand for advanced processes in AI infrastructure, it announced that it will increase its capital expenditure this year from the original US$52-56 billion to US$60-64 billion, and simultaneously increase the annual US dollar revenue growth rate to more than 40%. It eliminates market doubts about the sustainability of AI demand and establishes strong order visibility for next-generation 2-nanometer processes and advanced packaging. TSMC’s capital expenditures are indicative of the global semiconductor boom and the development of the AI ​​industry. Let’s review the changes in TSMC’s capital expenditures in recent years. Before 2020 (inclusive), TSMC’s capital expenditures were mainly driven by the demand for 5G smartphones and high-performance computing (HPC); when it entered the 5-nanometer and 3-nanometer mass production stages from 2021 to 2022, capital expenditures at this time Rapidly rising; there was a brief adjustment in 2003 due to weak global consumer electronics demand. However, with the outbreak of generative AI, the semiconductor industry boom grew again in 2004. Since 2005, it has increased significantly because AI demand far exceeds market expectations.

title_en: Tesla launches "children's limited edition car" to steal! Scalper prices skyrocketed 221 times
summary_en: Financial Center/Li Mingrong reported that electric vehicle leader Tesla’s peripheral products have always been a hot topic. From Cybertruck whistles to tequila glasses, they have triggered frantic buying. Tesla recently launched its first two-wheeled product, the "Balance Bike for Kids." Although it has no motor, no screen, and no high-tech equipment, and even needs to be propelled by stepping on the ground with both feet, it still sold out instantly after it went on sale. What's even more exaggerated is that outrageous prices immediately appeared in the second-hand market, with the highest price reaching an astonishing US$50,000 (approximately NT$1.47 million). The sky-high scalper price is even enough to buy a brand new Model 3 car in the United States (the standard range version on the US official website starts at about US$39,000).

title: 謝金河：先蹲才能再跳！3000點大跌後的台股新旅程
summary: 上周五，台股出現狂風暴雨般大屠殺，加權指數大跌二九五三．七一，跌幅達六．四七％，這是史上最大跌點，但不是最大跌幅。史上最大跌幅發生在去年四月二日川普祭出對等關稅方案，他手上拿著手板，唸出每一個國家要被課的關稅稅率，台股正值春假，但四月七日開盤幾乎全面躺平，連台積電都跌停，加權指數下跌二○六五．八七，跌幅是九．七％，台股有漲跌幅十％的限制，也意味著幾乎全部的個股都跌停，而這種非經濟因素通常都帶來一次逢低進場的好機會。以牽動台股指數最具代表性的台積電為例，去年四月七日跌停是八四八元，八日再跌三二元，收在八一六元，九日盤中最低七八○元，收盤是七八五元，這是逢低買進的最佳買點，但置身在恐慌殺盤中，我們很容易受到外界非理性情緒影響，那時候有一個台大管理學院副教授出來喊說，台積電若跌破五○○元，魏哲家要下台負責。

title_en: Xie Jinhe: Squat first before jumping! Taiwan stock market’s new journey after 3,000-point plunge
summary_en: Last Friday, the Taiwan stock market experienced a violent carnage, with the weighted index plummeting by 2,953. On July 1, the drop reached 6. 47%, which is the largest drop in history, but it is not the largest drop. The biggest drop in history occurred when Trump introduced the reciprocal tariff plan on April 2 last year. He held a tablet in his hand and read out the tariff rates that would be imposed on each country. Taiwan stocks were on spring break, but they opened almost flat on April 7. Even TSMC fell by the limit, and the weighted index fell by 2,065. Eighty-seven, the decline is nine. 7%, Taiwan stocks have a limit of 10%, which also means that almost all stocks have dropped to the limit, and this non-economic factor usually brings a good opportunity to enter the market at a low price. Take TSMC, the most representative company that affects the Taiwan stock index, as an example. On April 7 last year, the price limit fell to 848 yuan. On the 8th, it dropped another 32 yuan to close at 816 yuan. On the 9th, the intraday low was 780 yuan, and the closing price was 785 yuan. This was a bargain buy. The best buying point, but in the midst of panic selling, we are easily affected by the irrational emotions of the outside world. At that time, an associate professor at the School of Management of National Taiwan University came out and shouted that if TSMC fell below 500 yuan, Wei Zhejia would step down and take responsibility.

title_en: How much of the world's downstream output value is choked by China's rare earths? IEA: Up to $6.5 trillion!
summary_en: Editor's note: This article was first published on July 18, 2026. The relevant market conditions are based on that time, and it is intended to share investment concepts and trends. Text/You Analysis Industry Data Center In the past, the market generally knew that the supply of rare earths was crucial to the development of automobiles, national defense, energy and other industries, but there was a lack of specific data on how much economic impact it would have. Now, the International Energy Agency (IEA) has quantified this risk for the first time. The IEA pointed out in its latest "Global Critical Minerals Outlook" that if China fully implements rare earth export controls, up to 6.5 trillion in downstream output value outside China will be exposed to supply disruption risks, of which the United States and Europe combined account for nearly half, showing that the global manufacturing industry is still highly dependent on China's supply of critical minerals. The IEA pointed out that rare earths cover 17 kinds of metals. Although the usage of a single product is not high, they are widely used in automobiles, high-tech, aviation, national defense and energy equipment, and are indispensable basic materials for modern industry. Once supply is blocked, the impact will spread downstream along the supply chain, affecting not just the mining industry, but the overall manufacturing output. In addition to rare earths, the IEA has also included graphite export controls in its risk assessment for the first time. If China fully implements graphite export restrictions, approximately US$300 billion in downstream output value outside China will face the risk of supply disruption. Graphite is an important material for electric vehicle batteries, and China currently controls more than 90% of the world’s processed graphite production.

title_en: Three riders pretended to be currency dealers and withdrew a total of 11.91 million yuan. A man from Changhua was sentenced to 5 years in prison for pretending to be a currency dealer.
summary_en: Men surnamed Chen and Yang joined the fraud group in 2023. Chen and another man surnamed Chen joined another fraud group the following year. They both served as cash withdrawal drivers and accepted instructions to withdraw a total of 11.91 million yuan from two victims in Changhua County. The Changhua District Court concluded that Chen Nan should be sentenced to 5 years in prison for committing the crime of jointly defrauding three or more people to obtain property, Yang Nan was sentenced to 1 year and 4 months in prison, and the other Chen Nan was sentenced to 2 years in prison.

title_en: Lianjing independently reported that tea oil was found to be unqualified for benzene and pyrene, and the New Taipei City Health Bureau initiated removal from the shelves.
summary_en: The New Taipei City Health Bureau received an independent notification last night from Lianjing Green Technology Co., Ltd. that the "Lianjing Tea Oil" produced by it was suspected of detecting benzopyrene at 2.9 μg/kg (standard: 2.0 μg/kg), when the industry reported the report, it immediately notified the downstream industry to remove the relevant products from the shelves for recycling. The Health Bureau and the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare went to the site for inspection today. It was found that Lianjing Company produced a total of 5024 cans (1932L) of camellia oil in this batch, including "organic camellia oil 250 mL (batch number: 26V224XW01)" sold in Cotton Field Vitality Park and "unified vitality virgin camellia oil 250" mL (batch number: 26S624XW01)" A total of 939 cans (234.75 L) were sold in Uni-President Healthy Organic Supermarket. The remaining products were not sold and were sealed.

summary_en: The public is generally unclear about the correlation between vehicle speed and traffic accident deaths and injuries. title_en: AI native defense × subscription-based content economy: a new capital market path for Taiwan’s emerging technology companies
summary_en: Global capital markets are undergoing a deep structural restructuring. In 2026, AI is no longer just a technology accelerator, but has become the core battlefield of information security attack and defense, as well as the underlying engine for digital content production and distribution. According to the latest forecast from the Information Policy Council MIC, AI information security has become the most strategically valuable information and communication growth sector in 2026. The output value of Taiwan’s information security is estimated to be NT$74.9 billion by 2027, with a compound annual growth rate of approximately 11.7%. The Asia-Pacific audio and video streaming market continues to expand at a compound annual growth rate of more than 19%, and the competitive advantage of localized AI content is further increasing. Against this background, whether "asset-light new economy enterprises" with high technological content and high subscription stickiness can smoothly enter the capital market has become a key issue in whether a country's technological strength can be fully transformed into market competitiveness.

summary_en: Ministry of Economic Affairs today (22) On the afternoon of the same day, a closed-door meeting was held with food companies on the oil food safety incident. After the meeting, Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Mingxin said that a total of 30 batches of oil products were inspected, and 19 batches were qualified and could be put on the shelves. Although there were reports of a 13% price increase and news of shortages, upstream companies have made it clear that they have not increased prices and do not plan to increase prices. title_en: 1 in 8 people have kidney disease. Doctors reveal "early warning signs". Those at high risk must undergo "1+1" testing every year
summary_en: There are almost no symptoms in the early stages of kidney disease, often causing people to miss the golden period of treatment. The Taiwan Renal Medicine Society points out that on average, 1 in every 8 adults in the country suffers from chronic kidney disease, but as many as 96% of early-stage patients do not know they are sick. Nephrologists urge that disease prevention and treatment should not wait until function worsens. People over the age of 30 should understand their kidney health through adult health examinations, and high-risk groups should receive "1+1" dual-index testing every year to detect kidney disease early.

title: 日本泡沫經濟高點的啟示 研究：市場狂熱最危險的是「相信漲勢永遠不會結束」
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導商傳媒｜責任編輯／綜合外電報導1989年12月29日，日本東京股市迎來當年度最後一個交易日，日經225指數收在38,915.87點，至今仍是日本股市歷史最高收盤紀錄，也被視為日本泡沫經濟的巔峰。隨後日本股市與房地產市場相繼反轉，經濟進入長期停滯，被稱為「失落的年代」。不過，一篇刊登於日本平台《note》的研究報告指出，若回到當時的市場環境，多數投資人其實並不認為自己正站在泡沫頂端，而是相信日本正邁向新的經濟高峰。 報告指出，1980年代末期，日本企業積極拓展海外市場，企業獲利持續成長，土地價格與金融資產同步上揚，銀行信貸充裕，日圓升值也提升國際購買力。在當時的市場氛圍下，「日本企業將持續壯大」、「東京土地具有稀缺性」、「優質企業股票長期持有終將上漲」等觀點，被視為建立在現實基礎上的合理判斷，而非盲目樂觀。 研究分析，資產價格持續上漲形成了一種自我強化循環。股價上漲帶動投資人帳面獲利增加，進一步提高投資能力；土地價格攀升則提升企業與個人的融資能力，使更多資金流入股市與房市，再次推升資產價格。在這樣的循環中，積極加碼的投資人往往持續獲利，而保守觀望者則可能

title: TCL 電子上半年營收展望亮眼，股價估值兩極引投資人關注
summary: 商傳媒｜何映辰／台北報導影音電子產品製造商 TCL Electronics（TCL 電子，SEHK:1070）近期公布了 2026 年上半年的初步未經審計營收指引，預期集團營收將達到 603 億至 657 億港元，相較去年同期成長約 10% 至 20%。此一成長展望為市場帶來討論，但分析師對於其股價估值卻呈現兩極化看法。 根據 Simply Wall St 的分析，《Simply Wall St》的內部公允價值估計顯示，TCL 電子目前的股價較其合理價值低了 30.2%。此外，其每股 14.74 港元的股價，也低於 SWS DCF 模型（一種評估公司未來現金流價值的財務模型）所估算的每股 21.12 港元未來現金流價值。若與同業平均 27.7 倍的本益比（股價是每股盈餘的幾倍，數字越高代表市場願意為其獲利支付更多金額）相比，TCL 電子目前 13.8 倍的本益比，顯得具有較好的價值。 然而，Simply Wall St 的報告也指出，TCL 電子目前的 13.8 倍本益比，相較於香港消費性耐久財產業平均的 8.9 倍，仍屬偏高。報告認為，市場未來合理公允的本益比應落在 10.7 倍。

title: 搶搭「青安2.0」末班車 5大銀行購屋貸款月增110億
summary: 現行新青安貸款(青安2.0)將於本月底屆滿，不少首購族搶搭末班車。中央銀行今天(22日)公布6月五大銀行新承做購屋貸款金額，在重劃區交屋潮帶動下，購屋貸款金額達新台幣579億，單月增加110億元，新青安占比更來到44.7%，創下半年以來新高。 包括台灣銀行、合庫、土銀、華南、一銀等5大公股行庫，新承作房貸平均利率與金額，向來被市場視為反映民眾購屋意願的「房市風向球」。 央行22日公布6月本國五大銀行新承做放款加權平均利率為2.155%，相較5月2.208%下降0.05個百分點，主要是因為各類貸款利率都下降。特別在購屋貸款中，新青安占比來到44.7%，則是創下2025年12月以來新高。由於新青安貸款利率較低，也壓低整體利率，房貸利率來至2.299%，創5個月來新低。 央行經研處行務委員劉淑敏指出，從購屋貸款當中顯示首購族群仍有需求。至於即將上路的青安3.0方案，則要觀察後續實施後，所帶來的變化。(編輯:張芯瑜)

summary_en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare announced yesterday that Zoomlion Oils and Fats will take precautionary measures to remove products from the shelves from April to June, and will release a total of 19 batches of products to be put back on the shelves. Not only did Taipei Mayor Chiang Wanan and Taichung Mayor Lu Xiuyan object, but even Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chi-mai, a member of the ruling party, also had doubts. title: 日圓跌至近40年低　專家：「高市日圓貶值」態勢明顯
summary: （中央社記者潘姿羽台北22日電）美伊衝突再起，避險情緒升溫，助長美元強勢格局，日圓貶勢洶洶，今天跌至近40年來新低，失守163日圓兌1美元關卡。中經院經濟預測顧問王儷容說明，日本基本面欠佳、美日利差仍大，以及市場所稱的「高市日圓貶值」態勢愈來愈明顯，上述3大因素影響導致日圓貶勢難止，短期看不到反轉的理由。

title: Fed警告Mythos恐成金融網攻利器，自身卻數月無法取得模型權限
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美國金融監管機構對前沿AI帶來的網路安全風險拉響警報。外電報導，美國聯準會(Fed)與財政部今年4月曾召集大型銀行執行長召開特別會議，警告Anthropic旗下Claude Mythos Preview具備極強的軟體漏洞辨識與利用能力，若落入惡意行為者手中，可能對銀行、支付系統及核心金融基礎設施構成前所未見的威脅。然而，Fed在發出警告後至少三個月，卻因採購、權限與安全審查等障礙，始終無法直接使用Mythos模型進行自身系統檢測；截至7月15日，仍在爭取取得存取權限。相較之下，部分大型銀行及科技機構已透過Anthropic的「Glasswing計畫」測試該模型，利用其尋找程式漏洞、撰寫修補程式及執行滲透測試，形成監管機構警告風險、卻缺乏同等防禦工具的落差。Anthropic在4月推出Mythos Preview時表示，這是公司目前最強的通用型程式設計與代理式AI模型，已在關鍵基礎設施與開源軟體中找出數千個此前未被發現的漏洞；公司並採取受限研究預覽模式，只向經審核的合作夥伴開放。6月擴大Glasswing計畫後，參與機構開始把Mythos用於修補漏洞、產品發布前安全檢

title: 安永發表AI審計平台 全球150國16萬件率先導入
summary: 安永會計師事務所今（22）日宣布正式在全球審計（Assurance服務）中導入企業級代理式人工智慧（Agentic AI），全面升級審計科技平台與服務模式， 從「輔助工具」進化為「智慧協作夥伴」。  這套AI能力將支援安永全球的150多個國家與地區、13 萬名審計專業人員，應用在16萬件審計業務， 估計在 2028 年逐步實現端到端的智慧審計流程。

title: 食安問題沒有藍綠  賴清德：現在是中央和地方攜手解決問題時候
summary: 身兼黨主席的總統賴清德今（22日）在民進黨中執會談話強調，食安問題，沒有藍綠，必須中央和地方依法分工合作，才能確保民眾食品安全。他說，行政院會23日（周四）將討論《食品安全衛生管理法》修正草案，及相關執行法規修訂，此次修法將從源頭管理、製程管理、異常通報、品質管理及數位管理五大面向，全面強化食品安全管理機制，進一步提升食品安全把關能力。

title: 宇樹科技創辦人估，具身智能最快2-3年迎「ChatGPT時刻」
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中國《證券時報》報導，宇樹科技創辦人兼執行長王興興週三表示，具身智能的「ChatGPT時刻」最快可望在未來兩至三年內到來，屆時機器人將不再只依賴預先編程或固定場景訓練，而能在多數陌生環境中直接理解任務並完成基本工作。這項判斷再度點燃市場對人形機器人、運動控制、感測器及AI模型融合的關注，產業焦點也正由展示性動作轉向真正可落地的通用作業能力。王興興是在7月22日於陝西西安舉行的2026年世界網際網路大會數字絲路發展論壇開幕式上作出上述表示。這場論壇由世界網際網路大會主辦、陝西省政府承辦，於7月21日至22日舉行，主題為「智匯絲路、數啟新程——攜手構建網路空間命運共同體」。他指出，過去幾年人形機器人已由基本行走，快速進步至舞蹈、功夫格鬥及簡單服務，但真正的突破點，是機器人能否進入沒有預先見過的場景，仍能自主理解環境、拆解任務並完成工作。王興興今年3月亦曾多次表示，具身智能距離關鍵臨界點大約還需兩至三年，顯示他對技術成熟時程的判斷保持一致。

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，根據相關統計數據，美國方面今年已從委內瑞拉石油銷售中收取超過130億美元收入。但六個月內，該筆資金的後續流向及使用情況缺乏透明度，引發美國兩黨議員及經濟界持續關注。自今年1月美國方面採取行動並調整對委內瑞拉的制裁政策後，美國實際控制了委內瑞拉石油出口的相關資金。石油收入約占委內瑞拉國內生產毛額的四分之一，制裁的放鬆一度被預期將為該國經濟帶來顯著提振。然而，經濟專家指出，委內瑞拉經濟復甦跡象相對溫和，官方第一季2.5%的增長率創下近五年新低，分析認為這與美方未將全部新增石油收入轉移回委內瑞拉有關。美方對該筆資金的用途表述不一。相關行政命令稱其角色為「保管」，而美國總統川普則表示美國「賺了很多錢」且已透過石油收回軍事行動成本的28倍。美國能源部稱資金將為美國人民和委內瑞拉人民利益而分配，國務院官員則表示資金雖屬委內瑞拉，但需經美方許可方可使用，並稱已有數十億美元撥付至委內瑞拉經濟，同時正進行財務監督。美方官員還表示，對石油資金的控制已被用於對現任委內瑞拉領導人施加影響。美國國會兩黨議員正施壓政府說明資金去向並防止腐敗。有議員批評行政當局在此問題上「不透明」

summary_en: Phison Electronics, a large memory manufacturer, rode on the AI wave and became a leading indicator stock among ethnic groups. The Insurance Center represented 97 investors that year and sought compensation from Phison for 6.97 Billion yuan, but a dramatic turn occurred during the recent hearing of the High Court. summary_en: The insurance center has been involved in lawsuits for nearly ten years. Recently, a high court hearing took a dramatic turn, and it is expected to have a good outcome. This lawsuit was filed by the Insurance Center, which was appointed by 97 investors in 2017. It claimed that the false financial reports of Phison Company caused the stock price to be distorted, allowing investors to enter the market and suffer losses without knowing it. For this reason, it filed a civil claim at the end of 2019, with a total amount of 6.697 billion yuan, and simultaneously filed a director dismissal lawsuit. The lawsuit also required Phison Group founder Pan Jiancheng to no longer serve as a director of the company.

title_en: Phonline’s new plan to get out of trouble 2/Selling out stocks after one year of fake accounting case, the judge reveals the key to reversing the lawsuit in one sentence
summary_en: The High Court recently reopened the civil compensation case involving Phison's false accounts that has been litigated for nearly ten years. When the judge reviewed the latest investor transaction information submitted by the Insurance Center, he discovered that some of them actually sold their stocks nearly a year after the false accounts came to light. He asked on the spot to explain the causal relationship between the losses and the false accounts, which pointed to the core legal issue of the case. As the Insurance Center re-introduced the actual damage calculation, the case that originally represented 97 investors seeking compensation of 6.97 yuan, now only 5 people, a total of 8 transactions, and a total amount of approximately 1.21 million yuan were actually recognized as losses, bringing a dramatic reversal to this high-profile compensation lawsuit.

title_en: Continuing sunny and hot afternoon thunderstorms welcome the "big heat" Wu Derong: The path of the tropical system is diverted northward, and the weather may change over the weekend
summary_en: It has been hot and hot for days. Yesterday the highest temperature in Taiwan was 37.7 degrees in Luye, Taitung. Tomorrow will be the "Great Heat" of the 24th solar term. Wu Derong, an adjunct associate professor of the Department of Atmospheric Science of Central University, said in the "Tianji Classroom" column of the "Meteorological Application Promotion Foundation" today that from today to Friday, the southwesterly wind has weakened and the moisture in the south has decreased, the Pacific high pressure has slightly strengthened, and the weather has gradually stabilized. It is sunny everywhere and hot during the day. Pay attention to sun protection and prevent heat stroke; there is still a chance of local short-lived thunderstorms in the afternoon, mainly in mountainous areas. title: 全台待售新成屋再寫新高，六都僅新北庫存減少

summary: 文化部日前宣布，為落實文化基本法每四年召開一次全國文化會議的承諾，9月舉辦「2026全國文化會議」。不過，文化基本法中有一項重要性遠勝全國文化會議的法規，迄今仍無法落實，那就是「文化影響評估」—締結國際條約及制定重大政策、法律與計畫時，若有影響文化之虞，得提出文化影響分析報告。文化基本法公告七年以來，不曾有部會針對所提的政策、法律或計畫，提出文化影響評估。

title_en: From festivals to urban regeneration, South Korea has successfully created a "cultural impact assessment" in three years. Why has Taiwan been stuck for seven years?
summary_en: The Ministry of Culture recently announced that in order to implement the Culture Basic Law’s commitment to hold a national cultural conference every four years, the “2026 National Cultural Conference” will be held in September. However, there is one regulation in the Basic Law on Culture that is far more important than the National Council on Culture and has yet to be implemented, and that is "Cultural Impact Assessment" - when concluding international treaties and formulating major policies, laws, and plans, if there is a risk of cultural impact, a cultural impact analysis report must be submitted. In the seven years since the Culture Basic Law was promulgated, no ministry has proposed a cultural impact assessment on the proposed policies, laws or plans.

title: AI造富！滙豐「卓越理財」門檻翻倍至3千萬　台灣高資產客群實力雄厚
summary: 受惠AI浪潮，台灣高資產族群財富顯著增長。滙豐（台灣）銀行看準此趨勢，宣布全面升級「卓越理財」服務，將尊尚客戶門檻由1,500萬調高至3,000萬元，對標國際資產管理標準。此次升級聚焦財富管理、環球尊榮、旅遊禮遇及健康守護四大面向，除提供客製化全球投資策略外，更推出旗艦金屬卡，享有頂級旅遊回饋及24小時全球VIP醫療網服務。此舉展現外銀深耕台灣市場決心，隨著金融圈搶富大戰升溫，透過精準客群分級與高品質的跨國理財體驗，滿足高資產客戶對財富增值與頂級生活品質的雙重追求，進一步推動台灣邁向亞洲資產管理中心目標。

title_en: Electricity and Electricity Association supports small and medium-sized enterprises to expand overseas
summary_en: The Electrical and Electronics Industry Association continues to promote the development of TEEMA Science Park. Liu Yangwei, chairman of the Electrical and Electronics Industry Association and chairman of Hon Hai, expressed yesterday (21st) that he hopes to assist Taiwanese small and medium-sized enterprises in developing overseas and match up with foreign government agencies. He said that the association set three major goals when planning the TEEMA Science Park, including that all manufacturers, large and small, can enjoy equal treatment, that the park should have a unified external window, and that the park must create an environment that Taiwanese people are familiar with in terms of food, clothing, housing, and transportation, so they don’t have to worry about adapting to life.

title: 環部鬆綁 「老碳權」可抵碳費
summary: 環境部昨（21）日公布碳費收費辦法相關修正草案，給予兩大放寬。首先，針對新入列排碳大戶的業者，在入列第一年可免繳碳費，等於有一年緩衝期；其次，開放鋼鐵、水泥等高碳洩漏風險產業可運用「老碳權」抵減碳費。

title_en: Environmental regulations are loosened and "old carbon rights" can be used to offset carbon fees
summary_en: The Ministry of Environment announced the relevant draft amendments to the carbon fee charging method yesterday (21st), granting two major relaxations. First of all, new businesses that are listed as large carbon emitters are exempt from paying carbon fees in the first year of listing, which is equivalent to a one-year buffer period; secondly, open industries such as steel and cement with high carbon leakage risks can use "old carbon rights" to offset carbon fees.

title_en: Inference market, big names are rushing to invest
summary_en: North American CSP giant Google has announced that it will develop a new chip specially designed for Gemini to improve its inference efficiency. This indicates that the main AI battlefield is rapidly shifting from model training to the inference market. Coupled with the rapid rise of AI agents, the shift is accelerating. Therefore, major giants such as Huida, Microsoft, Meta, and Amazon also continue to invest in inference-related technologies.

title_en: The third reading of Starlink terms is beneficial to the implementation of services
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the third reading of the "Starlink Clause" yesterday (21st), namely Article 36 of the "Telecommunications Management Act", which relaxes regulations on foreign shareholding ratios, nationality of chairman, etc., and hopes to introduce the Starlink service of SpaceX, the world's largest low-orbit satellite operator, to Taiwan.

title_en: AI weight, ETF odd shares are very popular
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market made a strong counterattack yesterday (21st), driven by the leadership of AI value stocks and the rebound in market confidence. It ended up rising by 1,783 points, the largest single-day increase in history. The market sentiment returned. Not only did the value stocks make a strong statement, but the odd-lot market transactions also heated up significantly, and investors actively entered the market.

summary: 經過融資籌碼大幅清洗，台股昨（21）日上演報復性反彈，大漲1,783點並創下歷史最大單日收盤漲點。不過外資仍賣超，投信與自營商買超，顯示本次反彈主要由內資承接及空頭回補推動。

title_en: Market trends/Advanced packaging, high-end PCB focus
summary_en: After a substantial cleanup of financing chips, Taiwan stocks staged a retaliatory rebound yesterday (21st), rising 1,783 points and setting the largest single-day closing point in history. However, foreign investors were still oversold, while investment trusts and proprietary traders were overbought, indicating that this rebound was mainly driven by domestic capital taking over and short covering.

title_en: Netizens and Fubon Media seize sunscreen business opportunities
summary_en: Summer vacation is the peak travel season, but the Meteorological Administration has issued special high temperature reports continuously, and e-commerce companies have also grabbed a wave of tourism and sun protection business opportunities. According to previous consumption data of PChome 24h shopping, a subsidiary of the Internet Home (8044) Group, in the face of the double attack of high temperatures and ultraviolet rays, the sales of related heat-resistant products such as "sun protection jackets, cooling wipes, and cooling sprays" and other portable cooling products have increased significantly recently, and the search volume of the "sun protection" keyword has increased by 20% compared with June.

title: 航空貨運最強旺季來了 華航、長榮航、星宇營運爆發
summary: 航空貨運爆艙，最強旺季提前報到。指標貨攬業者昨（21）日指出，目前航空貨運市場「非常旺」，8月運價還會再漲，空運貨大排長龍、訂單滿天飛，急單運價至少加價三成，客戶為搶艙位「加價也要出貨」，看好旺季動能將延伸到下季。

title_en: The strongest peak season for air cargo is here, China Airlines, EVA Air, and Xingyu operations explode
summary_en: Air cargo capacity is overflowing, so check in early during the peak season. The index cargo shipping industry pointed out yesterday (21st) that the current air cargo market is "very prosperous" and freight rates will rise again in August. There are long queues for air cargo and orders are flying all over the sky. Urgent order freight rates will be increased by at least 30%. Customers "have to ship goods at increased prices" to grab space. They are optimistic that the momentum of the peak season will extend to the next quarter.

summary_en: (Central News Agency, London, comprehensive foreign news report on the 21st) European stock markets rebounded today after falling for two consecutive trading days, mainly due to gains in the technology sector and a series of strong corporate results, which offset the continued impact of the conflict between the United States and Iran.

title_en: Air cargo enters peak season ahead of schedule, logistics supply chain profits follow
summary_en: The demand for AI servers, semiconductors, cross-border e-commerce and the back-to-school season preparations in Europe and the United States are rising simultaneously, which not only drives air cargo to enter the peak season ahead of schedule, but also brings global air freight logistics competition to a new stage. The order volume of air freight logistics can expand. In addition to airline companies such as China Airlines and EVA Air, logistics supply chain companies such as China Philippine Airlines, Jet Express, and Farglory Port are also ushering in a new era of profitability.

summary_en: United Regeneration, a major solar power company, announced yesterday (21st) that it would join hands with Sino-American Crystal to set up a solar module factory with an annual capacity of 1GW (1 billion watts) in the United States to seize the huge local power business opportunities brought by the construction wave of AI data centers in the United States. The new factory is "a sensation before it is launched". United Regeneration's existing customers alone can capture 70 to 80% of the new factory's production capacity, adding points to its performance.

title_en: Huaxinke and Yubang achieved strong profits in June
summary_en: Huaxinke (2492), a major manufacturer of passive components, and Yubang, a solid-state capacitor manufacturer, have been listed as stocks to watch. Yesterday (21st), in response to the request of the competent authorities, they announced that their net profits after tax for June were 717 million yuan and 100 million yuan respectively, both more than doubled from the same period last year. Reflecting the booming passive component market, the single-month net profits per share were 1.48 yuan and 1.13 yuan respectively.

summary_en: The FIFA World Cup has come to an end. Spain has won the championship again after 16 years, setting off a ratings boom. China Central Television (2412) yesterday (21) announced the highest number of MOD and Hami Video paid members online at the same time and the number of views during the FIFA World Cup. The number of subscriptions set a new record for the previous tournament. The number of subscriptions for the daily plan increased 4.9 times compared with the previous tournament.

title: 集邦最新報告預測 NAND 供需吃緊 2027年改善
summary: 研調機構集邦科技（TrendForce）昨（21）日發布最新報告，預期受惠於AI需求爆發推升資料存儲需求，加上大廠產出有限，今年儲存型快閃記憶體（NAND Flash）市場供應將緊缺。隨著供應商提升製程、整體供給位元增速未見放緩，供需緊繃狀況可望於2027年下半年獲得改善。

title_en: TrendForce’s latest report predicts tight NAND supply and demand to improve in 2027
summary_en: TrendForce, a research institute, released its latest report yesterday (21st). It is expected that due to the explosion of AI demand, which will boost data storage demand, and the limited output of major manufacturers, the storage flash memory (NAND Flash) market supply will be in short supply this year. As suppliers improve their manufacturing processes and the overall bit supply growth rate does not slow down, the tight supply and demand situation is expected to improve in the second half of 2027.

title_en: Jin Yiding’s performance will increase by 20% in 2026
summary_en: Benefiting from the AI ​​wave that has driven major technology manufacturers to fully operate their production capacity, and with strong demand for production line replacement and scrapping, Jin Yiding (8390) has performed well in operations. As the expanded production capacity of Xibin Plant No. 2 is gradually put in place, the proportion of high-margin scrap IC and precious metal recycling increases, and the solar panel recycling business enters the market in the second half of the year, the legal person is optimistic that Jin Yiding's performance will improve quarter by quarter this year, and the annual revenue is expected to increase by 20%.

Legal persons are optimistic that Boda's profit in the second quarter will be better than that in the first quarter, and net earnings per share in a single quarter are expected to exceed 2 yuan.

title: 集雅社打造新成長曲線
summary: 精品家電通路商集雅社（2937）看好企業空間升級與商用不動產交易熱絡，一站式購足服務擴至企業專案市場。旗下集盛電器近期完成企業廠辦整合案，隨著商辦及廠辦需求升溫，商用工程將成百貨零售外的第二條成長曲線。

title_en: Jiyashe creates a new growth curve
summary_en: Jiyashe (2937), a distributor of high-quality home appliances, is optimistic about the upgrading of corporate space and the strong commercial real estate transactions, and its one-stop shopping service has been expanded to the corporate project market. Its subsidiary Jisheng Electric has recently completed the integration of enterprise, factory and office. As the demand for commercial office and factory office heats up, commercial projects will become the second growth curve besides department store retail.

summary: 達運 （6120）採取雙軸並進經營策略，在光電本業提升營運效率、改善品質及獲利能量；新事業布局包括擴大投資與更多合作機會。

title_en: Dayun enters new biomedical business
summary_en: Dayun (6120) adopts a dual-axis business strategy to improve operating efficiency, quality and profitability in the optoelectronics industry; the new business layout includes expanded investment and more cooperation opportunities.

title: 敍豐砸4.85億購地擴廠
summary: 高階ABF載板濕製程設備商敍豐（3485）昨（21）日公告，董事會授權董事長進行不動產購置及簽約等事宜，將以約4.85億元購買華大毛紡在桃園八德區土地以擴廠。相關細節將在實際簽約後另行公告，購買土地主要是因應公司營運需求及長期之發展規劃。

title_en: Syfeng spends 485 million to purchase land and expand factory
summary_en: Xifeng (3485), a high-end ABF substrate wet process equipment supplier, announced yesterday (21st) that the board of directors authorized the chairman to purchase real estate and sign contracts, and will purchase Huada Woolen's land in Taoyuan's Bade District for approximately 485 million yuan to expand its factory. Relevant details will be announced separately after the actual signing of the contract. The purchase of land is mainly in response to the company's operational needs and long-term development planning.

title: 攸泰看好2026年下半年營運
summary: 強固電腦廠攸泰科技（6928）昨（21）日舉行法說會，展望後市，看好下半年營運優於上半年，主要成長動能來自子公司E3D，海事及衛星應用則維持持平看法。隨著E3D業績貢獻擴大，整體毛利率有望增長。

title_en: Youtai is optimistic about operations in the second half of 2026
summary_en: Strong computer manufacturer Youtai Technology (6928) held a press conference yesterday (21st). Looking forward to the market outlook, it is optimistic that operations in the second half of the year will be better than the first half of the year. The main growth momentum comes from its subsidiary E3D. It maintains a neutral view on maritime and satellite applications. As E3D's performance contribution expands, the overall gross profit margin is expected to increase.

title: Google 攻強力 AI 晶片 市場推測聯發科將受惠
summary: 外媒The Information報導，Google正開發專為旗下Gemini大型語言模型打造的新一代AI伺服器晶片「Frozen v2」，採取將部分模型架構直接固化於晶片硬體的設計，大幅提升AI推論效率，市場預估效能可望較現有張量處理器（TPU）提升六至十倍。
title_zh: Google 攻強力 AI 晶片 市場推測聯發科將受惠
summary_zh: 外媒The Information報導，Google正開發專為旗下Gemini大型語言模型打造的新一代AI伺服器晶片「Frozen v2」，採取將部分模型架構直接固化於晶片硬體的設計，大幅提升AI推論效率，市場預估效能可望較現有張量處理器（TPU）提升六至十倍。
title_en: Google is developing powerful AI chips, and the market speculates that MediaTek will benefit from it
summary_en: Foreign media The Information reported that Google is developing a new generation of AI server chip "Frozen v2" specially designed for its Gemini large language model. It adopts a design that directly solidifies part of the model architecture into the chip hardware, which greatly improves the efficiency of AI inference. The market estimates that the performance is expected to be six to ten times higher than that of the existing tensor processor (TPU).

title: CCL 四雄紅火 獲利看增
summary: AI帶動高階PCB應用，並驅動材料升級。關鍵材料銅箔基板（CCL）業者預測，近二年中高階CCL材料將持續居賣方市場，台廠四大業者台光電（2383）、台燿、聯茂以及騰輝電子-KY受惠產業趨勢，獲利看增，隨新產能開出與轉嫁成本、漲價效益，市場看好下半年獲利成長表現。

title_en: CCL’s four heroes are booming and profits are expected to increase
summary_en: AI drives high-end PCB applications and drives material upgrades. The key material copper foil substrate (CCL) industry predicts that mid-to-high-end CCL materials will continue to be in a seller's market in the past two years. Taiwan's four major manufacturers, Taiwan Optoelectronics (2383), Taiyao, Lianmao and Tenghui Electronics-KY, are benefiting from industry trends and are expected to increase profits. With the opening of new production capacity and the benefits of passing on costs and price increases, the market is optimistic about profit growth in the second half of the year.

title: PCB 廠投資熱潮助攻 相關設備廠迎收割期
summary: 兩岸PCB大廠包含臻鼎-KY（4958）、欣興、華通、金像電、滬電、東山精密、勝宏等積極布局泰國，銅箔基板（CCL）廠也積極投資東南亞。法人看好，相關系統設備商包含志聖、揚博、牧德、迅得、群翊、敍豐以及CCL設備商亞泰金屬等也獲得商機，整體設備業步入旺季收割期。

title_en: PCB factory investment boom assists related equipment factories to welcome harvest period
summary_en: Major PCB manufacturers on both sides of the Taiwan Strait include Zhending-KY (4958), Xinxing, Huatong, Jinxiang Electronics, Shanghai Electronics, Dongshan Precision, Shenghong, etc., and are actively deploying in Thailand. Copper foil substrate (CCL) factories are also actively investing in Southeast Asia. Legal persons are optimistic that related system equipment manufacturers including Zhisheng, Yangbo, Mude, Xunde, Qunyi, Xufeng and CCL equipment supplier Yatai Metal have also gained business opportunities, and the overall equipment industry has entered the peak harvest period.

title: 前彭博記者：台灣重現亞洲四小龍榮景　靠經濟脫中親美
summary: （中央社台北21日綜合外電報導）前彭博（Bloomberg News）記者何貴森撰文指出，台灣今年第1季經濟成長率達近15%，重現亞洲四小龍之一榮景。拜美國對台灣科技產品需求之賜，台灣對美出口已超越對中國出口。

title_en: Former Bloomberg reporter: Taiwan has regained its status as one of the Four Asian Tigers, relying on its economy to break away from China and embrace the United States.
summary_en: (Central News Agency, Taipei, comprehensive foreign news report on the 21st) Former Bloomberg News reporter He Guisen wrote an article stating that Taiwan’s economic growth rate reached nearly 15% in the first quarter of this year, reviving the prosperity of one of the Four Asian Tigers. Thanks to U.S. demand for Taiwan's technology products, Taiwan's exports to the U.S. have surpassed exports to China.

title: 寰聖訂單看到2027年
summary: 長園科旗下寰聖（7936）昨（21）日登錄興櫃，終場收參考價18元。展望後市，寰聖看好今年訂單需求強勁，目前在手訂單及洽談中的專案，涵蓋工商業儲能設備、半導體廠UPS電池模組等，接單能見度已經看至2027年。

title_en: Huan Sheng order to see 2027
summary_en: Huansheng (7936), a subsidiary of Changyuan Branch, registered on the counter yesterday (21st) and closed at the reference price of 18 yuan. Looking forward to the market outlook, Huan Sheng is optimistic about the strong demand for orders this year. The orders currently on hand and projects under negotiation cover industrial and commercial energy storage equipment, UPS battery modules for semiconductor factories, etc. The visibility of orders has been extended to 2027.

title: MIC：AI 加速醫療業轉型
summary: AI與大數據以前所未有的速度重塑全球健康與醫療產業格局，臺灣證券交易所與資策會產業情報研究所（MIC）於台灣創新板官網發表研究報告指出，AI技術導入使「數位健康」（院外健康管理與遠距照護）與「智慧醫療」（院內臨床診斷）邊界逐漸模糊，產業加速轉向以個人健康需求為核心的跨域整合模式。
title_zh: MIC：AI 加速醫療業轉型
summary_zh: AI與大數據以前所未有的速度重塑全球健康與醫療產業格局，臺灣證券交易所與資策會產業情報研究所（MIC）於台灣創新板官網發表研究報告指出，AI技術導入使「數位健康」（院外健康管理與遠距照護）與「智慧醫療」（院內臨床診斷）邊界逐漸模糊，產業加速轉向以個人健康需求為核心的跨域整合模式。
title_en: MIC: AI accelerates the transformation of the medical industry
summary_en: AI and big data are reshaping the global health and medical industry landscape at an unprecedented speed. The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the Institute of Industrial Intelligence (MIC) published a research report on the official website of the Taiwan Innovation Board stating that the introduction of AI technology has gradually blurred the boundaries between "digital health" (out-of-hospital health management and remote care) and "smart medicine" (in-hospital clinical diagnosis), and the industry has accelerated its shift to a cross-domain integration model centered on personal health needs.

summary: 背光模組大廠瑞儀（6176）今年辦理現金減資，昨（21）日公告減資換發股票基準日，預計8月24日換發新股票上市買賣。

title_en: Ruiyi reduces capital and issues new shares on 8/24
summary_en: Ruiyi (6176), a major backlight module manufacturer, is undergoing a cash capital reduction this year. Yesterday (21st), it announced the base date for capital reduction and stock issuance. It is expected that new stock will be exchanged and listed for trading on August 24.

title: 櫃買招手印尼企業掛牌
summary: 櫃買中心持續配合政府新南向政策，積極爭取優質外國企業來台掛牌；近日首度踏上印尼萬隆及雅加達，攜手中國信託證券總經理林佳興率領的團隊、資誠（PwC）與安侯建業（KPMG）兩大會計師事務所、建業法律事務所，為印尼台商提供上櫃掛牌最完整「一條龍」服務。

title_en: Overseas shopping beckons Indonesian companies to list
summary_en: The Overseas Purchase Center continues to cooperate with the government's New Southbound Policy and actively strives for high-quality foreign companies to list in Taiwan. Recently, it set foot in Bandung and Jakarta, Indonesia for the first time. Together with the team led by Lin Jiaxing, general manager of China Trust Securities, two major accounting firms, PwC and KPMG, and Jiangye Law Firm, it provides the most complete "one-stop" service for Taiwanese companies in Indonesia to list over the counter.

title_en: Yang Jinhua: Actors are very special, roles will appear at the right time
summary_en: Although it will be some time before the new work is released to the audience, Yang Jinhua, who is sitting in front of him, is still living a very fulfilling life. Just before the Chinese New Year, I completed more than two months of filming in Malaysia. After returning to Taiwan, I continued to work in advertising, served as a judge for the Taipei Film Awards, and flew to Los Angeles to take acting classes. The blank period she talks about is actually not blank at all, but a period of time to refill and reopen oneself. Open your body and start your performance. "Although I haven't started shooting any new films, I still feel very busy." Yang Jinhua said with a smile. During this time, she watched a lot of movies, took English classes, and also participated in acting classes arranged by Golden Horse in Los Angeles. She worked 9 to 5 every day, as if she was back in school. Although that kind of intensive absorption makes the brain capacity larger, it also brings a sense of solid satisfaction, "I feel like I have gained a lot of new things." This study trip allowed her to re-understand acting and learn more carefully how to handle the emotional details of the character in each scene. Another part of the course is about "awareness" of the body, breathing and mental state. "It's very important for actors to be aware of this." She said that actors should be aware of their body, breathing, and mental state, and they should also learn to be less tense. "When you are tight, everything is locked in a box. Performance is an artistic creation and it cannot be limited." Now she is more aware that before performing, she may need to take good care of her body. Instead of rushing into the role, let yourself relax first so that you can take on more subtle emotions. Even the way I read scripts has changed. "In the past, when choosing a script, I would start with my own character.

summary: 商傳媒｜林昭衡／綜合外電報導在美國與伊朗的軍事衝突加劇，以及葉門胡塞武裝威脅封鎖關鍵航運要道之下，國際原油價格週二應聲大漲，創下近五週以來的新高。然而，投資者在權衡地緣政治風險與強勁的企業財報後，美國股市主要指數仍錄得小幅上揚。 國際指標布蘭特原油（Brent）期貨週二收盤上漲 2.1%，達到每桶 91.01 美元；而美國西德克薩斯中間基原油（WTI Crude）期貨也同步走高 2.0%，收於每桶 84.91 美元。這是自 6 月 11 日以來，布蘭特原油首次收盤價突破 90 美元關卡。 推升油價的主因是中東地區情勢緊張。美國軍隊已連續第十晚對伊朗境內的軍事目標發動空襲，包括指揮中心、飛彈發射場、無人機設施以及防空系統。伊朗方面也展開報復，襲擊位於巴林、科威特和約旦的美國軍事設施，其中伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊宣稱攻擊了雷達系統和愛國者飛彈防禦系統。 地緣政治緊張不僅限於美伊直接衝突。葉門胡塞武裝已於週一宣布對沙烏地阿拉伯港口實施海上封鎖，並威脅將封鎖連接紅海與亞丁灣的曼德海峽（Bab el-Mandeb Strait）。曼德海峽與荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）皆為全球重要的石

title_en: The conflict in the Middle East pushed international oil prices to a five-week high, and U.S. stocks rose slightly due to multiple factors.
summary_en: Business Media | Lin Zhaoheng/Comprehensive foreign reports As the military conflict between the United States and Iran intensified, and the Yemen Houthi armed forces threatened to block key shipping routes, international crude oil prices rose sharply on Tuesday, hitting a new high in the past five weeks. However, major U.S. stock indexes still posted modest gains as investors weighed geopolitical risks against strong corporate earnings reports. International benchmark Brent crude futures closed up 2.1% at $91.01 a barrel on Tuesday, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI Crude) futures also rose 2.0% to close at $84.91 a barrel. This is the first time since June 11 that Brent crude has closed above the $90 level. The main reason for the rise in oil prices is the tense situation in the Middle East. The U.S. military has launched air strikes on military targets in Iran for the tenth consecutive night, including command centers, missile launch sites, drone facilities and air defense systems. Iran also retaliated by attacking U.S. military facilities in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed to have attacked radar systems and Patriot missile defense systems. Geopolitical tensions are not limited to direct conflict between the United States and Iran. The Yemeni Houthis announced a naval blockade of Saudi Arabian ports on Monday and threatened to block the Bab el-Mandeb Strait that connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden. title: 加密貨幣市場普遍反彈 XRP漲幅領先眾主流幣
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導昨日晚間，加密貨幣市場普遍出現顯著反彈，其中 XRP 表現尤為突出，引領了整體市場的漲勢。據《Business Upturn》報導，XRP 大漲 5.28%，價格來到 1.15 美元。 其他主要加密貨幣也隨之走揚。比特幣（Bitcoin）盤中上揚 3.82%，達到 66,339.19 美元，已穩定保持在 66,000 美元以上。以太坊（Ethereum）則上漲 4.48%，價格來到 1,923.54 美元，正逐步逼近 2,000 美元關卡。Solana 攀升 3.98% 至 78.00 美元，卡爾達諾（Cardano）上漲 3.69%，報 0.17 美元。Binance Coin（BNB）小幅走揚 0.94% 至 573.13 美元，汪汪幣（Dogecoin）也小漲 1.12%，來到 0.07 美元。不過，Avalanche 則逆勢下跌 0.15%，報 6.57 美元。 市場分析指出，這次廣泛的漲勢，顯示出市場存在普遍的買盤壓力，而非僅是零星的投機行為。

title_en: Cryptocurrency market generally rebounds, XRP gains ahead of other mainstream currencies
summary_en: Picture/This newspaper’s database Shang Media | Fang Chengye/Comprehensive foreign news reports Yesterday evening, the cryptocurrency market generally rebounded significantly, with XRP performing particularly prominently, leading the rise in the overall market. According to "Business Upturn", XRP surged 5.28% to $1.15. Other major cryptocurrencies followed suit. Bitcoin rose 3.82% intraday to $66,339.19 and has stabilized above $66,000. Ethereum rose 4.48%, with the price reaching $1,923.54, gradually approaching the $2,000 level. Solana climbed 3.98% to $78.00 and Cardano gained 3.69% to trade at $0.17. Binance Coin (BNB) edged up 0.94% to $573.13, and Dogecoin also edged up 1.12% to $0.07. However, Avalanche bucked the trend and fell 0.15% to $6.57. Market analysts pointed out that this broad rally showed widespread buying pressure in the market, rather than just sporadic speculation.

title_en: IEA: Hostilities in the Middle East increase oil supply concerns, pay close attention to market dynamics
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that as the escalation of hostilities in the Middle East has intensified concerns about the security of oil supply, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said that the agency is "closely monitoring the oil market situation." The International Energy Agency said in a statement on its official website that the market continues to benefit from a number of buffering factors, including large supplies from Persian Gulf oil-producing countries such as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. The IEA is responsible for coordinating the release of emergency oil reserves by consuming countries. The Paris-based agency estimated that Gulf crude exports, while below the peak hit in late June, were still "significantly higher" than between early March and mid-June.

title: 英特爾確認數據中心部門啟動新一輪裁員，週二股價應聲大漲8.64%

title_en: Intel confirmed that the data center department has launched a new round of layoffs, and its stock price rose 8.64% on Tuesday.
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that U.S. semiconductor giant Intel Corp's stock price rose sharply on Tuesday after the company confirmed that it will further layoffs to cut costs and adjust its key data center division. Intel (INTC US) shares closed up 8.64% on Tuesday at $105.45, with the cumulative year-to-date share price increase reaching 185.77%. Intel said it would lay off employees in its Data Center Group (DCG), but did not disclose the specific number. That extends the stock's rally this year amid signs that Intel is making progress in turning around its decline under Chief Executive Chen Liwu. Intel said in a statement that as part of the company's overall strategy to build a more focused and efficient enterprise, DCG is adjusting its organizational structure to ensure appropriate job settings and skill configurations to lay the foundation for the long-term success of the business.

title_en: U.S. KKR Real Estate Financial Trust suffered huge losses in the second quarter, raising concerns about asset quality
summary_en: Picture/This newspaper’s database Shang Media | Jianmingxin/Comprehensive foreign news reports The United States KKR Real Estate Finance Trust (KKR Real Estate Finance Trust) announced its second quarter 2026 financial report on Tuesday. The net loss expanded to US$121.8 million, and the diluted loss per share (EPS) was US$1.95. The main reason for the huge loss was the provision of loan loss provisions of up to US$119.8 million. According to the earnings report, KKR Real Estate Finance Trust had a distributable loss of $36.4 million, or $0.58 per diluted share. Compared with the same period last year, the company's net loss in the second quarter of 2025 was $35.4 million, or a diluted loss of $0.53 per share, showing a significant worsening of losses this year of nearly $86.4 million. As of June 30 of this year, KKR Real Estate Finance Trust had approximately $721.6 million in liquidity, consisting of $83.1 million in cash, $254.8 million in loan repayments held by servicers, and an undrawn revolving credit facility of $350 million. To preserve shareholder value, the company repurchased 5.7 million shares worth $38 million in the second quarter and an additional approximately 1.4 million shares worth $1.0 in July.

title_en: The auto market shifts to the "stock market" and car dealers compete for market share
summary_en: Taiwan’s new car market is experiencing structural changes. In the context of declining birthrate, slowing population growth, and high automobile penetration, the past model of relying on the new car-buying population to drive market growth has gradually become ineffective. The automobile market has shifted from an "incremental market" to an "inventory market." The focus of competition among brands has also shifted from pursuing overall sales growth to competing for market share in a limited market.

title_en: The third phase of the Qiaotou New Town urban plan passed the test. The city government: optimistic that its success will take into account both conservation and development.
summary_en: The Kaohsiung Qiaotou New Town Phase 3 urban planning case involves the issue of the preservation and disposal of 100 hectares of forest land. Pros and cons have been arguing for a long time. The case was reviewed and approved by the Urban Planning Committee of the Ministry of Interior today. The Kaohsiung City Government stated that this plan is related to the overall development and industrial layout of North Kaohsiung. The city government is optimistic about the outcome of the review. It hopes to guide the orderly entry of population and industries through improving transportation construction, public facilities and green infrastructure planning, and enhance the overall development capacity of North Kaohsiung. In the future, it will cooperate with the Land and Resources Department to promote follow-up operations, taking into account environmental conservation, industrial development and transportation construction.

title_en: He started his business by making aluminum doors and windows with a capital of 40,000 yuan. The "Father of Shower Sliding Doors" and his brothers started a business to achieve a profit of 1 billion: I have been on this road for ten years.
summary_en: Hong Tuanzhang said that traditional construction methods are time-consuming and labor-intensive, and there is currently a severe shortage of workers in the market. title: 30歲眼睛就開始壞掉？你以為的老花，其實是這樣提早報到的
summary:
全球罹患青光眼的人數持續攀升，2020年患者已超過8千萬，預估2040年將突破一億。這個被稱為視力小偷的眼疾，年齡越大，罹患風險越高。

洛桑加參表示，一些學者從營養角度切入，發現較高的維生素B9攝入量可能與降低青光眼風險有關，惟仍需後續研究進一步證實預防效果。B9其實就是葉酸，身邊有孕婦的應該都不陌生，它除了幫助胎兒健康成長，在造血、維護神經系統健康上都有功勞。菠菜、蘆筍、綠花椰菜和香菜，都能買來補充。香菜再度上榜，是因為它可以生食，營養不容易因烹調流失。真心不愛香菜也不打緊，記得炒菜時採用快炒的方式，可提高葉酸保留率。

值得一提的是，預防青光眼，常保心情愉快也有幫助，主要原因跟壓力荷爾蒙皮質醇有關。適量適時出現的皮質醇有助我們應對緊急狀況，倘若緊急變成常態，皮質醇瘋起來，連視神經都不會放過。情緒越高昂，越生氣越激動，壓力荷爾蒙越是肆無忌憚，它才不管你會不會眼壓高。一把無名火上來，智慧無明，雙眼也無明，人真的有可能氣到兩眼昏花。算了算了，不如放寬心、看開點，好好看一眼這美麗的世界，才不負老天生給我們這雙美麗的眼。

值得一提的是，預防青光眼，常保心情愉快也有幫助，主要原因跟壓力荷爾蒙皮質醇有關。適量適時出現的皮質醇有助我們應對緊急狀況，倘若緊急變成常態，皮質醇瘋起來，連視神經都不會放過。情緒越高昂，越生氣越激動，壓力荷爾蒙越是肆無忌憚，它才不管你會不會眼壓高。一把無名火上來，智慧無明，雙眼也無明，人真的有可能氣到兩眼昏花。算了算了，不如放寬心、看開點，好好看一眼這美麗的世界，才不負老天生給我們這雙美麗的眼。
title_en: Eyes start to deteriorate at the age of 30? The old lady you think is actually reporting early like this
summary_en:
The number of people suffering from glaucoma continues to rise globally. In 2020, the number of patients has exceeded 80 million, and it is estimated that it will exceed 100 million in 2040. This eye disease is known as the thief of sight. The older you are, the higher your risk of developing it.

Luosang Jiacan said that from a nutritional perspective, some scholars have found that higher vitamin B9 intake may be related to reducing the risk of glaucoma, but follow-up research is still needed to further confirm the preventive effect. B9 is actually folic acid, which should be familiar to pregnant women. In addition to helping the healthy growth of the fetus, it also plays a role in hematopoiesis and maintaining the health of the nervous system. Spinach, asparagus, broccoli and cilantro can all be bought to supplement. Coriander is on the list again because it can be eaten raw and its nutrients are not easily lost through cooking. It doesn’t matter if you really don’t like coriander. Remember to use quick frying when cooking to increase the folic acid retention rate.

It is worth mentioning that to prevent glaucoma, it is also helpful to maintain a happy mood. The main reason is related to the stress hormone cortisol. Appropriate amounts of cortisol that appear at the right time can help us cope with emergencies. If emergencies become the norm, cortisol will go crazy and even the optic nerve will not be spared. The higher your mood, the more angry and agitated you are, the more unscrupulous your stress hormones are, and they don't care whether you have high intraocular pressure. When an unknown fire comes up, the wisdom is ignorant, and the eyes are also ignorant, it is really possible for a person to be so angry that his eyesight goes blind. Forget it, let's relax, open our eyes, and take a good look at this beautiful world, so that we can live up to the beautiful eyes God gave us.

title_en: Carbon fees and charges are relaxed. New large carbon emitters are exempt from paying carbon fees in the first year, and steel and cement can use old carbon rights at a 10% discount.
summary_en: The Ministry of Environment announced a draft amendment to the carbon fee charging method on the 21st. In addition to easing the restrictions on industries with high carbon leakage risks, old carbon rights can be discounted to offset carbon fee emissions. At the same time, "new large carbon emitters" will be exempted from paying carbon fees in the first year. However, new large carbon emitters must complete the application for an independent reduction plan by the end of October of the current year to facilitate the application and payment of preferential rates the following year.

summary_en: On the 196-kilometer Changhua section of National Highway 1 south, at least three large and small vehicles including a tractor-trailer, a pickup truck and a small truck were involved in a car chase and crash this afternoon. title_en: The first case of Japanese encephalitis this year was reported in Yunlin. A 58-year-old man with blurred vision and unsteady walking was sent to the ICU. There is a pigeonhouse next to his home.
summary_en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention today announced three new confirmed cases of Japanese encephalitis in the country, two cases in Luzhu District, Taoyuan City and one case in Kouhu Township, Yunlin County. All are males. The Yunlin County Health Bureau stated that a 58-year-old man from Kouhu Township had a history of stroke. On July 2, he was obviously unsteady when walking and his eyes were wandering. After emergency treatment, he was transferred to the intensive care unit for treatment. He was tested and found to be Japanese encephalitis. He is still under treatment. There is a pigeonhouse near the case's home. Mosquito traps have been set up and mosquito vector monitoring has been strengthened.

summary_en: Jiaoxi’s most representative hot spring vegetables in summer are now on the market! The Yilan County Government has assisted the Jiaoxi Farmers' Association to organize the "Jiaoxi Hot Spring Vegetable Market and Food Farmers' Education Experience" in the hot spring vegetable production area today. It will lead tourists to use luffa and water spinach grown in hot springs as the protagonists. title_en: Taiwan’s first high-temperature micro insurance is on the road! Tainan provides free insurance for the disadvantaged, providing a compensation of NT$10,000 for hospitalization due to heat injuries
summary_en: In order to protect the disadvantaged and improve the social safety net, the Tainan City Government continues to promote micro-insurance and micro-fire inconvenience insurance. Through public-private collaboration, insurance companies and charitable organizations donate the full premium amount to provide free protection to vulnerable groups. The Social Affairs Bureau stated that as of July this year, Tainan City’s micro-insurance policies have accumulated more than 88,000 people, and the premium sponsorship amount has exceeded 11.28 million yuan. In July this year, Taiwan's first "high temperature micro-insurance" was launched to improve the protection of vulnerable groups in the face of extreme weather.

title: 食安修法邀六都與會　政院：因涉地方權責 盼合作完善制度
summary: 行政院邀集六都代表參與食安法修法會議，行政院指出，食安沒有妥協空間，此次修法因涉及地方權責，政務委員陳時中衡酌後，決定依循過去案例，邀請相關部會和六都代表與會，盼中央地方各司其職、朝野理性討論，一起完善制度。

title_en: Food safety law revision invites six cities to attend meeting: Political Yuan: Since local powers and responsibilities are involved, cooperation is expected to improve the system
summary_en: The Executive Yuan invited representatives from the six cities to participate in a meeting on the revision of the Food Safety Law. The Executive Yuan pointed out that there is no room for compromise on food safety. Since this revision of the law involves local powers and responsibilities, Councilor Chen Shizhongheng decided to follow past cases and invite relevant ministries and representatives from the six cities to attend the meeting. It is hoped that the central and local governments will perform their respective duties, and the government and the opposition parties will discuss rationally and improve the system together.

title: 中聯合格油品將重新上架？陳其邁：確認安全無虞才准
summary: 高雄市長陳其邁應邀出席行政院「食品安全衛生管理法」修法會時說，建立食安制度是優先事項，問題源頭為廠商隱匿，應加重自主通報責任與加重隱匿不報刑責；對於衛福部宣布中聯檢驗合格的19批油品及其產品可重新上架，陳說，會以民眾安全為優先，確保安全無虞才上架。

title_en: Will China United’s qualified oil products be put back on the shelves? Chen Qimai: Only make sure it is safe and sound
summary_en: When Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chi-mai was invited to attend the Executive Yuan's "Food Safety and Hygiene Management Act" revision meeting, he said that establishing a food safety system is a priority. The source of the problem is concealed by manufacturers, and the responsibilities for independent reporting should be increased and the criminal liability for concealment and failure to report should be increased. As for the Ministry of Health and Welfare's announcement that the 19 batches of oil products and their products that have passed the Zhonglian inspection can be put back on the shelves, Chen said that people's safety will be given priority and safety will be ensured before they are put on the shelves.

title: 失智、PAC病人納入長照3.0分服務 衛福部推「一生一次免費ACP」
summary: 台灣已正式邁入超高齡社會，面對高齡人口快速增加，失能、失智人口持續攀升，衛福部於2025年開始分階段推動「長照3.0 十年計畫」，除了擴大服務對象，更強化醫療與長照整合、導入智慧科技照顧、提升家庭支持，並規畫特定對象可享有「一生一次免費預立醫療照護諮商」（ACP），希望打造更完整、更具韌性的長照體系。

title_en: Dementia and PAC patients are included in long-term care 3.0-point service. The Ministry of Health and Welfare promotes "free ACP once in a lifetime"
summary_en: Taiwan has officially entered a super-aged society. In the face of the rapid increase in the elderly population and the continuous increase in the number of people with disabilities and dementia, the Ministry of Health and Welfare will begin to promote the "Long-term Care 3.0 Ten-Year Plan" in phases in 2025. In addition to expanding service targets, it will also strengthen the integration of medical and long-term care, introduce smart technology care, improve family support, and plan for specific people to enjoy "free once-in-a-lifetime advance care consultation" (ACP), hoping to create a more complete and more resilient long-term care system.

title: 因應少子化、教師荒 教育部拋公費師培新制7月底上路
summary: 因應少子女化趨勢、部分類科師資供給仍待補充，以及教育現場對多元專業師資的需求，教育部完成修正《師資培育公費助學金及分發服務辦法》，於今（21）日正式發布，並明定自7月31日施行。修法內容包括增加中央儲備公費生培育機制、提供第二次教師資格考試機會等，同時加重違約責任，未依規定服務滿3年或放棄公費資格者，須返還1.5倍公費。

title_en: In response to the declining birthrate and teacher shortage, the Ministry of Education will abandon the public-funded teacher training system and launch it at the end of July
summary_en: In response to the trend of teenage children, the supply of teachers in some subjects still needs to be supplemented, and the demand for teachers in multiple professions in the education field, the Ministry of Education has completed the revision of the "Measures for Publicly Funded Bursaries and Distribution Services for Teacher Training", which was officially released today (21st) and will be effective from July 31st. The revised law includes increasing the training mechanism for centrally reserved public-funded students, providing a second opportunity for teacher qualification examinations, etc., and also increasing the liability for breach of contract. Those who fail to serve for three years as required or give up their public-funded qualifications must return 1.5 times the public funds.

title: 斗六西市場拆除成選戰焦點 林聖爵四度鞠躬道歉：不再提拆除
summary: 雲林縣斗六市西市場拆除案大轉彎，斗六市長林聖爵日前宣布規畫拆除重建複合式商業大樓，引發攤商及地方強烈反彈，甚至掀起反拆連署，市場去留成為下屆斗六市長選戰攻防焦點。市公所今天再度召開說明會，林聖爵四度向攤商鞠躬道歉，宣布「不會再提拆除」，將朝改善活化方向規畫，利用2個月時間充分蒐集各界意見。

title_en: The demolition of Douliuxi Market has become the focus of the election campaign. Lin Shengjue bowed and apologized four times: he will not mention the demolition again.
summary_en: The West Market demolition case in Douliu City, Yunlin County has taken a U-turn. Douliu Mayor Lin Shengjue recently announced plans to demolish and rebuild a complex commercial building, triggering a strong backlash from vendors and local governments, and even launching a joint petition against the demolition. The market’s survival has become the focus of the next Douliu mayoral election campaign. The city office held another briefing today. Lin Shengjue bowed and apologized to the vendors four times, announcing that he would "not mention demolition again" and would plan for improvement and revitalization, using two months to fully collect opinions from all walks of life.

title: 輕鬆試算 銓敘部開發「公務員退休金重審後實發金額試算器」今上線
summary: 立法院去年三讀「停砍公教年金」法案後，銓敘部6月中寄發退休金重新審定函，約有18萬名退休公務員所得替代率須重新計算。但不少退休公務員收到重新審定函後看得「霧煞煞」，銓敘部今宣布，「公務人員退休所得重審後實發金額試算器」正式上線，退休人員可免於法規繁瑣算式，快速計算年改重審後「實發金額」。

title_en: Easily do the calculations. The Ministry of Civil Service’s Ministry of Civil Affairs developed the “Re-examination of Civil Servant Pension Amount Calculator” launched online today.
summary_en: After the Legislative Yuan read the bill "Suspension of Public Education Pension" for the third time last year, the Ministry of Civil Affairs sent a pension re-examination letter in mid-June. The income replacement rate of about 180,000 retired civil servants must be recalculated. However, many retired civil servants are confused after receiving the re-examination letter. The Ministry of Civil Service announced today that the "Retired Civil Servant Retirement Income Calculator for the Actual Payment Amount After Reexamination" has been officially launched. Retirees can quickly calculate the "actual payment amount" after the reexamination of the annual change without the cumbersome calculations of regulations.

title: 行政院工程會審議通過「蘇花安」東澳南澳段基本設計 力拚121年通車
summary: 「台9線蘇花安計畫-東澳南澳段」的基本設計今天經行政院公共工程委員會審議後「原則通過」，工程會主委陳金德今與地方人士進行現勘時，要求交通部依審議意見儘速完成修正，落實設計、發包及施工各階段進度控管，力拚民國121年全線通車為目標。

title_en: The Engineering Council of the Executive Yuan reviewed and approved the basic design of the Dong'ao and Nan'ao section of "Suhua'an" and strives to open to traffic in 121 years
summary_en: The basic design of the "Provincial Line 9 Suhua'an Project - Dong'ao Nan'ao Section" was "approved in principle" after deliberation by the Public Works Committee of the Executive Yuan today. During the on-site survey with local people, Chen Jinde, the chairman of the engineering committee, requested the Ministry of Transportation to complete the revision as soon as possible based on the review opinions, implement progress control at each stage of design, contracting and construction, and strive to open the entire line to traffic in the 121st year of the Republic of China.

title: 影／政院召開食安會議　蔣萬安：沒有真相、沒有上架
summary: 台北市長蔣萬安、台中市長盧秀燕和高雄市長陳其邁等人今天到行政院開會討論食安法修法事宜，三位市長在會前都受訪。蔣萬安強調，修法和究責是兩件事情，沒有真相，沒有上架。盧秀燕也希望中央趕快把這樣的風暴給結束，還人民食安，還拿出賴清德總統擔任市長時的談話打臉執政黨。陳其邁則表示，制度是一個比較重要要優先要來釐清的一個問題。

title_en: Movie/The Political Yuan held a food safety meeting Jiang Wanan: There is no truth and it is not on the shelves
summary_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wanan, Taichung Mayor Lu Xiuyan, and Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chi-mai attended a meeting at the Executive Yuan today to discuss the revision of the food safety law. All three mayors were interviewed before the meeting. Jiang Wanan emphasized that amending the law and holding people accountable are two different things. There is no truth and no publicity. Lu Xiuyan also hopes that the central government will end this storm as soon as possible and restore food security to the people. She also used President Lai Qingde's remarks when he was mayor to slap the ruling party in the face. Chen Qimai said that the system is a more important issue that needs to be clarified as a priority.

title: 土城樹林線拚提前一年完工 侯友宜要求2030年達標
summary: 新北市長侯友宜今傍晚前往視察捷運土城樹林線CQ890樹林段工程，他指出，土城樹林線不只是軌道建設，也牽動樹林、土城周邊產業與大型開發，捷運局原訂2031年完工，但他要求工程團隊朝2030年完成目標努力，「一定要如期，而且更要提早完工」。

title_en: The Tucheng forest line construction was completed one year ahead of schedule. Hou Youyi requires that the standard be reached by 2030.
summary_en: New Taipei City Mayor Hou Youyi went to inspect the CQ890 forest section project of the MRT Tucheng Shulin Line this evening. He pointed out that the Tucheng Shulin Line is not only track construction, but also affects the surrounding industries and large-scale development of the woods and Tucheng. The MRT Bureau was originally scheduled to be completed in 2031, but he asked the engineering team to work hard towards the 2030 completion target. "It must be completed as scheduled, and it must be completed early."

title: 快訊／勞動部開放碼頭技術工聘用外勞　起薪39K、僑生可達兩成
summary: 勞動部因應國內近年少子化與高齡化趨勢造成的港區第一線勞動力短缺問題，今年首度針對商港碼頭與貨櫃集散站之核心技術崗位，開放引進外國技術人力，本月開始接受上網申請，今(21)日下午在高雄市立圖書總館召開說明會，外籍技術工起薪3.9萬元，僱用僑生可達勞保勞工數兩成，其餘符合特定學校經歷及技術人員資格的外國人則限一成。 《詳全文...》

title: 「券商史上最重」踩了10大業務 台新證系統出包錯帳20億元罰360萬元
summary: 台新證系統一個月出包三次，牽涉9321筆、錯帳20億元，金管會今（21）日開罰了。金管會表示，台新證「重大資安缺失，重傷投資人對金融機構信任」為由，處以360萬元罰金，他證實此為「券商史上最重金額」，同時也將要求增資並限制台新證後增據點等6項業務。之前證交所已先開罰331萬元違約金等。

title_en: "The worst in the history of a securities firm" trampled on 10 major businesses. Taishin Securities issued an incorrect account of NT$2 billion and was fined NT$3.6 million.
summary_en: The Taishin Certificate System issued packages three times a month, involving 9,321 transactions and NT$2 billion in wrong accounts. The Financial Supervisory Commission issued a fine today (21st). The Financial Supervisory Commission stated that Taishin Securities was fined 3.6 million yuan on the grounds that it had "significant information security deficiencies that seriously damaged investors' trust in financial institutions." He confirmed that this was "the heaviest amount in the history of a securities firm." It would also require capital increases and restrict six businesses including Taishin Securities' subsequent expansion of branches. The stock exchange had previously imposed a penalty of 3.31 million yuan in liquidated damages.

title: 台新證券系統頻出錯遭罰360萬　金管會限期提改善方案
summary: （中央社記者蘇思云、曾仁凱台北21日電）金管會今天表示，台新證券今年4月6日合併元富證券後，短時間內連續發生電子交易系統異常，顯示台新證券未落實內控，祭出警告並開罰新台幣360萬元，創下券商歷年最高裁罰金額，並要求增加資本計提、3個月限制業務，同時要求台新證券全面檢討缺失並在3個月內提出具體短、中、長期系統改善方案。

title: HOYA BIT AI金寶登上AWS Summit Taipei 彭云嫻分享AI Agent落地實戰
summary: AI是全球各產業爭相發展的方向，與全球趨勢同步，HOYA BIT今年推出台灣首個可透過自然語言完成虛擬資產交易的AI Agent「AI 金寶」，大幅降低數位資產使用門檻。HOYA BIT因此受邀登上AWS Summit Taipei千人舞台，由創辦人彭云嫻帶領著團隊，分享如何運用Amazon Bedrock AgentCore建立兼具安全治理、權限控管與可擴展能力的AI Agent基礎架構，協助企業從單一AI應用邁向可持續發展的多Agent生態。

title_en: HOYA BIT AI Jinbao appeared on AWS Summit Taipei, Peng Yunxian shared the actual implementation of AI Agent
summary_en: AI is the direction that various industries around the world are competing for development. In sync with global trends, HOYA BIT launched Taiwan's first AI Agent "AI Jinbao" this year that can complete virtual asset transactions through natural language, significantly lowering the threshold for using digital assets. Therefore, HOYA BIT was invited to the thousand-person stage of AWS Summit Taipei. Founder Peng Yunxian led the team to share how to use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to build an AI Agent infrastructure with security governance, permission control, and scalability, helping enterprises move from a single AI application to a sustainable multi-Agent ecosystem.

title: 00662首次追加募集獲准！新增200億元額度 待央行點頭
summary: [Newtalk新聞] 追蹤 NASDAQ-100 指數的被動式海外股票 ETF——富邦 NASDAQ（00662）規模突破千億元後，市場關注度持續升溫。富邦投信今（21）日表示，00662 首次追加募集案已獲主管機關核准，新增募集額度將開放申購，有助提升基金募集規模及市場交易供給，回應投資人布局美國大型科技股的需求。 根據富邦投信公告，00662 首次追加募集總金額為新台幣 200 億元，追加發行受益權單位共 10 億個；累計最高募集總金額將提高至新台幣 400 億元，淨發行受益權單位總數增至 20 億個。不過，本次追加募集仍有待中央銀行同意後始得辦理，實際募集日期將於取得央行同意函後另行公告。 富邦投信也指出，配合追加募集作業，00662 原訂分割時程將同步調整，相關日期將另行公告，實際時程仍以富邦投信官網公告為準。 展望後市，富邦 NASDAQ ETF 經理人王辰方表示，目前 S&P 500 與 NASDAQ 指數成分股中，站上年線、季線的比重尚未明顯惡化，顯示市場廣度仍維持穩健，美股中長期格局依舊偏多。近期盤勢主要反映漲多後的籌碼整理及類股輪動，並非企業基本面出現全面性反轉。

title: 阿聯酋批准62億美元天然氣開發項目，支撐長期出口戰略
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，阿聯酋阿布達比國家石油公司(ADNOC)週二宣佈，將投資62億美元開發烏姆沙伊夫氣頂(Umm Shaif Gas Cap)大型海上油氣田，此舉是其擴大天然氣產量、增加液化天然氣出口戰略的一部分。荷姆茲海峽承擔著全球約20%的液化天然氣運輸貿易，該航道此前接連出現運輸受阻情況，凸顯出此開發專案的重要性，也暴露出全球能源供應體系的脆弱性。烏姆沙伊夫油氣田是阿布達比營運時間最久的海上油氣田，本次開發專案將由道達爾能源、埃尼集團與中國石油天然氣集團聯合參與推動。阿布達比國家石油公司表示，該油田每天可開採超過6億標準立方英尺的天然氣及相關氣液，相當於阿聯酋當前日天然氣消耗量的近10%。預計生產將於2030年啟動。這一投資正值阿聯酋尋求實現天然氣儲量的商業化，同時加強國內能源安全，並鞏固其在全球液化天然氣市場中的地位。該國擁有全球第七大已探明天然氣儲量，此外每日石油產量超過400萬桶。阿聯酋今年稍早時退出了石油輸出國組織(OPEC)，現在不再設產量上限。阿布達比希望到明年實現日產量超過500萬桶的目標。

title: 中國風光大基地規模冠全球，特高壓輸電仍逾四成仰賴燃煤

title: 英國5月失業率持穩4.9%、工資增長率連三月維持3.4%，雙雙符合預期
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，英國5月份失業率持穩，工資增長不變，強化央行按兵不動的預期。英國國家統計局週二公佈的數據顯示，截至5月的三個月內，英國失業率為4.9%，與截至4月的三個月持平，表現也符合經濟專家預期。這段期間剔除獎金的年度工資增長率維持在3.4%，連續第三個月保持不變，表現同樣符合預期，表明企業成本壓力趨於穩定。經濟專家表示，數據顯示勞動力市場仍然脆弱，伊朗戰爭帶來的經濟不確定性持續抑制企業招聘意願。這項勞動力數據強化了市場對英國央行下週貨幣政策會議維持利率不變的預期。儘管決策層此前警告若伊朗衝突推高的能源價格開始向更廣泛通膨傳導將作出回應，但勞動力市場降溫顯示國內需求疲軟，限制了企業提價空間。英國央行貝利上週表示，中東局勢雖仍不穩定，但能源價格上漲對英國通膨的傳導效應迄今有限，相關證據持續偏弱。資料顯示，5月消費者價格指數意外持穩於2.8%，低於預期。定於本週三公佈的6月通膨數據預計將顯示通膨進一步回落。分析人士同時提醒，中東衝突升級可能進一步抑制招聘和商業信心，拖累勞動力市場，同時維持能源價格高水位，增加通膨較決策層預期更為持久的風險。

title: Signal Group週報顯示，荷姆茲海峽附近油輪數量超過700艘
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，根據海事分析機構Signal Group的報告，截至7月15日，荷姆茲海峽週邊共有728艘空載和滿載油輪，其中空載油輪394艘，滿載油輪334艘。Signal Group資深市場分析師Maria Bertzeletou在週報中指出，波斯灣水域共有168艘空載油輪和175艘滿載油輪。而在荷姆茲海峽以東的阿曼灣，共有226艘空載油輪和159艘滿載油輪。在所有空載油輪中，有115艘是超大型原油運輸船，每艘可裝載約200萬桶原油。46艘是蘇伊士型油輪，每艘約可裝載100萬桶原油。75艘是阿芙拉型油輪，每艘可裝載約75萬桶原油。自7月6日緊張局勢再次升級以來，穿越荷姆茲海峽、所有權訊息透明的油輪比重已降至45%，而在臨時和平協議期間這一比例為67%。

title: 中國傳考慮收緊AI模型和晶片技術出口管制，限制模型權重下載
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電引述英國金融時報的報導指出，參與討論的人士透露，中國監管機構正在考慮收緊對AI和半導體技術的出口管制。中國商務部已與阿里巴巴、字節跳動和智譜等AI公司討論，限制用於模型訓練的關鍵數據轉移至海外，以及限制外國用戶下載模型權重。不過，中國仍將允許海外客戶取得這些模型和服務。同時，商務部也徵詢各方對潛在限制舉措的意見，這些舉措將禁止高通及台積電等海外晶片製造商，依據華為、阿里巴巴及字節跳動等業者研發的設計生產先進半導體。上述人士表示，大多數提案仍在討論中。監管機構正在評估業界回饋意見，然後再做出最終決定。對於上述消息，中國商務部、字節跳動、阿里巴巴、智譜和華為均未回應置評請求。

title: 以為買房自住就有優惠？地稅局揭首購族最常漏掉這細節 1.2%稅率飛了
summary: 不少民眾買下人生第一間房屋，全家搬進新家後，以為只要實際自住，就能適用房屋稅自住優惠稅率，直到收到房屋稅單才發現，仍是按非自住用稅率課徵。台中稅務局解釋，自住用房屋除了符合居住用途外，還必須完成設籍並提出申請，才能適用優惠稅率。

title: 美國信貸申請衝五年新高 消費者借貸需求不減反增
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導根據紐約聯邦儲備銀行（Federal Reserve Bank of New York）發布的消費者預期信貸取得調查，美國消費者在今年六月申請新信貸的速度，達到近五年來最快。此申請率是自 2021 年 10 月以來所見的最高水準，顯示市場對信貸的需求持續強勁。 調查結果指出，即使借貸成本相對較高，美國消費者仍積極尋求各類借貸，包括信用卡、汽車貸款、房屋貸款以及提高信用額度。聯準會（Federal Reserve）預計，未來一年將升息 75 個基點，這將持續影響整體的借貸成本。 與今年二月相比，消費者申請新信用卡、汽車貸款、提高信用卡額度或房屋抵押貸款再融資的可能性略有下降，但申請房屋貸款的意願則略微上升。這反映了不同借貸產品的需求變化。 報告也揭示了部分消費者面臨的財務壓力。有 34% 的受訪者表示，他們至少有可能無法拿出 2,000 美元（約新台幣 6.5 萬元）來應對突發開銷。雖然這一比例略高於二月，但已低於去年六月調查時的 36%。紐約聯邦儲備銀行定期進行這項調查，以追蹤消費者的借貸行為、信貸可近性及整體金融狀況。

title: 高盛拆解Fed五大工作小組，華許借AI通縮推動降息恐難獲FOMC支持

title_en: United Newspapers won four Golden Tripod Awards, and the book "Reminiscences of Lost Time" set a record by winning two translation awards.
summary_en: The Ministry of Culture announced the winners of the 50th Golden Tripod Award on the 20th. Chen Yuhang, a senior publisher, editor, and writer, won the Special Contribution Award. United Daily News: "Let go of the myth of warm body meat" "The Last Bite of Tenderness for Pigs" won the Digital Content Award in the Digital Publishing category, while Lianjing Publishing Company won the Book Illustration Award for "Canopy Shyness" by Zhuo Peixin; and "Reminiscences of Lost Time 2: Under the Shadow of Flowers" translated by Chen Wenyao and "Reminiscences of Lost Time 3: Beyond Guermantes" won two book translation awards. Two translators from the same set of books won the award, marking a pioneering achievement in the history of publishing in Taiwan.

Following the Ford Mustang's immediate price in April, with the automaker bearing the import tariffs, Jeep's first batch of vehicles returning to Taiwan will be delivered at the end of July. Even though American cars still cannot enjoy zero tariffs, the general agent, original factory and dealers have reached a consensus that they will jointly bear a tariff of about 300,000 yuan. Car owners who have confirmed delivery of their vehicles will be able to deliver their vehicles at the zero-tariff price announced at the end of last year.

title: 美伊衝突金價反跌 市場關注油價與利率影響
summary: 商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導J. Rotbart & Co. 近期發布市場分析指出，在美國與伊朗衝突升溫的背景下，現貨黃金價格在上週（截至 7 月 17 日）卻逆勢下跌約 2.6%，盤中一度跌破每盎司 4,000 美元關卡，創下自 7 月 1 日以來的最低點。 該分析解釋，戰爭並不會自動推升黃金價格，市場會同時權衡多重因素。上週，原油價格大漲約 16%，加劇了通膨預期，進而提升市場對美國升息的預期。根據 CME FedWatch 的數據，市場目前預期美國在 9 月升息的可能性約為 58%。由於黃金本身不孳息，升息環境會增加持有黃金的機會成本，使投資人更傾向將資金轉往其他資產，這股力量抵銷了地緣政治緊張帶來的避險需求。 J. Rotbart & Co. 創辦人 Joshua Rotbart 表示：「戰爭從未自動推升黃金，市場權衡各種力量。本週，油價上漲對通膨和利率的影響，超越了尋求避險的本能。這是正常的市場行為，並非代表黃金已失去其防禦性作用。」 觀察亞洲實體黃金市場，新加坡的金價相較全球現貨價介於折價 1 美元至溢價 2 美元之間，香港則介於折價 1 美元至溢價 1.70 美元。這種狹

title: Netflix股價大跌近五成 再度發債籌資償債
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導串流媒體巨頭 Netflix 在股價過去一年大跌約 46% 後，再度重返美國投資級債券市場發行新債券。此舉是該公司自兩年前首次發債以來，再次進入市場。 根據《TradingView》報導，Netflix 此次發債的主要目的為償還年底將到期的約 10 億美元債務，並支應其他公司營運開銷。回顧 2024 年，Netflix 首次發行投資級債券時，成功募得 18 億美元，當時市場需求遠超發行量的十倍之多。 然而，這次發債的背景與上次明顯不同。此次行動發生在 Netflix 未能成功收購媒體公司華納兄弟探索（Warner Bros. Discovery）之後，且面臨市場對其成長放緩的預期。這些因素都可能影響投資者對其新債券的態度。 目前 Netflix 正在發售 2036 年到期的基準規模票據，初步議定的發行利率約較美國公債高出 0.95 個百分點。此外，該公司另一批 2056 年到期的債券，週一盤中價格約為面值的 92.94 美分，創下一年來的盤中新低點。

title: 高盛稱中國7月政治局會議有望再出招，寬鬆政策預期升溫提振市場
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，高盛集團方面表示，7月將召開的中共中央政治局會議可能釋放更強的寬鬆信號，因為當前經濟背景「在某些方面」與2024年年中，即大規模刺激方案推出前的情形類似。高盛經濟專家閃輝週一在一份研究報告中寫道，相似之處包括經濟成長動能放緩、消費和投資走弱、股市表現不佳，以及地方政府融資壓力導致更積極的稅收徵管。閃輝表示，目前最可能採取的路徑是加快現有財政資源投放，包括8,000億元人民幣政策性金融工具和剩餘政府債券額度。如有需要，未來還可能增加資源。高盛方面指稱，主要風險包括中央政府層面可能存在自滿情緒，在明年中共黨代會前政治人事調整期間，地方層面的執行力可能受到制約。閃輝表示，地緣政治緊張局勢和中美競爭可能促使決策者繼續聚焦安全和科技進步，而較高的政府債務和財政赤字令當局不願進行大規模財政擴張。

title_en: The "old carbon rights" approved by the Ministry of Environment more than ten years ago are valid until 2028. Use them quickly.
summary_en: The "old carbon rights" approved by the Ministry of Environment more than ten years ago are not as rigorous as today's scientific methods. The Ministry of Environment has set a "storage period". The old carbon rights can only be used to offset the carbon fee in the first three years before the carbon fee is put on the road. In other words, the shelf life is two years from the end, and can only be used until the carbon fee is paid in May 2028. Use it quickly. It is expected that companies such as TSMC and Sinosteel that hold old carbon rights will try their best to make the best use of them.

summary_en: In order to help sustainable information assurance agencies keep abreast of the latest system developments and improve the professional efficiency of assurance practices, the stock exchange and the OTC Exchange recently jointly held two "Sustainable Information Assurance Agency Promotion and Exchange Meetings" in Taipei and Taichung, inviting accredited accounting firms and inspection agencies to participate, to enhance their understanding of sustainable information disclosure standards and assurance systems, and to deepen the exchange of practical experience.

title_en: RMB 100 million profit is expected to bottom out and rebound
summary_en: The largest FIFA World Cup in history has officially come to an end. Major shoe manufacturer Laiyi-KY (6890) has benefited from the start of shipments of new shoes, as well as the gradual recovery of production capacity deployment and capacity utilization. title_en: In response to Japanese companies suspending production of high-purity tungsten hexafluoride, TSMC: Diversified supply of special gases will not be affected
summary_en: It has recently been reported in the market that Central Glass, a Japanese special gas supplier that supplies gases to major semiconductor manufacturers such as TSMC, will stop production of high-purity tungsten hexafluoride (WF6) due to a shortage of materials in the mainland. In this regard, TSMC stated yesterday (20th) that it currently does not expect to have an impact on the company's operations.

title_en: Sinosteel and Yehui seize Australian Olympic infrastructure business opportunities; Taiwan chain is expected to welcome a surge in orders
summary_en: Sinosteel joins hands with Yehui, a subsidiary of Yilian Group, to seize the business opportunities of the 2032 Olympics. Australia has recently released trillion-dollar Olympic infrastructure business opportunities, among which the core venues and infrastructure steel structure upgrade opportunities amount to A$7.1 billion (approximately NT$160 billion) in the construction pie. With the support of China Steel, Yehui recently led a delegation to Australia to win orders. It is reported that a preliminary consensus has been reached, and the Taiwan chain will have a great opportunity to welcome the surge in orders.

title_en: A grain of rice connects sustainability. Shin Kong Conservation and Shin Kong Life Charitable Foundation relay to protect the land and ocean.
summary_en: Witnessed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Shin Kong Insurance and Shin Kong Life Charitable Foundation work together to promote sustainable recycling actions, linking years of investment in land and ocean, from organic rice cultivation, charity donations to the reuse of agricultural surplus materials, and further extending to coral restoration and ocean conservation, allowing the value of a grain of rice to extend from land to ocean.

title: 中東局勢再升溫 伊朗與美國衝突油價飆升衝擊全球股債市
summary: 商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導中東地區緊張局勢升溫，加劇了石油市場的波動性，導致全球股、債市普遍下跌。美國總統川普誓言，伊朗必須為近期導致三名美國士兵喪生的事件「付出代價」，儘管調停方提出了新的停戰協議，但地緣政治衝突的疑慮仍主導市場氛圍。 根據《The Edge Malaysia》報導，葉門境內獲伊朗支持的青年運動（Houthi militants）威脅將封鎖紅海，沙烏地阿拉伯航運安全面臨挑戰，使中東地區的緊張情勢持續升高。原油價格因此受地緣政治風險推動，每桶結算價逼近 83 美元，高漲的能源成本也引發市場對通膨上升的擔憂，進而打擊債券市場。其中，英國公債（Gilts）在英國新任首相安迪·伯納姆的財政方針讓投資者感到不安後，價格應聲下跌。 資深策略師路易斯·納維利爾（Louis Navellier）指出，伊朗情勢持續擾亂市場，抑制了強勁獲利趨勢本應帶來的股價上漲。The Sevens Report 創辦人 Tom Essaye 也表示，若要股市反彈，除了期待本週主要科技巨頭能繳出亮眼財報外，伊朗局勢的緩和將會是關鍵。 高盛（Goldman Sachs）的 Prime Services 部門

title_en: The situation in the Middle East is heating up again. The conflict between Iran and the United States has caused oil prices to surge and hit the global stock and bond markets.
summary_en: Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei reported that rising tensions in the Middle East have intensified the volatility of the oil market, leading to a general decline in global stock and bond markets. U.S. President Donald Trump has vowed that Iran must "pay a price" for recent incidents that resulted in the deaths of three U.S. soldiers, as concerns over geopolitical conflict still dominate the market despite mediators proposing a new truce. According to a report by "The Edge Malaysia", the Iran-backed youth movement (Houthi militants) in Yemen threatened to block the Red Sea, and Saudi Arabia's shipping security faced challenges, causing tensions in the Middle East to continue to rise. As a result, crude oil prices were driven by geopolitical risks, with settlement prices approaching $83 per barrel, and rising energy costs also triggered concerns about rising inflation, which in turn hit the bond market. Among them, the price of British government bonds (GILTS) fell after new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham's fiscal policy made investors uneasy. Senior strategist Louis Navellier pointed out that the situation in Iran continues to disrupt the market, inhibiting the rise in stock prices that should have been brought about by the strong profit trend. Tom Essaye, founder of The Sevens Report, also said that if the stock market is to rebound, in addition to looking forward to eye-catching financial reports from major technology giants this week, the easing of the situation in Iran will be key. Goldman Sachs’ Prime Services unit
