title_en: The Fed's hawkish expectations add to tensions in the Middle East, and the U.S. dollar strongly suppresses the European, British, Canadian, and Japanese yen.
summary_en: Chart/Schematic Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei Report Market expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) will adopt a more hawkish monetary policy, as well as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East boosting demand for safe havens, prompted the U.S. dollar index to rise strongly on Monday (20th). This trend has put pressure on major currencies such as the euro, pound, and Canadian dollar, and the yen exchange rate is closer to multi-decade lows. The U.S. dollar strengthened and government bond yields rose. The U.S. dollar index briefly rose to 100.90 to around 101.00 during intraday trading on Monday. U.S. Treasury bond yields have also climbed, with the 2-year bond yield exceeding 4.22% and the 10-year bond yield approaching 4.60%. Analysts pointed out that bond traders were worried that rising oil prices might once again trigger inflationary pressures, so they sold government bonds, causing yields to rise. Oil prices have rebounded to month highs since the resumption of the U.S.-Iran conflict in early July, highlighting the risk of energy-driven inflation. The turmoil in the Middle East is also the main reason for the increase in safe-haven demand for the US dollar. According to Reuters, the Houthis have imposed a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia. In addition, the United States continues to carry out air strikes on Iran. Bloomberg reported that the United States has launched strikes on Iran for the ninth consecutive night. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned that the Strait of Hormuz (Strait of Hormuz) will no longer be safe for the transportation of petrochemical products. These factors have aggravated market nervousness and caused funds to flow to relatively safe U.S. dollar assets. Europe, Britain, Canada and the Japanese yen are under pressure due to the strength of the US dollar

title: 中東戰火凸顯星國中小企現金流風險

title_en: The war in the Middle East highlights the cash flow risks of small and medium-sized enterprises in Singapore
summary_en: Picture / Our database Business Media | Lin Zhaoheng / Comprehensive foreign news reports With the turmoil in the Middle East and the impact on the global supply chain, many small and medium-sized enterprises in Singapore are facing the risk of sharp reduction in profit margins due to rising costs and tight cash flow. Andrew Lim, CEO of Singapore's United Overseas Insurance Ltd., said that amid geopolitical uncertainty and continued disruption to the business environment, many small and medium-sized enterprises will feel rising logistics costs, weakening customer demand, and pressure on cash flow. In particular, the war in Iran (note: part of the war in the Middle East) has pushed up oil prices, energy and freight costs, and disrupted supply chains. title_en: Canada’s core inflation indicator averaged 1.85% in June, falling below 2% for the first time in six years.
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that newly released data showed that Canada’s inflation slowed more than expected in June due to a fall in gasoline prices, with a key indicator of core inflation falling below 2% for the first time in nearly six years. Data released by Statistics Canada on Monday showed that the consumer price index rose 2.8% in June. This figure is lower than the 3.2% reached in May, the highest level in more than two years, and also lower than the 2.9% expected by economic experts. The Bank of Canada's preferred core inflation measure, the average of the median and censored measures, was at 1.85%, the lowest level since September 2020 and the first time it fell below 2% in nearly six years. The lower-than-expected inflation report is further evidence that the inflationary impact of the Iran war has yet to spread beyond the energy sector. The Bank of Canada has warned it may have to raise interest rates if higher energy costs push up other prices, but lower core inflation suggests economic weakness is offsetting price pressures from the war. This data shows that gasoline prices in June were still up 20.5% compared with the same period last year, but lower than the 33.2% increase in May.

title_en: U.S. leading economic indicators fell 0.2% month-on-month in June, a larger-than-expected decline
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that newly released data showed that the U.S. leading indicators fell more than expected by economic experts in June. Data released by the Conference Board on Monday showed that U.S. leading economic indicators fell 0.2% in June from the previous month. In May, the indicator rose 0.1%. The median estimate of the 11 economic experts surveyed for leading economic indicators in June is a decrease of 0.1%, with the estimate range ranging from a decrease of 0.2% to an increase of 0.2%. At the same time, the synchronized indicator increased by 0.2% in June from the previous month, and the monthly ratio of the lagging indicator remained unchanged.

title_en: Among the 21 active Taiwan stock ETFs, only Active First Gold Excellent Dividend outperformed the market yesterday.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Liu Juquan] The Taiwan stock market has entered a period of high-end shocks after soaring higher. Market volatility has intensified significantly. This is a period for investors and managers to review their investment skills. At this stage, the thinking of "less losses to win" tests the flexibility of funds' active operations and the effectiveness of industry allocation strategies. Cmoney Asset Management According to statistics, the 21 active Taiwan stock ETFs that have been leading the recent performance are mainly the high-interest income active ETFs with stable strategies. The weighted index fell by 0.52% yesterday (20th), and only one outperformed the market. Active First Gold Premium Dividend (00408A) closed flat. According to legal observation, the reason why the investment allocation of this new active Taiwan stock ETF can show the characteristics of bucking the trend and resisting decline is mainly due to the adoption of a dual-axis allocation strategy of growth and dividends. At this stage, among the top ten holdings of the fund, in addition to the weight king TSMC (2330), it accounts for 5.2%. 6% is the largest holding, including targets with traditionally better dividend income and defensive characteristics, such as: Chung Hua Electronics (2412), Taiwan University (3045), Uni-President (1216), Uni-President Super (2912), etc. are also among the top ten holdings of this ETF. The market fluctuates in the second half of the year, making stock selection more difficult. In the past, when the market surged, the investment portfolio may have been focused on AI and technology stocks. Zhang Zhengzhong, the manager of Active First Gold Premium Dividend, reminded that when the stock price has experienced a large correction recently, investors may wish to review their investment positions in a timely manner and adopt a more balanced layout strategy of growth and dividend collection. title: 高溫天氣血壓飆升、頭暈別輕忽 醫：暑熱、脫水與情緒波動都是誘因
summary: 近期天氣高溫，讓不少民眾在戶外汗流浹背，甚至出現頭暈、頭痛、臉潮紅、心悸等不適。有些原本就有高血壓病史的患者，更發現血壓忽高忽低，以為只是天氣太熱，休息一下就會改善。睿鳴堂中醫診所院長吳宛容提醒，高溫環境下若出現頭暈、胸悶、暈厥等症狀，應留意是否為心血管疾病警訊，而非單純中暑。

title_en: Don’t ignore soaring blood pressure and dizziness in hot weather. Doctor: Heat, dehydration and mood swings are all triggers.
summary_en: The recent high temperatures have caused many people to sweat profusely outdoors and even suffer from dizziness, headaches, flushed faces, palpitations and other discomforts. Some patients with a history of high blood pressure find that their blood pressure fluctuates and they think it's just because the weather is too hot and it will improve after taking a rest. Wu Wanrong, director of Ruimingtang Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic, reminded that if symptoms such as dizziness, chest tightness, and syncope occur in high-temperature environments, you should pay attention to whether it is a warning sign of cardiovascular disease rather than a simple heatstroke.

title_en: Changyin co-ordinated and sponsored the 3.6 billion yuan joint loan project of Linghang Technology, assisting the memory supply chain in laying out AI business opportunities
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Liu Juquan] Changhua Bank (2801) and Yuanta Bank co-organized and sponsored the three-year 3.6 billion yuan joint credit project of Linghang Technology (3135). The fundraising was successfully completed and the signing was officially completed yesterday (20th). The purpose of this joint loan project is to supplement the working capital needed for mid-term operations and material purchase. It was jointly organized by Changhua Bank and Yuanta Bank, and with the participation of a total of 7 financial institutions, including Taiwan Enterprise Bank, First Bank, South China Bank, Mega Bank and Cooperative Treasury, the fundraising was completed with 3.6 billion yuan, which fully shows that the financial industry has given high recognition and support to Linghang Technology's excellent operating results and future development potential. Linghang Technology is mainly engaged in the application development and sales of DRAM and flash memory products. Chairman Zeng Zhen has led the company to become a major memory module manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities and its own brand. In recent years, as the global technology industry supply chain has accelerated the restructuring, and the international market demand for high-end technologies and innovative products has continued to rise, Linghang Technology has demonstrated strong growth momentum and excellent market adaptability. In order to seize the opportunity of global competition, raising stable and sufficient working capital for purchasing materials has become the key for enterprises to maintain high-efficiency production and strengthen the resilience of the supply chain. Through this capital injection of 3.6 billion yuan, Linghang Technology is expected to optimize its overall financial structure, effectively reduce comprehensive financing costs, and gain greater flexibility and core competitive advantages in raw material procurement and forward-looking technology research and development strategies, laying a solid financial foundation for the next stage of leap-forward development. summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter Liu Juquan] Yang Ming Marine (2609) is committed to providing customers with low-carbon transportation services. Yesterday (20th), it officially signed a cooperation memorandum with PSA International Port Group (PSA). The two parties will work together to reduce emissions in the end-to-end supply chain for sustainable transportation, and jointly create a new milestone in green transportation by promoting low-carbon solutions in the maritime value chain. The signing ceremony was signed by representatives of Yang Ming Marine Logistics Changjiang Jiawen and PSA Group Logistics and Technology and Sustainability Chief Eddy Ng, and was successfully completed under the witness of Yang Ming Marine General Manager Li Minghui and PSA Group CEO Ong Kim Pong. In response to the global demand for green shipping transformation and the widespread use of alternative fuels, Yang Ming Shipping will jointly promote greenhouse gas emission reduction initiatives with PSA through this alliance to help cargo owners and shippers reduce Scope 3 carbon emissions generated by transportation, thereby driving the entire maritime industry chain towards net zero. General Manager of Yang Ming Marine, Li Minghui, said that strengthening green competitiveness is the core strategy of the company's operations. Through Yang Ming Marine's energy-saving fleet, combined with PSA's high-quality low-carbon terminal operations, it provides sea-land joint carbon offset services (sea-land joint carbon inset package) to provide global cargo owners with transparent and verifiable emission reduction solutions, and actively assists customers in achieving emission reduction and sustainability goals. title_en: The Executive Yuan urgently summons the mayors of six cities to discuss the revision of food safety laws. Lu Xiuyan is confirmed to attend
summary_en: The storm of the cancer-causing toxin "benzopyrene" detected in Zoomlion Oils and Fats soybean oil continues to expand. After the head of Lanying County and City announced that they would host an "online state affairs meeting" on their own and called for public attention, the Executive Yuan made an emergency decision to convene a meeting of relevant ministries on the afternoon of the 21st and invited the mayors of six cities to meet to discuss the revision of food safety and health management laws. Taichung Mayor Lu Xiuyan has confirmed that she will go north to attend in person. She said that food safety is related to the health of the whole people, and she will communicate directly with the central government with the system loopholes and suggestions encountered by local front-line inspections.

title_en: Behind the Scenes/Chiang Wan Anming went to the Political Yuan meeting to discuss the revision of food safety laws...and invited Chen Qimai 725 to speak for the people
summary_en: Due to the poisonous oil food safety crisis, Beijing Mayor Jiang Wanan personally called Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Qimai today, and they went to Kaidao on 725 to fight against poisonous oil. It is understood that Chen Qimai said he would not go to the streets and invited Jiang Wanan to attend the Executive Yuan's food safety law revision meeting tomorrow afternoon. Jiang Wanan then invited Chen 725 to Kaidao and emphasized that the law amendment does not conflict with Kaidao. He still hopes that Mayor Chen will go to Kaidao to "voice for the people of Kaohsiung to protect food safety." Jiang will also personally attend tomorrow's Executive Yuan law revision meeting.

title: 男人髮型會說話：平頭藏教官魂、油頭是控制狂、長髮最自由？心理師教你看穿他
summary: 有些男性留長髮是因為偏愛自然、簡單的生活方式，不想被社會的框架所限制，他們通常較崇尚自由、追求個人的舒適感；同時也不太在意別人的眼光，更在乎內在的自我成長與心理平衡。髮型在傳統文化中被賦予性別特徵，如短髮象徵陽剛、長髮象徵陰柔，自從台中捷運攻擊事件中，長髮哥英勇對抗攻擊者後，或許我們可以打破這個「長髮刻板印象」，無論是男性或女性留長髮，都有他們的內在需求與情感狀態，我們只需要尊重，不需要評價。每一種髮型的選擇，都是一種內心的縮影，也是外顯的人格特質，習慣剪平頭的男性，也許是在強調自己的理性與紀律，提醒自己不可以軟弱；而總是維持精緻髮型的男性，往往把形象視為尊嚴的延伸，藉由外在整齊，安撫內在的不安；至於頂著長髮、蓬鬆或略顯隨興造型的男性，或許是在追尋一種不被框架束縛的自由靈魂。如果我們願意多花一點心思去觀察，就能發現，每一種髮型的選擇背後，都藏著「被理解」的渴望，當我們能夠用心理的角度去探索髮型背後的性格線索，或許就能避免太快貼標籤，也能在互動中多一分善體人意的尊重。

title_en: Men's hairstyles can speak: A flat head hides the soul of an instructor, a greasy head is a control freak, and long hair is the most free? A psychologist teaches you to see through him
summary_en: Some men grow their hair long because they prefer a natural and simple lifestyle and do not want to be restricted by social frameworks. They usually advocate freedom and pursue personal comfort. At the same time, they don’t care much about other people’s opinions and care more about inner self-growth and psychological balance. Hairstyles are assigned gender characteristics in traditional culture. For example, short hair symbolizes masculinity, while long hair symbolizes femininity. Since the long-haired man bravely fought against the attacker in the Taichung MRT attack, perhaps we can break this "long-haired stereotype." Whether men or women have long hair, they have their own inner needs and emotional states. We only need to respect them and do not need to judge. The choice of every hairstyle is an epitome of the inner world and an outward expression of personality traits. Men who are accustomed to a crew cut may be emphasizing their rationality and discipline and reminding themselves not to be weak; while men who always maintain exquisite hairstyles often regard their image as an extension of their dignity, and soothe their inner uneasiness through external tidiness; as for men with long, fluffy or slightly casual hair styles, they may be pursuing a free soul that is not bound by a frame. If we are willing to pay more attention to observation, we can find that behind every choice of hairstyle, there is a desire to be "understood". When we can use a psychological perspective to explore the personality clues behind hairstyles, we may be able to avoid labeling people too quickly and be more considerate and respectful in interactions.

title_en: Spouses of 500 million high school students wear the same style in court six times. A psychologist reveals the three hidden motives of blue POLO shirts

The same behavior, if thought from different angles, will be interpreted in different directions. For example, some people may think that they are stubborn and do not know how to adapt, but from another perspective, it can also be said that they are single-minded and dedicated, do not like the new and dislike the old, and are trustworthy people.

When he appeared in court for the sixth time, the media began to wonder about his psychological motivations. title: 看懂穿搭避開人際地雷！心理師：戴什麼帽子，透露你不想讓人知道的祕密
summary:
草帽輕盈透氣的特質，總讓人聯想到陽光、田野與海風。喜歡戴草帽的人，心中通常有一份親近自然、追求自由的渴望。他們不喜歡被沉重的規範壓抑，希望能像風吹過的麥田一樣，自由而靈活地生活。草帽幫助他們在物質世界與內心自由之間找到平衡，既展現個性，也提醒自己保持真實與無拘無束的生活方式。

這類人通常熱愛自然，渴望與土地、陽光、海洋等自然元素保持連結；也擁有開放而正向的心態，喜歡新鮮體驗，心胸開闊，容易對人生抱持樂觀。草帽不僅是遮陽工具，更是一種活出自我節奏、擁抱自然與自由的生活態度。

從棒球帽的自我防衛、貝雷帽的情感表達、鴨舌帽的實用與矛盾、紳士帽的秩序感、漁夫帽的隱匿需求、毛帽的安全感，到草帽的自由靈魂，帽子從來不只是搭配造型的裝飾，更是心理層面的表現。從防衛機轉、面具理論到依附理論、創造性表達等不同角度來看，每一種帽子的選擇，都透露出穿戴者的心理需求、情感狀態和自我表達的方式。也許看懂一頂帽子，就更能讀懂一個人如何在社會與自我之間，找到那個最舒服的平衡點。

title_en: Know how to dress and avoid interpersonal landmines! Psychologist: What hat should you wear to reveal the secrets you don’t want others to know?
summary_en:
The light and breathable nature of straw hats always reminds people of sunshine, fields and sea breeze. People who like to wear straw hats usually have a desire to be close to nature and pursue freedom. They do not like to be suppressed by heavy norms and hope to live freely and flexibly like a wheat field blown by the wind. Straw hats help them find a balance between the material world and inner freedom, not only showing their individuality, but also reminding themselves to maintain an authentic and unrestrained lifestyle.

This type of people usually loves nature and longs to stay connected with natural elements such as land, sunshine, and ocean. They also have an open and positive mentality, like new experiences, are broad-minded, and are easily optimistic about life. The straw hat is not only a sun protection tool, but also an attitude towards life that follows your own rhythm and embraces nature and freedom.

From the self-defense of baseball caps, the emotional expression of berets, the practicality and contradiction of peaked caps, the sense of order of gentleman hats, the need for concealment of bucket hats, the sense of security of woolen hats, to the free soul of straw hats, hats are never just a decoration to match the shape, but also a psychological expression. From different perspectives such as defense mechanisms, mask theory, attachment theory, and creative expression, the choice of each hat reveals the wearer's psychological needs, emotional state, and self-expression method. Perhaps by understanding a hat, you can better understand how a person finds the most comfortable balance between society and himself.

title_en: 1 community, 1 green shade to create a 6-minute green living circle. The draft urban forest plan will be submitted before the end of the year.
summary_en: Extreme heat has become an issue that urban governance must respond to head-on. The Ministry of Environment today held the 4th National Green Shade Climate Adaptation Plan and Promotion of Wood Resource Recycling Briefing at the National Taipei University of Technology. The Ministry of Environment pointed out that the urban forest plan will be based on the direction of "one tree per person, one green shade per community, and one green belt per kilometer" to create a green living circle within a 6-minute walk and achieve an 8-degree cooling effect in the shade. Legal planning related to urban forests and public planting will be proposed before the end of the year.

title: 心理師的觀察：為何有人「化妝前」與「化妝後」會有這麼大的差別？
summary:
為什麼有些人化妝前後像是兩個人？明明五官沒有變，態度卻判若兩人。看似只是整理外表，背後牽動的，其實常常是自信、自我認同，以及一個人面對他人眼光時的心理狀態。專業諮商心理師林萃芬在其著作《從裝扮洞察人心》中指出，從女性化什麼樣的妝，如淡妝、濃妝、非化妝不可，或是從來不化妝，可以看出其內在的心理狀態、自我形象、社會期待及文化影響。

每次到電視台錄影，都會有一段等待的空檔，正好可以觀察化妝室裡的各種現象。多年下來發現，有些人「化妝前」和「化妝後」很不一樣，但改變的不是她們的臉龐，而是她們的態度。

化妝前，有些人會對周圍人彷彿視若無睹，也不太跟別人打招呼。化妝後，就會面帶笑容地主動跟別人打招呼。為何一個人「化妝前」與「化妝後」會有這麼大的差別？

原因便出在她們的「公眾自我意識」很強，非常在意「別人怎麼看自己」，所以，沒化好妝前，在心理上是「不想見人的」，即使碰到熟人，也會先假裝沒看見。

title_en: Psychiatrist’s Observation: Why is there such a big difference between someone “before makeup” and “after makeup”?
summary_en:
Why do some people look like two different people before and after makeup? Although his facial features have not changed, his attitude is completely different. It may seem like just tidying up the appearance, but what's behind it is often self-confidence, self-identity, and a person's psychological state when facing the eyes of others. Professional counseling psychologist Lin Cuifen pointed out in her book "Insights into the Human Heart through Dressing Up" that judging from what kind of makeup a woman wears, such as light makeup, heavy makeup, mandatory makeup, or never makeup, we can see her inner psychological state, self-image, social expectations and cultural influence.

Every time I go to the TV station to record, there will be a waiting period, just in time to observe various phenomena in the dressing room. Over the years, I have discovered that some people are very different "before" and "after" makeup, but what changes is not their faces, but their attitudes.

Before putting on makeup, some people seem to turn a blind eye to the people around them and don't say hello to others. After putting on makeup, I will greet others proactively with a smile on my face. Why is there such a big difference between a person's "before makeup" and "after makeup"?

The reason is that they have a strong "public self-awareness" and are very concerned about "how others see themselves." Therefore, before putting on makeup, they psychologically "don't want to see people." Even if they meet an acquaintance, they will pretend not to see them.

title_en: The bigger the wedding ring, the happier you are? A psychologist reveals the truth: A ring can predict how you will quarrel after marriage.
summary_en: Choosing a wedding ring should be one of the sweetest rituals in life, but have you ever thought that this process is actually a preliminary test of whether two people's values ​​are compatible? One party values ​​the sense of design and commemorative value, while the other party insists on practicality and budget control; one party looks forward to a romantic ceremony, while the other party believes that there is no need to spend a lot of money. Professional counseling psychologist Lin Cuifen pointed out in her book "Insights into People's Hearts through Dressing Up" that the disputes and frictions in these processes not only reveal the personality compatibility of the two parties, but also predict the possible interaction patterns and potential frictions after marriage.

title_en: Movie/Yilan herpes zoster vaccine starts! Full subsidy of RMB 16,000 for two doses. Beneficiaries praised the good government.
summary_en: The Yilan County government has launched a publicly funded herpes zoster vaccination service, with a full subsidy of NT$16,000 for two doses. The woman who registered for the first vaccination at the Yilan City Health Center today thanked the county government for its good governance. The county councilors also hope that the age group for vaccination will be lowered in the future, or that the vaccine will not be restricted to vulnerable groups. The county government stated that it will consider whether to expand the scope of vaccination in the future based on the status of vaccination in the first year and the financial budget.

title: 國家重要民俗口湖牽水狀登場 多項獨特的水狀祭靈莊嚴壯觀
summary: 國家重要民俗的雲林縣口湖鄉「牽水狀（車藏）」兩天祭典登場。金湖萬善爺廟、蚶寮萬善祠及下寮仔萬善爺廟等三廟，今天下午起陸續展開挑飯擔、放水燈、萬人塚點燈等傳統重要祭儀，明天則進行起狀、牽狀、燒狀等重頭戲，藉以追思1845年水災罹難先民，讓這項延傳181年的地方記憶持續流傳。

title_en: Nationally important folk customs, the mouth of the lake is made in the shape of water. Many unique water-shaped sacrifices are solemn and spectacular.
summary_en: The two-day festival of the nationally important folk custom "Pian Shui Shao (Che Zang)" in Kouhu Township, Yunlin County is on display. The three temples including Jinhu Wanshan Ye Temple, Fengliao Wanshan Ye Temple and Hagliao Tsai Wanshan Ye Temple will start this afternoon to carry out traditional important rituals such as carrying rice poles, releasing water lanterns, and lighting mass graves. Tomorrow, they will carry out important activities such as raising, carrying, and burning to commemorate the ancestors who died in the flood in 1845, so that this local memory that has been passed down for 181 years will continue to be passed down.

title: 幸運密碼是墾丁福華？屏東旅遊購GO節百萬休旅車2得主都住這裡

title_en: The lucky password is Kenting Fuhua? Pingtung Travel Shopping GO Festival Millionaire RV 2 winners all live here
summary_en: The Pingtung Travel Shopping GO Festival has driven a tourism craze in Pingtung. Since its launch on May 1, the cumulative registration amount has exceeded 37 million yuan, bringing a tourism output value of 660 million yuan. The winner of the first million-dollar SUV in June was Zheng Nu from New Taipei City. Today, the second SUV was drawn live on the 20th, and it was lucky enough to be drawn by Mr. Lu from Kaohsiung City. Coincidentally, the two grand prize winners stayed at Kenting Fuhua when they came to travel. Four more SUVs of the same model will be drawn out each month.

title: 高雄義大醫院宣布推出護理師續任獎金 每季最高加薪1.5萬元
summary: 高雄義大醫院去年升格醫學中心，為留住護理人才，2年前全面為護理師加薪4000元，今天再度宣布推出義大醫療體系護理部護理師及專科護理師「季度續任獎金」制度。院方表示，目前護理部護理人員約1600人，若符合資格者，每三個月可領取一次續任獎金，每季最高可領取1萬5000元，持續強化護理人才留任措施。

title_en: E-Da Hospital in Kaohsiung announces the launch of a renewal bonus for nursing staff, with a maximum salary increase of NT$15,000 per quarter
summary_en: E-Da Hospital in Kaohsiung was upgraded to a medical center last year. In order to retain nursing talents, it gave all nurses a salary increase of NT$4,000 two years ago. Today it once again announced the launch of a "quarterly renewal bonus" system for nurses and specialist nurses in the nursing department of E-Da Medical System. The hospital stated that there are currently about 1,600 nursing staff in the nursing department. Those who meet the qualifications can receive a renewal bonus every three months, up to a maximum of 15,000 yuan per quarter, and continue to strengthen nursing talent retention measures.

title: 貿協：台北自行車展7/22開放參展報名
summary: （中央社記者曾筠庭台北20日電）外貿協會表示，2027年台北國際自行車展（TAIPEI CYCLE）將於今年7月22日開放參展報名，預計徵集1000家廠商、使用3600個攤位，邀請全球自行車品牌、零組件供應商、電動輔助自行車及相關業者來台參展，掌握產業轉型商機。

title: 國銀5月底外幣存款餘額達16.2兆元　續創新高
summary: （中央社記者蘇思云台北20日電）金管會統計顯示，本國銀行截至5月底外幣存款餘額達新台幣16兆2664億元，續創歷史新高，月增3142億元。至於國銀外幣存款的「兆元俱樂部」依然是6家業者，並續由中信銀行以1.71兆元居冠。

title_en: Eat with confidence and deliver with peace of mind! Food delivery specialist is on the road, 4 departments will join forces to strengthen insurance, wages and food safety
summary_en: The food delivery industry is ushering in major changes, and the "Special Food Delivery Law" that everyone has been waiting for will be officially implemented at 0:00 tomorrow (21st). In order to implement the system and balance the industrial ecology, the Ministry of Labor, the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Transport and the Ministry of Health and Welfare, after half a year of preparation, have launched a number of key supporting regulations, ranging from labor rights, business fairness, traffic safety to food hygiene.

title: 中聯油脂22批完成檢驗全合格 食藥署明開會評估是否解除下架
summary: 中聯油脂食安事件最新檢驗結果出爐，食藥署今天公布，中聯公司今年4月至6月生產的30批油品中，除7批已確認不合格油品未再重複抽驗、1批外銷無檢體外，其餘22批已全數完成檢驗，檢驗結果皆符合規定。食藥署副署長王德原表示，明日將召開食品風險評估諮議會，邀集毒理、食品安全及風險評估專家，研議相關油品及下游產品後續處置方式。

title_en: 22 batches of China United Oils and Fats have passed the inspection and the Food and Drug Administration will hold a meeting tomorrow to evaluate whether to lift the removal from the shelves.
summary_en: The latest inspection results of the Zoomlion oil and fat food safety incident are out. The Food and Drug Administration announced today that among the 30 batches of oil products produced by Zoomlion from April to June this year, except for 7 batches of oil products that have been confirmed to be unqualified and have not been repeatedly inspected, and 1 batch of exported oil products that have not been inspected. The remaining 22 batches have all been inspected and the inspection results are in compliance with regulations. Wang Deyuan, deputy director of the Food and Drug Administration, said that a food risk assessment advisory meeting will be held tomorrow, inviting experts in toxicology, food safety and risk assessment to discuss the subsequent disposal methods of relevant oil products and downstream products.

title: 防堵問題油再現 台南推「三管一演練」強化油品管理守食安
summary: 因應中聯油脂致癌油事件，台南市政府今邀集製油業者、公（協）會代表、專家學者及相關局處，針對製油業者油品安全管理精進舉行座談會，由副市長趙卿惠主持，會中拍板推動「油品安全三管一演練」，提高原油自主檢驗及政府抽驗頻率，也要求業者強化製程品質管理、異常事件通報及追蹤溯源機制等，全面提升油品安全管理。

title_en: Oil blockage prevention problem reappears, Tainan launches "three pipes and one drill" to strengthen oil management and food safety
summary_en: In response to the China United Oil and Fat carcinogen oil incident, the Tainan City Government today invited oil producers, public (association) representatives, experts and scholars, and relevant bureaus to hold a symposium on improving oil safety management of oil producers. Deputy Mayor Zhao Qinghui chaired the meeting. During the meeting, it was decided to promote the "three pipes and one drill for oil safety", increase the frequency of independent crude oil inspections and government random inspections, and also require the industry to strengthen process quality management, abnormal event notification and tracking and traceability mechanisms, etc., to comprehensively improve oil safety management.

title_en: Urban resilience drill network slows down for 30 minutes New Taipei police and police: local mobile phone calls will not be affected
summary_en: In conjunction with this year's Hanguang Exercise Urban Resilience Exercise, NCC plans to disconnect the network for the first time, and the mobile network will be slowed down for half an hour. The New Taipei Police and Consumer Affairs Bureau stated that dialing 110 and 119 for general local and traditional mobile phone voice calls during the drill will not be affected, and people will have no fear of reporting the crime. During the exercise, police and civil defense personnel will be stationed in various places, and the public can also directly seek help from on-site personnel.

title_en: Pingtung County Government has passed all oil product inspections in the past five years. Zhou Chunmi: There is no room for compromise in safeguarding food safety.
summary_en: In response to the recent Zhonglian oil product scandal, Pingtung County Magistrate Zhou Chunmi immediately instructed the Health Bureau to cooperate with the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare to initiate an inventory operation, complete the preventive removal of relevant products from the shelves, and continue to announce the latest information. County Magistrate Zhou Chunmi said today that although The upstream oil product manufacturing plants are not located in Pingtung County. The Health Bureau strictly controls food safety. In the past five years, it has implemented inspection projects on the edible oil processed products manufacturing industry, and all of them are safe and qualified. "The county government defends food safety and there is no room for compromise." Please rest assured, folks.

title_en: Did the Hanguang exercise experience "internet disconnection" for the first time, affecting disaster relief and rescue signals? Central City Fire Department: No impact
summary_en: In conjunction with the urban resilience exercise of this year's Han Kuang exercise, the NCC has planned the "Network Disconnection" subject for the first time, which will target the slowdown of mobile networks in 14 counties and cities in the north and central part of the country. Whether this will affect disaster relief and ambulance services has aroused concern. The Taichung City Fire Department stated that the exercise uses the large bandwidth of mobile phones, and disaster relief units use radios and satellite phones to perform tasks, so that disaster relief and rescue communications can be kept unaffected.

title: 影／三大原民樂舞盛宴起動 原民會期許「歌舞讓彼此更靠近 」

title_en: Taichung's failure to conduct inspection of Chung Lian Oil and Fat raises controversy over rights and responsibilities. Food and Drug Administration: Local governments have the obligation to proactively conduct inspections
summary_en: The case of carcinogenic oil continues to spread. The Taichung City Government recently stated that when it carried out random inspections of cooking oil benzene and pyrene last year, China United Oils and Fats was not included in the inspection list because the central government did not provide the relevant list. The outside world questioned whether the local government could only conduct inspections in accordance with the central government's instructions. Wang Deyuan, deputy director of the Food and Drug Administration, emphasized that in accordance with the provisions of the Food Safety Law, local health bureaus are originally the food safety authorities and are legally responsible for food inspections, random inspections and inspections. They do not have to wait for central government designation before they can be implemented.

title: 比照防疫？致癌油催生修法 行院拍板十大改革 中央可成立食安指揮中心

title_en: Compared with epidemic prevention? Carcinogenic oil prompts law revision, the National Academy of Sciences decides on ten major reforms, and the central government can establish a food safety command center
summary_en: The food safety incident of China Federation of Oils and Fats has aroused great public concern and accelerated the process of amending the food safety law. Wang Deyuan, deputy director of the Food and Drug Administration, said that the Executive Yuan has decided on the direction of amending the law, which is expected to be submitted to the Executive Yuan for review as soon as this Thursday. The content covers ten key points such as high-risk industry management, third-party verification, abnormal notification, property preservation, and major food safety incident command mechanisms. It is hoped that through system reform, the current food safety management loopholes will be strengthened.

title_en: 21 active Taiwan stock ETFs, only this one outperformed the market
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market has entered a period of high-level volatility after rising high. Market volatility has intensified significantly. This is a period for investors and managers to review their investment skills. At this stage, the thinking of reducing losses to win will test the flexibility of funds' proactive operations and the effectiveness of industry allocation strategies. According to CMoney statistics, the 21 active Taiwan stock ETFs that have been leading in recent times are mainly won by the stable strategy high-interest income active ETF. The weighted index fell by 0.52% on the 20th. Only the active first gold premium dividend (00408A) closed flat and outperformed the market performance.

title_en: Why are the people who tell the truth the first to be eliminated? Investment experts see through the hidden rules of the workplace from history: only those who can endure will survive to the end
summary_en: The allusion of "spitting one's face on oneself" comes from the conversation between Lou Shide and his younger brother. At that time, his younger brother was about to be appointed governor of Daizhou. Before leaving, he bid farewell to Lou Shide and asked for instructions. Lou Shide said earnestly: "I have become the prime minister, and now you are also a local official. Such honor will inevitably attract jealousy and hatred. In order to avoid being harmed, we must learn to be patient in everything." His younger brother said: "Follow the teachings carefully. If someone spits phlegm, If you spit on my face, I will wipe it off myself." Lou Shide shook his head and said, "No! If you wipe it off immediately, it will anger the other person and make him hate you even more. The correct way is to let it dry naturally." To endure humiliation like this is different from ordinary people. Lou Shide's tolerance is not only reflected in family discipline, but also in daily coping. Once, he was walking with the minister Li Zhaode (unknown birth date - 697). Lou Shide was plump and walked slowly. Li Zhaode impatiently reprimanded: "I am dragged down by a country bumpkin!" Lou Shide smiled and replied: "If I am not a country bumpkin, then who is?" Such humor and self-deprecation left the strong-minded Li Zhaode speechless. Li Zhaode was an upright minister who was once trusted but was beheaded for offending Wu Zetian. It is said that Di Renjie initially disapproved of Lou Shide. One day, Wu Zetian tested Di Renjie and asked, "Do you think Lou Shide is a virtuous person?" Di Renjie replied, "I only know that he was careful in running the army when he was a general, but I don't know whether he is a virtuous person." Wu Zetian asked again, "Then do you think he knows people and is good at assigning tasks?" Di Renjie shook his head and said, "I have never heard that he knows people and uses talents." Wu Zetian smiled and said, "The reason why I appointed you is because of Lou Shide's recommendation.

title_en: Foreign investors sold Taiwan stocks for US$8.76 billion last week, outselling Taiwan and South Korea stocks for four consecutive weeks.
summary_en: The South Korean stock market was dragged down by the heavy decline of chip stocks last week, triggering the eighth meltdown mechanism in 2026, simultaneously detonating a wave of retail investors losing their jobs, and panic began to spread to other Asian stock markets. China Trust Investment Trust said that observing the flow of funds last week, emerging Asian stocks had a net outflow of US$9.52 billion. Taiwan stocks were sold the most by foreign investors at US$8.76 billion, while foreign investors oversold India by US$670 million and South Korea by US$460 million. It is worth noting that foreign capital has outperformed the Taiwan and South Korea stock markets for four consecutive weeks. Since July, the Taiwan and South Korea markets have been sold off by US$18.57 billion and US$8.13 billion respectively.

title: 好運能複製？耳朵低、眉眼距離近、山根塌...命理師揭面相不佳有對策：向松鼠學習
summary: 仔細回想生活中，是否有這樣的朋友？他們的決定總是讓人感到匪夷所思，超越我們正常理解的範疇，然而卻每次都能莫名其妙地成功。這些人的成功究竟有何祕訣？難道真的是命運的眷顧？還是有其他我們未曾察覺的因素？新創科技圈的國師、專業命理看相風水師簡少年，在其著作《業力大腦》中指出：這些看似瘋狂的決定背後，其實藏著一套超越一般常識的成功法則，而解開謎底的關鍵，竟然是一隻松鼠。簡少年坦言，過去他傾向於將這類人歸因於「祖上積德」，認為某些人因為福報足夠，所以能夠安然度過種種考驗。或許，他們掌握了某些我們所不知道的策略，或者擁有某些特質，使他們在看似瘋狂的決定中反而能夠脫穎而出，甚至成為眾人眼中的奇蹟。

title_en: Can good luck be replicated? Low ears, close distance between eyebrows and eyes, flat roots... Numerologists reveal the countermeasures for poor appearance: learn from squirrels
summary_en: Think carefully about your life, do you have such friends? Their decisions always make people feel incredible and beyond the scope of our normal understanding, but they are inexplicably successful every time. What is the secret to these people’s success? Is it really a blessing from fate? Or are there other factors that we are unaware of? Jian Shaoyou, a national master in the new technology circle and a professional numerologist and geomancer, pointed out in his book "Karma Brain": Behind these seemingly crazy decisions, there is actually a set of success rules that transcend common sense, and the key to unlocking the answer turned out to be a squirrel. Young Jian said frankly that in the past, he tended to attribute such people to "the virtues accumulated by their ancestors" and believed that some people were able to survive various trials safely because of sufficient blessings. Perhaps they have mastered some strategies that we don’t know about, or possess certain qualities that allow them to stand out from seemingly crazy decisions, and even become miracles in the eyes of everyone.

title: 從算力到感測 全光網路重塑智慧城市基建
summary: 整體而言，IOWN各應用路徑成熟度存在差異。資料中心互連、遠端GPU調度與廣電製播，因痛點明確且具商業獲利模式，商用化進程較快；公共工程、智慧農業與城市光纖感測，則受限於政策驅動、公共採購制度與跨部門權責整合，服務化時程尚不明朗。此外，目前示範案例高度集中於日本與NTT生態系，未來能否在其他市場建立穩定採購模式與維運機制，仍有待觀察。由於多數應用仍處示範驗證或早期商模評估階段，我國城市端宜採從需求出發、小規模試點的務實路徑。盤點具備高資料量、低延遲敏感性、明確營運主體與效益可量測性的場景：如醫療與交通影像所需之遠端算力、港區與公共工程遠端操控、大型展演影音同步，以及道路橋梁與管線廣域感測與預警。同時，我國宜優先布局產業供應鏈與算力基建。憑藉光通訊、網通設備、AI伺服器、資料中心與系統整合等優勢，從全光網路設備、光模組、光交換、多廠互通驗證、資料中心互連及高安全AI算力服務切入。對SI業者而言，亦可圍繞分散式算力、遠端操控、媒體遠端製作與光纖感測等領域，發展可驗證、可複製的垂直場域方案。

When many people returned to Taiwan, their flights were canceled and they were forced to stay abroad for many days, thus incurring additional transportation and accommodation expenses. title_en: High-purity tungsten hexafluoride material shortage and production reduction impact semiconductors? The supply chain looks at the uninterrupted supply of raw materials
summary_en: Recently, there are market rumors that Central Glass, a Japanese special gas supplier that is a gas supplier to major semiconductor manufacturers such as TSMC (2330), will stop production of global high-purity tungsten hexafluoride (WF₆) due to material shortage, which has attracted attention from the outside world about the interference to the semiconductor market. In this regard, both the supply chain and suppliers mentioned that there is currently no shortage of gaseous tungsten powder raw materials, and there are still many alternatives. The impact on the industry is expected to be limited, but production costs have continued to increase due to inflation.

title_en: The war in the Middle East and Russia-Ukraine boosted the military industry theme, and concept stocks such as Hanxiang and Taiwan Shipbuilding strengthened
summary_en: The conflict in the Middle East and the Russia-Ukraine war continue to rage, global defense demand remains high, and the government's acceleration of the "Special Regulations on the Procurement of Autonomous Unmanned Vehicles for National Defense" has driven Taiwan's military industry group to once again become the focus of the market. title: 國巨、聯電連躺兩天跌停拖台股下水221點 大盤滿地傷台積電漲30元硬扛 ｜Yahoo財經掃描
summary:
台股今日延續上周周線重挫近6%的弱勢格局，盤中高低震盪逾1100點，雖一度重返43000點，仍不敵電子股賣壓，終場下跌221.57點、跌幅0.52%，收在42449.70點，周線與季線皆未能收復，成交金額達9851.82億元。台積電(2330)逆勢上漲30元或1.31%，收2320元，成為大盤最重要支撐。鴻海(2317)也小幅走揚。緯創(3231)、技嘉(2376)與環球晶(6488)相對強勢，其中環球晶受AI需求與12吋產能滿載題材激勵亮燈漲停。軍工族群亦在AI股熄火之際力撐盤面。反觀成熟製程與被動元件賣壓沉重，聯電(2303)、國巨*(2327)再吞跌停，成為拖累指數反彈的主要壓力。

亞股今日走勢分歧，日本股市適逢海之日休市；韓股上周五休市躲過全球科技股賣壓，今日開盤補跌逾4%，盤中雖一度受SK海力士走揚激勵急拉逼近平盤，但賣單隨後再度湧出，一度跌逾5%並觸發熔斷，尾盤跌勢收斂，終場下跌4.46%。而陸港股逆勢走強，港股上漲2.36%；上證指數上漲0.85%。

美股部分，四大指數上周五(17日)全面收低，其中，費城半導體指數跌1.63%，並較6月高點回落逾20%，正式落入技術性熊市。科技股方面，輝達下跌2.2%，Alphabet也因中國AI競爭疑慮下挫2.2%；網飛因營收展望不如預期重挫7.3%，SpaceX則受Starship V3試飛臨時喊卡拖累下跌5.4%，台積電ADR同步收跌2.77%，晶片與AI概念股賣壓持續擴散。

title: 健身工廠逆轉勝／逆境中創業成本土龍頭　健身工廠力抗國際品牌拚百店
summary: 旗下擁有本土連鎖健身房龍頭健身工廠的柏文健康（簡稱柏文），不僅是台灣第一家成功掛牌上市的健身中心，創業20年來一路挺過市場洗牌與新冠疫情海嘯，去年每股獲利仍創下8.49元新高紀錄。日前柏文董座陳尚義接受本刊專訪，暢談如何從被看衰的逆境，一路走向本土健身第一品牌外，更喊出明年據點要衝破百家，下一步計畫揮軍美國。「台灣健身人口僅４％，相對歐美，我們還有翻倍空間。」他肯定地說。

title_en: Medical insurance can be collected at one time 1/millions of people in Taiwan hold major illness and injury cards. Is your medical insurance really leak-proof?
summary_en: After the medical community raised the issue of "one-day surgery", many people were anxious about whether outpatient surgery could be compensated and whether it met the definition of hospitalization. These discussions may seem pragmatic, but in fact most of them only focus on medical expenses ranging from several thousand to hundreds of thousands of yuan. However, insurance experts remind that it is never this small amount of money that can really destroy a family's finances, but sudden major injuries such as cancer and stroke.

summary: 重大疾病險、特定傷病險、精選傷病險、重大傷病險，這些保險名稱雖只差幾個字，但保障內容卻大不相同，也是民眾最容易混淆的保險商品。尤其不少人誤以為，只要取得健保重大傷病證明，這些保險都能申請理賠，但事實上，真正與健保重大傷病制度直接連結的只有「重大傷病險」，其餘商品仍須依各家保單條款認定疾病嚴重程度、觀察期間及失能狀況。

title_en: Get 2 medical insurance at one time/How to prevent serious illness? Experts name 4 "injury insurance": It is easiest to buy it
summary_en: Critical illness insurance, specific injury and illness insurance, selected injury and illness insurance, and major injury and illness insurance. Although the names of these insurances only differ by a few words, their coverage contents are quite different. They are also the insurance products that people are most likely to confuse. In particular, many people mistakenly believe that as long as they obtain the National Insurance Major Injury and Injury Certificate, they can apply for claims from these insurances. However, in fact, the only one that is truly directly linked to the National Insurance Major Injury and Injury System is the "Major Injury and Injury Insurance." Other products still require the determination of disease severity, observation period, and disability status in accordance with the terms of each policy.

title: 焦點股：AI測試設備出貨支撐，振樺電下半年營運轉佳
summary: 【財訊快報／研究員周佳蓉】在經歷數月的營收衰退之後，振樺電(8114)6月營收繳出19.91億元，年增雙位數成長的表現，上半年營運動能主要受惠於AI晶片模組檢測設備需求加溫與美國基礎建設專案出貨。振樺電是少數同時獲得三大PC品牌宏碁、聯想、華碩投資的IPC公司，以自有品牌POSIFLEX與提供全球通路的POS、KIOSK解決方案推進市場，也持續把SDA商業模式的場景定義智能設備，做成高毛利營運主軸，去年PC大廠宏碁(2353)成為振樺電最大法人股東，並在董監改選取得四席董事席次，近日傳出後續振樺電與聯想合資公司的合作架構也再添變數。法人觀察，振樺電今年營運主軸仍是Embedded Foundry帶頭、O2O與KIOSK接棒，目前包括系統品牌、醫療、場景定義致設備等高毛利產品貢獻約75%，有望朝八成邁進。目前股價跌破季線之後顯示較為疲弱，市場關注的重點，已從單月營收起伏，轉向產品組合升級能否延續到下半年。

summary: 商傳媒｜何映辰／台北報導科技產業在市場上向來是成長動能最強勁的板塊之一。據《Business Research Insights》報告指出，全球科技市場規模在 2025 年已達 5.8 兆美元，並預計在 2034 年前將大幅成長至 10.3 兆美元。這波成長主要由人工智慧（AI）趨勢推動，無論是軟體應用如生成式 AI 工具、聊天機器人，或是硬體方面如半導體與電子元件的需求，都呈現顯著成長。 在眾多科技公司中，微軟、蘋果與輝達這三大巨頭，憑藉其創新能力、市場規模與穩健的財務實力，成為分析師關注的焦點，並被視為投資組合的核心配置。這三家公司皆具備強大的競爭優勢，並產生豐沛的自由現金流。 微軟：雲端與 AI 雙引擎驅動成長 微軟（Microsoft）不僅以 Windows 作業系統和 Microsoft Office 軟體聞名，更已透過 Azure 雲端服務成為全球最大雲端基礎設施供應商之一。該公司積極將 AI 整合至其產品線，例如 Copilot 助理以及 Azure OpenAI 服務，使其成為 AI 發展的主要受惠者。從 2021 財年至 2025 財年，微軟平均每股自由現金流達 8.

title: 中國維持1年期LPR 3.00%以及5年期 3.50%不變
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，中國維持1年期與5年期LPR利率不變。中國人民銀行在網站上發布公告指出，7月份1年期和5年期貸款市場報價利率(LPR)分别為3.00%和3.50%，維持在6月份的水準不變。LPR是中國銀行業貸款定價的主要參考利率，由報價行根據其對最優質客戶的貸款利率報價形成。該利率通常於每月20日公布，如遇週末或假日則順延。

summary_en: The war between the United States and Iran has once again triggered alarm in the global energy and transportation chains. The industry believes that container shipping freight rates, which have been declining for two consecutive weeks, may rise again in the short term. The previous freight rate correction should be a technical consolidation after continuous surges; the "peak season market" of container shipping in the third quarter is supported, and the three major container shipping companies including Evergreen, Yang Ming, and Wan Hai are still optimistic about their operations this quarter.

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電引述上海證券報的報導指出，近期，A股市場寬幅震盪，前期漲幅較大的科技類股調整尤為明顯，投資者情緒也隨之波動。從追逐熱門賽道到重新審視風險，市場題材似乎在很短時間內發生了切換。報導指出，需要看清的是，當前調整更多體現為高預期的再定價、集中持倉的再平衡和風險偏好的階段性收縮，並不意味著人工智能產業趨勢、中國科技自立自強進程或上市公司基本面發生了整體逆轉。市場真正需要修復的，是價格與基本面之間的局部偏離，而非對中國資產長期價值的判斷。報導指稱，中國資產的安全韌性，來自宏觀政策空間、完整產業體系、超大規模市場和企業盈利基礎。中國科技的長期價值，則取決於技術突破、產業轉化和商業回報。這些因素不會因海外市場幾日波動或一次交易風格的切換而消失，仍是A股價值中樞的基本盤。報導引述專業人士指稱，當前市場流動性充裕，問題還是出在情緒面上。資本市場從來都是「訊息」和「信心」共同作用的市場。如果說「訊息」的決定因素是基本面和披露效率，那麼「信心」的關鍵則在於每一個市場參與者的情緒，這需要更強有力的市場信號。

title_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs plans to require contract capacity above 5MW to install its own power generation equipment. "Larger Electricity User Clause 2.0" will affect 400 companies
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan will review the draft amendment to the Energy Management Law on Wednesday (22nd). The Ministry of Economic Affairs plans that this revision of the law will clearly stipulate that "large electricity consumers" with a contract capacity of more than 5MW (thousand miles) will be forced to set up their own power generation equipment and energy storage equipment. It is estimated that more than 400 semiconductor, optoelectronics, steel, petrochemical, and AI data centers (AIDC) will be affected.

title_en: Who will take care of the elders during the holidays? Respite care is hard to find, and family members lament that “they can see it but don’t use it”
summary_en: Many families hire foreign caregivers to take care of disabled or demented elders at home. However, when the caregivers are on vacation, the care often falls into a window period. Family members need to apply for respite services to assist with care. However, due to factors such as insufficient manpower of caregivers, it is difficult to apply for home respite services, forcing family members to hire caregivers at their own expense. They lament that respite services are "available but not used." Minister of Health and Welfare said that a number of measures have been developed to increase the manpower of caregivers so that the elderly can receive better care.

title_en: Long-term care manpower is already insufficient and we are still busy with evaluations. The frontline calls for simplifying the system and returning services to the elders.
summary_en: According to the "Long-term Care Services Act", long-term care institutions are evaluated every four years to maintain service quality. Residential long-term care institutions are evaluated by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and community-type and home-based long-term care institutions are responsible for municipal, county and city competent authorities. However, during actual evaluations, institutional directors and evaluation committee members often have conflicts, and long-term care institutions have called for the elimination of the cumbersome evaluation system. Minister of Health and Welfare Zhaosi said that if the rated institutions have any doubts or disputes, a handling process has been established to handle them.

title: 長照喘息一人難求！家總推「互助喘息」解人力荒 今年正式納入長照3.0
summary: 家有失能、失智長輩，家庭照顧者最需要的莫過於居家喘息服務。據衛福部統計，從事居家式照服員人數自2021年3萬8339人，增加至2024年5萬4342人，仍供不應求。家庭照顧者關懷總會秘書長陳景寧說，家總在多年前已意識到喘息服務已派不出人力，而為解決照服員人力不足問題，必須用創新服務解決問題，並於2019年開始試辦「互助喘息服務」提供另一選擇，今年更納入長照3.0方案。

title_en: It’s hard to find a long-term respite! Parents promote "mutual aid and respite" to alleviate manpower shortage. This year it will be officially included in long-term care 3.0
summary_en: If there is an elder in the family who is disabled or has dementia, what family caregivers need most is home respite services. According to statistics from the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the number of home-based caregivers has increased from 38,339 in 2021 to 54,342 in 2024, and demand still exceeds supply. Chen Jingning, secretary-general of the Family Caregivers Association, said that family caregivers have realized many years ago that the respite service can no longer dispatch manpower. In order to solve the problem of insufficient manpower of caregivers, innovative services must be used to solve the problem. In 2019, they began to pilot the "Mutual Aid Respite Service" to provide another option. This year, it has been included in the long-term care 3.0 plan.

title_en: The preliminary value of the University of Michigan's consumer confidence index in the United States rose to 54.4 in July, a five-month high
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that newly released preliminary data showed that U.S. consumer confidence rose to a five-month high in July, and falling gasoline prices boosted consumer sentiment. A preliminary survey released by the University of Michigan on Friday showed that the consumer confidence index rose to 54.4 in July from 49.5 in June, which was higher than the median forecast of 51.0 by economic experts. Gasoline prices continued to fall in June and early July, helping to ease pressure on household budgets. However, with the resumption of war in the Middle East and the recent rebound in gasoline prices, the outlook for inflation is once again facing uncertainty. The survey covered responses from respondents between June 23 and July 13, but the report noted that more than 70% of the questionnaires were completed before the U.S. airstrike on Iran in early July. Improvements in consumer confidence span all age, income and political affiliation groups. The survey shows that consumers expect prices to rise by 4.2% in the next year, which is smaller than the 4.6% expected in June; the average annual inflation rate for the next five to ten years is expected to be 3.3%, the same as in June. Survey leader Joanne Hsu said in a statement that consumers remain concerned that inflationary pressures may intensify in the future. An increasing number of respondents believe it is more cost-effective to buy goods now to avoid price increases in the future. Households' perceptions of their own financial situation and the overall economic situation have improved, the survey showed. An index of durable goods purchasing conditions rose to its highest level since October last year. The cost of living remains the top source of dissatisfaction among American consumers. title: 美墨未來一週啟動USMCA第三輪談判，聚焦鋼鋁、汽車與經濟安全
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美國與墨西哥將於未來一週在墨西哥市展開《美國—墨西哥—加拿大協定》(USMCA)第三輪雙邊談判，雙方將就鋼鐵、鋁、汽車及經濟安全等敏感議題進行三天密集磋商。隨著USMCA聯合審查程序推進，美墨正試圖提前化解原產地規則、產業補貼及第三國產品繞道進入北美市場等分歧，以降低貿易政策不確定性對跨境供應鏈與企業投資的衝擊。美國貿易代表辦公室(USTR)最新表示，兩國談判團隊將自7月21日起會晤，討論鋼鋁及其衍生產品、汽車、經濟安全、勞工、農業與電子支付服務。這是雙方圍繞USMCA聯合審查進行的第三輪正式雙邊談判，前兩輪已觸及汽車原產地規則、非關稅壁壘、農產品准入及監管協調等問題。汽車與戰略製造業預料將是本輪談判核心。美國貿易代表葛里爾(Jamieson Greer)日前表示，墨西哥在談判中展現務實態度，但華府仍關切對墨西哥貿易逆差擴大，並希望提高北美生產汽車中的美國零組件含量，同時收緊電子、製藥等戰略產業規則，防止中國及其他第三國透過墨西哥供應鏈取得USMCA優惠待遇。美國亦可能尋求以關稅、配額或更嚴格原產地規定管理部分商品流入，但需避免破壞高度整合的北美產業鏈。市場人士指出

title_en: The United States and Mexico will launch the third round of USMCA negotiations next week, focusing on steel, aluminum, automobiles and economic security
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] The United States and Mexico will launch the third round of bilateral negotiations on the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) in Mexico City in the next week. The two sides will conduct three days of intensive consultations on sensitive issues such as steel, aluminum, automobiles, and economic security. As the USMCA joint review process advances, the United States and Mexico are trying to resolve differences in advance about rules of origin, industrial subsidies, and the detour of third-country products into the North American market to reduce the impact of trade policy uncertainty on cross-border supply chains and corporate investment. The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) recently stated that the negotiating teams of the two countries will meet starting on July 21 to discuss steel, aluminum and their derivatives, automobiles, economic security, labor, agriculture and electronic payment services. This is the third round of formal bilateral negotiations between the two sides focusing on the joint review of the USMCA. The first two rounds have touched on issues such as automobile rules of origin, non-tariff barriers, agricultural product access and regulatory coordination. Automobiles and strategic manufacturing are expected to be at the core of this round of negotiations. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer recently stated that Mexico has shown a pragmatic attitude in negotiations, but Washington is still concerned about the expansion of the trade deficit with Mexico, and hopes to increase the content of U.S. components in North American-produced cars, while tightening rules for strategic industries such as electronics and pharmaceuticals to prevent China and other third countries from obtaining USMCA preferential treatment through the Mexican supply chain. The United States may also seek to manage the inflow of some goods through tariffs, quotas, or stricter origin regulations, but it needs to avoid disrupting the highly integrated North American industrial chain. title_en: Agricultural product futures showed mixed trends for the week of the 17th. Chicago wheat rose more than 7% for the week, while New York cocoa fell 7.5%.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Chen Mengshuo] The global agricultural products futures have diverged in the week of the 17th. Cereals and some oil and fat commodities have strengthened significantly. Wheat has become the main leading variety. Soybean oil is also supported by supply and demand themes. In comparison, cocoa, coffee and cotton are under heavy selling pressure. Overall, market funds are still biased toward cereal varieties with higher weather and supply risks, but profits continue to be taken on soft commodities that have experienced large gains in the past. The cereal sub-index in New York rose 1.01% to 31.8718 points, a weekly increase of 3.16%. Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) wheat futures rose 7.12% on the week to US$6.8475 per bushel, making it the strongest major cereal in the past week; corn futures rose 1.57% on the week to US$4.6825, showing a W-shaped reversal during the week. Soybean futures rose 0.90% on the week to US$12.0250, soybean meal edged up 0.16%, and soybean oil rose 5.06%. In terms of livestock products, the CBOT lean hog period rose by about 3.26% on a weekly basis, the live cattle period fell by about 4.30%, and the feed cattle period fell by about 2.45%. The sugar market was mixed, with ICE raw sugar futures falling 0.40% week-on-week, while white sugar futures rose 0.99%. The coffee market was also divided, with New York Arabica coffee C-type futures falling 3.93%, while Robusta coffee futures edged up 0.49%. Among soft commodities, the selling pressure on cocoa was the most prominent. New York cocoa futures fell 7.50% for the whole week to US$5,610 per ton, while London cocoa futures fell 1.10%, reflecting that the market continues to digest slowing demand and high prices.

title: 哈瑪克放鷹稱通膨仍過高，Fed加息聲浪升溫、7月底例會料按兵不動
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】克里夫蘭聯邦銀行總裁貝絲．哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)上週五(17日)釋出鷹派訊號，直言在消費支出仍具韌性、失業率保持低檔之際，持續偏高的通膨是她目前對美國經濟更大的擔憂。她強調，Fed的物價穩定與充分就業雙重使命目前並不存在衝突，因為通膨仍明顯高於目標，勞動市場則大致處於充分就業附近，意味貨幣政策仍須優先處理物價壓力。哈瑪克表示，近期與企業及社區人士交流時，廣泛聽到對能源成本、供應鏈中斷、保險費用上漲及AI熱潮推升支出的擔憂。她指出，這是上任以來首次聽到企業明確要求Fed採取行動遏制通膨，也首次聽到部分難以維持生計的消費者流露日益加深的絕望情緒，反映高物價不僅影響企業成本，也持續侵蝕家庭實質購買力與生活承受能力。哈瑪克的表態緊接在達拉斯聯邦銀行總裁蘿莉．洛根(Lorie Logan)之後。洛根日前主張進一步提高利率，認為通膨尚未呈現持續回落至Fed 2%目標的明確趨勢。哈瑪克與洛根今年均擁有聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)投票權，兩位具表決權官員接連放鷹，顯示Fed內部政策辯論正由先前討論降息時點，轉向是否需要再次升息以防止通膨預期重新失控。Fed將於7月28

title_en: Harmack said that inflation is still too high, the Fed is raising interest rates, and the regular meeting at the end of July is expected to remain unchanged.
summary_en: [Financial News Flash/Chen Mengshuo] Cleveland Federal Bank President Beth. Beth Hammack issued a hawkish signal last Friday (17th), bluntly stating that while consumer spending remains resilient and the unemployment rate remains low, continued high inflation is her current greater concern about the U.S. economy. She emphasized that there is currently no conflict between the Fed's dual missions of price stability and full employment, because inflation is still significantly higher than the target and the labor market is roughly near full employment, which means that monetary policy must still prioritize dealing with price pressures. Hammaker said that in recent interactions with businesses and community members, concerns about energy costs, supply chain disruptions, rising insurance costs and rising expenditures driven by the AI ​​boom have been widely heard. She pointed out that this is the first time since taking office that she has heard companies explicitly request the Fed to take action to curb inflation, and it is also the first time she has heard some consumers who are struggling to make ends meet express their deepening despair, reflecting that high prices not only affect business costs, but also continue to erode families' real purchasing power and affordability. Hammaker's statement came immediately after Federal Bank of Dallas President Lori. After Lorie Logan. Logan recently advocated further raising interest rates, believing that inflation has not yet shown a clear trend of continuing to fall back to the Fed's 2% target. Harmack and Logan both have voting rights on the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) this year, and the two voting officials have made hawkish statements one after another, indicating that the Fed's internal policy debate is shifting from the previous discussion of interest rate cuts to whether it is necessary to raise interest rates again to prevent inflation expectations from getting out of control again. title_en: The war crossed the civilian red line + Homuz shipping was blocked. The two major oil futures rose 4.3% last Friday and soared 15% on the week
summary_en: [Financial News Flash/Chen Mengshuo] The scope of mutual attacks between the United States and Iran has expanded from military targets to bridges, ports, power plants and desalination facilities. The market is worried that the conflict has crossed the "red line" of civilian infrastructure and may further affect the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, the two major energy waterways. New York oil futures surged to a more than one-month high last Friday (17th). Iran attacked Kuwait's hydropower facilities, and the US military extended its attacks to transportation and port facilities in southern Iran. Coupled with attacks on merchant ships and an escalation of maritime blockades, traders quickly increased the risk premium for crude oil supply interruptions. New York August oil futures closed up US$3.42, or 4.3%, at US$82.49 per barrel on the 17th, the highest closing price in more than a month; September Brent oil futures closed up US$3.64, or 4.3%, at US$88.10 per barrel. New York oil futures surged by about 15.5% for the week, and Brent oil futures rose by about 15.9%, both experiencing their largest weekly gains since the breakdown of the US-Iran ceasefire agreement. Shipping data deepened supply concerns. Ship tracking agency Kpler pointed out that only 8 ships were confirmed to pass through the Strait of Hormuz on the 16th, which dropped to the lowest level in the past three weeks, and 7 of them chose to pass through the Iranian side of the channel. Iran said that a Thai ship trying to cross the strait without permission from the Revolutionary Guard Navy was intercepted and attacked; the U.S. Central Command stated that within three days of the restoration of the naval blockade, it had forced four commercial ships to change course, made one incapacitated, and boarded another ship for inspection, indicating that the passage of the strait has transformed from a commercial shipping issue into a direct military confrontation. title_en: Power Semiconductor Selected for more than 100 days
summary_en: Power Semiconductor (6770) benefited from a significant increase in ASP. Revenue in the second quarter of this year (2026) increased by 27%, gross profit margin jumped to 28%, and net earnings per share (EPS) after tax was 0.76 yuan, both better than market expectations. Looking forward to the market outlook, it is expected that the new round of DRAM price increases will reach 45%, and logic will also increase by 10% to 15% in July, which is expected to further increase the volume of operations in the second half of the year. The company is also actively investing in the 3D AI Foundry business. Among them, silicon capacitors have been adopted and shipped by Intel EMIB. In the future, it is expected to work with Interposer, WoW, etc. to simultaneously create new growth momentum. The outlook for the second half of this year and next year will benefit from price increases and continues to be optimistic.

title_en: The number of U.S. oil wells has increased for five consecutive weeks, the total number of drilling rigs has risen to a 15-month high, and the potential for supply growth has heated up.
summary_en: [Financial News Flash/Chen Mengshuo] U.S. energy companies continue to increase drilling activities. At a time when the U.S.-Iran conflict has pushed up oil prices and production incentives, the number of oil well platforms has risen to a high of more than a year, indicating that shale oil companies are gradually resuming upstream investment. Drilling rigs are regarded as a leading indicator of future production. If oil prices remain high and drive more investment in drilling equipment, it may increase the growth potential of U.S. crude oil supply in the second half of the year and form a partial check on the geopolitical risk premium in the medium term. Reuters reported that energy services company Baker Hughes announced that the total number of oil and natural gas drilling rigs in the United States increased by seven to 588 in the week ended July 17, rising for the fifth consecutive week. It was the first five consecutive increases since early June and hit the highest level since April 2025. Compared with the same period last year, the total number of platforms increased by 44, or about 8%, indicating that drilling activity has been significantly higher than the level a year ago. In terms of classification, the number of oil drilling rigs increased by 7 in a single week to 452, the highest since May 2025; the number of natural gas drilling rigs remained unchanged at 126, and other types of platforms were also unchanged at 10. This total increase was entirely driven by oil wells, reflecting that after the escalation of the war between the United States and Iran, the obstruction of passage in the Strait of Hormuz, and the sharp rise in international oil prices, producers became more optimistic about the economic benefits of crude oil drilling, but the natural gas industry has not yet significantly accelerated its expansion. Market participants pointed out that the increase in platforms will not be immediately converted into production. There is usually a time gap between drilling, completion and formal production, and shale oil companies have still attached great importance to capital discipline and shareholder returns in recent years. summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，蘋果公司(Apple Inc)與美國司法部正在就和解2024年的違反反托辣斯法訴訟進行初步磋商。根據知情人士透露，雙方的談判正在進行中，但無法保證協議的最終達成。目前該案尚未確定開庭日期。不願公開身份的知情人士表示，蘋果公司今年已多次向司法部提出和解方案。司法部與企業之間的和解談判也可能沒有結果。對於上述消息，蘋果方面拒絕置評。司法部暫無就此作出回應。

title_en: Apple launches preliminary settlement talks with U.S. Department of Justice in antitrust case
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports indicate that Apple Inc and the U.S. Department of Justice are in preliminary negotiations to settle antitrust law violation lawsuits in 2024. According to people familiar with the matter, negotiations between the two parties are ongoing, but there is no guarantee that an agreement will be reached. No court date has been set for the case yet. Apple has made multiple settlement offers to the Justice Department this year, said people familiar with the matter who asked not to be identified. title_en: Tariffs expire on the 24th! Trump takes over Article 301 and imposes tax hikes on 60 countries. Will Taiwan escape the disaster?
summary_en: The global 10% temporary tariff implemented by the Trump administration in accordance with Article 122 of the Trade Act will expire on the 24th. The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) is expected to replace it with Article 301 of the Trade Act, which has a more stable source of law, and launch a new round of tariff measures for about 60 countries. The tariff rates of most countries such as Japan and South Korea will increase from 10% to 12.5%. Since Taiwan has signed the Taiwan-US Reciprocal Trade Agreement (ART) with the United States, it is expected to be listed as one of the 14 countries that propose to impose a lower tax rate of 10%, alongside Canada, Mexico and the United Kingdom.

title_en: A large-scale food safety issue has emerged in the United States. More than 5,000 people have been infected with parasites. Two major suppliers have urgently withdrawn Mexican lettuce.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Reuters reported that the largest foodborne disease epidemic in the United States in recent years continues to expand. California lettuce supplier Taylor Farms and Sysco, the largest food distributor in the United States, announced on Friday (17th) that they would withdraw iceberg lettuce from central Mexico. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has traced the outbreak to a lettuce supplier used by some Taco Bell stores. The related chopped iceberg lettuce is suspected to be related to large-scale infections of cyclosporiasis. Taylor Farms stated that based on information provided by the FDA on the 16th, it has stopped supplying iceberg lettuce from central Mexico, but emphasized that neither Taylor Farms brand salads nor salad combo packs are involved in this wave of epidemics, and its brand salad combo packs do not use iceberg lettuce. Sources revealed that Taylor Farms has notified customers, including Taco Bell parent company Yum Brands and Sysco, to withdraw related chopped lettuce; Sysco also confirmed that it has stopped selling and delivering all Mexican iceberg lettuce supplied by Taylor Farms. The FDA and the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) are investigating the availability of shredded iceberg lettuce at Taco Bell stores in Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio and West Virginia. Cyclospora infection can cause diarrhea and other gastrointestinal symptoms. About 100 people have been hospitalized so far, and there have been no deaths. Michigan has reported a total of 5,002 cases as of Friday.

title_en: China’s “industrial vitamin” molybdenum prices soared, with ferromolybdenum rising more than 35% during the year, hitting a three-year high
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] China's molybdenum market has continued to strengthen this year. The price of molybdenum, known as the "industrial vitamin", has further exceeded previous highs. Both ferromolybdenum and molybdenum concentrates have risen to their highest levels in the past three years. Antaike data shows that on July 16, the quoted price of ferromolybdenum rose to RMB 335,000 per ton (the same below), a cumulative increase of 35.35% since the beginning of the year; the quoted price of molybdenum concentrate rose to RMB 5,335 per ton, an increase of 41.69% during the year, reflecting that China's molybdenum market still maintains a strong pattern under the support of tight raw materials and downstream demand. The head of China Molybdenum's smelting business pointed out that the price of ferromolybdenum was 332,000 yuan per ton on July 14, an increase of 1,500 yuan from the previous day, and the quotation was further pushed up thereafter. Ferromolybdenum is the core finished product after smelting molybdenum concentrate. It is also an indispensable alloy additive for high-strength steel, stainless steel, heat-resistant steel and other special steels. Price increases will directly push up the manufacturing costs of some high-end steel products and equipment. This wave of gains is mainly due to tight supply and demand. In addition to traditional steel metallurgy, on the demand side, the use of molybdenum in high-end equipment, marine engineering, wind power, new energy and military special steel continues to increase; on the supply side, affected by the limited number of new large-scale mines, the slow increase in production of some copper-molybdenum associated mines, and insufficient spot circulation, the bargaining power of the raw material side has significantly improved. China has the world's largest molybdenum ore reserves and is also an important production and consumption market. The rapid rise in domestic quotations has indicator significance for global molybdenum product prices. Market participants pointed out that in the short term, molybdenum prices are still supported by steel plant bidding, raw material costs and tight supply. However, after the price rises rapidly, it must also be observed.

title: 美擬推新外援，撥款扶植歐洲MAGA陣營、200萬美元反制歐盟科技法規
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】英國《金融時報》報導，川普政府準備公布一系列針對歐洲及其他地區的新補助計畫，將美國對外援助資源轉向支持與「讓美國再次偉大」(MAGA)理念相近的組織與倡議，反映華府正大幅改寫傳統外援政策，把言論自由、國家主權、反審查及保守派價值納入資金分配核心。根據美國國務院提交國會的通知副本，其中一項提案將撥款200萬美元，支持反制歐盟數位服務法(DSA)及數位市場法(DMA)所造成「審查」的團體。另據《金融時報》報導，相關規劃還包括500萬美元用於在歐洲建立所謂「文明聯盟」、500萬美元支持國際言論自由組織，以及4000萬美元撥給共產主義受難者紀念基金會。川普政府長期批評歐盟數位監管制度壓制言論自由，並對美國大型科技企業形成不公平限制。美國國務院今年稍早已表明，將資助西方盟國境內推動言論自由的計畫；華府也曾考慮制裁負責執行歐盟科技法規的官員。歐盟方面則否認相關法律構成政治審查，強調DSA旨在要求大型平台處理非法內容，DMA則著重限制大型數位平台濫用市場支配地位。這項政策若正式落實，意味美國外援將由傳統的人道援助、民主治理與經濟發展工具，進一步轉化為介入盟國政治及文化議題的槓桿。

title: 波灣7月上半月原油出口急增16%，戰火再起拖慢荷姆茲海峽通行
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，波灣產油國7月上半月原油出口一度回升至美伊戰爭爆發前以來最高水準，帶動市場供應憂慮降溫，但隨美伊敵對行動重新升級，荷姆茲海峽油輪通行量已明顯放緩。分析人士警告，若海運持續受阻，波灣產油國可能被迫削減產量，先前短暫出現的出口復甦恐難延續，全球原油供應風險也將再次升高。航運數據顯示，沙烏地阿拉伯、阿拉伯聯合大公國、伊拉克、科威特及伊朗7月上半月原油與凝析油出口量，較6月全月日均水準增加約16%，達每日1,200萬桶，創2月底伊朗戰爭爆發前以來最高。Vortexa估算同期出口量更高達每日1,306萬桶。不過，即使出口反彈，仍較2月戰前每日1,760萬桶的高峰低約32%。Kpler指出，沙烏地阿拉伯、伊朗及伊拉克是7月上半月出口回升的主要推手；Vortexa則估計，伊拉克月比增幅最大，阿聯酋出口則由6月紀錄高點回落。美國與伊朗6月中旬達成臨時協議，一度重新開放荷姆茲海峽並尋求更全面的停戰安排，供應緊張情緒隨之降溫，油價亦承受回檔壓力，但雙方因海峽管理權出現歧見，臨時協議在7月初破裂。隨雙方空襲再次升高，荷姆茲海峽商品油輪通行量已降至週四僅三艘，創5月以來單日最低。

title: 醫界聯盟基金會林世嘉：GLP-1國際政策賽道已經確立 台灣應儘早卡位
summary: 台灣醫界聯盟基金會執行長林世嘉近日表示，世界衛生組織（WHO）於2025年9月將GLP-1藥物納入基本藥物清單、12月再發布肥胖症治療指引，將肥胖定調為慢性、復發性疾病；美國Medicare自2026年7月啟動GLP-1 Bridge計畫，正式將肥胖治療納入公共保險與慢病預防體系，國際政策動向顯示「賽道已經確立」，台灣應提前卡位。

title_en: Lin Shijia from the Medical Alliance Foundation: The GLP-1 international policy track has been established and Taiwan should secure its position as soon as possible
summary_en: Lin Shijia, CEO of the Taiwan Medical Alliance Foundation, recently stated that the World Health Organization (WHO) will include GLP-1 drugs in the list of essential drugs in September 2025, and will issue obesity treatment guidelines in December, defining obesity as a chronic and relapsing disease. In the United States, Medicare will launch the GLP-1 Bridge program in July 2026, officially incorporating obesity treatment into the public insurance and chronic disease prevention system. International policy trends show that "the track has been established," and Taiwan should get in early.

summary_en: The "Cold Spring Concert" and "Carnival Water Splashing Festival" in Suao, Yilan, which were postponed due to the typhoon, were held on two consecutive days. At the same time, the first wave of lucky winners were drawn. Especially during the Water Splashing Festival this afternoon, in order to let everyone spray water and enjoy the coolness, the public office specially closed the section of the Suao train station, allowing tourists to bring water guns and put on goggles to have fun. title_en: The barrier lake has not overflowed yet, and Taiwan Railway trains will run normally on all lines before 12 noon tomorrow.
summary_en: The Central Disaster Response Center held the 12th Information Research and Assessment Meeting and Work Report on the Wanli Creek Barrier Lake this afternoon. The meeting pointed out that the Hualien Wanli Creek Barrier Lake had not overflowed as of 3 p.m. The Taiwan Railway Corporation stated that all trains on all levels will run normally before 12:00 noon tomorrow (20th). The train operation information after 12:00 noon will be subject to changes in the overflow level of Wanli Creek Barrier Lake and a press release will be issued before 10:00 tomorrow morning.

title_en: Barrier lake overflow warning is on! Precautionary bridge closure from 10pm tonight to 6pm tomorrow morning. 1 picture showing alternative routes
summary_en: The Central Disaster Response Center held the 12th Information Research and Assessment Meeting and Work Report on Wanlixi Barrier Lake this afternoon. The meeting pointed out that Hualien Wanlixi Barrier Lake had not overflowed as of 3 p.m., but the Highway Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation stated that considering the nighttime water flow, Due to poor monitoring visibility, the bridge will be closed as an early warning from 10pm today (19th) to 6am tomorrow (20th). Depending on the situation of the barrier lake overflowing or the water level rising significantly, the bridge closure time will be adjusted on a rolling basis to maintain the safety of passers-by.

title_en: There will still be plenty of moisture in the south tomorrow. "Beware of short-term heavy rains in these two places." A tropical system may develop in the second half of the week.
summary_en: There will still be plenty of moisture in the south tomorrow, with occasional brief showers or thunderstorms. Zhang Chengchuan, a forecaster from the Central Meteorological Administration, said that special attention should be paid to short-duration heavy rains in the northern and central mountainous areas in the afternoon. From Wednesday, it will turn into an afternoon thundershower pattern, and the rainfall will gradually slow down. In the second half of the week, tropical systems will still develop in the sea from Guam to the east of the Philippines. However, the locations and paths predicted by models in various countries are quite different, and continuous observation is required.

title: 今明兩天午後防短延時豪雨 關島至菲律賓東方海面有熱帶擾動發展
summary: 中央氣象署預報員張承傳上午指出，今明兩天持續受西南風影響，南部整天有不定時短暫陣雨或雷雨，並有局部大雨，中部以北午後有短延時豪雨發生機率。周二起太平洋高壓西伸，各地午後降雨逐漸減少。此外，本周關島至菲律賓東方海面有熱帶擾動發展跡象，不過位置及路徑仍有不確定性，後續須持續觀察。

title_en: Prevent short-term heavy rains in the afternoon today and tomorrow, and a tropical disturbance will develop in the sea east of Guam to the Philippines
summary_en: Zhang Chengchuan, a forecaster from the Central Meteorological Administration, pointed out in the morning that today and tomorrow will continue to be affected by southwesterly winds. There will be sporadic short showers or thunderstorms in the south throughout the day, as well as local heavy rains. There is a chance of short-term heavy rains in the afternoon in the north of the central area. The Pacific high pressure will extend westward from Tuesday, and rainfall will gradually decrease in various places in the afternoon. In addition, there are signs of the development of tropical disturbances in the sea east of Guam to the Philippines this week, but the location and path are still uncertain, and follow-up observations must be continued.

title_en: Life insurance talent hunt is recruiting 18,000 people, offering high bonuses to attract young and cross-industry manpower

According to statistics, the total number of employees of seven companies in the second half of the year exceeds 18,000. title: 金融業掀史上最大籌資潮 上半年衝2,217億 年增逾32%
summary: 金融業籌資潮今年可望站上高峰。據金管會統計，上半年銀行、券商及產壽險現增與發債合計2,217億元，年增32.7%，已達去年全年史上高峰4,384億元的51%，銀行、壽險及券商三路搶錢，全年再創新高有望。
title_zh: 金融業掀史上最大籌資潮 上半年衝2,217億 年增逾32%

title_en: The financial industry has launched the largest fundraising wave in history, reaching 221.7 billion in the first half of the year, an increase of more than 32% year-on-year
summary_en: The financing wave in the financial industry is expected to reach its peak this year. According to statistics from the Financial Supervisory Commission, in the first half of the year, banks, securities companies and property and life insurance companies added a total of 221.7 billion yuan in current and bond issuances, an annual increase of 32.7%, which has reached 51% of last year's historical peak of 438.4 billion yuan. Banks, life insurance companies and securities companies are competing for money, and the whole year is expected to hit a new high.
