title_en: The annual interest rate of US dollar fixed deposits has increased to 12%. Wangdaoyin launches the most favorable high-interest project for new accounts.
summary_en: Recently, officials from the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) have successively released hawkish signals. The market is optimistic about the accelerated flow of funds into U.S. dollar assets. Many domestic banks have also laid out favorable plans for U.S. dollar fixed deposits in the second half of the year. Among them, Wangdao Bank has launched a U.S. dollar fixed deposit with an annual interest rate of up to 12%, which is the "ceiling" in the current market. In addition, including Standard Chartered Bank, KGI Bank, and Commonwealth Bank, the annual U.S. dollar fixed deposit interest rate has reached a maximum of 10%.

title_en: The Taiwanese version of VT will be on the road! Avoid the strangulation of a single stock category, even lazy people can make global wealth steadily
summary_en: Recently, the AI ​​and semiconductor groups have been facing profit-taking selling pressure. Market funds have quietly staged a strong storm in the sector, and the investment logic has shifted from chasing a single hot topic to examining fundamentals. BlackRock Investment Trust launched the Global Stock ETF (009826), which focuses on cross-border and cross-industry diversified allocations. By investing in nearly 40 countries and 11 major industries, it helps investors reduce their dependence on specific sectors, just like adding shock absorbers to asset allocation. This ETF is denominated in New Taiwan dollars and has an accumulation design, eliminating the hassle of currency exchange and taxation of overseas dividends. It allows investors to participate in the global rise in the volatile AI era through a robust strategy that does not require guesswork. The fund-raising activity will end on July 21, making it a new investment option to avoid the shock of a single industry.

title_en: Niche credit cards exit the market in the second half of the year and reach new highs
summary_en: The “CUBE-ization” of the credit card market has led to the accelerated withdrawal of niche credit cards. In the second half of this year alone, at least 10 credit cards have entered history, such as the Taishin Woojii card and the Taishin Sanshang Meiban co-branded card. The former was due to the expiration of the contract between the two parties, and the latter was suspended after Sanshou was acquired by Yushan Financial Holdings. However, they reached the same goal in different ways. In the end, they were all replaced by Richart cards with optional benefits.

title_en: Taiwan index futures rebound nearly 1,000 points, Taiwan stocks hold on to 42,000
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market experienced its biggest "Black Friday" drop in history last week, and whether it will continue to fall this week has attracted much attention. Taiwan stock analysts believe that the Taiwan Index futures rebounded nearly 1,000 points on Friday night. Although it was a weak rebound, it has stabilized slightly and can be relieved. However, if the Korean stock market continues to decline, Taiwan stocks will also be dragged down. If the neckline of 42,000 points is not held, it is very likely to face a defense battle of 40,000 points.

title_en: TSMC CoPoS supplier Ming-Chi Kuo estimates there are variables
summary_en: TSMC held a press conference last week. Chairman Wei Zhejia was asked about the use of glass as packaging technology. He revealed that the packaging technology is still building a trial production line, and it is estimated that the technology will mature and be introduced into production in one year. Although Wei Zhejia did not directly mention "CoPoS" during the meeting, analysts interpreted that the advanced packaging technology with glass as the core is the CoPoS packaging that the market is focusing on, and reminded that the manufacturers currently participating in the supply chain are not necessarily the final suppliers.

title_en: Not afraid of plummeting, TSMC and MediaTek shareholders increase by more than 20,000
summary_en: Taiwan stocks experienced violent fluctuations last week. The weighted index fell 2,683.34 points in a single week, a drop of 5.92%. The share prices of the four largest stocks all closed in the black. However, retail investors did not completely withdraw from the market. Instead, they bought more and more as they fell; according to statistics from the China Insurance Clearing House, TSMC The number of shareholders of MediaTek increased by more than 20,000 in a single week. The four weight stocks added a total of 55,219 new shareholders in a single week, of which 49,647 were odd-lot investors. This shows that petty bourgeoisie are actively using odd lots to seize advantage of large technology stocks when they plummet.

title_en: The origin of the global financial crisis? Analysts warn of "systemic risks" in Taiwan, Japan and South Korea
summary_en: Is the "Grond Zero" of a potential global financial crisis right under our feet? Eugenio Catone, an analyst at the U.S. stock trading platform Seek Alpha, wrote an article warning that the stock market bubbles in Taiwan, South Korea, and Japan are huge, with a combined size of US$18 trillion. Among them, Taiwan and South Korea's semiconductor stocks are overvalued, coupled with the latter's retail investors' leverage, and the mines laid by the continued weakening of the yen, they are intertwining into systemic risks that global investors should beware of. He is worried that the stock markets of the three countries are all supported by narrow stocks. Once the leading stocks retreat, it may drag down the entire market.

title_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs plans to force large electricity consumers to install power generation and energy storage equipment. More than 400 people in these industries will be affected.
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan is scheduled to review the "draft amendments to some provisions of the Energy Management Law" this Wednesday. According to the plan of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, this revision of the law will clearly stipulate that "large electricity consumers" with a contract capacity of more than 5,000 kW (watts) will be forced to set up their own power generation equipment and energy storage equipment. title_en: Gold price rises and collapses Rogers: People who panic sell have one thing wrong
summary_en: The international gold price has risen sharply since 2024, reaching a record high in January 2026. However, it subsequently faced violent fluctuations, with the market falling by more than 5% in a single day twice. Well-known investor Jim Rogers analyzed that factors such as geopolitics and inflation have pushed up gold prices, and the short-term sharp decline is mostly a normal correction. Rogers emphasized that gold should be regarded as insurance rather than investment. It is an excellent store of value and can provide protection when assets plummet. He suggested that investors should hold for the long term, adopt a batch layout strategy, and avoid chasing highs and lows. He also reminded investors to fully understand asset risks, prudently evaluate market fluctuations, and not to panic due to short-term fluctuations. They should establish a sound asset allocation concept to resist financial risks.

title_en: Taiwan stocks plummeted 2,953 points, scaring investors! KGI reveals the truth and says to do this
summary_en: Affected by the recent deleveraging in the South Korean stock market, which triggered a sharp decline in technology stocks and market doubts about the growth of the AI ​​industry, global stock markets simultaneously experienced a significant retracement on the 17th. Taiwan's weighted index also experienced a gap-down at the opening on the 17th, and its closing point expanded to 2953.71 points, a drop of as much as 6.47%. KGI Investments pointed out that in addition to being affected by short-term profit-taking and market sentiment, this decline also reflects the huge rise in AI-related stocks in the past period and the risk adjustment and chip reorganization of funds after the increase in global leverage. It can be regarded as a healthy "chip defoaming". If market fluctuations are viewed from a long-term holding perspective, short-term declines are expected to be transformed into medium- and long-term asset appreciation opportunities.

title_en: Yingwei released important news: the Intellectual Property Court ruled to reject the lawsuit
summary_en: Yingwei (6515) issued an important announcement on the 19th. The announcement stated that the Intellectual Property and Commercial Court has made a first-instance judgment regarding the civil damages lawsuit arising from unfair competition and improper exercise of intellectual property rights with Wangsi. The main text is "The plaintiff's lawsuit is dismissed, and the litigation costs shall be borne by the plaintiff." Yingwei said that the complete judgment has not yet been received, and the reasons for the court's judgment are still not known. After receiving the judgment, the subsequent legal procedures will be discussed with the appointed lawyer, and relief will not be ruled out in accordance with the law to safeguard the company's rights and interests.

title_en: Peach machines curb the chaos of using signboards and baggage occupying seats. Violators will be fined up to RMB 25,000 starting from August.
summary_en: For group travelers coming to Taiwan to join a travel agency itinerary, many operators will provide airport pick-up services. However, some pick-up personnel use stand-up signs, luggage or personal belongings to occupy the low wall at the passenger exit of the pick-up hall, affecting the flow of passengers and the orderly flow of terminal operations. The Taoyuan Airport Company stated that there have been disputes over space occupation in the past, and it will strengthen publicity before the end of this month. Starting from August, those who violate the regulations and do not listen to advice will be fined in accordance with the law, with a fine of more than 5,000 yuan and not more than 25,000 yuan.

title_en: Taiwan Stocks After Black Friday, Three Must-See Risks Before Opening
summary_en: Affected by the drag of Korean stocks and high market leverage, Taiwan stocks plunged 2,953 points on Friday, breaking the quarterly line and closing at 42,671 points, a weekly decline of nearly 6%. The three major legal entities made a total withdrawal of more than 380 billion this week, and only the investment bank continued to be overbought. Du Xinpei, manager of Yushan Small and Medium Cap Fund, pointed out that the recent high level of financing and the confusion of rising chips have led to deleveraging, but the long-term trend of AI has not changed, corporate profits are stable, and the evaluation of Taiwan stocks at this stage is becoming more reasonable. It is recommended that investors do not need to panic and can take advantage of the retracement to deploy AI leading stocks, cloud components and power supply chains in batches. The current price-to-earnings ratio range of Taiwanese stocks has moved upward. If it corrects to near the quarterly line, it will be a mid- to long-term entry opportunity worthy of attention. Investors should make careful assessments, pay attention to geopolitics and US stock market fluctuations, remember that investments are risky, and the layout should focus on core holdings.

title_en: Formosa Petrochemical: Gasoline and diesel prices will not be adjusted starting from the 20th
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Wu Jiahao, Taipei, 19th) The conflict between the United States and Iran has heated up rapidly, and international oil prices have continued to rise. In order to stabilize prices, China National Petroleum Corporation announced that gasoline and diesel prices will not be adjusted starting from the 20th. Formosa Petrochemical Company followed up with the freeze increase today. From 1 a.m. on the 20th, the wholesale prices of gasoline and diesel will not be adjusted. The market retail prices are determined by the franchised gas stations.

summary_en: According to TrendForce’s latest robot industry research, in addition to the long-term care companionship and healing design dominated by Japan in the early days, companion robots have expanded to real-person interaction and emotional companionship in recent years. title_en: Sichuan Investment Gu new move! Pay millions a month to be the first to read Trump’s posts, and get bombarded with policy announcements turning into product sales
summary_en: "Trump Media and Technology Group" (TMTG), a social media company owned by U.S. President Trump, recently launched a paid authorized data streaming service called "Truth API" for Wall Street traders and investment institutions. According to people familiar with the matter, the service charges a maximum of US$100,000 per month, equivalent to approximately NT$3.24 million, allowing financial operators to obtain instant posts from core accounts such as Trump as quickly as possible. As soon as this bold business model was exposed, it immediately attracted attention in the financial and political circles.

title_en: Taiwan stock market crashes on an epic scale! The weekly line is black twice in a row. Legal person: Don’t blindly kill lows in panic.
summary_en: The weighted index fell 2,953 points last Friday to close at 42,671 points, a decrease of 6.4%, with a trading volume of 1.3 trillion yuan. In terms of chips, the three major legal persons sold more than 263.14 billion yuan, of which foreign spot sales exceeded 188.31 billion yuan, futures net short orders increased by 1,736 lots to 86,189 lots; investment trust buying exceeded 7.34 billion yuan, and self-operated traders sold more than 82.17 billion yuan. Last week, Taiwan stocks fell 2,683 points, or 5.9%, marking the second consecutive black week.

title_en: Kissinger said that if China cuts off Taiwan's energy, the global economy will be worse than the Great Depression...The Ministry of Economic Affairs responded
summary_en: Former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said in a recent interview that the world is overly dependent on Taiwanese chips. If China completely cuts off Taiwan's energy supply, causing Taiwan to face a power crisis, the global economy will be worse than the "Great Depression" of the 1930s. In response, the Ministry of Economic Affairs solemnly responded on the 19th that Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain has not been completely disrupted so far. title_en: From ex-dividends to dividend reinvestment, KGI Securities connects life scenes to create a safe investment ecosystem
summary_en: As Taiwan stocks enter the peak season of ex-rights and dividends, high yield rates and interest rate filling have once again become the focus of the market. KGI Securities reminds us that dividends are not additional compensation that is added out of thin air. After ex-dividend, the stock price will be adjusted according to the amount of the dividend. Investors should not only use the yield rate as the basis for judgment, but should also conduct a comprehensive evaluation from the aspects of corporate profitability, cash flow stability, dividend sustainability, and long-term total return.

summary_en: In June, global stock markets were affected by geopolitics, inflation and interest rate policy uncertainties, and their volatility increased significantly. However, the fluctuations encouraged investors to be more courageous to enter the market. According to statistics from "Juheng Buying Fund", the platform's subscription amount exceeded 20 billion yuan in June, setting a new monthly high in history. title_en: Fubon Securities guided Dapeng Technology to complete the auction with an underwriting price of 180.53 yuan
summary_en: Dapeng Technology (7689), guided by Fubon Securities, completed the bidding opening on July 17. The number of shares auctioned this time was 3,634 thousand shares. The lowest bid price was 166.50 yuan per share, the highest bid price was 220 yuan per share, the weighted average price of the bids was 180.53 yuan per share, and the underwriting price was set at 180.53 yuan. In addition, the company has also conducted public subscription. The number of shares subscribed is 1,588 thousand shares, and the subscription price is 180.53 yuan. The subscription period is until July 20, and a public lottery will be held on July 22. It is expected to be listed on July 28.

title_en: The stock exchange joined hands with the Overseas Securities Trading Center to hold a publicity conference on my country’s green securities certification system, which concluded successfully
summary_en: In order to help listed OTC companies smoothly integrate green finance policies and jointly create a new milestone in the sustainable development of the capital market, the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC Securities Exchange Center successfully held an online and physical promotion conference for the "my country Green Securities Certification System" in July, attracting more than 500 sustainability promotion personnel from listed OTC companies to participate. title_en: KGI Investments: Healthy “chip defoaming” is expected to turn into asset appreciation opportunities
summary_en: Taiwan stocks closed at 2953.71 points last Friday (17th), a drop of 6.47%. KGI Investments pointed out that in addition to being affected by short-term profit-taking and market sentiment, this decline also reflects the huge rise in AI-related stocks in the past period and the risk adjustment and chip reorganization of funds after the increase in global leverage. It can be regarded as a healthy "chip defoaming". If market fluctuations are viewed from a long-term holding perspective, short-term declines are expected to be transformed into medium- and long-term asset appreciation opportunities.

title_en: Four counties and cities discuss joint food safety prevention in response to the poisonous oil case. Jiang Wanan calls for three key points in amending the law.
summary_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wanan went to Taichung on the 19th to discuss the poisonous oil incident with Taichung City Mayor Lu Xiuyan, Yunlin County Mayor Zhang Lishan, and Keelung City Mayor Xie Guoliang. In an interview before the meeting, Jiang Wanan said that in the face of this poisonous oil incident, the Taichung City Government immediately informed the Taipei City Government after grasping the flow of the product and the list of operators, and only then did the Taipei City Government take precautionary measures to remove the product from the shelves and publish the list of operators. Therefore, today the four county and city governments of Keelung, Yunlin, Taichung, and Taipei gathered together again to continue joint prevention and discuss relevant opinions including the revision of the food safety law.

title_en: Unexpected revelations about drone procurement...Ministry of Economic Affairs: Don’t let political squabbles cause a chilling effect on Taiwanese factories
summary_en: Recently, the outside world erroneously broke the news about the Ministry of National Defense’s drone/drone defense system procurement case. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that the country has the need to develop a drone strategy from a security perspective. If domestic industry players can make their own, in addition to industrial development, it is also a part of security resilience. After selection by a selection steering group jointly established by the three ministries, 9 manufacturers of qualified military commercial drones and 4 manufacturers of drone defense systems were selected and recommended to the Ministry of National Defense for reference. Subsequent vendor selections were also conducted in accordance with the law and based on the needs of the national military, without any private involvement. There is no need for political attacks and defenses to cause a chilling effect on domestic businesses and harm Taiwan's security and industry.

title_en: The Taiwan stock market plunged nearly 3,000 points and the market fell into panic. Why did Ruan Muhua "buy more the more it fell" after comparing the data of the 2020 stock market crash?
summary_en: Taiwan stocks closed down nearly 3,000 points on the 17th, triggering market panic. In this regard, financial expert Ruan Muhua pointed out that his own statistics on the decline of Taiwan stocks over the years showed that Taiwan stocks fell by 30% in 2020, with a median retracement of 16%, and this wave has retraced 11%, which is not far from the backtest data of the previous stock market crash. He bluntly said that even if it falls by another 5% next week, Taiwan stocks will not be in danger of turning into a short position. He stressed, "If it falls again next week, I will buy again!" Based on past experience, Ruan Muhua posted on Facebook that Taiwan stocks will fall in varying degrees every year, and he made statistics from 1991 to 2026, excluding the year of the big drop in 1990. After statistics, he found that the median maximum drawdown (MDD) of the weighted index over the years was 20%; the maximum annual historical decline during the statistical period was 56%. (2008), the median recovery trading day is 102 days (the number of trading days required for the index to close back to the high point before the retracement starting from the low point of the year). Ruan Muhua further borrowed data to illustrate that if the cycle is brought closer to after 2020 (including 2020), the maximum retracement of the band will be about 30%, and the median retracement will be 16%. In this regard, this wave of weighted index retracement has reached 11%, which is close to the median retracement range in 2020. Even if it falls by another 5% next week, it will fall to around 40,000 points. He believes that there is no chance that Taiwan stocks will turn into a short crisis. title_en: Qing'an 3.0 Guide 2/Newlyweds and children enjoy a quota of 15 million, and the full monthly payment of a good loan will increase by 14,500
summary_en: Qing'an 3.0 offers a big red envelope for marriage and childbirth. Families can borrow up to NT$12 million within two years of marriage, and families with minor children can borrow up to NT$15 million. This is NT$5 million more than the average first-time homebuyer, making them the group that will benefit most from the new system. However, experts remind that the increase in the loan limit will reduce the pressure of self-prepared funds, but it does not mean that the monthly payment is less. If the loan is really over 15 million yuan, even if you enjoy the preferential interest rate of 1.775%, you will still have to repay 43,668 yuan per month. Compared with the loan limit of 10 million yuan, the monthly repayment is 14,556 yuan more.

title_en: Taiwan stock market outlook: Jen-Hsun Huang refutes rumors of Rubin Ultra delay, ABF carrier board has not been eliminated, "ASP has doubled"
summary_en: It was originally rumored in the market that in order to reduce the area pressure of advanced packaging interposers approaching the limit, Huida changed Rubin Ultra from a radical single substrate with four dies to two groups of 2-die modular splicing. It was believed that the reduction in the number of dies would lead to a decrease in the number of carrier board layers and a downward revision of specifications. After the Huida roadshow on July 10, the latest market interpretation is that the power consumption and signal density of a single chip of Rubin Ultra are approaching physical limits. If we rashly switch to immature glass packaging, the yield rate will collapse. Therefore, it is speculated that Rubin Ultra still adheres to the ABF carrier board technology route.

title: 從電動車轉移到AI基礎建設 國際功率半導體巨頭跨界淘金
summary: 當ＡＩ的發展從GPU/CPU轉向ＡＩ基礎建設設施時，由於高倍速運算需要強大電源供應來源，因而發展出單一ＡＩ機櫃的功耗普遍從過去的20kW暴增到100kW，甚至未來上看1MW（兆瓦）。這麼強大的電流量需要強大的功率半導體元件來應對。過去這四大車用半導體業者因應電動車強大電流研發出來的功率技術，現在能無縫轉移到ＡＩ基礎建設的商機並不是巧合，而是趨勢使然。當前電動車市場受到中國廉價電動車的衝擊下，歐美各大電動車廠都遭到嚴重的衝擊，連帶影響到車用半導體業者在這方面的需求。從業者最新一季的財報與展望都顯示車用半導體的景氣還在谷底沒有好轉。但ＡＩ資料中心對高效率功率元件的強大需求，剛好承接車用產能的缺口。以前用在電動車的碳化矽晶片，現在賣給Nvidia裝在NVL72的機櫃側邊內。技術的互通性，讓傳統車用晶片業者，就成為ＡＩ時代下解決高電壓直流電方案的新霸主。

title_en: Shifting from electric vehicles to AI infrastructure, international power semiconductor giants cross-border gold rush
summary_en: When the development of AI shifts from GPU/CPU to AI infrastructure, because high-speed computing requires a powerful power supply source, the power consumption of a single AI cabinet has generally increased from 20kW in the past to 100kW, and even 1MW (megawatt) in the future. Such a large amount of current requires powerful power semiconductor components to cope with it. In the past, the power technology developed by the four major automotive semiconductor companies in response to the strong current of electric vehicles can now be seamlessly transferred to the business opportunities of AI infrastructure. It is not a coincidence, but a trend. The electric vehicle market is currently being impacted by China's cheap electric vehicles. Major electric vehicle manufacturers in Europe and the United States have been severely impacted, which has also affected the demand for automotive semiconductor manufacturers in this area. The latest quarterly financial reports and outlook of practitioners show that the automotive semiconductor boom is still at the bottom and has not improved. However, the strong demand for high-efficiency power components in the AI ​​data center just fills the gap in automotive production capacity. Silicon carbide chips that were previously used in electric vehicles are now sold to Nvidia and installed in the side of the NVL72 cabinet. The interoperability of technologies has allowed traditional automotive chip manufacturers to become the new overlords in high-voltage DC solutions in the AI ​​era.

title_en: Four waves of advanced packaging industry trends: InFO helps TSMC shake off Samsung CoWoS and take over the high-end AI battlefield
summary_en: Advanced packaging has become the absolute battlefield for semiconductors to break through computing power bottlenecks! Looking back on this technological revolution, InFO in 2016 proved its huge commercial value for the first time, and also laid a solid foundation for Taiwan's supply chain. The industry moved from two-dimensional to three-dimensional, and from organic materials to glass substrates. In the face of capacity shortages and technology replacement, understanding the industrial logic of technological evolution will be the key to understanding the restructuring of the global semiconductor landscape and the breakthrough of the supply chain. The 2413th issue of "Xiantan Investment Weekly" published this Wednesday will talk to you about TSMC's most powerful weapon, advanced packaging, that subverts the global semiconductor competition. With the demand for AI computing power experiencing an unprecedented explosion, global market funds are highly focused on the same battlefield in the semiconductor supply chain - advanced packaging. There is no other reason. In this era where those with computing power win the world, the performance improvement of a single chip is no longer enough to cope with the huge data throughput. Advanced packaging can integrate computing cores such as GPUs or ASICs and high-bandwidth memories (HBM) in the shortest path and lowest power consumption. Therefore, it has become a core choke point in the current semiconductor supply chain with very tight production capacity. InFO helps TSMC get rid of Samsung. However, this packaging revolution, which affects the competition among global technology giants and also changes the layout of Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain, did not explode overnight. If we want to trace the starting point when advanced packaging truly crossed the cost threshold and moved toward large-scale commercialization, we can go back to 2016. When Apple launched the iPhone 7, its A10 processor used TSMC's InF on a large scale for the first time.

title_en: It has been 10 years since Global Crystal set up a factory in the United States and was bound to Micron. How long will the silicon wafer cycle last? Will we look at these two levels in the next wave of gains?
summary_en: Global Crystal (6488) is one of the top three silicon wafer fabs in the world, capable of providing high-purity 12-inch advanced epitaxial wafers required for high-performance computing HPC and advanced CPUs. It steadily supplies TSMC's 3nm and 2nm advanced processes, which is equivalent to indirectly receiving CPU OEM orders from major manufacturers such as Huida, Intel, AMD, and Apple. As the production capacity of 12-inch wafers continues to be scarce and mature processes have entered an upward cycle, Global Wafer's profitability will grow structurally. The production line in Texas, USA, has been started, and localized production capacity is gradually taking shape, bringing new revenue momentum.

title_en: Advanced Optoelectronics once surged in the short term and its volatility expanded. Can it be upgraded from a Largan concept stock to a CPO beneficiary stock?
summary_en: Largan's CPO progress is established. Is Advanced Optoelectronic's daily limit just the first step to make up for the increase? Largan Optoelectronics said it will further confirm the progress of silicon photonics and CPO layout. The company will give priority to the development of fiber array (Fiber Array, FA) and plans to complete the first automated trial production line by September. At present, FA alignment accuracy has reached less than 0.3 microns, which is better than general commercial products. It shows that Largan's silicon photonics layout has gradually entered the stage of trial production, sample delivery and customer verification from technology research and development. The news drove Largan's stock price to hit its daily limit, and also encouraged reinvested companies to advance their efforts.

summary_en: Huang Shihui, who only took over the board of directors of Tiger Airways Taiwan (hereinafter referred to as Tiger Airways) in April last year, is a rare female leader in Taiwan's aviation industry. Just one year after taking office, she led Tiger Airways to continue to be the profitability champion of Air China in an environment of high fuel prices and high market competition. summary: 近期泛AI產業雜音四起，多空雜陳，尤其是記憶體在三星與海力士股價重挫之際顯得特別敏感。包括大摩示警：DRAM價格與獲利上修空間逼近「變化速率頂峰」；Meta傳出擬對外出租AI算力；中國長鑫存儲可能打入蘋果iPhone供應鏈；韓國宣布約800兆韓元半導體投資計畫等。不過筆者認為：AI需求仍持續支撐記憶體市場，基本面並未惡化；未看到Meta削減AI基礎建設投資或減少高階記憶體採購；中國長鑫存儲須克服美國出口限制、蘋果品質驗證及專利等門檻；韓國建廠與產能擴充屬於長期規畫，距離正式量產仍需數年，加上高階HBM受限先進製程、封裝技術與良率，記憶體產量短時間難以快速增加。此外，SK海力士ADR發行共募得265億美元，掛牌那斯達克首日漲幅12.7%，等於市場直接對AI記憶體需求投下信任票，即使近期韓國股市遭遇賣壓而使得三星與海力士股價大跌，這並不影響位階偏低的台灣記憶體股。

title_en: Foreign capital has started to make plans this month. The memory stocks backed by rich dad have seen positive performance in Q2. If legal persons do not hold back, will the market still be in Q3?
summary_en: Recently, there has been a lot of noise in the pan-AI industry, with many bulls and bears mixed up. Memory, in particular, has become particularly sensitive when the stock prices of Samsung and Hynix have plummeted. Including Morgan Stanley's warning: DRAM prices and profit upward revisions are approaching the "peak of change rate"; Meta is reported to be leasing AI computing power; China's Changxin Memory may enter Apple's iPhone supply chain; South Korea announced a semiconductor investment plan of approximately 800 trillion won, etc. However, the author believes that: AI demand continues to support the memory market, and the fundamentals have not deteriorated; Meta has not seen any reduction in AI infrastructure investment or high-end memory purchases; China's Changxin Memory must overcome U.S. export restrictions, Apple quality verification and patents and other thresholds; South Korea's factory construction and capacity expansion are long-term planning, and it will still take several years before formal mass production. In addition, high-end HBM is limited by advanced processes, packaging technologies and yields, making it difficult for memory production to increase rapidly in the short term. In addition, SK Hynix’s ADR issuance raised a total of US$26.5 billion, and the price rose by 12.7% on the first day of listing on Nasdaq, which is equivalent to the market’s direct vote of confidence in the demand for AI memory. Even though the Korean stock market has recently suffered from selling pressure, causing the stock prices of Samsung and Hynix to plummet, this does not affect the low-ranking Taiwanese memory stocks.

title_en: There is no end in sight to the barrier lake crisis. The Taiwan Railway emergency response team has not been able to demobilize. All lines will be operating normally before tomorrow noon.
summary_en: Hualien Wanlixi Barrier Lake continues to be listed as a red alert. The Forestry Protection Bureau estimates that the latest overflow time is uncertain. Taiwan Railway was originally scheduled to announce tomorrow's train operation status before 8 pm today, but it was delayed by 2 hours and 8 minutes. Passengers' itineraries are also difficult to arrange because the barrier lake is like a time bomb. However, until 12:00 tomorrow, the Taiwan Railways will still maintain normal traffic on all lines. Adjustments will be made depending on the water level of the barrier lake.

title_en: Oil import structure shifts, Taiwan switches to buying U.S. crude oil, posing new challenges
summary_en: It has been five and a half months since the US-Iraq war started on February 28. The Strait of Hormuz has been closed for most of the time except for a brief ceasefire when traffic was restored. The export of crude oil from the Middle East has been blocked. Taiwan has switched to purchasing crude oil from other countries, with the United States being the largest purchaser. From March to May after the war, the proportion of U.S. crude oil in Taiwan's imports increased from 32% in the same period last year to 43%, while the share of Saudi Arabian crude oil dropped from 29% to 21%. Taiwan's crude oil purchasing structure has clearly shifted to the United States.

title_en: Two more batches of Zoomlion’s carcinogenic oil were exposed, and 343 businesses in Kaohsiung removed more than 100,000 kilograms from their shelves
summary_en: Zoomlion Oils and Fats soybean salad oil was found to be four times over the standard for the carcinogen benzene pyrene. After the Food and Drug Administration recently announced the batch numbers of two batches of benzene pyrene that exceeded the standard, the number of problematic products has increased to 7 batches. Today, the Gao City Health Bureau added 163 affected downstream operators, and related products have been removed from the shelves and sealed. A total of 103,150 kilograms of problematic oil products have been recycled in the city.

title_en: The government questioned the government and rushed to China United to inspect the factory. The city government: "The central government should not ignore the risks" after a series of abnormal batches were discovered.
summary_en: As the Chung Lian cancer oil incident spreads, Taichung Mayor Lu Hsiu-yen criticized the central government on Facebook yesterday for pressuring local governments not to inspect factories, not to announce the flow of the poisonous oil, and not to remove the poisonous oil from the shelves. Executive Yuan spokesperson Li Huizhi said today that the Food and Drug Administration and the Taichung City Government went to Zhonglian to inspect the factory on July 4. The expert meeting on the 4th stated that Zhonglian had no possibility of resuming work and would not inspect the factory again unless it agreed to resume work. "Why is the Taichung City Government anxious to go to Zhonglian again on the 5th?" In this regard, the Taichung City Government pointed out that abnormal batches have appeared one after another, and the central government should not ignore the risk.

summary_en: Hualien started experiencing afternoon thundershowers today, and the amount of water entering the Wanli Creek barrier lake increased. It is estimated that the full time of the reservoir will be advanced to noon tomorrow. However, since the rain has slowed down, there is still a possibility of delay. The Central Disaster Response Center stated that the overflow time will fluctuate and must be closely monitored. If the weather is good and there is no risk of overflow, the security residents can leave the shelter during the day, but they must report before entering the warning area.

title_en: 7 batches of carcinogenic oil exploded! The Central Government took a heavy blow: Randomly inspected 17 batches of oil from China United and other brands from January to March and sent them to SGS immediately.
summary_en: The food safety crisis involving Zoomlion Oil and Fats soybean oil has expanded, with seven batches of oil found to have excessive levels of the carcinogen benzenepyrene. The Taichung City Food Safety Department continues to pursue problematic oils. In addition to sampling and inspecting all 28 batches of oil from Zoomlion from April to June, it has also expanded the sampling and testing of soybean oil from Zoomlion from January to March, as well as downstream products of Fushou, Fumao and other brands. A total of 17 items have been entrusted to the third-party unit SGS for sampling and clarification.

title_en: The Political Yuan proposed amendments to the "Food Safety Law" on the 23rd to strengthen source process management and increase penalties for malicious concealment.
summary_en: As the Chung Lian carcinogen oil incident spreads, Cabinet Minister Zhuo Rongtai announced that the Executive Yuan will pass the draft amendment to the "Food Safety and Hygiene Management Act" next Thursday (23rd). It is pointed out that the draft amendment to the law will strengthen source and process management, and will add a series of strengthening measures for the three-level food safety management mechanism. It also requires operators to report abnormal inspection results within a time limit. If they maliciously conceal or deceive, they will be severely punished.

summary_en: Disputes over military product procurement and contract performance have erupted one after another in the military. The Legislative Yuan will invite Defense Minister Gu Lixiong to submit a special report next week. In a report submitted to the Legislative Yuan, the Ministry of National Defense distinguished six main types of military goods procurement and performance disputes and proposed five improvement practices, including strengthening demand review and risk assessment, and establishing alternative sources and second sources of supply to reduce procurement and contract performance risks.

title_en: The quantity and energy may be insufficient. The Ministry of Health and Welfare plans to require cooking oil samples to be inspected by the government. There are only 3 certified laboratories in Taiwan.
summary_en: After the Zoomlion Oil and Fat carcinogen oil scandal, the central government rushed to fix the problem. The Ministry of Health and Welfare proposed a number of directions for amending the "Food Safety Law". Minister Shi Chongliang recently pointed out that sampling inspections of suspected oil products will be extended from the back market to front-end semi-finished products, and it is planned to conduct batch inspections on a batch-by-batch basis. However, the amount of domestic inspections is facing a test. This time, the National Laboratory of the Food and Drug Administration is already exhausted just to test the oil and fat samples retained by Zoomlion from April to June. It needs to ask for private assistance. However, there are only three laboratories certified by the Food and Drug Administration to test benzopyrene. Experts suggest that risk classification should be adopted based on border inspections.

title: 食藥署擬修正！食安事件下游產品下架原則陳舊 專家建議整合檢驗結果
summary: 中聯製油油脂案爆發初期，衛福部引用民國106年食安事件相關食品下架原則，第一時間只願下架第一層原油及其分裝油品，是挨批蓋牌、延誤下架主因，食藥署近期將邀集食品風險諮議會委員，檢討該標準修訂。該諮議會成員、海大食科系教授凌明沛指出，以本案原油檢出苯駢芘8ppb為例，其第二層產品濃度仍超標可能性存在，建議原則修訂時，下架與否應搭配檢驗機制。

title_en: Food and Drug Administration plans to amend! The principle of delisting downstream products due to food safety incidents is outdated. Experts suggest integrating inspection results
summary_en: In the early days of the Zhonglian Oils and Fats case, the Ministry of Health and Welfare cited the principles for delisting foods related to the food safety incident in 106 of the Republic of China, and was only willing to remove the first layer of crude oil and its subpackaged oil products from the shelves at the first time. This was the main reason for the rejection of the brand and the delay in removal. The Food and Drug Administration will soon invite members of the Food Risk Advisory Council to review the revision of this standard. Ling Mingpei, a member of the advisory council and a professor at the Department of Food Science of Hainan University, pointed out that taking the crude oil in this case with 8 ppb of benzene pyrene as an example, there is still a possibility that the concentration of the second-tier product may exceed the standard. It is recommended that when the principles are revised, whether to remove the product from the shelves should be combined with an inspection mechanism.

summary_en: Is Generation Z’s favorite place to go to Japan? The answer may be surprising! According to the 2025 air ticket sales data of Yiyou.com, one of Taiwan's largest online travel agencies (OTA), the most popular destination for Generation Z is Seoul with 20%, slightly better than Tokyo with 19.6%; Busan also squeezed into the top five with 8.1%, becoming the destination that is most different from other generations. title_en: Deal with inflationary shocks with caution
summary_en: Not long ago, the General Accounting Office announced that the consumer price index (CPI) rose by 2.6% in June. This is the highest rate of growth in the past 17 months, much higher than the 2.16% in May. It means that inflation is serious, which will damage the purchasing power of Chinese people in the short term and reduce industrial competitiveness in the long term. At the same time, due to the slow growth of domestic project wages, inflation will cause negative growth in real wages. Vulnerable workers with lower project wages will be more affected by inflation, which will also lead to a deterioration in income distribution in the long term.

title_en: The culprit behind Fei Ban’s fall into the bear market! Revealing China’s Strongest AI Model Kimi K3
summary_en: Chinese AI unicorn "Dark Side of the Moon" (Moonshot AI) has released its most powerful model, Kimi K3, claiming that it can complete chip design in just 48 hours, but the cost is only 60% of the top model in the United States. The amazing cost-effectiveness shocked the market, and the practice of technology giants spending huge sums of money to invest in AI infrastructure was once again questioned. Selling pressure on global technology stocks broke out, and the US Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell into a bear market! The huge impact has led the market to describe it as a "Kimi moment," similar to the global sell-off triggered by DeepSeek's low-priced models last year.

title_en: The leniency for travel inconvenience insurance claims will be retroactive to April, and the maximum 1.2 times for typhoon stranded foreign accommodations
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 18th) The Property and Casualty Insurance Association pointed out that travel inconvenience insurance claims for trip change insurance will be leniently recognized. Fubon Property & Casualty Insurance and Shin Kong Product Insurance announced today that if you temporarily stay an extra night overseas due to a typhoon, you can use the last night's accommodation receipt of the original trip as the basis. The claim limit is 1.2 times. There is no longer a uniform one-day limit of NT$2,000. The new system is retroactive and applies to policies purchased after April 1 this year.

title: 2026台美共製思維與保護策略白皮書發布 供企業投資評估與決策參考
summary: 面對全球供應鏈重組、美中科技競爭、美國再工業化，以及美國總統川普第二任期帶動的新一波產業政策變革，台灣企業正迎來赴美投資與全球布局的重要轉折點。由財團法人人工智慧法律國際研究基金會策劃，歷時近一年籌備，集結台美近30位產官學研專家共同撰寫的「2026台美共製思維與保護策略白皮書」17日發布。白皮書總召集人、基金會董事長朱兆民表示，這不僅是一項政策研究成果，更是一套提供企業投資評估與決策參考的實務工具。

title_en: 2026 Taiwan-U.S. Communist Thinking and Protection Strategy White Paper released for corporate investment evaluation and decision-making reference
summary_en: Faced with the restructuring of the global supply chain, U.S.-China technology competition, U.S. reindustrialization, and a new wave of industrial policy changes driven by U.S. President Trump’s second term, Taiwanese companies are ushering in an important turning point in investment and global layout in the United States. Planned by the Artificial Intelligence Legal International Research Foundation, a consortium that took nearly a year to prepare and co-authored by nearly 30 industry, government, academic and research experts from Taiwan and the United States, the "2026 Taiwan-U.S. Communist Thinking and Protection Strategy White Paper" was released on the 17th. Zhu Zhaomin, the general convener of the white paper and chairman of the foundation, said that this is not only a policy research result, but also a set of practical tools that provide reference for corporate investment evaluation and decision-making.

title_en: The conflict between the United States and Iran is heating up rapidly. Ministry of Economic Affairs: There will be no adjustments to gasoline and diesel prices next week.
summary_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated on the 18th that the conflict between the United States and Iran has escalated rapidly, and the government continues to stabilize oil prices and take care of people's livelihood, and there will be no adjustments to gasoline and diesel prices next week. The Ministry of Economic Affairs pointed out that international oil prices continue to rise, but in order to reduce the impact of the US-Iraq War on the public, China National Petroleum Corporation implemented various stabilization measures. From February 28 to July 19, gasoline and diesel still absorbed approximately 15.56 billion yuan in total.

title_en: Despite tariffs and exchange rate impacts, the number of registered factories in Taichung bucked the trend and grew to the first among the six cities.
summary_en: The strong development of AI and semiconductor supply chains has led to increased demand for manufacturing orders in Taichung, and the number of registered factories in Taichung continues to rise. The Economic Development Bureau of the Taichung City Government stated that as of the end of June this year, the number of registered factories had reached 19,778. Not only does the total number of factories rank first among the six cities, but the "number of new factories" since 108 also ranks first in the country. It shows that Taichung's industry is not afraid of international tariffs and exchange rate shocks, showing strong resilience.

title_en: The 68-year-old thinks the regular quota is too slow! The consequences of spending tens of millions of dollars on "this type of stocks" are revealed
summary_en: International Center/Comprehensive Report In the face of an aging society and shrinking retirement funds, many elderly retirees are increasingly feeling uneasy and starting to invest with the idea of ​​"wanting to increase their assets somewhat." However, if there is a lack of psychological construction and sufficient homework, they may end up with more losses than gains. A 68-year-old retired man who lives alone originally wanted to manage his finances safely through the "new tax-free small investment system" implemented by the government. However, because he was unwilling to make regular fixed amounts too slowly, he followed the trend and blindly invested in individual stocks under the instigation of the media and online public opinion. As a result, not only did he lose money in a short period of time, but his physical and mental health completely collapsed due to the fluctuations in the stock market.

title: 檢驗頻率加密、一定規模要設實驗室 政院下周公布《食安法》修法草案
summary: 中聯沙拉油油品的食安事件，行政院長卓榮泰18日表示，《食品安全衛生管理法》的修法，其中很重要的就是檢驗的頻率要加密，針對一定規模以上的公司要設置實驗室，而且這個實驗室要經過第三方的認證，未來實驗室必須負有即時通報的責任跟義務等等，他強調，食安法修法也會在20日提出報告，23日在行政院院會來通過。

title_en: The frequency of inspections will be increased, and laboratories of a certain scale will need to be set up. The Political Yuan will release a draft amendment to the Food Safety Law next week.
summary_en: Regarding the food safety incident involving Zoomlion Salad Oil, Chief Executive Officer Zhuo Rongtai said on the 18th that one of the most important aspects of the amendment to the Food Safety and Hygiene Management Act is that the frequency of inspections must be intensified, and laboratories must be set up for companies above a certain size, and this laboratory must be certified by a third party. In the future, laboratories must have the responsibility and obligation to report immediately, etc. He emphasized that the food safety law amendment will also submit a report on the 20th and pass it at the Executive Yuan meeting on the 23rd.

title_en: Taiwan stock market crashes and "free points" returns! Analyst: TSMC is not the killer of the decline; layout strategy exposed
summary_en: [Reporter Lu Chengzhe/Comprehensive Report] The Taiwan stock market plunged 2,953 points on the 17th, the largest drop in history. Senior analyst Cai Minghan said that the market immediately pointed the finger at TSMC, which held a legal meeting the day before, but TSMC's fundamentals have not deteriorated and are not the "murderer" of this decline. The real reason is that the increase in the first half of the year was too large, coupled with the increase in trading volume and the index falling below the quarterly line, leading to an outbreak of market panic.

summary_en: SinoPac Investment Consulting pointed out that after the Taiwan stock market fell 5.9% this week, we need to pay attention to the development of three events, including: the South Korean stock market, the U.S. stock earnings week, and the U.S. FOMC. The fluctuations in Taiwan stocks are on the one hand the impact of international stock markets, and on the other hand the adjustments that occur during the earnings season. title_en: Qing'an 3.0 promotes increased marriage and childbearing. He wonders: is it a punishment for being married for a long time and not having children?
summary_en: The "Qing'an 2.0" previously launched by the government will expire on July 31. Now the Ministry of Finance has announced that "Qing'an 3.0" will be launched in August, and the application period will be from August 2026 to July 31, 2029. Among them, Qing'an 3.0 has a family that has completed marriage within 2 years, and the loan limit has been increased to a maximum of 12 million yuan. People are confused and ask, "Is this punishing people who have been married for a long time and have no children?" Will there be a situation where people get married immediately after getting divorced? It attracts different opinions. Some people think it is a punishment, while others think it is a reward for having children.

title: 輪胎專家與NASA警告：4個習慣，雨天開車最致命
summary: 米其林技術行銷經理Ron Margadonna過去在受訪時說得更白：如果新胎裝在前軸、胎紋較淺的舊胎留在後軸，一旦遇到濕滑路面緊急煞車，後輪會先開始水漂，對駕駛人而言是極難處理的狀況；但如果水漂先發生在前輪，駕駛人多半能及早從方向盤感覺到異常，進而爭取到修正的時間。美國輪胎工業協會（TIA）與美國輪胎製造商協會（USTMA）的官方建議與米其林完全一致：只換兩條胎，一律裝後軸。這不是單一品牌的行銷說法，而是整個輪胎產業共同的安全共識。

title_en: Tire experts and NASA warn: 4 habits that are the most deadly when driving in the rain
summary_en: Ron Margadonna, Michelin's technical marketing manager, put it more clearly in an interview in the past: If new tires are installed on the front axle and the old tires with shallow tread are left on the rear axle, in the event of emergency braking on a slippery road, the rear wheels will start to float first, which is an extremely difficult situation for the driver to deal with; but if the water float occurs in the front wheels first, the driver will most likely be able to feel the abnormality from the steering wheel early and gain time to correct it. The official recommendations of the Tire Industry Association (TIA) and the U.S. Tire Manufacturers Association (USTMA) are completely consistent with Michelin: only replace two tires, and install both rear axles. This is not a marketing statement from a single brand, but a safety consensus shared by the entire tire industry.

title_en: Travel inconvenience insurance claims are retroactive to April, with a maximum of 1.2 times for accommodation stranded abroad due to typhoon
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 18th) The Property and Casualty Insurance Association pointed out that travel inconvenience insurance claims for trip change insurance will be leniently recognized. Fubon Property & Casualty Insurance and Shin Kong Product Insurance announced today that if you temporarily stay an extra night overseas due to a typhoon, you can use the last night's accommodation receipt of the original trip as the basis. The claim limit is 1.2 times. There is no longer a uniform one-day limit of NT$2,000. The new system is retroactive and applies to policies purchased after April 1 this year.

title_en: Sounding rocket cooperation breaks through! National Space Center wins lawsuit and must return NT$54.8 million for promotion to space
summary_en: The National Space Center cooperated with Taiwan's Shine Space Co., Ltd. to promote the launch of sounding rockets, but a major performance dispute broke out. Because the company was late in completing its rocket launch mission and was accused of concealing the fact that it had obtained an Australian rocket launch permit and diverting the rocket originally used in the contract for use with a third party, the National Space Center terminated the contract in accordance with the law. After hearing the case, the Hsinchu District Court found that the breach of contract by Shengzheng Space was serious and ruled that the received price should be returned and liquidated damages should be paid, totaling 54.8 million yuan and related interest. The whole case can still be appealed.

title_en: Su Weiyuan: Acer combines three dream themes: king of stocks, queen of stocks, and TSMC, high gross profit and low price-to-earnings ratio
summary_en: Forum Center/Comprehensive Report Information security and server topics are in strong rotation. Senior analyst Su Weiyuan mentioned Acer (6277) in "Financial Sunday Party", saying that this stock also holds three dream themes: Wang Xinhua Technology Cooperation, National Guardian Mountain TSMC Clean Room Exclusive Access, and Huida MGX Platform Certification. The fundamentals have tripled and tripled, but the stock price is still gaining momentum in the low base period, and there is considerable room for supplementary growth. Su Weiyuan pointed out that Acer's core product, the KVM multi-computer switch, is the world's leading product, which can simultaneously monitor more than 180 screens, and has been included in the U.S. government and defense-related security projects. The most critical niche is that advanced process equipment such as TSMC EUV does not allow software to be poured into it. Acer exclusively solves the remote monitoring needs of the clean room of the wafer factory with external hardware solutions. Engineers can operate the entire factory equipment without changing dust-free clothes. The technical threshold is extremely high and difficult to replace. In addition, Acer has obtained Huida MGX platform certification, and its product line extends to cabinet servers, power distributors and cooling modules. It also has an AI voice-changing module that can be applied to robots, with an astonishing breadth of topics. In terms of finance, Su Weiyuan emphasized that Acer's profit margin has increased three times from the fourth quarter of last year to the first quarter of this year. Gross profit margin, operating profit margin, and after-tax net profit margin have all jumped, and the fundamentals have accelerated upward. Technically, the stock price is currently only trading around 80 yuan, and there is still huge room for supplementary growth from the previous high of 185 yuan. The base period of the monthly K-line is extremely low. Su Weiyuan recommends using band operations and a back-and-forth range layout, waiting for the main rising segment to start. There are risks in stock market investment. Investors should evaluate carefully and never blindly chase high prices.

summary: 民眾辦理遺產稅後常忽略節稅關鍵，專家指出，若被繼承人死亡前兩年內有房產贈與行為，依遺產及贈與稅法第15條需併入遺產申報。透過專業操作，將土地前次移轉現值調整至繼承時之公告土地現值，可大幅縮短未來出售時的稅基計算區間。以近期案例為例，繳納21萬元遺產稅後，成功省下43萬元土地增值稅，實質省下22萬元。此項節稅手續國稅局不會主動通知，必須由納稅義務人主動向地政事務所申請調整。專家提醒，處理遺產繼承時，若涉及死亡前兩年內的房產贈與，務必諮詢地政士專業建議，以免漏辦手續導致未來出售房產時多繳冤枉稅，保障自身權益。

title_en: A must-read for couples to save taxes! After paying her husband’s inheritance tax of 210,000 yuan, she can actually save 430,000 yuan when selling her house in the future.
summary_en: People often ignore the key to saving taxes after handling inheritance tax. Experts point out that if the decedent has donated real estate within two years before his death, it must be included in the inheritance declaration in accordance with Article 15 of the Inheritance and Gift Tax Law. Through professional operation, adjusting the present value of the previous land transfer to the announced present value of the land at the time of inheritance can significantly shorten the tax base calculation range for future sales. Taking a recent case as an example, after paying inheritance tax of 210,000 yuan, the land value-added tax of 430,000 yuan was successfully saved, which was an actual saving of 220,000 yuan. The IRS will not proactively notify you of this tax-saving procedure, and the taxpayer must proactively apply to the Land Affairs Office for adjustments. Experts remind that when handling inheritance, if it involves the gift of real estate within two years before death, you must consult a land consultant for professional advice to avoid missing procedures and causing unjust taxes to be paid when selling real estate in the future, and to protect your own rights and interests.

title_en: Weekend Highlights｜TSMC Legal Reform Meeting! Understand 9 major focuses and market concerns in one article
summary_en: [Reporter Xiao Wenkang/Report from Taipei] TSMC (2330) held a press conference on the 16th. Not only did it deliver a brilliant second-quarter financial report and record-high third-quarter revenue, it also revised its full-year revenue in U.S. dollars this year to increase by more than 40%, raised capital expenditure to 60-64 billion U.S. dollars, and announced an increase in investment of 100 billion U.S. dollars in U.S. factories and other major issues. However, yesterday's stock price "exhausted all profits" and ended up plunging 180 yuan, or 7.29%, to 2,290 yuan, falling below the quarterly support. The legal person pointed out that TSMC's fundamental performance is still strong, but the market has doubts that the gross profit margin in the third quarter will be 1.7 percentage points lower than that in the second quarter, and the increase in capital expenditure may further erode the gross profit margin and free cash flow. Therefore, short-term profit selling pressure has emerged.

summary_en: The draft "Special Regulations on the Procurement of Autonomous Unmanned Vehicles for National Defense" plans to allocate an upper limit of 210 billion yuan in the form of a special budget from 2026 to 2031 to promote the development of independent national defense and unmanned vehicles. summary_en: The Executive Yuan plans to promote the "Special Regulations on the Procurement of Autonomous Unmanned Vehicles for National Defense" and plans to prepare a special budget of up to 210 billion yuan from 2026 to 2031. This has driven military industry and drone concept stocks to become the focus of the market. title_en: Taiwan stock market’s epic collapse: “Should I enter the market?” Experts Reveal "Wei Zhejia's 9-Character Hint" Gold Buying Point Is Here
summary_en: Financial Center/Zeng Yuya reported that TSMC (2330) held a corporate briefing on the 16th and delivered second-quarter results that were better than market expectations. Single-quarter after-tax net income was 706.5 billion yuan, earnings per share (EPS) was 27.25 yuan, and gross profit margin was 67.7%. The performance was outstanding. However, the market did not say anything about paying the bill. On the 17th, TSMC's stock price plunged 180 yuan to close at 2,290 yuan, a drop of 7.2%. This dragged down the Taiwan stock market to plummet 2,953.71 points, or 6.47%, to close at 42,671.27 points. It not only set the largest closing point in history, but also fell below the quarter line. The transaction value increased to 1.21 trillion yuan. Faced with this epic setback, many analysts believe that the main reason for the correction is still market sentiment and international capital risk aversion, rather than deterioration in corporate fundamentals.

title_en: Independence/Poison Oil Storm...Inspection has seized NT$130 million from 4 companies including China United. Continuing to pursue illegal gains may spread upwards.
summary_en: The soybean salad oil produced by Zoomlion Oil Company tested positive for the first-level carcinogen "benzopyrene". General Manager Yu Lingchong was suspected of concealing the results of the oil product inspection. The Taichung District Court reopened the detention court today and detained him. The Taichung District Prosecutor's Office determined that the four oil companies involved, including Zoomlion, had criminal proceeds. In the first wave, they seized nearly 130 million yuan in land and houses, and will continue to pursue the seizures.

summary_en: As the poisonous oil incident spread, Taipei Mayor Chiang Wanan called on 725 to take to the streets to protest. Taichung Mayor Lu Xiuyan also expressed support and posted a post on Facebook questioning the central government's "several pressures on local governments not to inspect factories," "not to announce the flow," and "not to remove poisonous oil from the shelves." title_en: Will Taiwan's "Black Friday" affect financial stability? Look at these indicators
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market hit its largest single-day drop of nearly 3,000 points on "Black Friday". Especially now that the chaos of "four loans under one roof" has caused the outside world to pay attention to whether it will affect the stability of the financial market? An unnamed financial industry executive pointed out that how much further the Taiwan stock market will have to fall before bottoming out will be an important indicator. If there is still some distance from the bottom, and a "dead wave" breaks out next week, it means that previously highly leveraged investors will have no source of funds to repay bank loans. By then, whether it is housing loans, credit, car loans, etc., repayments will become a problem. The bank's over-lending ratio after one month will become a major indicator of financial stability.

title_en: Will Taiwan's "Black Friday" affect financial stability? Look at these indicators
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market hit its largest single-day drop of nearly 3,000 points on "Black Friday". Especially now that the chaos of "four loans under one roof" has caused the outside world to pay attention to whether it will affect the stability of the financial market? An unnamed financial industry executive pointed out that how much further the Taiwan stock market will have to fall before bottoming out will be an important indicator. If there is still some distance from the bottom, and a "dead wave" breaks out next week, it means that previously highly leveraged investors will have no source of funds to repay bank loans. By then, whether it is housing loans, credit, car loans, etc., repayments will become a problem. The bank's over-lending ratio after one month will become a major indicator of financial stability.

title_en: From the queen of shop patrols to the overlord of ice cream products, goddess Lai Shufen strikes out across borders and Mando breaks out of its second growth curve
summary_en: After Mandu chairman Lai Shufen took over the hairdressing group founded by her father 60 years ago 10 years ago, she made early arrangements to reduce the birthrate. In addition to expanding hairdressing-related products, she also acquired cross-industry food companies such as Xiaomei ice cream, successfully creating new sources of profit. Author: Sun Ronping In the Mandu Hair Store, designers and assistants were busy, and Chairman Lai Shufen, who was called the "goddess" by employees, quietly walked in. Although she is a goddess, she is actually as friendly as a big sister. Without disturbing everyone's work, she chatted with the employees in the store, looked at the employee lounge and toilets, and then rushed to the next store to visit. Use your feet to discover the truth. The meal completion rate of lunch boxes has become a performance indicator. According to a biweekly report in Financial News, Lai Xiaoyi established the Mandu Group in 1966 and handed over the baton to his daughter Lai Shufen in 2016. She implements mobile management. Mandu and its brands including Li's Hairstyle, Beishi, Dianxian, etc., have a total of about 350 stores. She will visit a store three times a year on average and visit more than 20 stores a day. Some store managers only see her twice a year and complain to her: "Chairman, you owe me once!" Financial statements are cold numbers, but the hairdressing industry is a business that serves people. In addition, Lai Shufen herself is a woman, so she is observant and can see many details from the perspective of a consumer. She said: "When I visit a store, I will definitely check the toilets, because girls are very concerned about whether the toilets are clean. In addition, I will also check the rest rooms. If there are many half-eaten lunch boxes, I know that this business is doing well without looking at the numbers." There is another advantage of going to the store in person.

title_en: The world's largest advanced packaging factory for AI chips. Before the groundbreaking of Phase II of TSMC Chiayi, seven palaces and temples were visited to pray for blessings. Employees and local shareholders walked together as believers.
summary_en: When the world's most advanced advanced packaging factory for AI chips meets Taiwan's most representative folk belief - "circulation", what kind of sparks will be created? Author: Chen Bizhu, Cai Xun News Center According to the biweekly report of Cai Xun, at 6:30 in the morning on July 12, beside Forbidden City East Road in Chiayi Science Park, palanquins from seven local temples in Chiayi gathered one after another, slowly taking off amid the sound of gongs, drums and suonas. The clairvoyant and wind-eared gods walked in front of the procession to clear the way. More than a hundred believers followed the palace and temple sedans all the way around the Chiayi Science Park Phase 1 and Phase 2. The whole journey was about 6 kilometers. Wherever the sacred sedan went, the sound of firecrackers could be heard. The scene in front of me is almost the same as the Mazu circumnavigation that Taiwan is familiar with in recent years. But a closer look revealed that the destination of the mikoshi this time was not a temple, but the TSMC Chiayi AI chip advanced packaging plant. The ground-breaking ceremony, which was originally filled with steel, concrete and construction machinery, was filled with a strong sense of Taiwanese humanity. At 10:30 a.m., Chairman Wu Chengwen of the National Science Council, Chiayi County Mayor Weng Zhangliang, Director of the Southern Science and Technology Administration Bureau Zheng Xiurong, and TSMC Vice President of Plant Affairs Zhuang Zishou waved their golden shovels and announced the official start of the second phase of the TSMC Chiayi Science Park. Prior to this, seven temples and hundreds of believers had already "step by step" and sincerely showered blessings. "Do you know which company you are praying for today?" a reporter from "Financial News" casually asked a believer named Chen next to him who was taking his daughter to participate in the circumambulation. "TSMC." He replied without hesitation, and then added: "I am a shareholder of TSMC and a believer.

title_en: Is AI really a bubble? All four major U.S. stock indexes collapsed, TSMC ADR fell 2.37%
summary_en: Real-time Center/Comprehensive Report Affected by the fading artificial intelligence (AI) craze and the expanding sell-off in chip stocks, U.S. stocks continued to fall on Friday (17th). All four major indexes closed down in a single day. The S&P 500 index fell 76.08 points, or 1.01%, to close. at 7,457.69 points; the Nasdaq fell 361.70 points, or 1.40%, to close at 25,520.24 points; the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 406.55 points, or 0.77%, to close at 52,146.42 points. Within the S&P 500, energy stocks were the best performers as crude oil prices soared as hostilities in the Iran war escalated. TSMC ADR fell by 11.37 yuan or 2.37%, SpaceX fell by 5.43%, and Huida fell by 2.21%.

title_en: The results of the data leakage investigation of Auction International are released. They are willing to compensate 500 yuan, but the number of people affected is unknown.
summary_en: Paifu International, which mainly operates Pi wallets and payment connections, silently revealed on its official website the evening of the 17th that it was investigating the incident after the hacker organization Settra launched an attack on it in June this year. The leaked information includes files on daily operations of internal employees, as well as project member information for 2019 and 2022, including names, mobile phone numbers and license plate numbers. In addition to not explaining the number of people affected, affected users will only be notified through push messages on the APP. In the eyes of the industry and users, they can only shake their heads and sigh: "Information security protection is not done well, and follow-up processing is not sincere. I wonder if Zhan Hongzhi, chairman of Dajiajia Online Family, knows?"

title_en: Taiwan stocks plummeted nearly 3,000 points, and OTC financing fell by NT$41.6 billion in a single day
summary_en: Taiwan stocks plummeted by nearly 3,000 points on the 17th, breaking a record. Foreign capital also sold 189 billion yuan, which also set a new record for single-day sales. According to statistics from the stock exchange and OTC purchases on the evening of the 17th, the amount of financing in the centralized market dropped by 27.6 billion yuan, and the amount of OTC financing decreased by 14 billion yuan. The total amount of OTC financing decreased by 41.6 billion yuan, setting a record for the highest amount of weight loss in a single day. According to statistics from the stock exchange, the amount of financing in the centralized market decreased from 615.5 billion yuan to 587.9 billion yuan, a decrease of 27.6 billion yuan.

title_en: Stabilize finance...Taiwan stocks are on guard against a wave of bankruptcies, fearing a series of bankruptcies involving four loans under the same roof
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market hit its biggest single-day drop in history on "Black Friday", especially with the continued chaos surrounding the "four loans under one roof", making the outside world also pay attention to whether it will affect the stability of the financial market. Executives in the financial industry pointed out that if a "bankruptcy wave" breaks out next week, it means that investors who have previously adopted highly leveraged strategies will have no source of funds to repay bank loans. By then, repayment of housing loans, credit, car loans, etc. will become a problem. The bank's over-loan ratio after one month will become a major indicator of financial stability.

title: 外資殺瘋！國家隊砸近7億護不住　晶圓三哥跌停作收
summary: 台股昨（17）日上演史詩級崩跌！而外資為此次血洗的最大黑手，賣超台股金額達到破紀錄的1890億元。此前五天累計狂飆7.59%的力積電（6770），則淪為這波屠殺下的最大肥羊，被爆砍11萬5284張。雖然國家隊砸下6億8662萬4861元、買超9740張予以護盤，力積電仍被殺至跌停，全程奄奄一息，終場跌幅9.93%，收報68.9元。

title_en: Foreign capital is going crazy! The national team spent nearly 700 million and couldn't protect it. The third brother of Wafer dropped to the limit.
summary_en: Taiwan stock market staged an epic crash yesterday (17th)! Foreign capital was the biggest culprit in this bloodbath, with the amount of overselling of Taiwanese stocks reaching a record-breaking 189 billion yuan. Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (6770), which had surged by 7.59% in the previous five days, became the biggest loser in this wave of slaughter, with 115,284 shares cut. Although the national team spent 686.624861 yuan and bought over 9,740 shares to protect the market, Power Semiconductor was still beaten to the limit and was dying throughout the process. The final drop was 9.93%, closing at 68.9 yuan.

title_en: The reason why Yu Lingchong, general manager of China United Federation of Trade Unions, was detained was revealed! The court found that there was "deliberate concealment and editing of relevant information"
summary_en: The soybean salad oil produced by Zoomlion Oil Company was found to be four times higher than the level of the first-level carcinogen "benzopyrene", triggering a food safety crisis across Taiwan. General Manager Yu Lingchong of Zoomlion was detained by prosecutors in accordance with the food safety law. On the 10th, the Taichung District Court granted a NT$20 million bail but was revoked. This afternoon, another judge reopened the detention court and found that Yu "deliberately concealed or edited relevant information." He was changed to rule that he should not be detained.

summary_en: The 2026 Art Self-Made Festival "Museum of Books" was unveiled tonight at Yilan Zhongxing Cultural and Creative Park. National treasure master Huang Chunming appeared at the event, which was surprising. Teacher Huang's classic poem "Sugaloo" is the highlight of this exhibition. For the first time, beautiful poems leave the page and become a large-scale landscape, which is unique. There are 20 works in the exhibition, which extends "book" from paper reading to space, architecture and landscape. It is worth seeing.

title: 影／明德水庫空中滑索、自行車完工啟用 打造水陸空遊憩區
summary: 苗栗縣政府推動明德水庫「明湖水岸遊憩廊帶亮點計畫」促參案已有階段性成果，縣長鍾東錦今天中午視察設在遊客中心的空中飛索（滑索）設施。縣府指出，滑索長度達330公尺，是目前台灣西半部最長的高空滑索設施，在取得國際ACCT安全認證後，7月5日起開放預約體驗，遊客能以飛越湖面的絕佳視角，飽覽明德水庫的湖光山色。

title_en: Shadow/Mingde Reservoir zipline and bicycles are completed and put into use to create a water, land and air recreation area
summary_en: The Miaoli County Government's promotion of the Mingde Reservoir "Minghu Waterfront Recreation Corridor Highlights Project" has achieved preliminary results. County Magistrate Zhong Dongjin inspected the aerial zipline (zipline) facility at the visitor center at noon today. The county government pointed out that the zipline is 330 meters long and is currently the longest zipline facility in the western half of Taiwan. After obtaining the international ACCT safety certification, reservations will be available for experience from July 5. Visitors can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Mingde Reservoir’s lakes and mountains from an excellent perspective flying over the lake.

title_en: Protein Burger sells 10,000 copies a day! McVidian returns to thousands of stores and secures top spot in terms of revenue: "Two secret weapons" reshape breakfast chain landscape
summary_en: The landscape of breakfast restaurants in Taiwan is changing. This year, McVidian has exceeded 1,000 stores and has risen to the second-largest number of breakfast chain stores in Taiwan. The reason behind this is Dong Zhuo Jinglun's management method of deeply cultivating franchisees and regular customers. There are more than 20,000 breakfast restaurants in Taiwan, and the number of stores even exceeds convenience stores. The market ranking has hardly changed in more than ten years. Until April this year, Yang Qin's Maiwei Deng returned to the scale of 1,033 stores and currently has 1,033 stores, surpassing Good Morning Beach City and Hongye Burger, and second only to Ruilin Meiermei, which has more than 2,000 stores. In one fell swoop, it jumped from the fourth position in the market to the second place, and its revenue has firmly established itself as the leader.

title_en: I once failed to invest in LED, and I laughed at myself that the worst time is now... Qiangmao and Fang brothers spent 10 years developing an AI pass from car manufacturers and entering the international car chain.
summary_en: Since the beginning of this year, Qiangmao's operations have continued to heat up, with revenue in the first half of the year hitting a new high in nearly 11 years. summary: 櫃買中心(Taipei Exchange)表示，上櫃公司891家（含KY公司30家）皆已完成115年6月營收申報作業。上櫃公司115年6月營收公告資料顯示，全體上櫃公司6月份單月營收總計3,519億元，較114年同期成長962億元(38%)，營收成長公司共621家，衰退公司共267家，營收持平公司共3家。

title_en: Add more money! The maximum mark-up on Western medicine primary outpatient consultation fees will be increased by 8% to narrow the specialist gap
summary_en: In response to the continuous increase in the cost of medical services in recent years, in order to reasonably reflect the care load of various specialties and the investment in primary care, today's "Interim Meeting for Discussion on the Total Amount of Primary Care for the National Health Insurance" will jointly discuss the adjustment of the payment standard for primary care. The All-China Federation of Medical Doctor Associations recommends using the 2014 and 2015 total primary medical service cost index to increase the budget by approximately 4.968 billion yuan, increase the first segment of outpatient consultation fees for each specialist, and review diagnostic and treatment items whose payment points have been low for a long time and have not been adjusted to increase the capacity of primary medical services.

title_en: The reconstruction of Jiuru Bridge in Kaohsiung has been delayed and has not been opened to traffic as scheduled. People complain about insufficient lighting and drainage that needs to be improved.
summary_en: The Jiuru Bridge reconstruction project in Kaohsiung City has been delayed and did not open to traffic as scheduled at the end of June. The People's Representative pointed out that the construction delay, insufficient night lighting, multiple adjustments to the road route, and drainage concerns have caused dissatisfaction among surrounding residents, demanding that it be completed as soon as possible to restore traffic and living quality.

title_en: Tainan Baiyou and Hongyou, etc., suffered continued damage caused by Typhoon Danas. Applications for cash assistance will be accepted starting tomorrow
summary_en: Typhoon Danas in 2014 caused damage to white and red pomeloes in Tainan City. The Ministry of Agriculture announced that Tainan City is an agricultural natural disaster cash assistance area for "white pomelo and other pomelo". From tomorrow to the 31st, eligible farmers can apply to the regional office where the land is located to help farmers resume farming and production as soon as possible.

title: 美國環孢子蟲症爆千例病例 生吃蔬果+持續水瀉恐已被寄生蟲感染
summary: 美國疾病管制與預防中心截至7月13日已接獲1645例環孢子蟲症（Cyclosporiasis）本土確診病例，另有5100餘例疑似病例待確認，疫情已擴及34州，累計至少141人住院，目前尚無死亡病例。衛福部疾管署發言人曾淑慧表示，被感染最常見症狀為持續性水樣腹瀉，若有相關情況務必盡早就醫並告知醫師近期旅遊史。環孢子蟲症非我國法定傳染病，目前不會發布旅遊疫情警示。
