title_en: Thousands of cases of cyclosporiasis in the United States explode. Eating raw fruits and vegetables + persistent watery diarrhea may lead to parasitic infection
summary_en: As of July 13, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has received 1,645 locally confirmed cases of Cyclosporiasis, and more than 5,100 suspected cases have yet to be confirmed. The epidemic has expanded to 34 states, with a total of at least 141 people hospitalized. There are currently no deaths. Zeng Shuhui, spokesperson for the Department of Disease Control and Prevention of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, said that the most common symptom of infection is persistent watery diarrhea. If you have such a situation, you must seek medical advice as soon as possible and inform the doctor of your recent travel history. Cyclosporiasis is not a notifiable infectious disease in my country, and no travel epidemic warning will be issued at this time.

title_en: Pingtung Rongzong was upgraded to a regional hospital this year and it will take four years to upgrade to a medical center.
summary_en: Pingtung Veterans General Hospital held a medical results conference today titled "Cutting-edge Medical Innovation, Upgrading Critical Care". Pingtung Rongzong will be upgraded to a regional hospital this year, and will establish and improve cardiac catheterization medical services, improve maternal and child emergency care, neonatal intensive care and other capabilities. It is expected to open a 24-hour children's emergency department in October and strive to upgrade the medical center in four years.

title_en: Blood bank is about to bottom out, Tainan charity blood donation event raised 202 bags of blood for emergency use
summary_en: The stock of blood is about to bottom out. The Tainan Guanmiao District Youth League Committee of the National Salvation Corps responded to the charity of stabilizing the blood bank and held a "Donate a bag of blood, save a life" charity blood donation at Guanmiao Shanxi Palace Square today, calling on the public to donate blood to give a ray of hope to patients in need of blood transfusions. At the end of the evening event, a total of 202 bags of blood were collected. The next event is expected to be held on October 17.

summary_en: Lin Mingzhang, chairman of Guanghongke, a MOSFET (metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor) design factory that cooperates with Weichuan Electric, also pointed out that Weichuan Electric not only has good service efficiency, but also has good product solution features, which is the key to winning. Its stock price has increased by 30% this year. "Wei Chuan Electronics is like onions, ginger, garlic, salt and pepper next to the main course. When production capacity is tight, it still adheres to the single-supplier source strategy and stays loyal to TSMC, allowing Wei Quan to obtain support from the wafer factory when mature wafer foundry processes are in short supply. "Because he doesn't want customers to be unable to serve food without onions, ginger, and garlic." Although the introduction of liquid cooling technology into AI servers has raised market concerns about reduced demand for air-cooling fans, Lin Chongtao pointed out: "The air-to-water architecture is still mainstream in terms of efficiency and cost, and the server periphery still relies on air cooling. In addition, voltage upgrades have driven up the unit price of chips, and the overall output value has not decreased.

summary_en: Wireless radio frequency RFID solution provider Wei Qiao (6417-TW) has hit new highs in revenue for three consecutive quarters. title_en: China National Petroleum Corporation of Taiwan held the "Integrity in Energy and Creation of the Future" Corporate Integrity Forum
summary_en: On the 17th, China National Petroleum Corporation held the 115th "Energy Integrity and Integrity for the Future" Corporate Integrity Forum at the Hongnan Activity Center of the Refining Division. It invited anti-corruption inspection agencies, industry, government, academia and supply chain partners to focus on issues such as quality management and safety practices in the energy equipment supply chain, legal compliance and integrity governance, and corporate integrity standards. It hopes to build consensus between the public and private sectors and jointly create a safe, transparent and resilient energy industry environment.

After she was unable to make further capital injections, the fraud group tricked her into acting as a driver and collecting money from other victims, and also asked her to hand over her debit card. It wasn't until her account was listed as a warning that she realized that not only had she been deceived, but she had also been used as a criminal tool by a fraud group. The Criminal Bureau followed up the investigation and found out that the group caused more than 110.72 million yuan in financial losses to the victims, and launched three waves of operations to arrest 19 people.

summary_en: Star Cruises' "Star Discovery" six-day, five-night cruise trip to Kagoshima, Kumamoto, and Naha suddenly canceled its call at Naha Port one hour before the cruise yesterday, triggering a large number of dissatisfied and protested tourists and questioning that they did not apply for a port call, and the itinerary to the islands was changed to a cruise on the high seas. title_en: Human behavior expert: 4 short sentences often used by successful people to make you appear smarter in front of your boss
summary_en: Summary: Every time you have a meeting, are you still hesitating about how to get to the point in one sentence? Whether or not you can speak often determines who is seen and remembered by the boss first. Author: Huang Yixuan Compiled by Melody Wilding, a certified social worker and professor of human behavior at Hunter College in New York. She has served as a coach for senior executives at Google, Amazon and other companies for more than 15 years. In her new book, Managing Up: How to Get What You Need from the People in Charge, she identifies four speaking skills that can help people stand out in meetings. Tip 1: Ask the right questions Many people rush to speak at meetings, but they say things that are not helpful to anyone. Instead of rushing to present your ideas, ask a good question. A good question can reveal unseen assumptions and get an out-of-focus discussion back on track. You might as well try to connect the ideas raised by others to the current situation. title: 黃仁勳：我教小孩先說「Yes」再問為什麼？不會反過來
summary: 輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳近期在台分享典型亞洲父母的教養觀，引起網上熱烈討論。其實黃仁勳也常在其他場合談到引領小孩與員工的原則，被領導管理專家認為相當獨特。黃仁勳如何在一場科技界爐邊對談中，另外提到他在家教小孩的堅持，在管理輝達員工時也用得上？說「Yes」與問為什麼後就放手，而不是像一些人先問為什麼，還得讓小孩或員工等他恩准說是，才能做。這樣能如何激勵他們表現卓越？2026年一場與思科（Cisco）董事長兼執行長羅賓斯（Chuck Robbins）的爐邊對談，黃仁勳說了一句聽起來不太像企業領袖會說的話：「如果你想掌控一個人的人生，請先去看心理醫生。」台下哄堂大笑。但這位輝達（NVIDIA）創辦人要談的是教養小孩，跟領導企業員工都該用同一種思維，他是這樣成功的：放下控制吧。「掌控是一種幻覺，你根本控制不了。如果你想讓公司成功，你就不能控制它。」黃仁勳表示，教養小孩也是一樣。接著黃仁勳談到，他帶小孩與帶公司共用的同一套邏輯。

title_en: Jen-Hsun Huang: I teach my children to say "Yes" first and then ask why? not the other way around
summary_en: NVIDIA CEO Jen-Hsun Huang recently shared the parenting views of typical Asian parents in Taiwan, sparking heated discussions online. In fact, Huang Renxun often talks about the principles of leading children and employees on other occasions, which is considered quite unique by leadership and management experts. How did Huang Renxun mention in a fireside chat in the technology industry that his persistence in educating children at home can also be used when managing Huida employees? Say "Yes" and let go after asking why, instead of asking why first and letting children or employees wait for their permission to say yes before doing it like some people do. How does this motivate them to excel? In a fireside chat with Cisco Chairman and CEO Chuck Robbins in 2026, Huang Jen-Hsun said something that did not sound like what a business leader would say: "If you want to control a person's life, please see a psychologist first." The audience burst into laughter. But what the founder of NVIDIA wants to talk about is that raising children should use the same thinking as leading corporate employees. This is how he succeeded: let go of control. "Control is an illusion. You can't control it at all. If you want the company to succeed, you can't control it." Huang Renxun said that the same is true for raising children. Huang Renxun then talked about the same logic he uses to take care of his children and his company.

title: 雄三飛彈可空中射擊，台灣如何多一張反制王牌？
summary: 國軍又有一款新彈藥曝光！台灣自研自製、過去只能由陸地、軍艦上發射的雄風三型反艦飛彈，克服微型化挑戰，近日正式掛載在IDF經國號戰機上首度完成空中射擊。專家指出，雄三飛彈可進行空射，不但讓國軍的反艦手段更多元化，隨著中國新型航空母艦「福建艦」的服役，雄三空射帶來的射程提升，更能突破岸基發射的「手短」問題，將是國軍未來應對中國航艦的一大利器。作為全球反艦飛彈密度最高的國家，台灣手上共握有逾1400枚各式國造（雄二、雄三）、美造（魚叉）的反艦飛彈，大部分屬於岸基發射，堪稱刺蝟島。這些陸基發射的反艦飛彈，雖具載台較便宜、高機動、不易偵獲等優勢，只是隨著中國海上戰力持續提升，部分飛彈的手短問題也愈來愈明顯。

title_en: Xiongsan missiles can be fired from the air. How can Taiwan get another counterattack trump card?
summary_en: The Chinese army has another new ammunition exposed! Taiwan's self-developed Hsiung Feng III anti-ship missile, which in the past could only be launched from land and warships, has overcome the challenge of miniaturization and was recently officially mounted on an IDF Ching Kuo fighter jet to complete aerial firing for the first time. Experts point out that the Xiongsan missile can be air-launched, which not only diversifies the Chinese military's anti-ship means. With the entry into service of China's new aircraft carrier "Fujian Ship", the range increase brought by Xiongsan air-launching can also overcome the "short hand" problem of shore-based launches, and will be a great weapon for the Chinese military to deal with Chinese aircraft carriers in the future. As the country with the highest density of anti-ship missiles in the world, Taiwan possesses more than 1,400 domestically produced (Xiong Er, Xiong San) and American-made (Harpoon) anti-ship missiles of various types. Most of them are launched from shore, making it a hedgehog island. Although these land-launched anti-ship missiles have the advantages of cheaper launch platforms, high maneuverability, and difficulty in detection, as China's maritime combat power continues to increase, the problem of short hands of some missiles has become more and more obvious.

title: 營養師：50歲以後每天睡前該做的6件事
summary: 50歲是一個人生里程碑，妳變得更睿智、更自信，能毫無顧忌地做真實的自己，但身體比較難回到20幾歲的狀態。為了好好照顧自己，營養師建議每天睡前可以做6件事。編譯 樂羽嘉1. 啜飲一杯無酒精調酒如果你習慣在傍晚或睡前喝酒，不妨考慮改喝無酒精的調酒、葡萄酒或啤酒。營養師阿扎羅（Melissa Azzaro）指出，「超過50歲的女性多數都會因為處於『更年期前期』與『更年期』飽受失眠和睡眠障礙之苦，像是熱潮紅、夜間盜汗等症狀會讓人難以入眠，而體內其他荷爾蒙失調，也會讓女性很難獲得一整晚高品質充足睡眠。」所以她強烈建議50歲以上女性睡前戒酒，「妳可能覺得喝酒能幫妳更快入睡，但實際上酒精會導致更多的睡眠中斷，降低睡眠深度與休息效果。」科學研究也證實了這一點，指出較高的酒精攝取量與較短的睡眠時間、較差的「恢復性睡眠」品質甚至打呼都有直接關聯。你可以用酸櫻桃汁特調取代調酒。酸櫻桃汁可以幫助我們更快入睡，有效提升睡眠品質。科學家認為，這可能要歸功於酸櫻桃中所富含的植物多酚以及其他功能性成分，包括褪黑激素和色胺酸。你只要在酸櫻桃汁加入氣泡水，再裝飾一片青檸切片，一杯助眠聖品就大功告成。

title_en: Nutritionist: 6 things you should do before going to bed every day after the age of 50
summary_en: Turning 50 is a milestone in life. You become wiser, more confident, and able to be your true self without any scruples, but it is difficult for your body to return to the state of your 20s. In order to take good care of yourself, nutritionists recommend doing 6 things before going to bed every day. Compiled by Le Yujia 1. Sip a glass of non-alcoholic cocktail If you are used to drinking in the evening or before bed, consider switching to a non-alcoholic cocktail, wine or beer. Nutritionist Melissa Azaro Azzaro pointed out, "Most women over 50 years old will suffer from insomnia and sleep disorders due to pre-menopause and menopause. Symptoms such as hot flashes and night sweats can make it difficult to fall asleep, and other hormonal imbalances in the body will also make it difficult for women to get a full night of high-quality sleep." So she strongly recommends. Women over 50 years old should quit drinking before going to bed. "You may think that drinking alcohol can help you fall asleep faster, but in fact alcohol will cause more sleep interruptions, reduce sleep depth and rest effectiveness." Scientific research has also confirmed this, pointing out that higher alcohol intake is directly related to shorter sleep time, poorer "restorative sleep" quality and even snoring. You can substitute tart cherry juice for the cocktail. Tart cherry juice can help us fall asleep faster and effectively improve sleep quality. Scientists believe this may be down to the plant polyphenols and other functional ingredients found in tart cherries, including melatonin and tryptophan. All you need to do is add sparkling water to sour cherry juice, garnish with a lime slice, and you're done with a sleep-inducing drink.

title: 心理學家：一段愛情不健康的7個跡象
summary: 一段不健康的愛情關係可能害你浪費多年時間在不對的人身上、陷入自我懷疑的循環，不確定是否反應過度、分手是否正確。專門研究伴侶關係的心理學家崔佛斯分享7個警訊，告訴你怎麼確定這段關係不健康。編譯 樂羽嘉以下是不健康關係的7個警訊：1. 吵架時總是貶低你研究顯示，輕蔑是預測離婚的最強指標之一。當雙方發生爭執時，伴侶可能嘲笑你、辱罵你或一副高高在上的態度。他們可能翻白眼、對你的擔憂嗤之以鼻，或是利用諷刺的方式貶低你。多數關係都能熬過衝突，但長期不尊重就很難克服了。一旦輕蔑成為互動模式的一部分，你的擔憂就不再被視為需要處理的正當議題，反而會被當成你有問題的證據。2. 你提出要求，對方一味退縮另一種令人擔憂的互動模式，是研究中常見的「要求－退縮循環」（demand-withdraw cycle），也就是一方不斷想要改變現狀、要求討論或解決問題，另一方卻逃避、轉移話題、離開現場，或乾脆築起心牆、拒絕溝通。這種循環時間一久會自我強化。一方愈是想解決問題，另一方就愈退縮。結果，重要的問題一直沒解決，雙方的挫折感不斷累積。最終伴侶會徹底放棄溝通，一再陷入沒有結果的僵局。3.

title_en: Psychologist: 7 signs that a relationship is unhealthy
summary_en: An unhealthy relationship can cause you to waste years with the wrong person, spiraling into a cycle of self-doubt about whether you're overreacting and whether breaking up is the right thing to do. Travers, a psychologist who specializes in partner relationships, shares 7 warning signs to tell you how to determine if your relationship is unhealthy. Compiled by Le Yujia Here are 7 warning signs of an unhealthy relationship: 1. Always belittling you during arguments Research shows that contempt is one of the strongest predictors of divorce. When you have an argument, your partner may laugh at you, call you names, or act condescending. They may roll their eyes, scoff at your concerns, or use sarcasm to put you down. Most relationships can survive conflict, but chronic disrespect can be difficult to overcome. Once contempt becomes part of the pattern of interaction, your concerns are no longer seen as legitimate issues to address, but rather as evidence that something is wrong with you. 2. You make a request, but the other party always withdraws. Another worrying interaction pattern is the "demand-withdraw cycle" commonly seen in research. That is, one party constantly wants to change the status quo, ask for discussion or solve problems, but the other party avoids, changes the subject, leaves the scene, or simply builds a wall and refuses to communicate. This cycle will become self-reinforcing over time. The more one party tries to solve the problem, the more the other party withdraws. As a result, important issues remain unresolved and frustrations accumulate on both sides. Eventually, the partner will give up communication completely and fall into fruitless deadlocks again and again. 3.

title_en: Hot blast! The Ministry of Labor subsidizes fan jackets and ice vests for outdoor work. The second wave of applications is expected to be opened by the end of July.
summary_en: Summers are getting hotter and hotter, and the risk of thermal hazards for outdoor workers such as construction sites, road maintenance, and farmers is also getting higher and higher. This year, the Ministry of Labor subsidized fan jackets, ice vests and other protective equipment for high-temperature operations, as well as personal protective equipment. Applications were so popular that they exceeded the allocated funds. Minister of Labor Hong Shenhan said in an interview today that the budget is currently being negotiated and the second wave of applications is expected to be opened in late July.

title_en: Taiwan stocks fell more than 2,400 points during the session, with financial stocks relatively resilient.
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market suffered a bloodbath today (17th), plunging more than 2,400 points or more than 5% during the session. Compared with the heavy selling pressure of the electronic technology group, financial stocks showed relatively defensive resilience during the session. As of 12 noon, they only fell 22.62 points, or about 0.73%. The financial stock index reached 3,084.5 points. The legal person pointed out that financial stocks will still be affected by factors such as the Federal Reserve's interest rate policy and capital market conditions.

title: 美日企業資本政策兩樣情：重股東回報抑或現金為王
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導日本東京證券交易所（Tokyo Stock Exchange）於2026年4月再度呼籲上市公司，應重視資本成本及股價意識經營，尤其需關注「經營資源的適當分配」。此舉旨在改善日本企業普遍存在的股價淨值比（PBR）低於一倍的現象，即使這些企業擁有雄厚的現金儲備、強勢品牌或領先技術，仍未能獲得市場足夠評價。 GLOBIS經營大學院大學教員森生明（Akira Morio）指出，日本與美國企業在評估企業價值上的觀點差異，正是造成股價淨值比偏低問題的關鍵。《築摩書房》出版的森生明新版著作《公司的價值［新版］》中提到，企業價值應衡量為「事業未來能創造多少現金流」。因此，他的企業價值計算公式為「股票價值＋有利子負債－多餘現金」。 在此觀點下，負債被視為支撐企業營運的資金，但多餘現金（surplus cash）則被視為「未直接用於營運的閒置資產」，在評估事業價值時會將其剔除。儘管這些多餘現金是過去累積的利潤，且最終歸屬於股東，但若長期閒置未能產生合理回報，將影響資本效率，進而引發投資人對企業價值的質疑。 森生明認為，日本社會普遍傾向於將現金充裕的公司視為財務健全的表現。

title_en: TSMC’s law says the market won’t pay! Fei Ban's heavy fall triggered a replenishment of losses, and Taiwan stocks once plunged 1,700 points, breaking 44K
summary_en: The Fed Semiconductor Index plunged 4.29% last night, and TSMC (2330) ADR fell 2.32%, dragging down the Taiwan Index futures to plummet 976 points in overnight trading. The Taiwan stock market opened 390.9 points lower on the 17th and closed at 45,234.08 points. At the beginning of the session, TSMC fell below the monthly line, the five major value stocks weakened across the board, and the selling pressure of UMC (2303), memory, and carrier board groups simultaneously emerged. The index fell rapidly by more than 1,700 points, and the 44,000-point integer barrier was lost. On the market, active unified upgrade 50 (00403A), UMC and Yuanta Taiwan 50 positive 2 (00631L) were the most popular.

summary: 炙熱的陽光掩蓋不住藝術的美。富邦美術館展出「古典光影大師：林布蘭到哥雅—托雷多美術館珍藏展I》。本次展覽精選 52 件托雷多美術館珍貴館藏，集結林布蘭、哥雅、透納、范・戴克、弗拉戈納爾等歐洲藝術史重量級大師真跡，帶領觀眾走進橫跨三百年的古典藝術世界。

title_en: World Football Championship/The top four’s reversal by Argentina has been questioned. England’s coach hopes to reshape the team’s DNA.
summary_en: England failed again in the semi-finals of the World Football Championship. They were reversed by Argentina despite taking the lead, and they missed the chance to win the glory of the finals. This tragic defeat not only severely damaged the "Three Lions" dream of winning the championship, but also pushed coach Thomas Tuchel to the forefront of public opinion. Faced with overwhelming doubts, Tuchel bluntly pointed out that if English football wants to reach the top of international competitions, it must completely reshape the "football DNA" flowing in its bones.

title_en: Qianjing Nijia 1/The index did not fall much, but individual stocks fell deeply Du Jinlong: Keep 50% in cash and wait for 42,000 points
summary_en: Taiwan stocks surged in the first half of the year, driven by the AI ​​craze, and market sentiment was once boiling. However, after entering the third quarter, high-priced AI stocks began to correct, and trading volume also cooled down significantly. Investors began to worry about whether the bullish market had ended. Du Jinlong, a veteran stock market visionary, said in the "Money Mirror Your Home" program that the fundamentals have not changed, and the profits of listed companies continue to grow. It is currently just a consolidation stage in the bullish market. He predicts that the box-shaped shock will remain in the third quarter, and the index has a chance to test back to the quarterly line around 42,000 points; but the real new wave of offensive may not start until the end of the six capital elections at the end of the year.

title: 台股雪崩2953點寫史上最慘　閃開科技台股避險9檔必收
summary: 受美股收黑影響，費城半導體指數重挫，台股今（17）日遭遇黑色星期五，終場大跌2953.71點，收在42671.27點，跌幅達6.47%，創下史上最大跌點紀錄，失守季線與43000點關卡。AI概念股漲多回檔，市場避險情緒升溫，資金開始轉向具防禦特性的傳產與民生消費類股。法人點名包括大成、卜蜂、愛之味、大統益、台肥、正新、群光及統一超等個股，因具備業務穩定、現金流充沛與抗跌特性，有望成為市場震盪期間的資金避風港。投資人應注意，市場短期波動劇烈，布局防禦型標的需審慎評估風險，並關注後續資金輪動趨勢。

title: 這家晶圓大廠「才出關就跌停鎖死」6.9萬張等逃生　專家估恐再腰斬
summary: 今（17）日台股大跌，不少電子、晶片大廠如台積電（2330）等均有跌勢。而被評為晶圓二哥的聯電（2303），在脫離處置後沒多久，今日便遭遇沉重賣壓，盤中跌停鎖死144元，還有約6.9萬張等賣。證期雙照分析師翁偉捷指出，過去聯電受惠於AI產業溢價而上漲，但其營收主力仍是消費性電子，若該領域需求未復甦，股價可能持續下修，不排除接近腰斬。

title: 短影音崛起競爭加劇　Netflix預估第3季成長持續降溫

title: 日經指數週五重挫4.03%，鎧俠、東京威力科創、三菱日聯股價黯淡
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】日本股市週五走跌，因華爾街拋售潮引發市場對AI熱潮能否持續的疑慮。收盤時，東證第一部指數下跌109.58點或2.72%，報3,919.21點；日經225指數則是下滑2,694.42點或4.03%，報64,141.12點。近期科技股表現疲軟，因投資人對於AI熱潮能否持續抱持高度憂心。週四追蹤科技股的那斯達克100指數收跌1.62%；追蹤半導體的費城半導體指數收跌4.29%。Sumitomo Mitsui DS Asset Management首席市場策略分析師Masahiro Ichikawa表示，儘管半導體相關股票的盈利報告強勁，但市場仍然賣出，這表明市場已經消化了這些強勁的業績，從而導致了利多出盡的反應。大和證券首席策略分析師Yugo Tsuboi則是表示，日股此次拋售的幅度遠比美國市場看到的要大得多。由於韓國股市週五休市，投資者們還來不及消化韓國半導體行業的擔憂，所以有些人可能會轉而利用日本股市進行對沖。個股表現方面，記憶體晶片製造商鎧俠股價下跌16.10%；半導體製程設備生產商東京威力科創股價下滑8.17%；營收逾五成來自北美市場的汽車製造大廠豐田汽車股價滑落

title: 韓股波動急升創亞洲金融危機來之最，槓桿踩踏外溢、晶片股逼近熊市
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】主導亞洲股市上半年漲勢的AI與半導體動量交易正快速逆轉，韓國成為這波去槓桿風暴的震央。外資撤離、散戶融資接盤與單一個股槓桿ETF被迫再平衡形成連鎖賣壓，韓股波動急升至亞洲金融危機以來罕見水準，跌勢並向台灣、日本及美國晶片股擴散，顯示6月可能已成為本輪亞洲科技股動量行情的階段高點。首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)週四重挫6.37%，收在6,820.60點，較6月19日盤中締造的史上高點9,385.59點相比，急瀉2,564.99點或27.3%，不到一個月即跌入技術性熊市，韓股週五因國定假期休市。與此同時，費城半導體指數自6月22日高點回落約19%，逼近20%的熊市門檻，30檔成分股自高點以來全數下跌，顯示韓國市場的賣壓已演變為全球晶片股的同步估值修正。韓股脆弱性來自資金結構失衡。外資在高檔持續減碼，散戶則透過融資與兩倍做多ETF承接三星電子和SK海力士，使漲勢期間的正向動量在行情反轉後變成強制賣壓。韓國與香港掛牌、連結兩大記憶體股的單股槓桿產品規模合計已達數百億美元，交易一度占KOSPI成交量約三成；由於產品每日必須恢復兩倍槓桿，標的下跌時須機械性賣出部位，造成股價越跌

title: 群益證舉辦「ETF開創投資新視界論壇」，看好布局電力基建長線商機

title: 韓股、日股光芒漸退，Michael Burry看好現在是逢低買入港股時機
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，知名投資人Michael Burry認為現在正是香港股市尋找逢低買入機會，因港股在今年的全球AI浪潮中表現落後。Scion Asset Management創始人Burry週五在X上發文表示，現在正是關注香港廉價股票的好時機，隨著韓股、日股和Soxx的光芒逐漸褪去，這些股票應該會有良好表現。本月稍早時加倉了京東股票的Burry的最新評論，正逢全球晶片股拋售加劇之際，投資者對AI公司的技術及高額支出能否帶來回報產生質疑。除了他之外，看好香港股票的隊列也在不斷擴大，摩根士丹利也建議投資者增持港股，一定程度受盈利樂觀情緒推動。由於消費者支出疲軟以及對中國電商行業的信心減弱，市場情緒低迷，香港恆生指數今年已下跌4.9%。相較之下，韓國基準股指飆升62%，主要得益於該國兩大晶片巨頭股價的上漲。日本日經225指數自2026年初以來已上漲26%，而交易代碼為SOXX的iShares半導體ETF上漲76%。

title: 台股長黑摜破季線釋中期整理訊號，留意Q2財報布局新主流
summary: 【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股今日長黑摜破季線，從技術面來看，已釋出中期整理的訊號。 台積電(2330)法說會後股價不漲反跌，成為週五大盤重挫的主因。加權指數終場大跌2,953.71點，創下台股盤中及收盤最大跌點紀錄，跌幅達6.47%，K線以長黑摜破季線，市場短線賣壓宣洩明顯。 事實上，過去一段時間以來，日本、南韓股市已率先展開修正，其中南韓股市更因市場進入去槓桿階段，引發多殺多走勢，造成指數大幅下跌，最終也連帶波及台股表現。 隨著台積電股價跌破季線，意味著股價已正式進入回檔整理階段；再加上其他大型權值股同步轉弱，市場整理時間恐將拉長。不過，由於短線跌幅已深，待賣壓充分消化後，下週起仍有機會醞釀技術性反彈。 展望下半年，具有領漲動能的族群，可能與上半年有所不同。隨著8月中旬前第二季財報陸續公布，市場資金焦點可望重新轉向基本面表現突出的個股，屆時將有機會展開新一波個股表現行情。

title: 防堵中國太陽能產品借殼登陸！美商務部對衣索比亞祭出最新貿易調查
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，美國商務部已展開調查，以確定從衣索比亞(Ethiopia)發運的太陽能電池是否在規避針對中國製造組件的關稅。這是一系列旨在保護美國國內清潔能源企業的調查中的最新一起。此次調查之前，First Solar Inc和Qcells等美國太陽能製造商曾於5月要求美國商務部調查相關指控，也就是衣索比亞企業正在使用來自中國的組件組裝太陽能板。美國國內太陽能供應商指稱，美國自衣索比亞進口的太陽能板規模2025年7月以前幾乎為零，但2025年下半年已升至2.77億美元。十多年前，一項調查發現，中國製造商以低於公允價值的價格銷售產品，並獲得不公平的政府補貼。此後，美國已對中國製造的太陽能產品加徵關稅。自那以來，美國國內太陽能製造商已針對其他亞洲國家提起並贏得一系列貿易案件，他們聲稱這些國家被用於規避針對中國太陽能組件的關稅。

summary_en: TSMC announced its second quarter financial results yesterday (16th), with net profit after tax of 706.562 billion yuan in a single quarter, a quarterly increase of 23%, and an annual increase of more than 70%. title_en: Specialized delivery methods will be launched. Scholars warn: Efficiency and cost are decoupled.
summary_en: The "Law on the Protection of Rights and Interests of Delivery Workers and Management of Delivery Platforms" (Special Delivery Law) will officially come into effect on July 21. This law is intended to protect labor rights with good intentions, but some provisions still face many challenges in practical implementation. Chen Zhaoer, a professor at the School of International Political Science and Economics at National Taiwan University, warned that when evaluating the effectiveness of food delivery methods, one must not just look at "whether the return per order has increased." Instead, one should deeply examine its long-term impact on the "multilateral market" structure, cost function, and overall market equilibrium. How to balance laws and regulations, operational resilience and market mechanisms will be the focus after the new law comes into effect.

title_en: The number of Americans filing initial jobless claims fell to 208,000 last week, lower than expected showing labor market resilience
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that newly released data showed that the number of unemployment benefit applications in the United States fell in the latest week, indicating that the labor market remains stable. According to data released by the U.S. Department of Labor on Thursday, the number of initial jobless claims fell by 8,000 to 208,000 in the week ended July 11. The median forecast among economic experts was 217,000. The four-week moving average of initial jobless claims fell to 214,250 in the latest week. The number of continuous claims for unemployment benefits fell to 1.805 million in the week ended July 4, which was also lower than the 1.818 million expected by economic experts. After surging in May and early June, initial jobless claims have fallen back to historically low levels. Meanwhile, the unemployment rate fell last month, a further sign that employers are trying to retain workers.

title: 美國6月零售銷售月增0.2%，符合預期
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，美國6月份零售銷售溫和成長，加油站銷售下滑掩蓋了部分零售商強勁的銷售表現。美國普查局週四公佈的數據顯示，6月份零售銷售月比值成長0.2%，表現符合預期，5月份數據修正成為月增1%。剔除加油站後後，6月份的零售銷售則是成長0.7%。這份數據顯示，6月份13個零售類別中有7個實現成長。其中，加油站銷售下降5.3%，創2022年以來最大降幅，主要因為6月全美汽油平均零售價格每加侖下降約50美分。非實體零售商銷售成長1.9%，創近一年來最大增幅，可能受亞馬遜Prime Day促銷活動帶動。體育用品和興趣愛好用品商店、電子產品及家電商店等其他可選消費類別銷售也有所成長。機動車及零組件經銷商銷售錄得2025年7月以來最大增幅。零售銷售報告中唯一的服務業類別，也就是餐館和酒吧支出小幅上升。這份報告表明，進入夏季後，美國消費者支出依然保持韌性。6月汽油價格下跌為家庭可選消費騰出了部分支出空間，而大型零售商促銷活動以及世界盃也可能提振了銷售。

title_en: U.S. retail sales increased 0.2% monthly in June, in line with expectations
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that new data showed that U.S. retail sales grew moderately in June, and the decline in gas station sales masked the strong sales performance of some retailers. Data released by the U.S. Census Bureau on Thursday showed that retail sales increased by 0.2% month-on-month in June, in line with expectations. The May data was revised to a monthly increase of 1%. Excluding gas stations, retail sales increased by 0.7% in June. This data shows that 7 of the 13 retail categories achieved growth in June. Among them, gas station sales fell by 5.3%, the largest decline since 2022, mainly because the national average retail price of gasoline fell by about 50 cents per gallon in June. Sales of non-physical retailers increased by 1.9%, the largest increase in the past year, which may be driven by Amazon's Prime Day promotions. Sales in other consumer discretionary categories such as sporting goods and hobby stores, electronics and home appliance stores also grew. Motor vehicle and parts dealer sales recorded the largest increase since July 2025. The only services category in the retail sales report, spending at restaurants and bars, rose slightly. This report shows that U.S. consumer spending remains resilient heading into the summer. Falling gasoline prices in June have freed up some room for household discretionary spending, while promotions by major retailers and the World Cup may also have boosted sales.

title: 美元指數飆破關鍵壓力區 聯準會升息預期推升匯價

title_en: The U.S. dollar index surges above the key pressure zone, expectations of a Fed rate hike push up the exchange rate
summary_en: Chart/Schematic Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei Report The U.S. Dollar Index (DXY) has performed strongly recently and has broken through the consolidation zone, reaching a new high of 101.38 points since May 2025, with an intraday appreciation of 0.39%. Since the low of 98.82 in February this year, the US dollar index has gained 5.80%, indicating its strong long-term bullish trend. Market participants widely expect the Federal Reserve to take a more hawkish stance to curb current inflationary pressures. According to data from the CME Group's FedWatch Tool, the market expects a 50% chance that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates by 1 point (25 basis points) at its September meeting. Additionally, there is a 34% chance that the target rate will rise to 4.25% at the December meeting, slightly lower than the 36% chance of a rise to 4.0%. New Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh has publicly emphasized that the central bank will focus on curbing inflation. Recently released economic data has also provided support for the strengthening of the US dollar. U.S. retail sales growth slowed in June, but the dollar and Treasury yields continued to rise in tandem. According to personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index data released by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) on June 25, analysts had expected the annual growth rate to accelerate from 3.8% to 4.0%, while core PCE would also increase from 3.3% to 3.4%.

summary_en: Taiwanese stocks surged in the first half of the year, driven by the AI ​​craze, and market sentiment was once boiling. However, after entering the third quarter, high-priced AI stocks began to correct, and trading volume also cooled down significantly. Investors began to worry about whether the bullish market had ended. Du Jinlong, a veteran stock market visionary, said in the "Money Mirror Your Home" program that the fundamentals have not changed, and the profits of listed companies continue to grow. It is currently just a consolidation stage in the bullish market. He predicts that the box-shaped shock will remain in the third quarter, and the index has a chance to test back to the quarterly line around 42,000 points; but the real new wave of offensive may not start until the end of the six capital elections at the end of the year.

title_en: Zeiss: Advanced packaging has become the main battlefield for semiconductors, and we will work with customers to create next-generation technologies in the future
summary_en: The AI ​​wave is redefining the development direction of the semiconductor industry. In a joint interview with Asian media, decision-makers at ZEISS, a major manufacturer of optical and semiconductor measurement equipment, said that AI is not a short-term boom, but a "new industrial revolution" that can change the global industrial structure. It will continue to drive the growth of the semiconductor market in the next few years, and the rapid increase in the demand for AI chips for small chips (chiplets), high-bandwidth memories (HBM) and heterogeneous integration has also made advanced packaging leap from a back-end process in the past to a core technology that determines the competitiveness of chips.

summary_en: Tariffs on U.S.-made cars, U.S.-China trade policies, and the market's wait-and-see atmosphere disrupted the auto market in the first half of the year. title: 先進製程與美時間差至少2年 專家：確保利益須根留台灣
summary: 台積電將增加投資美國一千億美元，總投資額達二六五○億美元。台經院產總資料庫總監劉佩真表示，台積電原本就產能不足，既要符合美國在地製造，且要防範競爭對手搶單，加大對美投資符合台積電利益。不過，在台創造的就業及投資規模，可能會受影響。她說，台積電必須根留台灣，在台灣的先進製程與美國時間差至少兩年，才能確保台灣優勢與利益。

title_en: There is at least a 2-year gap between advanced manufacturing processes and the U.S. Experts: Ensure that benefits must remain in Taiwan
summary_en: TSMC will increase its investment in the United States by US$100 billion, bringing the total investment to US$265 billion. Liu Peizhen, director of the Industrial Database of the National Taiwan Economic Academy, said that TSMC already has insufficient production capacity. It must be consistent with local manufacturing in the United States and prevent competitors from grabbing orders. It is in TSMC’s interest to increase investment in the United States. However, the scale of employment and investment created in Taiwan may be affected. She said that TSMC must stay in Taiwan and its advanced manufacturing processes in Taiwan are at least two years behind those in the United States in order to ensure Taiwan's advantages and interests.

summary_en: MIT robot dog is here! summary_en: A drifting pig carcass was recently found on the shore of Xintou, Jinhu Town, Kinmen County. After sampling and testing, it was confirmed today that the African swine fever virus nucleic acid was positive. The Ministry of Agriculture announced that from today until July 22, pork and pork processed products from the Kinmen area will be suspended from being exported to the main island of Taiwan and other outlying islands; the Coast Guard will comprehensively strengthen coastal inspections, ship security inspections and cargo inspections.

title_en: 460,000 people in Korean stocks liquidated their positions! Li Zaiming only set up a debt hotline in October. She was sour: Do you want Guanluoyin consultation?
summary_en: The South Korean stock market has been experiencing violent fluctuations recently. The losses of leveraged ETFs (index stock funds) tracking Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and other stocks have expanded rapidly. However, Hu Caiping, a beauty on the financial website, published a bitter article on the 16th, "We were forced to liquidate our positions in July, and only set up a debt hotline in October. title: 5摯友黃金週泡湯之行變調　出發前「一筆」費用竟掀友情危機
summary: 日本一名25歲上班族繪里，原定與四名摯友共遊溫泉，卻因成員臨時取消導致產生高額違約金。繪里代墊約16.3萬日圓取消費後，遭部分友人拒付並封鎖，多年情誼因此決裂。此案例引發網路熱議，專家建議規劃旅遊時應採預付制，以規避潛在的金錢糾紛風險。針對年輕族群而言，數萬日圓的意外支出負擔沉重，法律上雖可追討，但因訴訟成本過高常陷入兩難。這場溫泉旅行爭議，凸顯了團體出遊中「主辦人」面臨的財務風險與人際挑戰，提醒民眾在規劃行程時，務必建立明確的費用分擔機制，避免友情因金錢糾紛而破產。

title_en: LED factories transform semiconductor supply chain CPO, high-end packaging and heat dissipation become new battlefields
summary_en: Catalyzed by high-end computing power and emerging applications, Taiwan's LED industry is accelerating the optimization of product and production capacity structures, ushering in a key turning point in high-value transformation. Taiwanese manufacturers, which in the past suffered from the dumping of production capacity by mainland manufacturers, are now collectively focusing on emerging tracks such as co-packaged optics (CPO), high-end semiconductor packaging and high-end heat dissipation. The traditional optoelectronics strategy has shifted to span the core semiconductor supply chain.

title_en: China United Oils and Fats Co., Ltd. will be prosecuted for failing to truthfully provide soybean oil on April 1st.
summary_en: The Taichung City Food Safety Department said today that five batches of soybean salad oil produced by China United Oils and Fats from April to June this year had been found to be unqualified, and the sixth and seventh batches had been found to be unqualified. The list of second-tier downstream operators in the country was announced today. At the same time, because China United did not provide the truth about the soybean oil batch number 314-1150401 produced on April 1, and was suspected of causing false reports to public servants, the relevant information was sent to the Taichung District Prosecutor's Office for investigation. This batch of oil was also included in the scope of preventive removal.

title_en: Tariff quotas for steel exports to the EU are on the way, and the Ministry of Economic Affairs is recruiting anti-laundering production areas to grab zero-tariff resources, which will take effect on the 24th.
summary_en: The European Union has implemented tariff quotas on 28 types of steel products imported into the EU since July 1. my country's national quotas are given to 9 types of steel products. The quantity within the quota is zero tariff, and the quantity exceeding the quota is subject to a 50% ad valorem tariff. In order to prevent the illegal practice of laundering the origin from infringing on the rights of Chinese manufacturers, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced on the 16th that "steel products exported to the EU from the free trade port zone must be approved by the Ministry" new regulations, which will take effect on July 24th.

summary_en: President Lai Ching-te, who is also the chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party, warned at the regular meeting of the Democratic Progressive Party on the 15th that the mainland continues to use the "Anti-Secession Law", the "National Unity and Progress Promotion Law" and other laws to form long-arm jurisdiction and cross-border suppression, which has a chilling effect on democratic society, and called for unity to protect democracy. In response, Chen Binhua, spokesman for the Taiwan Affairs Office of the Mainland China, countered on the evening of the 16th that the relevant claims were completely fabricated and smeared, with the purpose of intimidating the Taiwanese people. He also questioned Lai Qingde for repeatedly inciting the false narrative of "democracy versus authoritarianism", but the DPP is engaged in "green terror", so what qualifications and dignity does it have to talk about "democracy"?

The main affected crops were persimmons.

title: 台糖撤回吳乃仁管收後首次協商 1.8億債務還款計畫未談妥

title: 中聯油脂食安風暴延燒 金門下架逾1831公斤油品 未發現問題產品流市
summary: 衛生福利部食品藥物管理署日前公布，今年4月至6月間中聯公司共生產29批大豆沙拉油，目前已有5批產品檢出苯駢芘超過法規限量，為降低食品安全風險，已要求該公司4月至6月生產的其他油品及相關製品全面預防性下架。金門縣衛生局表示，自7月2日接獲中央通知後，立即啟動跨局處查核，截至今日中午12時止，縣內已累計下架回收受影響油品1831.87公斤，以及使用受影響原料製成的食品73.75公斤，目前相關產品仍持續回收中。

title: 影／颱風假引爭議 蔣萬安：立場就是料敵從寬

title: 青安3.0上路 財政部次長阮清華：幫助年輕人購屋

title: 金門海漂豬屍驗出非洲豬瘟病毒　豬肉7天禁運台灣本島

title_en: Optical Polycrystalline restarts strategic mergers and acquisitions with 252 million yuan; Tu Junguang talks about the layout for the first time
summary_en: Optical Polycrystal announced on the 15th that it will spend approximately 252 million yuan to acquire 100% equity of Zaolong Electric Engineering and Qinyao Electric Engineering, and the newly established subsidiary Zhaoyao Electric Engineering will undertake the transaction. Chairman Tu Jung-Kuang said today (16th) that what he values ​​​​is not short-term revenue, but the ability of the two companies to delve deeply into Taipower Engineering and Public Infrastructure. In the future, based on the past experience of integrating the group's Hazen, the engineering business will be built into the group's new growth engine through the expansion of capital, equipment and production capacity.

title: 晶華捷絲旅中山館首月住房率衝82%　瞄準獨旅、續拓林口、大阪
summary: 晶華國際酒店集團（2707）旗下設計旅店品牌「Just Sleep捷絲旅」持續拓展版圖，今年6月中旬開幕的「捷絲旅台北中山館」，營運滿月便繳出住房率82%、平均房價約2,500元的成績，開幕首月即獲利。隨著新館加入，目前捷絲旅海內外據點已達10館、客房數1,122間，集團也規劃2027年再開設林口館及日本大阪二館。

title_en: Hong Kong independent bookstore under investigation for "Only Red Flowers Bloom" Liang Wenjie: I recommend everyone to buy it and read it
summary_en: Independent bookstores in Hong Kong have been under investigation one after another this year. Among them, "Leave Bookstore" and "Tian Yuan Bookstore" were raided by the Hong Kong National Security Department yesterday on suspicion of violating national security regulations and several staff members were taken away. Liang Wenjie, deputy chairman of the Mainland Affairs Council, today not only mentioned that the book "Only Red Flowers Bloom" is very interesting, but also pointed out that Taiwanese business operators will conduct self-censorship when participating in the Hong Kong Book Fair, reminding the Chinese people to pay more attention to this information in Hong Kong.

title_en: Asian Biotechnology Conference opens Zhuo Kui: Investment in the biotechnology industry last year reached 55.08 billion yuan
summary_en: Executive President Zhuo Yongtai attended the opening ceremony of the Asian Biotechnology Conference on the 16th and said that the 2026 conference will have more than 50 countries and 3,000 biotech and medical experts and leaders coming from afar, including Nobel Prize winners to participate in discussions, demonstrating the international recognition and importance of Taiwan's biomedical industry. Zhuo Rongtai pointed out that "biotech and medical care" has been included in the country's thirteen strategic industries. In the future, the government will continue to use the collective strength of the country to help Taiwan's biotech and medical care reach new heights. He hopes that advanced biomedical doctors from various countries will provide valuable suggestions to bring more vitality to Taiwan's biomedical industry and jointly create a healthy life for mankind in the future.

title_en: Carrying 19 in a row! The jackpot of the Lotto is expected to be 700 million yuan, and a group is gathering funds to win the big prize
summary_en: The Grand Lotto jackpot has been won for 19 times in a row. The jackpot prize tomorrow (July 17) will be 700 million yuan, which is the highest Grand Lotto jackpot since the 5th Charity Lottery (113 years ago). If one person wins it alone, it will set a record for the highest single-bet jackpot prize in this year's Grand Lotto. At the same time, the Lotto Dragon Boat Festival has added "100 groups of 1 million yuan" event. As of July 14, 94 groups of 1 million yuan prizes have been given away. Tomorrow is also the last period of the lottery for the Dragon Boat Festival. There are still 6 groups of 1 million yuan to be given away. There are double chances of winning the high jackpot and the million plus prize.

title_en: The three major legal entities resold more than 43.1 billion yuan! TSMC comes to the rescue and the Taiwan stock market’s falling point converges from 660 points to 6 points
summary_en: The U.S. stock index closed black last night, and the trend of Taiwan stocks on the 16th was under pressure. In addition, on the eve of TSMC (2330)'s press conference, the long and short battles between weighted value stocks made the concentrated market index fluctuate. The highest intraday increase was 223.43 points, reaching 45,855.02 points, and the lowest fell 660.95 points, reaching 44,970.64 points. Fortunately, TSMC was close to midday. The momentum of the bulls gradually increased, inspiring Sun Semiconductor (8028) and other related concept stocks to light up at multiple levels. The final drop point sharply converged to 6.61 points, closing at 45,624.98 points, holding the 5-day moving average, with a transaction value of 900.838 billion yuan. title_en: An individual’s annual income of RMB 2 million is the threshold for Qing’an 3.0 wealth ranking. The Ministry of Finance considers that the burden of buying a house is less than one-third of the income.
summary_en: The Executive Yuan will finalize the Qing'an 3.0 plan. The terms of the wealth exclusion are the borrower's personal annual income of 2 million yuan, and there is almost no threshold for approval. Finance Deputy Minister Nguyen Thanh Hwa explained at a press conference after the Executive Yuan meeting on the 16th that this is an estimate based on the Household Income and Expenditure Survey of the General Accounting Office and considering that the housing purchase burden should not exceed one-third of the income. The reasonable standard is about 1.74 million yuan, and the rounded number is set to not exceed 2 million yuan.

title_en: Ministry of Finance: Those who have not received funding for Qingan 2.0 can withdraw their applications and reapply for Qingan 3.0 if they meet the qualifications of a married family.
summary_en: The Ministry of Finance’s “Young People’s Safe Home Purchase Preferential Loan” (hereinafter referred to as Qing’an Loan) 3.0 (hereinafter referred to as Qing’an 3.0) was approved by the 4012th meeting of the Executive Yuan on July 16 and will be implemented from August 1. summary_en: The Ministry of Labor announced on the 16th that the latest period of overtime breaks (unpaid leave) was 231 companies and 2,768 people. In the previous period on July 1, there were 245 households and 2,897 people. This time there are 14 fewer companies and 129 people. This is the lowest number since mid-May last year after the United States imposed tariffs in 2025. title: 一圖看外資預測！台積電達標了嗎？最樂觀40%仍被超車
summary: [Newtalk新聞] 台積電（2330）今（16）日召開法說會，市場原先聚焦外資對全年營收、資本支出與毛利率的預測是否能被公司正式財測驗證。從最終公布結果來看，營收與資本支出均優於市場原先較保守的預期，但毛利率則未達外資最樂觀估值。 主圖是根據分析師林鈺凱數據資料： 在全年營收成長方面，外資樂觀情境預估年增約40%，中性預估接近40%，悲觀情境則約35%。台積電表示，全年營收成長將「略高於40%」，顯示AI晶片與高效能運算（HPC）需求仍持續強勁，也讓市場對下半年接單動能更具信心。 資本支出則成為法說會另一大焦點。外資中性預估約560億美元，悲觀情境落在540億至560億美元區間。台積電最終將今年資本支出提升至600億至640億美元，明顯高於市場中性預估，反映2奈米、先進封裝CoWoS與AI相關產能仍處於積極擴充階段。 至於毛利率部分，外資樂觀預估一度上看70%，中性預估約67%至68%，悲觀情境約66%至67%。台積電實際給出的區間為65%至67%，低於市場最樂觀期待。市場普遍認為，海外新廠折舊增加、2奈米初期量產成本，以及先進封裝擴產費用，都是短期壓抑毛利率的主要因素。 整體而言

summary: [Newtalk新聞] 根據《彭博》報導，南韓金融服務委員會（FSC）今（16）日下午宣布，即日起暫停受理新增單一個股槓桿型 ETF 的上市申請，試圖為近期快速升溫的槓桿交易「踩煞車」。這項措施主要是針對散戶大量湧入三星電子（Samsung Electronics）、SK 海力士（SK Hynix）等記憶體大廠相關槓桿產品，所引發的市場波動。 與此同時，南韓監管機構也將槓桿 ETF 的最低保證金門檻，由原先的 1,000 萬韓元大幅提高至 3,000 萬韓元（折合約 2.03 萬美元），新規預計自 8 月 5 日起生效。 約兩個月前，南韓推出十多檔單一個股槓桿 ETF，可提供三星電子、SK 海力士等個股每日報酬「正二」的曝險。不過，由於相關產品為維持目標槓桿倍數，必須在每日收盤前進行大規模再平衡交易，也被部分市場人士認為是加劇個股及大盤波動的禍首之一，使南韓股市成為近期全球波動較為劇烈的市場之一。 報導指出，南韓金融監管機構是在與南韓財政部及央行官員舉行會議後，拍板採取上述措施。 除了暫停新增產品及提高保證金的門檻外，金融服務委員會也將強化對投資人的教育，未來槓桿 ETF 投資人的強制

title: 門神退散？金管會出招　明首度召開銀行獨董座談
summary: 金管會銀行局將於明（17）日召集全體本國銀行獨立董事舉行座談會，由銀行局長親自坐鎮，全面拉高銀行治理規格。本次會議聚焦三大核心，包括強化金融機構誠信經營文化、提升獨董職能及落實普惠金融政策。針對外界擔憂獨董恐流於「門神」或面臨利益衝突，銀行局副局長張嘉魁強調，監理機關將秉持依法辦理、透明且公平的原則，不會因銀行負責人背景而有差別待遇。金管會期望透過與獨董的深度對話，協助其精準掌握監理脈絡，進一步完善銀行治理防護網，確保金融市場健全經營，並展現監理機關不受外部干擾的獨立性與決心。

title_en: Tigerair Taiwan strives to break through/No need to worry about high fuel prices! Helping Tigerair gain muscle and lose fat, Huang Shihui cuts the "Ginger Duck route" and makes headwinds
summary_en: Huang Shihui, who took over as the chairman of Tigerair Taiwan (hereinafter referred to as Tiger Airways) in April last year, has led Tiger Airways to become the first national airline in profitability despite high oil prices, geopolitical risks and intensifying market competition just one year after taking office. In an exclusive interview with this magazine, she said that her first task after taking office is to "build muscle and lose fat" for the company, re-examine route efficiency and adjust the layout of the flight network. Even if oil prices soar, she is still confident that she will continue to maintain competitiveness.

title_en: Tiger Airways Taiwan breaks through the competition 1/Save 800 yuan by buying odd-share Taiwan Tiger tickets. She turns passengers into shareholders and Tiger fans explode
summary_en: After taking office, Huang Shihui, chairman of Tigerair Taiwan, not only re-examined route layout and improved operational efficiency, but also actively changed the brand image of low-cost airlines. In March this year, an exclusive shareholder discount was launched. As long as you hold one share of Taihu stock, you can enjoy a 800 yuan ticket purchase reward. In just one month, the number of shareholders has greatly increased from about 30,000 to 160,000. She believes that low-cost airlines should not just compete with others for being cheaper, but should allow passengers to choose the consumption method that best suits them according to their needs.

title_en: Tigerair Taiwan strives to break through 2/aims to be the first in Asia Huang Shihui’s four major layouts strive to become the first choice of low-cost airlines in Asia
summary_en: After completing route adjustment and brand innovation, Huang Shihui, chairman of Tigerair Taiwan, has set his sights on the next stage of growth. In an exclusive interview with this magazine, she proposed four major layouts: "new fleet, new products, new experience, and new services." She hopes that by expanding the fleet, deepening cooperation with joint airlines, and extending the route network, Taihu will no longer just delve into the Japanese market, but move towards becoming "Asia's first choice for low-cost airlines."

title: 英國監管機構審查TikTok，聚焦兒童安全與有害內容防護
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，英國通信管理局對TikTok的兒童安全措施展開調查。英國通信管理局(Ofcom)發布聲明表示，已對TikTok信息技術英國公司展開調查，以確定該公司是否未能履行英國網路安全義務，保護兒童免受有害內容侵害。此前Ofcom審查了各大平台的兒童安全措施及該局的兒童線上體驗報告。週四發布的一份年齡保證報告指出，一些年齡推斷模型，可能未能正確識別相當一部分兒童的年齡，這也包括TikTok使用的模型。聲明指稱，展開調查並不意味著已認定TikTok違反了其職責。證據收集和分析可能至少需要三個月，將於2026年10月提供進一步訊息。

title: AI股湧現獲利賣壓，日經225指數週四大跌1,915.97點或2.79%
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】日本股市週四走跌，AI相關業者股價紛傳跌聲，因在市場靜待晶片製造大廠台積電週四下午公佈財報之際，對近期表現優異的人工智能相關股票獲利了結。收盤時，東證第一部指數下挫59.33點或1.45%，報4,028.79點；日經225指數則是大跌1,915.97點或2.79%，報66,835.54點。T&D資產管理公司首席策略分析師Hiroshi Namioka表示，包括東京威力科創在內的許多晶片相關公司股價看起來都很高，因此投資者獲利了結也就不足為奇了。Namioka補充稱，市場參與者在台積電財報發布前可能持謹慎態度，如果業績超出預期，下午科技股可能會出現反彈。此外，Namioka指出，人們對人工智能，尤其是實體人工智能的成長預期依然非常強烈，根本上並未對科技股感到悲觀。週四的走勢看起來像是獲利回吐。個股表現方面，記憶體晶片製造商鎧俠股價大跌15.03%；半導體製程設備生產商東京威力科創股價下滑4.51%；營收逾五成來自北美市場的汽車製造大廠豐田汽車股價上揚1.17%；金融控股業者三菱日聯金融集團股價滑落1.84%；能源開採商國際石油開發帝石股價下挫0.61%。

Wu Derong, an adjunct associate professor of the Department of Atmospheric Science of National Central University, said in the "Tianji Classroom" column of the "Meteorological Application Promotion Foundation" today that although there will be tropical cloud clusters waxing and waning in the South China Sea and the east of the Philippines in the next few days, the development conditions are not good; however, the disturbance in the South China Sea will maintain southwesterly winds and moisture near Taiwan, increase atmospheric instability, and bring about heavy thunderstorms in the afternoons for several days.

summary_en: The defending champion Argentina and the "Three Lions" England met in the semi-finals of the World Cup today, staging a classic "English-Argentina showdown" 24 years apart. title_en: The Ministry of Environment issued carbon fee subsidy measures, with a maximum subsidy of 50% of the total funds for each case.
summary_en: my country has entered the era of pricing carbon emissions since 2025. This year, it has collected a carbon fee of 4.97 billion yuan, which has been included in the "Greenhouse Gas Management Fund" for the implementation of greenhouse gas reduction and climate change adaptation. The Ministry of Environment officially released the "Greenhouse Gas Reduction Technology and Climate Change Adaptation Subsidy Measures", with the subsidy amount capped at 50% of the total project funds. Subsidy projects are required to cooperate with the effectiveness evaluation, and the information will be disclosed on the Ministry of Environment website on a quarterly basis.

title_en: Taiwan stocks continue to rise, driven by AI concept stocks, and the amount of defaulted delivery soared past 7 billion
summary_en: Taiwanese stocks have continued to rise this year, driven by AI concept stocks. Market capital is highly concentrated and leveraged trading has expanded rapidly, which has also significantly increased the risk of defaulted delivery. According to statistics, as of July 15, the total amount of defaulted delivery of Taiwan stocks this year has reached 7.08 billion yuan, which not only exceeded the 3.85 billion yuan last year, but also reached 1.8 times that of last year. The number of default cases also climbed to 48, much higher than the 13 cases last year. This shows that as the stock market reaches a high, market credit risks have also increased simultaneously, attracting great attention from the competent authorities and the Legislative Yuan.

summary_en: AI has boosted TSMC's advanced manufacturing process, which has received strong orders, leading to an explosion in demand for electronic-grade chemicals. Coupled with the conflict in the Middle East, chemical raw materials have surged. Formosa Plastics has reflected market conditions and costs, and its two major electronic-grade chemicals, including electronic-grade hydrofluoric acid (HF) and electronic-grade isopropyl alcohol (IPA), have rarely seen a "double increase" in quotations.

title_en: Formosa Plastics Group's high-value transformation is heading towards harvest
summary_en: Formosa Plastics Group has successfully transformed into a high-value company, and its electronic chemicals business will feed back into the petrochemical industry. Formosa Plastics said that its wholly-owned subsidiary Formosa Plastics Deshan has started recycling electronic-grade isopropyl alcohol waste liquid in Linyuan Industrial Park and will complete it in the second half of the year. In addition, Formosa Plastics Daikin's new electronic-grade hydrofluoric acid (HF) production capacity will also be added to operations next year. It is estimated that the electronic chemicals business will make a significant contribution to Formosa Plastics' operations starting next year.

summary_en: Citing supply chain sources, foreign sources pointed out that Intel's next-generation "Nova Lake-S" processor production strategy has undergone a major shift. From the original contract of 60% to 70% of TSMC's 2nm foundry, most of them will be produced in-house, and outsourcing will drop to less than 20%, which is equivalent to a significant reduction of more than 60% of TSMC's order volume.

summary_en: As Intel strives to sprint towards the 18A advanced process, it is simultaneously accelerating its layout in the advanced packaging field. This shows that Intel is strengthening the competitiveness of the AI ​​chip supply chain through the dual engines of advanced process and advanced packaging.

summary_en: The Executive Yuan meeting will finalize the "Qing'an 3.0" plan today (16th). The new system will be launched on August 1 and will be implemented until July 31, 2029, for a period of three years. This time, there are four new restrictions: age limit, total house price limit, wealth exclusion mechanism, and "3+3" interest subsidy exit mechanism. The first three years are full subsidy of 2 digits, and starting from the fourth year, the subsidy is reduced by half a digit each year until it reaches zero.

title: 上市腳步逼近，Anthropic計畫數週內啟動IPO投資者會議
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，熟知內情的消息人士透露，Anthropic PBC正安排與投資者舉行會面，為潛在的大規模IPO做準備。以相關訊息尚未公開為由要求匿名的消息人士表示，負責此次IPO的承銷銀行將在未來幾週安排投資者與這家Claude聊天機器人開發商會面。此前有報導指稱，Anthropic最快有可能於10月啟動IPO。如果按計畫推動上市，Anthropic將領先於競爭對手OpenAI。有消息指稱，OpenAI目前計畫於2027年上市，較此前考慮的2026年秋季上市時間有所延遲。兩家公司均已秘密提交上市申請。若Anthropic於今秋上市，也將早於中國AI企業DeepSeek。DeepSeek正不斷擴大其在人工智慧市場的占有率。知情人士此前表示，DeepSeek正籌備IPO，最快可能於今年提交上市申請。知情人士指稱，相關討論仍在進行中，包括上市時間在內的細節仍可能發生變化。對於上述消息，Anthropic發言人拒絕置評。Anthropic在5月完成一輪融資後估值達到9,650億美元，首次超過OpenAI成為全球估值最高的未上市公司之一。

title: 美國7月份紐約州製造業指數攀升至15.6，表現優於預期

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，最新一週衡量美國抵押貸款申請的指標下跌，連續第二週下滑，因購屋貸款需求下滑。美國抵押貸款銀行協會(MBA, Mortgage Bankers Association)公佈的數據顯示，衡量截至7月10日止當週再融資與購屋抵押貸款需求的MBA貸款申請指數較前一週下跌2.7%，報259.1點。根據MBA數據，上週再融資抵押貸款申請分項指數上揚3.5%，報821.9點；購屋抵押貸款申請分項指數則是下跌7.3%，報157.2點。上週30年期固定抵押貸款利率由前一週6.58%，向上升至6.65%的水準。15年期固定抵押貸款平均利率則是由前一週的5.99%，向上升至6.05%的水準。上週再融資貸款申請占總申請的比例為43.2%，前一週為40.6%。MBA自1990年以來按週進行該項調查，調查涵蓋了美國逾75%的零售住宅抵押貸款申請。

title_en: Federal Reserve Beige Book: U.S. economy grows moderately, inflation outlook differs, fuel costs become key variables
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that the Federal Reserve stated that U.S. economic activity has grown at a slight to moderate pace in recent weeks, and employment levels have barely changed in most regions. The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released its Beige Book report, based on a survey of regional business contacts, reporting that overall prices were rising modestly. The Fed said some contacts attributed these rising costs to conflicts in the Middle East, while others cited tariffs. Consumer prices continue to rise, with some jurisdictions saying contacts are seeing their customers become more price-sensitive. The report is based on information collected by 12 regional Fed banks as of July 6 and compiled by the Chicago branch of the Federal Reserve. Several Fed officials have recently expressed concerns about high inflation and warned that interest rates may need to be raised this year. However, both Federal Reserve Chairman Joshua Washer and Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams have recently expressed dovish views on the outlook for inflation. The Beige Book report shows that as the situation in the Middle East intensifies energy price fluctuations, the inflation outlook for different Fed jurisdictions also differs. Expectations for price growth in the coming months vary across regions, with contacts in some regions expecting inflation to continue at its current pace, while those in others expect inflation to slow, partly due to lower fuel prices, the report said. title_en: Jen-Hsun Huang denies Huida product delay theory and emphasizes that Vera Rubin will be delivered to customers as planned
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that in response to claims that manufacturing issues may lead to product delays, Jensen Huang, founder and CEO of AI chip maker Nvidia Corp, said that the company's next-generation artificial intelligence accelerated computing system has entered the production stage and will be delivered to customers as planned. Jen-Hsun Huang told the media in Tokyo on Wednesday that Vera Rubin hardware is on track to achieve "large-scale" production as planned, but did not disclose a specific timetable. Huang Renxun reiterated that Huida is ready to supply H200 chips to China upon approval. Previously, Trump administration officials responsible for U.S. export controls confirmed that a small amount of Huida H200 artificial intelligence chips had been shipped to Chinese customers after receiving approval from Washington. "We haven't actually started shipping on a large scale yet," Huang said.

title_en: Bank of America Merrill Lynch's July manager survey showed a bullish market consensus, with the sentiment index hitting a new high since February.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Liu Juquan] The Bank of America Merrill Lynch manager survey report in July showed that managers’ bullish sentiment has increased, mainly driven by global economic prosperity, continued strength in AI capital expenditures, and the fact that the Federal Reserve’s policy may not be as hawkish as expected. The Manager Sentiment Index compiled by Bank of America Merrill Lynch based on indicators such as cash levels, stock allocation, and expectations for global growth prospects has climbed to 7.2 from 6.0 in June, a new high since February 2026. Cash levels have dropped sharply from 4.1% to 3.6%, which is also the lowest since February 2026, and has once again fallen below the 4% sell signal threshold. As for the overall economy, the proportion of managers who expect that the global economy will "not land" in the next twelve months has risen sharply from 40% to a record high of 54%. The proportion of managers who expect a soft landing has dropped from 47% to 39%, and the proportion who expects a hard landing has dropped from 5% to a historical low of 2%. The proportion of managers who expect global economic growth to become stronger in the next twelve months has risen sharply from a net -1% in June to a net 21%, a five-month high. If we look at the combination of economic growth and inflation, the proportion of people who expect the global economy to enter "stagnant inflation" dropped from 58% to 47%, while the proportion of people who expect to enter a "prosperity" scenario increased from 36% to 41%, which is the highest level since February 2022. , compared with the significant cooling of inflation expectations, a net 4% of managers expect global CPI inflation to fall in the next twelve months, a sharp reversal from the net 45% expected inflation in June, and the lowest inflation expectations since January 2025. title: IBM獲利預警 股價重挫25% 逾50年最大單日跌幅
summary: IBM上季營收初步估計低於預期，並發布獲利預警，坦言低估人工智慧（AI）帶動企業支出轉向硬體的程度，股價14日應聲崩跌25%，寫1972年以來最大單日跌幅，市值蒸發約670億美元。

title: 台幣連二貶 探15個月新低
summary: 美國6月通膨降溫，市場對聯準會（Fed）升息疑慮進一步緩解，美股四大指數全面收紅、美元指數同步回落，也激勵台股昨（15）日盤中一度大漲逾千點。不過，新台幣匯率仍未能擺脫外資匯出壓力，終場在中央銀行尾盤調節下，收在32.189元、貶值1.7分，續探近15個月新低，成交量縮至17.3億美元。新台幣收盤價連二貶。

summary: 國內13家上市金控今年上半年獲利成績單昨（15）日全數揭曉，13家金控6月單月稅後純益合計達734.9億元。累計上半年金控業大賺4,408.7億元，刷新歷史同期新高紀錄，年增率達101%，續寫三位數成長的戰績。

summary_en: The nine-in-one general election will be held on November 28. The Internal Affairs Committee of the Legislative Yuan has invited Chairman of the Central Election Commission You Yinglong and others to report and prepare for questions on "election preparations for local civil servant elections, election neutrality, countermeasures against disinformation, and the handling of referendum elections." The Central Election Commission stated that if a person from mainland China applies to register as a candidate, each county or city election committee will ask the household registration office to assist in checking whether there is an annotation on the certificate of loss of origin and the date of submission to prove whether the candidate has been registered in Taiwan for 10 years.

title_en: This ETF newcomer reverses the trend of breaking in June 00408A and attacks Taiwan stocks in a new situation
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market has experienced violent surges, with frequent single-day fluctuations of more than 1,000 points. This has also caused many active Taiwan stock ETFs to break on the day they were listed since June. The 00408A Active First Gold Premium Dividend, which was listed on July 15, has become the only active Taiwan stock exchange since June to reverse the situation of breaking on the day of listing. A newcomer to the Taiwan stock ETF, it closed up to 10.16 yuan. The listing of 00408A raised expectations for Taiwan stocks to resume their high-tech development and attracted investors' trading enthusiasm. The trading volume on the first day of listing exceeded 62,000, ranking among the top five active Taiwan stock ETF trading volumes on July 15.

At the end of the day, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 150.37 points, or 0.29%, to close at 52,658.64 points; the S&P 500 Index rose 0.38%; the Nasdaq Index, which is dominated by technology stocks, rose 0.62%; and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 2.08%. The other Taiwan index futures ended the day down 249 points, or 0.54%, at 45,817 points.

title: 牛市要變天了？外媒驚爆「5大致命警訊」齊發
summary: 財經中心／李明融報導地緣政治與金融市場的雙重風暴來襲，讓全球股市的牛市狂歡戛然而止。受到美伊新一輪軍事衝突升溫影響，美股科技股於週一（13日）慘遭血洗，費城半導體指數大跌 619 點（跌幅逾 4.5%）；這股恐慌情緒隨即在次日（14日）重創台股，盤中一度暴跌逾 1600 點，失守 44000 點大關。對此，外媒《Financial Review》示警，全球金融市場近期已同步浮現「5大警訊」。過去幾個月，投資人樂觀押注聯準會不會升息、經濟不會放緩、中東局勢穩定以及 AI 投資不減，如今這些樂觀預期都將面臨極其嚴峻的現實考驗。

Facing this important moment of global asset re-pricing, the earlier you plan your investment, the better your chances of seizing future growth dividends. In order to help investors participate in the market, Mega Securities offers major discounts for the dual markets of Taiwan and the United States. Not only will you receive a discount on Taiwan stock handling fees starting from NT$3,000 when you open an account, but you will also receive MO coins when you log in for the first transaction, and you will win a NT$100,000 travel gold prize when the transaction is completed, helping investors to easily start global investments.

title_en: U.S. and South Korean technology stocks plummeted, triggering shocks. Morgan: Demand for AI continues to strengthen, and the fundamentals of Taiwan’s technology industry are solid.
summary_en: Affected by multiple factors such as a sharp correction in the South Korean stock market, a pullback in U.S. technology stocks, and rising geopolitical and interest rate risks, the U.S. 10-year Treasury bond yield rose above 4.6%, and global technology stocks have experienced significant fluctuations in recent days. J.P. Morgan Asset Management pointed out that this correction is more biased toward short-term sentiment and evaluation adjustments rather than a reversal in the fundamentals of the AI ​​industry. As AI applications continue to expand, demand for high-end semiconductors remains strong, and TSMC (2330)’s latest revenue hit a record high, Taiwan’s technology industry’s profit prospects are still supportive and it is expected to become an important stabilizing force amid market fluctuations.

title: 影／賴清德頒「東方領袖人物」獎 盛讚施振榮實至名歸
summary: 台灣上市櫃公司協會晚上在台北舉辦第一屆「東方領袖人物」頒獎典禮，賴清德總統親自頒獎給宏碁集團創辦人、智榮基金會董事長施振榮。賴清德致詞表示，施振榮提出的「微笑曲線」為台灣產業從代工走向創新與品牌發展指引方向；推動的「王道文化」更強調創造價值、利益分享、雙贏及永續經營，對台灣企業文化帶來深遠影響。賴清德並表示，自己擔任行政院長時曾閱讀《王道文化》一書，深受啟發，盛讚施振榮獲獎實至名歸，感謝他對產業、社會及國家的卓越貢獻。

title_en: Film/Lai Ching-tak presented the "Oriental Leader" Award and praised Shi Zhenrong as well-deserved
summary_en: The Taiwan Listed Companies Association held the first "Oriental Leaders" award ceremony in Taipei in the evening. President Lai Ching-te personally presented the award to Shi Zhenrong, founder of Acer Group and chairman of Zhirong Foundation. Lai Ching-te said in his speech that the "Smile Curve" proposed by Shi Zhenrong guided the direction of Taiwan's industry from OEM to innovation and brand development; the "kingly culture" promoted emphasized value creation, benefit sharing, win-win and sustainable management, which had a profound impact on Taiwan's corporate culture. Lai Ching-te also said that when he was the Executive Dean, he read the book "Kingly Culture" and was deeply inspired. He praised Shi Zhen for winning the award and thanked him for his outstanding contributions to industry, society and the country.

title_en: Qing'an 3.0 will be finalized tomorrow. Four new thresholds including age and income will be added. Marriage and childbearing families are expected to increase in number.
summary_en: The Executive Yuan is expected to finalize on the 16th the "Young People's Safe Home Purchase Preferential Loan 3.0 (Qing'an 3.0)" plan, which plans to add new loan application thresholds such as age, income and total house price. According to the Ministry of Finance's plan, applicants must be under 50 years old, and the borrower's annual income of 2 million yuan is used as the criterion for wealth selection; the general loan limit remains at a maximum of 10 million yuan, and the loan limit will be increased for newlyweds and families with underage children, and it will be launched as soon as August 1.

title: DRAM 缺口愈補愈大 分析師：2027年供給滿足率恐降至六成
summary: 全球記憶體缺貨壓力持續升高。韓國券商Meritz Securities資深分析師15日指出，目前DRAM供應商僅能滿足約75%至80%的市場需求，2027年供給滿足率恐進一步降至六成；即使排除重複下單，實際供給仍只能滿足約七成需求，記憶體業者也開始與客戶簽訂三至五年長期供應協議。
title_zh: DRAM 缺口愈補愈大 分析師：2027年供給滿足率恐降至六成
summary_zh: 全球記憶體缺貨壓力持續升高。韓國券商Meritz Securities資深分析師15日指出，目前DRAM供應商僅能滿足約75%至80%的市場需求，2027年供給滿足率恐進一步降至六成；即使排除重複下單，實際供給仍只能滿足約七成需求，記憶體業者也開始與客戶簽訂三至五年長期供應協議。
title_en: DRAM gap is getting bigger and bigger. Analysts: Supply satisfaction rate may drop to 60% in 2027
summary_en: Global memory shortage pressure continues to increase. A senior analyst at Meritz Securities, a Korean brokerage, pointed out on the 15th that current DRAM suppliers can only meet about 75% to 80% of market demand, and the supply satisfaction rate may further drop to 60% in 2027; even if repeated orders are excluded, actual supply can still only meet about 70% of demand. Memory companies have also begun to sign three- to five-year long-term supply agreements with customers.

title_en: After waiting for 47 years for justice...Liang Zaifa, a victim of oil poisoning, will be re-identified with a history of exposure
summary_en: Liang Zaifa, a 61-year-old patient with oil syndrome in Waizhong Village, Fuxing Township, Changhua County, has been suffering from the disease for 47 years. His feet from the knees down still suffer from repeated swelling, pus, and blood spurts, and he is unable to work. However, because he was not registered at the time, he was unable to receive due care and rights protection. After a report by the United Daily News, the Ministry of Health and Welfare's Holistic Care Center for Oil Disease Patients and the Changhua County Health Bureau considered his poor financial situation and determined his exposure history.

title_en: The deadline for filling in the TWAC declaration has been extended to 7 days before arrival in Taiwan. Foreign tourists can complete the entry declaration in advance.
summary_en: In order to improve the convenience of entry for foreign tourists, the Immigration Department announced that from now on, it will relax the deadline for filling in the Taiwan Entry Registration Form (TAIWAN ARRIVAL CARD, referred to as TWAC). title_en: TSMC says life or death will be decided tomorrow!
summary_en: Yesterday, the Taiwan stock market plummeted by more than 1,700 points, and many investment friends were dejected. However, today, the Taiwan stock market surged by a thousand points, and finally closed up by 893 points, which made many people come back and win! Taiwan stocks surged today, and the biggest benefit lies in the latest CPI inflation data released by the United States. The latest actual value of inflation dropped to 3.5%, lower than market estimates of 3.8% and lower than the current Federal Reserve (Fed) benchmark interest rate of approximately 3.5% to 3.75%. Everyone should remember my words: "Interest rates must suppress inflation." Now that interest rates have successfully suppressed inflation, it means that the Federal Reserve has no pressure to continue to raise interest rates, and the withdrawal of funds that the market fears most will not happen. This is a huge real benefit to the global stock market!

title_en: On the second day of his visit to the mainland, Li Weihua, head of the youth exchange group of the People’s Party: Urban governance must be rational, pragmatic and scientific
summary_en: On the second day of the Taiwan People's Party's youth exchange tour in Shanghai, they visited the 12345 Citizen Service Hotline Operation Center and other places. Li Weihua, the leader of the group, said that the biggest inspiration from the visit is that urban governance must be rational, pragmatic, and scientific. Rationality means not letting emotions and slogans replace professional judgment; pragmatism means truly solving the problems that people encounter every day; science means using data, processes, systems and tracking mechanisms to continuously improve government services.

title_en: Domestic enterovirus continues to rise. Enterovirus 71 conjugate multivalent vaccine provides complete protection
summary_en: Enterovirus has long been one of the important infectious diseases that affects the health of infants and young children. Among them, enterovirus 71 (EV71) may cause neurological complications, severe illness or even death, and has been listed as a condition requiring special attention by doctors. Doctors recommend that young children should receive preventive vaccines. Domestic manufacturers continue to develop new generations of vaccines to provide complete protection.

title: COVID封鎖恐留後遺症？研究：4歲幼兒語言、執行功能表現下降
summary: 英國一項研究針對COVID-19封鎖疫情封鎖禁令前、中、後出生的4歲幼兒，進行語言及執行功能評估，發現這方面技能較弱。專家建議，一般建議照顧者多給予幼兒語言刺激，如多對話、親子共讀等，另外避免過早接觸3C產品。

title_en: Coca-Cola and Lion's short-term trial run for independent/single tour groups without accommodation. Tourists who take advantage of the group leader's rights may pay nearly 10,000 yuan more.
summary_en: Travel agencies in group tours usually arrange double rooms for double-occupancy. In order to save travel expenses, many tourists who sign up in odd numbers often choose to accept room allocations from travel agencies and stay in the same room with strangers in the same group or with the tour leader. However, complaints and disputes have arisen in an endless stream for a long time. Coca-Cola Travel and Lion Travel, two major domestic travel companies, have successively announced that from September, short-term tour groups will not be allocated rooms. After hearing the news, the tour leader praised it, but the odd number of tourists will have to pay the difference in room fees, and the travel expenses may increase by nearly 10,000 yuan.

title_en: In response to the cost of long-term care for the elderly, Farglory Life Insurance advocates a "dual-track mechanism" to create a peace of mind guide for both generations
summary_en: With the increase in average life expectancy and the impact of the declining birth rate, how to walk gracefully in the second half of a long life has become an inevitable and compulsory course for everyone. According to statistics from the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the total number of people with disabilities, dementia, and physical and mental disabilities in need of care in Taiwan has exceeded 800,000, and the average length of long-term care for Taiwanese people is as high as 7.3 years. If we estimate that the monthly basic care fees, nutritional products, and consumables are about 40,000 to 50,000 yuan, it will be a large family expense in the long run. summary_en: As Taiwan enters a super-aging society, accident protection for the elderly has become an important issue. In order to help the elderly to strengthen their protection against accidental injuries, Global Life has launched the "Global Life Senior Safe Term Insurance (LLF)" specially designed for the elderly. Breaking the common insurance age limit in the market, the insurance age is raised to 80 years old in one fell swoop, and the "principle-free physical examination" insurance mechanism is adopted. It also provides multiple protections for the fracture risks that the elderly are most worried about, and fills the gap in accidental medical treatment and care for the elderly.

title_en: World Football Championship/Hope to use Maradona’s spirit to withdraw from England McAllister: Maybe Messi can do it
summary_en: The United States-Canada-Mexico World Football Championship has entered its climax. After Spain took the lead in grabbing the first championship ticket of the year today, the "Blue and White Army" Argentina will compete with the "Three Lions" England for another championship qualification. This rivalry is not only about the final ticket, but also attracts attention because of the long historical grudge between the two countries. Facing the upcoming tough battle, the Argentine soldiers have expressed their stance that they will be led by the spirit of the legendary star Diego Maradona and strive to advance to the final.

title: ECB管委Kocher稱尚未見通膨第二輪影響，利率決策將保持靈活性
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，歐洲央行管委會成員Martin Kocher在接受Boersen Zeitung報採訪時表示，歐洲央行正特別關注中東衝突帶來的間接價格影響以及可能的第二輪影響。歐洲央行目前尚未看到第二輪影響，但必須根據預期調整貨幣政策，而市場預期正受到高度不確定性的影響。Kocher表示，如果必要，歐洲央行已做好準備採取措施。同時，Kocher重申，下次利率決議將討論維持利率不變或升息的選項。每次會議都將根據現有數據做出決定，歐洲央行的溝通提供了必要的靈活性。Kocher表示，歐元區經濟與基線預測情景「相差不遠」，近幾週油價略低於預期，但中東衝突再次爆發。

title: 勞退施行細則修正發布　保障純舊制勞工權益
summary: 勞動部今（15）日修正發布「勞工退休金條例施行細則」，針對純舊制勞工推出新方案，增設自願提繳退休金及勞雇雙方合意提前結算年資機制，自115年7月17日正式生效。此修正重點在於讓純舊制勞工能以每月工資6%範圍內自願提繳，並在符合退休要件下，經勞雇合意結算退休金後全數存入勞保局個人帳戶。此舉旨在提升勞工退休生活保障，增加理財彈性。勞動部強調，該方案未改變純舊制勞工身分，雇主仍須依舊制規定提撥準備金。若勞工結算後持續工作，雇主仍須支付剩餘年資退休金，或經勞雇雙方合意逐年結算，確保勞工退休準備更完善，降低老年經濟風險。

title: SEMI最新預測！全球半導體設備銷售連5年增加 估2028年衝2295億美元
summary: 國際半導體產業協會（SEMI）於15日發布《年中總半導體設備預測報告》，在全球人工智慧（AI）強勁需求的驅動下，半導體製造商積極擴充先進製程與封測產能，預期全球半導體設備銷售額將迎來連續5年的成長，並於2028年達到2295億美元的新高規模。

title: 川普召開戰情室會議研議擴大攻伊，荷姆茲與核設施成主要目標
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，美國總統川普週二在白宮戰情室召開國安高層會議，討論對伊朗發動規模更大的軍事攻勢，範圍可能超越目前集中於荷姆茲海峽周邊的打擊行動。消息顯示，華府正評估對伊朗戰略目標實施更具破壞力的攻擊，以迫使德黑蘭重新開放荷姆茲海峽，並接受美方在核問題上的要求。報導指出，出席會議者包括美國副總統范斯(JD Vance)、國務卿魯比歐(Marco Rubio)、國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)、參謀長聯席會議主席凱恩(Dan Caine)、中央情報局局長拉特克利夫(John Ratcliffe)，以及總統特使魏科夫(Steve Witkoff)。會議核心議題包括擴大打擊伊朗境內戰略設施，以及如何把軍事壓力轉化為談判籌碼。川普在會議前接受訪問時表示，美軍對伊朗的打擊將持續到他認為「已經足夠」為止，並警告若伊朗不重返談判桌，美方可能在下週攻擊橋梁與發電廠。他也未排除派遣地面部隊的可能性，顯示美方正在刻意保留進一步升級戰事的選項。市場人士指出，若美軍由荷姆茲海峽周邊有限打擊升級為深入伊朗境內的大規模攻勢，全球市場將重新評估原油與天然氣供應、航運保險、避險資產及通膨風險。

title: UBP預測，人民幣兌美元短期維持6.7-6.8區間波動
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，瑞士金融商Union Bancaire Privee(簡稱：UBP)表示，儘管人民幣兌美元從實際有效匯率角度來看被低估約9%，但受中國低利率環境以及荷姆茲海峽石油供應風險上升影響，未來數月人民幣兌美元匯率可能維持在6.7至6.8區間內波動。UBP亞洲外匯銷售主管Ignatius Pang在接受電視媒體採訪時表示，未來幾個月人民幣匯率的走勢可能會相當平淡。Pang表示，鑒於中國對石油的高度依賴，人民幣走勢在很大程度上取決於荷姆茲海峽局勢以及後續進展。

title: 穎崴大擴產／AI推升測試需求　穎崴滿手訂單5倍擴產迎大潮

title_en: Yingwei expands production/AI drives up testing demand. Yingwei is full of orders and expands production 5 times to meet the tide.
summary_en: Recently, there have been constant noises about the AI ​​bubble. Last week, the Asian stock market suffered a bloodbath. Thousand-dollar stocks staged a reshuffle show. Yingwei, the leader in test seats behind the stock market, was overtaken by the server guide rail manufacturer Chuanhu. As the chairman of Yingwei, Wang Jiahuang is not worried. In a recent interview with this magazine, he revealed: "The heterogeneous integration of chips has greatly increased the difficulty of testing. The higher the difficulty of testing, the better for Yingwei." He even emphasized: "We will never be absent in the next generation of silicon photonics layout." Not only that, Yingwei, which has orders from big names such as Huida and AMD, is actively expanding its factory by 5 times, continuing to deepen its hometown of Kaohsiung, and fully embracing the AI ​​​​trend.

title_en: Mirror Theory/The rise of default delivery in the stock market
summary_en: Taiwan’s financial tyrant and central bank president Yang Jinlong went to the Legislative Yuan again last week. Legislators raised many questions about the stock market, mainly regarding the high price-to-earnings ratio and the increase in defaulted deliveries. Regarding the former, Yang Jinlong did not comment on it, but only emphasized that the central bank is paying close attention to the rapid expansion of leverage operations in the stock market. As for defaulted delivery, Yang Jinlong stated that if this matter becomes widespread, it will become a "terrible" crisis, and the central bank is now paying close attention to it.

title: ASML再獲突破，英特爾導入最新光刻機生產晶片
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，荷蘭半導體生產設備製造商艾司摩爾控股公司(ASML Holding NV)表示，美國半導體業者英特爾公司(Intel Corp)已開始使用其最先進的機器進行晶片生產，顯示這種新設備已準備好被廣泛採用。艾司摩爾與英特爾兩家公司在聯合聲明中表示，英特爾將依靠艾司摩爾的EXE高數值孔徑極紫外線光刻機來生產其Ultra 3系列晶片的部分產品。這台新設備代表了艾司摩爾用於生產先進晶片的最新技術。這對總部荷蘭的艾司摩爾來說是一次關鍵性的勝利。新款高數值孔徑機器一直被批評價格過高，難以被主流市場接受，而英特爾的採用或許有助於扭轉這種看法。生產世界上最先進晶片的台積電曾表示，最新一代艾司摩爾機器太貴，不適合大規模生產，未來某個時候才會轉向採用該技術。

title_en: The cause of the severe afternoon thunderstorms this week was revealed. Expert: South China Sea air pump transports warm and humid air
summary_en: Due to southwesterly winds, watch out for afternoon thundershowers. Driven by the entire South China Sea wind field, the ambient water vapor will move toward the northeast, providing more supply. Large-scale southwesterly or southerly winds continue to transport warm and moist air from the South China Sea to the vicinity of Taiwan. This southwesterly wind is like a water vapor conveyor belt, and the South China Sea is more like a pump for water vapor.

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，統計數據顯示，6月份中國煉油企業將產量大幅削減至六年來的最低水準，以因應需求惡化以及波斯灣原油供應中斷。中國國家統計局週三公佈的數據顯示，6月份原油加工量延續跌勢，年比值下降18%至5,124萬噸，為自2020年3月以來的最低水準。此前公佈的中國6月份原油進口量已跌至近十年低點。經濟增速放緩以及交通運輸領域的電氣化浪潮顛覆了燃料需求格局，並嚴重壓縮了利潤空間，其中，由於依賴價格較低的伊朗原油，獨立煉油企業受衝擊最為嚴重。根據諮詢公司JLC，占全國煉油總產能三分之一的中國獨立煉油廠的開工率已降至九年來的最低水準。另一家諮詢機構GL Consulting則是表示，隨著更多企業為控制虧損而暫停部分裝置進行檢修，預計7月中國煉油總加工量將進一步下降。估計全年加工量將下降5.6%。中國通常從中東進口一半的原油，其需求疲軟迄今為止在一定程度上舒緩了伊朗戰爭引發的全球供應衝擊。但本月衝突的再度升級，使中國消費復甦的前景以及全球已耗盡的石油儲備前景都蒙上陰影。

summary_en: The 33rd Third Joint Meeting of Directors and Supervisors of the Asian Federation of Taiwan Chambers of Commerce was held in Taichung. The Taichung City Government held a welcome dinner last night. Mayor Lu Xiuyan personally attended to welcome Taiwanese business leaders and distinguished guests from Asia and around the world. On behalf of the Taichung City Government and the families of the 2.86 million citizens, she welcomes everyone back to Taichung. title_en: Taiwan Cultural Expo debuts in August, launching "online reservation" for the first time to bid farewell to the nightmare of queuing. Grab a reservation today
summary_en: The cultural curation exhibition of the 2026 Taiwan International Cultural Expo will be on display at the National Cultural Base Heritage Building of the Air Force from August 1 to 31, and the trade exhibition will be held at Taipei Nangang Exhibition Hall 1 from August 6 to 12. In response to the large number of people queuing up at the trade fairs every year, this year, for the first time, dual admission lines of "online reservation" and "on-site queuing" are adopted to provide a more comfortable and smooth viewing experience. In addition to the 18% increase in the number of used square meters this year, participating brands and used booths also increased by 26.3% and 25.7% respectively. It is estimated that the overall number of exhibition participants will reach a new high compared to last year's 650,000 visitors.
