title: 兩大期油亞洲電子盤續漲約1%，布油和紐約同創五週新高
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美伊衝突持續升溫，加上荷姆茲海峽航運與中東能源出口風險未解，國際油價週三亞洲電子盤延續強勢。兩大期油在前兩個交易日累計飆漲約11%後再追高約1%，顯示市場仍持續把供應中斷風險計入價格。布蘭特9月期油最新上漲0.93美元或1.1%，報每桶85.66美元；紐約8月期油漲0.66美元或0.8%，報每桶80美元，雙雙升至五週新高。油價連日急升，反映交易員對波斯灣油輪遇襲、區域空域風險及伊朗可能進一步干擾油氣出口的憂慮升高。伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊日前揚言，只要美國繼續對伊朗發動攻擊，中東地區便不會出口「一滴石油和天然氣」；與此同時，荷姆茲海峽附近接連發生油輪遇襲事件，使市場更加擔心衝突由軍事目標擴散至能源基礎設施與商業航運。即使實際出口尚未全面中斷，戰爭風險溢價仍快速推高原油報價。市場人士指出，油價短線走勢將取決於美伊是否恢復實質談判，以及荷姆茲海峽船流能否維持正常。若區域油氣出口進一步受阻，布蘭特與紐約期油仍可能延續漲勢；但在兩日急漲約11%後，盤中波動也可能明顯放大。

title_en: SoftBank founder counters skepticism Son Masayoshi: AI bubble theory is ridiculous

title: 美國對俄制裁新法案瞄準能源買家，中、印或面臨懲罰性關稅
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，由已故參議員Lindsey Graham領銜並獲得美國總統川普支持的最新對俄制裁法案將針對俄羅斯原油和天然氣的前五大買家，包括中國和印度。這項由兩黨參議員協商達成的法案將授權川普對這些國家徵收最高100%的關稅。此舉將進一步加大對俄羅斯的經濟壓力，迫使其結束持續四年的烏克蘭戰爭。這場戰爭已造成雙方軍隊合計約200萬人傷亡，並給基輔造成近2,000億美元的損失。如果川普實施這些關稅，可能衝擊美國與中、印兩國本已動盪的貿易關係。這並非美國首次因購買俄羅斯石油而懲罰其他國家。美國去年曾對印度加徵25%關稅，以懲罰該國進口俄羅斯石油，但在2月取消了涉俄關稅。

title: 歐盟航空安全局擴大中東空域警告，四個波灣國家列入避飛名單
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，美國與伊朗軍事對抗再度升溫，歐盟航空安全局(EASA)週二恢復並加強中東地區航空安全警告，要求航空公司避開巴林、科威特、卡達及阿拉伯聯合大公國領空，反映戰事風險已由伊朗及其鄰近地區，進一步擴散至波斯灣主要航空樞紐。根據最新警告，針對巴林、科威特、卡達及阿聯酋空域的避飛建議有效期至7月29日；伊朗、伊拉克及黎巴嫩空域的禁飛或高度風險警告則延長至8月底。相關措施將迫使歐洲及其他國際航空公司重新規畫航線，增加繞飛距離、燃料消耗與航班調度壓力。EASA擴大警告之際，美伊雙方正持續以導彈、無人機及空襲互相攻擊，荷姆茲海峽附近亦接連發生油輪遇襲事件。即使部分波灣國家並非直接交戰方，其境內設有美軍基地、能源設施及重要機場，仍可能面臨誤擊、攔截碎片、全球定位系統干擾及空中交通管制中斷等風險。市場人士認為，避飛範圍若持續擴大，將對卡達航空、阿聯酋航空、阿提哈德航空等區域航空樞紐造成壓力，歐亞航線與轉機網路亦可能受到干擾。航空公司除須承擔額外燃料與機組成本，也可能面臨航班取消、延誤及保險費率上升，顯示中東戰事對全球運輸體系的衝擊正由海運進一步擴散至航空領域。

title_en: Foreign carbon rights offset carbon fees to be launched next year. The Ministry of Environmental Protection has set game rules and can deduct up to 5% of carbon fees.
summary_en: The Ministry of Environment will announce the recognition criteria for foreign emission reduction credits (carbon rights) at the end of July. When large carbon emitters report to pay carbon fees next year, they will be able to use foreign carbon rights to offset carbon fees, up to 5%. There will be two principles. First, carbon rights cannot be used to offset carbon fees. Secondly, businesses with high carbon leakage risks cannot use foreign carbon rights to offset carbon fees.

title_en: Yiqi lost 0.05 yuan per share in May
summary_en: The stock price of time-lapse camera maker Yiqi (7402) has recently reached the trading information standard for many times. Yesterday (14th), in response to the request of the competent authorities, it announced a net loss after tax of 1.72 million yuan for May, which was narrower than the loss of 15.24 million yuan in the same period last year. The net loss per share in a single month was 0.05 yuan.

title: 東陽6月每股稅前盈餘0.58元
summary: 汽車零組件大廠東陽（1319）昨（14）日公告自結6月稅前盈餘3.46億元，每股稅前盈餘0.58元；第2季雖是傳統淡季，單季稅前盈餘仍衝上9.9億元，為同期次高；上半年稅前盈餘21.78億元，每股稅前盈餘3.69元。

title_en: Dongyang’s pre-tax earnings per share in June were 0.58 yuan
summary_en: Dongyang (1319), a major auto parts company, announced yesterday (14th) that it had a pre-tax profit of 346 million yuan in June, and a pre-tax profit per share of 0.58 yuan. Although the second quarter was the traditional off-season, the single-quarter pre-tax profit still reached 990 million yuan, the second highest in the same period. The pre-tax profit in the first half of the year was 2.178 billion yuan, and the pre-tax profit per share was 3.69 yuan.

title_en: Tong Ling spent 400 million to buy land in Xinzhuang
summary_en: Tongling (2910) held a major news press conference yesterday (14th) and stated that the board of directors recently approved the purchase of land in Xinzhuang District, New Taipei City from a related party, with a transaction amount of approximately 486 million yuan. After completing the transaction, the company will obtain complete ownership of the base and can independently plan construction and development in the future, and conduct overall development in conjunction with adjacent land, and strive for a 5% development reward.

title_en: China Fiber plans to spend RMB 1 billion on TSMC shares
summary_en: China Fiber (1718) has recently been actively activating its assets and adjusting its investment structure. The company announced yesterday (14th) that it has completed the disposal of more than 3,000 Huanan Gold stocks, cashed out approximately 130 million yuan, and plans to dispose of the shares of its subsidiary Taichung Commercial Bank again. On the other hand, the board of directors also decided to buy TSMC stocks for more than 1 billion yuan to optimize the overall asset allocation.

title_en: Xinhongzhou, a subsidiary of Tuokai, will be launched in the counter before the end of 2026
summary_en: Carbon fiber composite material manufacturer Tuokai (4536) is accelerating its expansion of operations. Its Xiamen subsidiary Xinhongzhou Precision Technology is expected to be listed on the market before the end of this year and is aiming to be listed next year. In addition, for the second phase of the factory construction plan in Vietnam, the board of directors also approved an investment increase of US$10 million (approximately NT$320 million) earlier. It is expected to start construction of the factory next year and be completed and put into production in 2029.

title_en: Protection of the rights and interests of people affected by Typhoon Bawei in highway supervision business can be extended to the end of the year
summary_en: The Highway Bureau announced the "Regulations on Measures for the Rights and Interests of Highway Supervision Services for People Affected by Typhoon Bawei on 0711". title_en: Who is responsible for cutting down or protecting trees? The Ministry of Environment promotes special laws on urban forestry and the "Green Shade Climate Adaptation Network Platform" is supervised by the whole people.
summary_en: Taiwan’s urban high temperature and tree pruning issues have solutions! The Ministry of Environment held a briefing on the "National Green Shade Climate Adaptation Plan" at National Chung Hsing University today (14th). Environment Minister Peng Qiming officially announced six major urban forest management priorities, announcing that the policy will shift from simply pursuing the number of trees planted to institutionalized management. In the future, urban forestry will be promoted and digital twin science will be established.

title_en: Driven by the growth of AR displays, Omdia estimates that the near-eye display market revenue will rebound to US$675 million in 2026
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Zhang Jiawei] According to the latest "VR, AR, and XR Near-Eye Display Analysis Report 2026" released by the research organization Omdia, after experiencing a sharp shrinkage in 2025, the near-eye display market revenue is expected to reach US$675 million in 2026, with an annual growth rate of 12%. The study also predicts that shipments of near-eye displays will reach 14.53 million units in 2026, an annual increase of 16%. The rapid growth of AR glasses will partially offset the continued weakness in the VR field. The current market sentiment in the VR field is still sluggish. Valerie Li, chief analyst at Omdia, said that since 2025, the XR industry has experienced significant strategic changes. Major technology companies including Meta, Apple, Samsung and Huawei have adjusted their product roadmaps, delaying or scaling back the release of VR headsets, and instead focusing on lightweight AI smart glasses and AR glasses. As manufacturers such as RayNeo, Alibaba, XREAL and VITURE launch new products, AR glasses are expected to become the fastest growing application area in the near-eye display market in 2026. Omdia predicts that AR display shipments will reach 4.1 million units, a 154% increase from the same period last year. Market revenue is expected to increase 152% annually to $156 million. This growth reflects the accelerated development of AR glasses, which is driven by increased industry investment and expanding ecosystem support. title_en: Kai Fund’s after-tax profit in the first half of the year was 28.44 billion yuan, and EPS was 1.64 yuan.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Liu Juquan] Kai Fund Holdings (2883) made a self-stated monthly after-tax profit of 6.11 billion yuan in June. The cumulative after-tax profit in the first half of this year was 28.44 billion yuan, and the earnings per share (EPS) was 1.64 yuan. KGI Life, a subsidiary of the company, will apply the new IFRS 17 accounting standards starting this year, and profits will no longer include FVOCI (Fair Value through Other Comprehensive Income) stock disposal benefits. If the FVOCI stock disposal benefits in June are added in, the total reaches 15.447 billion yuan, continuing to hit a new monthly high this year; the cumulative after-tax profit in the first half of this year plus the FVOCI stock disposal benefits is 67.775 billion yuan, a record high for the same period in history. The above-mentioned FVOCI stock disposal benefits mainly come from KGI Life's control of the market pulse. In June, it has realized stock disposal benefits of approximately 9.34 billion yuan. In the first half of this year, the cumulative stock realized benefits have exceeded 39.33 billion yuan. Although it is not included in the profits of the current period, it is directly reflected in retained earnings and is still the basis of distributable earnings. Kai Fund Holdings said that in June, Taiwan stocks continued their bullish trend in May and continued to hit new highs driven by AI and semiconductor groups. Later, due to high-end profit-taking selling pressure, the stock market showed a high-end consolidation pattern. Financial Holding's securities, banking and life insurance businesses performed solidly and continued to boost the group's profit momentum. In terms of banking business, benefiting from the steady expansion of the overall deposit scale, net interest income and wealth management business have driven the continued growth of fee income, becoming an important factor in boosting bank profits.

title: BioTReC攜手DCB舉辦「NBRP Demo & Pitch Day」 展現生醫創新能量
summary: 中央研究院生醫轉譯研究中心（BioTReC）與生物技術開發中心（DCB)）於13日至14日在國家生技研究園區共同舉辦「2026 NBRP Demo & Pitch Day」，集結24組具發展潛力的生醫團隊，經專業評審遴選，選出優秀團隊，肯定其在技術創新、臨床應用及市場發展潛力上的卓越表現，並為後續技術落地與產業合作奠定基礎。

summary_en: The Biomedical Translational Research Center of Academia Sinica (BioTReC) and the Development Center of Biotechnology (DCB) jointly held the "2026 NBRP Demo & Pitch Day" at the National Biotechnology Research Park from the 13th to the 14th, gathering 24 groups of biomedical teams with development potential. title_en: Zoomlion Oils and Fats Case Xiang Jiguang: Unpurchased and abnormal batch numbers used
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Jiang Mingyan, Taipei, 14th) As the Zoomlion Oil and Fats case spreads, Xiangjiguang Group stated that during the period from April to June when the competent authorities expanded the investigation, it did not purchase or use the abnormal batch numbers of oil products announced by the Food and Drug Administration. In response to the Changhua County Health Bureau’s announcement of 15 records involving Xiangjiguang-related storage locations, the actual purchased batches were also different from the abnormal batches announced, and a letter will be requested for review on the 15th.

title: 中信金上半年稅後盈餘395.37億元，再刷新紀錄，EPS 1.96元
summary: 【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】中信金(2891)2026年6月自結盈餘，單月稅後盈餘47.47億元，累計前6月合併稅後盈餘395.37億元，再度刷新上半年獲利紀錄，每股盈餘（EPS）1.96元。中國信託金控表示，子公司中國信託商業銀行6月份放款持續增長且財富管理業務動能強勁，單月稅後獲利為42.33億元。累計前6月稅後獲利311.78億元，較去年同期成長12%，創下歷年上半年獲利新高。除淨利差擴大外，各項核心業務同步展現強勁成長動能，其中財富管理業務表現尤為亮眼，收入成長幅度超過四成；放款量亦有近二成的成長，已超越去年全年水準。此外，存款量及刷卡消費金額亦均有雙位數成長，充分展現市場擴展及客戶經營成果。子公司台灣人壽保險公司6月份受惠於國內外股利進帳與金融資產評價利益，單月稅後獲利15.95億元。累計前六月稅後獲利為102.76億元，主要來自過往累積CSM攤銷、基金評價利益及投資型保單以國際財務報導準則第15號重新衡量之影響。保險業務動能方面，在分紅及投資型保單銷售帶動下，累計新契約保費達641億元，較去年同期成長139%。

summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Liu Juquan] CITIC Financial (2891) recorded a self-reported profit in June 2026, with a single-month after-tax profit of 4.747 billion yuan, and a cumulative consolidated after-tax profit of 39.537 billion yuan in the first six months, once again setting a profit record for the first half of the year, with earnings per share (EPS) of 1.96 yuan. China Trust Financial Holdings said that its subsidiary China Trust Commercial Bank continued to grow in lending and had strong momentum in its wealth management business in June, with a single-month after-tax profit of 4.233 billion yuan. The cumulative after-tax profit for the first six months was 31.178 billion yuan, an increase of 12% over the same period last year, setting a new record for profit in the first half of the year. In addition to the expansion of net interest margin, all core businesses simultaneously demonstrated strong growth momentum. Among them, the wealth management business performed particularly well, with revenue growth exceeding 40%; loan volume also increased by nearly 20%, exceeding last year's full-year level. In addition, the amount of deposits and card consumption also recorded double-digit growth, fully demonstrating the market expansion and customer management results. The subsidiary Taiwan Life Insurance Company benefited from domestic and foreign dividend receipts and financial asset evaluation benefits in June, with a single-month after-tax profit of 1.595 billion yuan. The cumulative profit after tax for the first six months was 10.276 billion yuan, mainly due to the impact of past accumulated CSM amortization, fund evaluation benefits and investment insurance policies remeasured according to IFRS No. 15. In terms of insurance business momentum, driven by the sales of dividend and investment policies, cumulative new contract premiums reached 64.1 billion yuan, an increase of 139% over the same period last year.

title_en: Can TSMC buy it before the meeting? Foreign media calls for a strong buy! Experts reveal 1 strategy for risk avoidance
summary_en: The ADR of TSMC’s U.S. stocks has soared by more than 45% this year. The National Protectorate Mountain will hold a legal meeting on the 16th, and the market is paying close attention to it. Palkaf, a well-known American analyst, pointed out that TSMC has achieved excellent revenue and gross profit margin performance due to strong demand from giants such as Huida and Apple, with an operating profit rate as high as 55%, demonstrating its strength as a global semiconductor hegemon. Through the actuarial calculation of the discounted cash flow model, analysts believe that TSMC’s true valuation is US$616, and the current stock price is still undervalued. In the face of market fluctuations before the meeting, experts suggest that retail investors adopt a "half-fund split" strategy, that is, half of the funds will be blocked before the meeting, and the rest will be released after the opening of the trading meeting.

title: 潤泰全旗下中和量販店去年轉虧，擬於9/30結束營運，退出量販市場
summary: 【財訊快報／記者陳浩寧報導】潤泰全(2915)14日重訊指出，大全聯中和店因近年受整體量販零售市場環境變遷影響，經營面臨嚴峻挑戰，去年全年虧損約1200萬元，今年第一季則虧損逾800萬元，經審慎評估後，為維護股東權益並優化公司資產運用，擬於今年9月30日終止該店之營運。 潤泰全提到，中和量販店近年因受零售市場變遷，營運績效未達預期水準，為維護股東權益，經審慎評估後，決議於今年9月30日終止營運。該店自民國89年正式營運以來，每年提供穩定獲利，然而近年隨消費模式轉移至電子商務，加上租金、水電與人力成本增加，營運面臨嚴峻挑戰，使得該店出現虧損，去年虧損約1200萬元，今年第一季則虧損逾800萬元，至於出售後的資產價值則還在估算當中。 針對後續的自有資產與員工安置問題，潤泰全表示，已研擬完善的方案因應，營業資產如目前經營場所、設備、存貨等將洽詢有意的廠商出租或出售。現有編制同仁將依據勞基法之規定全數辦理資遣或退休。公司亦將秉持負責任態度，全面協助同仁媒合、轉調相關產業。

title_en: Taishan stops selling soy salad oil related products and promises to donate 30 million yuan to increase food safety inspection capacity
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter He Xiuling, Taipei, 14th) The soybean salad oil produced by Zoomlion Oil and Fats was found to have exceeded the standard level of the first-level carcinogen benzene pyrene (BaP). summary_en: The Taipei City Investigation Bureau of the Bureau of Investigation received a report that Shao Zihang, a former engineer of the Kaichuang Water Resources Company, knew that environmental protection is now in the spotlight and major factories need to have sewage monitoring certificates to operate. After leaving his job, he actually stole the circuit diagram of the company's water quality monitoring system equipment and used his girlfriend as his wife. He started a new company and stole the business of his old employer's Taiwanese and mainland customers, and profited from it. The task force searched and interviewed Shao Zihang and his girlfriend Ke Huizhen today. After interrogation, the Taipei District Prosecutor's Office ordered Ke's daughter to post a bail of 200,000 in accordance with the Trade Secrets Act, and Shao's man is under interrogation.

summary_en: The four major U.S. stock indexes all closed higher, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index soaring 2.54%, and the Taiwanese Index futures soaring 225 points in overnight trading. Although TSMC futures fell slightly by 5 yuan after the market, driven by the stabilization of international stock markets, Taiwanese stocks are expected to rebound after opening today (15th). The market focus will still be on the performance of AI, semiconductors and weight stocks.

title: 穎崴大擴產／AI推升測試需求　穎崴滿手訂單5倍擴產迎大潮
summary: 近期AI泡沫聲浪不斷，上週亞股遭血洗，千金股上演洗牌秀，原為股后的測試座龍頭穎崴，遭伺服器導軌大廠川湖超車。身為穎崴董事長的王嘉煌卻不擔心，日前他接受本刊訪問透露：「晶片異質整合讓測試難度暴增，測試困難度愈高，對穎崴愈好。」他更強調：「在下一世代矽光子布局，我們絕不缺席。」不僅如此，手握輝達、超微等大咖訂單的穎崴正積極擴廠5倍，持續深耕家鄉高雄，全力迎接AI大潮。

title: 鏡論／股市違約交割波瀾漸興
summary: 台灣金融扛霸子、央行總裁楊金龍，上週又去立法院。立委針對股市提問不少，主要是本益比偏高，以及違約交割增多。對於前者，楊金龍沒有著墨，只強調央行密切注意股市槓桿操作快速擴張；至於違約交割，楊金龍則表態，此事若普遍氾濫，就成了「不得了」危局，央行現在也是密切關注。

title: 穎崴大擴產2／全面卡位矽光子新賽道　王嘉煌：穎崴不缺席CPO

title: 穎崴大擴產3／取代國際大廠　穎崴2關鍵優勢成測試座龍頭
summary: 穎崴不僅在現有半導體測試市場寫下高獲利奇蹟，更以業界最高的研發投入卡位未來的矽光子賽道，甚至開出高達40個月的員工年薪震驚業界。外界普遍感到好奇，這家規模看似精簡、來自高雄的本土企業，究竟憑什麼打破歐美日國際大廠長期以來的技術壟斷？

title_en: Runtai Group officially bids farewell to the mass retail industry. What structural challenges has the large-scale mass merchandiser industry faced in recent years?
summary_en: Runtai Group has been deeply involved in Taiwan's mass retail market for nearly 30 years, and now it officially bids farewell to this business. Its subsidiary Runtaiquan (2915) announced on the 14th that the franchised Daquan Lianzhonghe store will end operations on September 30 and will be directly operated by Quanlian Group in the future; at the same time, the Daquan Lianzhonglun store under Runtaixin (9945) is also expected to turn off its lights on September 13. With the two major strongholds gradually withdrawing from operations, Runtai Group's mass retailing layout has come to an end, which has also caused the market to re-examine what structural challenges the large-scale mass retailing industry has faced in recent years?

title_en: Combined benefits show off! Taishin Shin Kong Gold made a huge profit of 43.83 billion in half a year
summary_en: Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holdings announced its self-finance report for the first half of 2026. The consolidated after-tax net profit surged to 43.83 billion yuan, an annual growth rate of 329%, and the earnings per share (EPS) was 1.71 yuan, both hitting record highs. This outstanding performance not only benefited from the strong momentum of the core business of banking and securities, but also included the impact of IFRS 3 accounting adjustments after corporate mergers. Taishin Bank's cumulative profit increased by 26% year-on-year and continued to hit a new high for the same period. Shin Kong Life Insurance increased its new contract premiums by more than 30% through dynamic investment allocation optimization. Taishin Securities benefited from the active market trading and also performed well in profits. Overall, the operations of each subsidiary are stable and asset quality remains at a high level, demonstrating strong merger synergies and operational expansion momentum.

summary_en: The Legislative Yuan will launch a joint review of the "UAV Regulations" on July 16. The market expects more than 200 billion in capital injection, driving a strong rise in indicator stocks such as Leihu and Hanxiang. The Executive Yuan recently passed special regulations on the procurement of autonomous unmanned vehicles for national defense, covering surveillance and reconnaissance, attack drones and suicide unmanned boats, aiming to strengthen the asymmetric combat capabilities of the national army. According to legal analysis, as the bill enters the review process, subsequent budget preparation and procurement plans will be carried out one after another. Military supply chains such as AirAsia, Hanxiang, Evergreen Aerospace, Yaguang, Shengtian, Zhulong, Shixinke, Liji and Quanxun will directly benefit, and the industrial camp movement is expected to be popular. Investors should pay attention to the progress of policy advancement and carefully assess risks.

title_en: Interest rate insurance policies should be sold as fixed deposits. The Financial Supervisory Commission will put an end to rhetorical marketing and set up three lines of defense.
summary_en: Variable interest rate insurance policies (variable interest rate insurance policies) are sold by some operators as bank fixed deposits, which has led to misunderstanding among the public and has caused a lot of controversy. The Financial Supervisory Commission yesterday announced the establishment of three lines of defense, requiring businesses to add warnings, list different scenarios for announcing interest rates, and include internal audit and control projects. Violations can be punished with fines of up to NT$12 million. The new regulations will go into effect on New Year's Day next year.

The Financial Supervisory Commission has asked the Property and Casualty Insurance Association to formulate unified claims settlement principles, and any doubts should be explained in the direction of benefiting policyholders.

summary_en: How to accurately cool down cities in hot summer? title_en: Three explosions in a row in half a month! Yageo is rumored to have defaulted on delivery for a huge amount of 26.51 million yuan, and the cumulative amount exceeded 100 million yuan
summary_en: Yageo* (2327), the leading passive component manufacturer, has been frequently reported to have defaulted on delivery of huge amounts in recent days. Following the huge defaults reported on June 30 and July 9 respectively, the Taiwan Stock Exchange today once again announced the huge default delivery case of Yageo. The reporting securities firm was KGI Linkou, and the default amount reached 26.514 million yuan. This is Yageo’s third major breach of contract in just half a month, and it is also the first time this year that a stock has defaulted on delivery three times. The cumulative default amount has reached 166 million yuan, which has attracted market attention.

title_en: Geopolitics heats up + chip stocks sell off, Taiwan stock market shock intensifies Legal person: Continue to focus on AI mainstream stocks
summary_en: The United States has once again launched a powerful attack on Iranian oil shipments, tensions in the Middle East are rising, and the recent sharp decline in chip stocks in the United States, Japan, and South Korea has significantly expanded the volatility of Taiwan stocks. Xu Qiwei, manager of China Trust Taiwan Vitality Fund, said that the short-term market is facing pressure from evaluation revisions and profit adjustments, but the trend of the global AI industry has not changed, and corporate profit prospects are still resilient. Taiwan's supply chain continues to maintain its leading edge in high-performance computing, advanced processes, and AI applications. Supported by fundamentals, the mid- to long-term growth momentum of Taiwanese stocks remains positive. It is expected that in the future, the market will shift from an overall push by funds to a stock selection-dominated one. Investors are advised to adopt a turnaround strategy and focus on leading AI and technology companies with clear industry trends and high profit visibility.

In order to help travelers calmly face various emergencies during the journey, Cathay Property & Casualty Insurance will launch the "Summer Travel Double Enjoyment" travel protection plan from now on, focusing on the dual protection design of "fixed payment" and "pay-as-you-go" for flight delays that is rare in the market, to cope with various additional derivatives. title: 台股重摔又V轉千點！千金俱樂部血流成河 台塑、軍工合力救火｜Yahoo財經掃描
summary:
美國總統川普宣布重啟對伊朗港口的軍事封鎖，並將向行經荷姆茲海峽的貨船收取20%通行費，國際油價聞訊飆升近一成，通膨與聯準會升息疑慮再起，加上AI晶片股遭遇獲利了結，美國四大指數13日全面收跌，其中費城半導體指數更重挫4.78%。個股方面，SK海力士ADR掛牌熱潮迅速退燒，股價暴跌19.32%，拖累記憶體與晶片族群全面走弱，美光下跌4.32%、輝達下挫3.52%，英特爾雖宣布斥資57億美元擴建愛爾蘭晶圓廠，股價仍重挫6.12%，逼近100美元保衛戰；SpaceX也下跌4.24%至139美元附近，距離135美元IPO價已不遠。台積電雖公布營收創新高，ADR仍下跌2.89%。

亞股方面，前一日遭遇熔斷重挫的韓股反彈，三星電子與SK海力士回升，韓股終場上漲0.74%；日股同步走揚上漲0.74%。陸港股也全面收漲，上證指數上漲1.36%，港股上揚0.52%，亞股在前一日劇烈殺盤後出現修復。

台股今(14)日受美股晶片股重挫與中東局勢升溫衝擊，早盤一度下殺1726.48點至43,654.04點，隨低接買盤進場，跌幅大幅收斂，終場下跌642.57點、跌幅1.42%，收44,737.95點，失守4萬5關卡，成交金額1兆1802.54億元，拉出逾千點長下影線。台積電(2330)盤中承壓，尾盤跌幅收斂，終場下跌20元至2420元，守住2400元關卡；權值股聯發科(2454)重挫逾4%，台達電(2308)也同步走弱。盤面資金轉向傳產避險，台塑(1301)、南亞(1303)、台化(1326)、台塑化(6505)逆勢走強，帶動塑膠類股上漲4.61%；矽晶圓與軍工族群也有零星個股點火。整體來看，台股雖從盤中低點強彈逾千點，但電子權值股與高價股賣壓仍重，盤勢呈現資金撤出科技、轉進塑化等傳產族群的分歧格局。

title_en: The stock exchange continues to improve the ETF market infrastructure and promotes the further upgrade of the application and redemption platform functions.
summary_en: In response to the continued growth of my country's ETF market, the Taiwan Stock Exchange has improved the infrastructure of the ETF market and promoted the optimization of the functions of the ETF application and redemption platform in line with market practical needs. This time, the platform has added a "batch upload" function, which has been officially launched on July 13, 2026. Investment trust companies can upload all the company's issued ETF-related files at one time, simplifying the file-by-file upload process, and retaining the file-by-file upload mechanism to take into account the operational needs of different operators. The launch of new functions is an important achievement of the stock exchange in improving the infrastructure of the ETF market. It not only reduces the burden of repetitive operations on investment companies, but also maintains the convenience of platform operations in response to the continued increase in ETF products in the future and further improves the efficiency of primary ETF market operations.

title: 考量季節影響及需求尚須復甦，中鴻8月內銷熱軋、冷軋調降800元/噸
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】中鴻(2014)今日開出8月內銷及9月外銷盤價，內銷熱軋、冷軋及鍍鋅各調降800元/噸，外銷則依產品及地區別調整，實際報價視當地市場行情而定。中鴻表示，當前鋼市供需結構正逐步調整，核心原料成本仍提供鋼價一定支撐，惟考量國內市場受高溫多雨季節影響及終端需求復甦仍需時間，經審慎評估市場狀況後，本次盤價適度調降，以協助客戶維持接單動能。鋼鐵供需方面，中國大陸中鋼協公布6月下旬粗鋼日產環比續降3.6%，供給端持續調整，帶動下游鋼材庫存去化，有助市場供需結構逐步改善。另一方面，煤鐵原料價格維持高位，鋼廠成本有所承壓；惟受季節性淡季影響，終端需求恢復偏緩，加上歐盟TRQ保障措施，使區域出口競爭加劇，亞洲鋼市因區域供需及市場差異，價格走勢呈現分化。總體經濟方面，IMF小幅下修今年全球經濟成長至3.0%(-0.1%)，惟報告指出全球經濟承受地緣政治衝擊能力優於預期。此外，S&P Global最新6月全球製造業PMI雖放緩至52.2，但整體仍維持擴張格局，顯示主要經濟體製造活動尚具支撐；當前在能源價格維持區間震盪及通膨壓力未再升溫下，預計全球經濟於不確定環境中將維持一定韌性。

title: 過戶代理機構請願美國SEC：未經授權代幣化股票非實質股權
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導美國證券過戶代理機構協會（Securities Transfer Association, STA）昨日向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）遞交請願書，主張若無發行人授權並經正式記錄的代幣化股票，不應被視為實質股權。此舉旨在敦促美國證管會確保任何針對代幣化證券的創新豁免或試點計畫，僅適用於發行公司已授權的產品，以保護投資人權益並維護市場完整性。 過戶代理機構是維護上市公司股權檔案的關鍵單位，這些檔案是所有權的官方記錄。Computershare 北美發行人服務執行長 Ann Bowering 指出，上市公司客戶對於「包裝式產品」感到擔憂，因為這些產品看似代表了公司股份的所有權，卻存在於發行人自身的記錄、治理和溝通管道之外。Equiniti 執行長 Dan Kramer 更直言，未經發行人授權且未經其過戶代理機構記錄的代幣，並非代幣化股權，而是一種合成工具，讓投資者面臨風險且發行人無法追溯。 該請願書回應了美國證管會今年5月潛在的監管方向。當時《Bloomberg》曾報導，美國證管會正考慮允許第三方平台在未經公司同意的情況下，發行和交易代幣化股票的創新豁免

summary_en: The Institute of Economics of Academia Sinica released its latest forecast yesterday (13th), revising Taiwan's economic growth rate this year to 10.16%, a surge of 6.45 percentage points from the forecast at the end of last year. It is currently the highest forecast value by a major domestic economic think tank, and also declares that Taiwan's economy is entering a period of rapid expansion.

title_en: The annual CPI growth rate rose to 1.95%, approaching the 2% inflation warning line
summary_en: The Institute of Economics of Academia Sinica yesterday (13th) raised its forecast for the annual growth rate of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) this year to 1.95%, approaching the 2% inflation warning line. The latest consumer survey also shows that due to the impact of the war in the Middle East, 63.1% of the people expect the cost of living to increase in one year, with the average expected increase reaching 8.77%, and 92.9% expect that inflation will continue to rise in one year, reflecting the rapid rise in public expectations for inflation.

title_en: National Security Fund settlement earns tens of billions
summary_en: The National Financial Stability Fund held its second quarter regular meeting yesterday (13th) and announced that it had liquidated all its holdings on May 6. The net profit from stock disposals plus cash dividends made a total profit of 10 billion yuan, reaching 10.08 billion yuan, of which stock profits were 9.86 billion yuan, with a return rate of about 81%, the second highest record in history.

title: ABF 四強目標價 調高

title_en: ABF top four target price raised
summary_en: Goldman Sachs Securities released a shocking report in its latest "Asian Technology Industry" report, pointing out that the ABF carrier board bottleneck is difficult to solve and the nightmare of shortages is getting worse, which will drive the related Taiwanese supply chain's profit performance in the next two years to be better than expected. Therefore, it has significantly raised the target prices of four stocks including China Southern Power (8046), Jingshuo, Xinxing, and Zhending-KY.

title: 紐約市清潔能源輸電幹線二度停擺，60億美元加國水電線路故障引關注

title: 世芯6月合併營收暴衝 月增84% 推升第2季業績站上近一年高點
summary: ASIC設計服務商世芯-KY（3661）昨（13）日公布6月合併營收35.72億元，攀上近15個月高點，並較5月增84.6%，推升第2季營收衝上76.39億元，為近四季新高，季增率逾八成。

title_en: Sechip's consolidated revenue surged in June, rising 84% month-on-month, pushing second-quarter results to the highest level in nearly a year
summary_en: ASIC design service provider Shixin-KY (3661) announced yesterday (13th) that its consolidated revenue in June was 3.572 billion yuan, reaching a high of nearly 15 months and increasing 84.6% from May, pushing its second-quarter revenue to 7.639 billion yuan, a new high in the past four seasons, with a quarterly growth rate of more than 80%.

title: 年化配息率3.33%！「這檔ETF」配息暴增150%　1.9萬人搶搭末班車
summary: 台股近期表現強勁，不少投資人荷包滿滿，也帶動全民投資熱潮，其中ETF更成為小資族布局首選。採季配息模式、受益人數突破3.8萬大關的台股ETF台新臺灣IC設計（00947），昨（13）日宣布最新一期配息，每受益權單位配發0.3元，換算持有一張可入袋300元，相較上次配息0.12元，漲幅高達150%。該檔ETF除息日訂於明日7月15日，今日即為最後買進日，凡於今日收盤前持有或進場者，皆可參與本次配息，股息預計8月4日撥入帳戶。若以昨日淨值36.04元換算，年化配息率約落在3.33%。值得注意的是，00947今年以來股價漲幅已達90%，吸引大批小資族進場卡位，季增受益人數更達1.9萬人，幾乎呈倍數成長。

title: 美股散戶瘋買不停，城堡證券示警：追漲熱情降溫、避險意識升高
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，城堡證券(Citadel Securities)認為，散戶投資者仍以有史以來最快的速度之一繼續向美國股市投入資金，儘管逢低買進的動能已有減弱跡象。根據城堡證券股票衍生性商品策略主管Scott Rubner彙編的數據，截至7月，該公司的散戶現金股票平台上沒有出現任何一個淨賣出日。散戶日均淨買入金額約為歷史月度均值的3.2倍，使今年7月成為自2020年1月以來散戶資金流入量第二高的月份。儘管散戶投資者仍是看漲期權的淨買方，但他們對看漲期權的興趣開始減弱。城堡證券一項衡量看漲期權相對於看跌期權的指標顯示，該比率已降至3月底以來的最低水準，表明投資者越來越傾向買進下滑保護，而非一味追漲。這種突然背離本輪牛市以來盛行的逢低買進心態，在科技股尤其明顯。在費城半導體指數最近一波跌勢期間，散戶投資者賣出半導體和硬體股。不過，每次回跌之後，晶片股仍能迅速反彈。

title: 【林宏文專欄】大交棒時代來了！ 研華劉克振：成功的傳承都很利他 這樣對後代福報最大

summary_en: Yuan Ling breaks into the U.S. Starbucks supply chain. Yuan Ling Precision Industry (4564), a major manufacturer of high-pressure cylinders, is actively developing new products and new businesses. It recently passed the Starbucks Inspection Factory certification in the United States and is expected to start shipping in the second half of the year. In addition, Yuan Ling has also made progress in the military industry, including submarine projects and gas propulsion systems for drones.

summary: 立法院交通委員會昨（13）日初審通過《電信管理法》修正草案，大幅放寬外資持股比率與董事長國籍等規定，外界將此解讀為「星鏈條款」，希望引進全球最大低軌衛星商SpaceX的星鏈（Starlink）服務來台落地，助力台灣能享有SpaceX無遠弗屆的低軌衛星服務。

title_en: Starlink launches services, the Legislative Yuan opens its doors, and relaxes restrictions on foreign shareholding and nationality of directors
summary_en: The Transportation Committee of the Legislative Yuan passed a preliminary review yesterday (13th) on the draft amendment to the "Telecommunications Management Act", which significantly relaxes the regulations on foreign shareholding ratio and chairman's nationality. The outside world interpreted this as the "Starlink Clause" and hopes to introduce the Starlink service of SpaceX, the world's largest low-orbit satellite operator, to Taiwan to help Taiwan enjoy SpaceX's low-orbit satellite service.

title_en: Hotai Che's consolidated revenue in June reached a new high for the same period
summary_en: June has entered the peak sales season in the auto market. The leading car manufacturer and Taiche (2207) recorded a combined revenue of 28.99 billion yuan in June yesterday (13th), an increase of 48.36% year-on-year. The combined revenue in the first six months of this year was 157.59 billion yuan, an increase of 13.06% over the same period last year. The revenue in a single month and in the first half of the year hit a new high in the same period in history.

The cumulative total revenue in the first half of the year was 28.553 billion yuan, an increase of 30% compared with the same period last year, and it stood at a new high for the same period in previous years.

summary_en: Evergreen Aerospace (2645) consolidated revenue in June was 1.825 billion yuan, setting a new single-month record, with a monthly increase of 8.08% and an annual increase of 13%. In the first six months, the cumulative revenue was approximately 9.96 billion yuan, an annual increase of 12.4%. Benefiting from delays in the delivery of new aircraft, airlines' demand for maintenance of old aircraft has increased, which has boosted EVA Aviation's business volume and performed strongly this year.

Lamex said its revenue jumped in June and the first half of the year, mainly due to the merger of Alvogen; in addition, its B2B business also grew strongly.

title_en: The Legislative Yuan opens the door to welcome SpaceX’s Starlink to the stage. Industry players hope to take into account both supervision and industrial development.
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan opened the door to welcome SpaceX's Starlink to the stage, and at the same time gave the National Communications Commission (NCC), the competent authority, great room for "accurate refutation". Industry players expect to take into account issues such as national security, network security, communications resilience, supervision and industrial development. The Institute of Communications recommends referring to Japan’s “diversion supervision” model.

title_en: The party, government and military can hold shares in media, with an upper limit of 1%
summary_en: In the past, the party, government and military's withdrawal from media clauses became the key to hindering the flow of funds to promote industrial development. The Transportation Committee of the Legislative Yuan discussed the draft amendment to the "Cable Broadcasting and Television Act" yesterday (13th), which will limit the ownership of "one share" and relax the shareholding limit to "1%". According to industry interpretations, this move has lifted the string of investors in most system companies, and Taiwan is expected to legally merge with Kaibo.

It is currently sent to the Economic Committee of the Legislative Yuan for review.

In addition to releasing benefits to increase fertility incentives, the government must also suppress housing prices to be effective.

title_en: Zhuo Kui: An amendment to the Food Safety Law will be proposed this week, instructing the Ministry of Health and Welfare to develop principles for the re-listing of oil products
summary_en: In response to the excessive levels of the carcinogen benzene pyrene in Zoomlion Oil Products, Chief Executive Officer Zhuo Rongtai announced yesterday (13th) that the sample inspection of Zoomlion Oil Products will be completed within a week. If the products that have been taken off the shelves as a precautionary measure are to be re-listed, they will be inspected based on the principles of separate source and itemization. title_en: Shipments of server cooling and power components are booming, and Guanghongke’s revenue in June and Q2 simultaneously hit highs
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Guanghongke (6693) announced consolidated revenue of 234 million yuan in June, a monthly increase of 9.57%, an annual increase of 106.98%; consolidated revenue in the second quarter was 652 million yuan, a quarterly increase of 26.76%, an annual increase of 102.24%; the cumulative consolidated revenue in the first six months was 1.167 billion yuan, an annual increase of 83.5%. Guanghongke benefited from the AI ​​wave and increased shipments of server air-cooling products, driving revenue in a single month, a single quarter and the first half of the year to record highs. The legal person expects shipments to continue to be strong in the second half of the year, and single-quarter revenue is expected to continue to rise. Guanghongke focuses its resources on developing high-gross-margin energy storage products, electric motorcycle applications, and battery management systems (BMS). Driven by the AI ​​wave, key cooling solutions have successfully entered the data center supply chain and become the core driving force supporting future growth. The product layout on the AI ​​server application side has entered the harvest period. Not only the main MOSFET products have shown strong momentum due to insufficient supply, but the system-on-a-chip (SoC) fan drive IC and BLDC motor drive module integrating cooling solutions have also increased in volume and price in response to the demand for precision temperature control in high-wattage servers. Looking forward to operations in the second half of 2026, Guanghongke will continue to benefit from the strong demand for AI servers, especially the digital analog programmable SoC cooling fan driver IC with the most outstanding gross profit margin. Since it is widely used in AI servers and data center CPU cooling, it is expected to grow strongly. It is expected that as market demand continues to heat up, this product line's contribution to overall profits will be stable

title: SK Hynix 第二季獲利預警 AI 半導體股面臨調整
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導韓國記憶體大廠 SK Hynix 預期第二季（Q2）營業利益恐低於市場預期，引發市場對 AI 半導體類股的波動擔憂。韓國投資證券（Korea Investment & Securities）預估，SK Hynix 第二季的營業利益將比市場共識低約 8%。 根據韓國投資證券研究員蔡旻淑的分析，SK Hynix 第二季營收預計達 80.9 兆韓元，營業利益約為 60.4 兆韓元。儘管這兩項數據相較去年同期分別大幅成長 264% 和 556%，但 60.4 兆韓元的營業利益仍低於市場普遍預期的 65.3 兆韓元。該機構因此下修 SK Hynix 今明兩年的營業利益預估，幅度分別為 9% 和 11%。 報告指出，由於 SK Hynix 的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）產品營收佔比高於競爭對手，使其在通用型記憶體價格上漲時，受惠程度相對受限。不過，預計今年第三季起，新一代高頻寬記憶體 HBM4 將進入量產並開始銷售，屆時 SK Hynix 的平均銷售單價（ASP）成長率可望達到市場平均水準。韓國投資證券也提到，長期供貨協議（LTA）的擴大有助於降低記憶體產業固有的業績波

title_en: SK Hynix second-quarter profit warning, AI semiconductor stocks face correction
summary_en: Picture/Schematic Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei report South Korean memory manufacturer SK Hynix expects second quarter (Q2) operating profit to be lower than market expectations, triggering market concerns about the volatility of AI semiconductor stocks. Korea Investment & Securities estimates SK Hynix's second-quarter operating profit will be about 8% lower than market consensus. According to analysis by Chae Min-sook, a researcher at Korea Investment and Securities, SK Hynix's second-quarter revenue is expected to reach 80.9 trillion won, with operating profit of approximately 60.4 trillion won. Although these two figures increased significantly by 264% and 556% respectively compared with the same period last year, operating profit of 60.4 trillion won was still lower than the market consensus of 65.3 trillion won. As a result, the agency revised down its operating profit forecast for SK Hynix this year and next by 9% and 11% respectively. The report points out that because SK Hynix’s high-bandwidth memory (HBM) products account for a higher revenue share than its competitors, its ability to benefit from increases in general-purpose memory prices is relatively limited. However, it is expected that the new generation of high-bandwidth memory HBM4 will enter mass production and begin sales from the third quarter of this year. By then, SK Hynix's average sales unit price (ASP) growth rate is expected to reach the market average. Korea Investment Securities also mentioned that the expansion of the long-term supply agreement (LTA) will help reduce the performance fluctuations inherent in the memory industry.

title_en: Tensions in Iran hit market confidence, U.S. stocks closed lower, led by chip stocks
summary_en: Picture / Our database Business Media | Wu Chengyue / Taipei report The U.S. stock market was affected by the rising geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran on Monday (July 13), and investors' risk appetite decreased, causing Wall Street's major indexes to close overall, with technology and semiconductor stocks falling particularly sharply. U.S. President Trump announced that the United States would resume its blockade on Iranian shipping and promised to ensure the smooth flow of the Strait of Hormuz after the United States and Iran exchanged missiles and drone attacks over the weekend. The move not only overturned last month's interim agreement aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz and ending the conflict, but also triggered a surge in crude oil futures prices of about 5% to 9.4%, exacerbating market concerns about a resurgence of inflation. The market reacted quickly, with the Nasdaq Composite Index falling 1.06% to close at 26,003.23 points; the S&P 500 Index falling 0.49% to close at 7,538.21 points; and the Dow Jones Industrial Average falling 0.28% to close at 52,488.48 points. Among the 11 sectors in the S&P 500, information technology stocks were the worst performers, falling 1.4%. The semiconductor industry was hardest hit, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 3.7%, down more than 14% from its all-time high in late June. The stock prices of many iconic semiconductor companies were affected. Witten Electronics' stock price fell by 6%, Micron Technology fell by 5%, Cintiq Corporation fell by 10%, and South Korean memory maker SK Hynix's American Depository Receipt (ADR) stock price also fell by 9% after it was listed on Nasdaq. title: 關稅退款激增，美國聯邦預算赤字擴大，6月飆至1200億美元
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，在美國最高法院裁定非法後開始退還的大量關稅，導致美國聯邦預算赤字自本財政年度開始以來首次擴大。美國財政部週一公佈的數據顯示，2026財政年度前九個月預算赤字為1.37兆美元。這意味著較2025年同期擴大2%。僅僅是6月份，預算赤字就達到1,200億美元。此前幾個月，在收入成長帶動下，預算赤字持續收窄，主要得益於就業和經濟成長穩健推動稅收增加，以及川普提高關稅帶來的關稅收入成長。但最高法院在2月裁定政府的大部分關稅違法，而近幾週關稅退款金額大幅增加。美國財政部數據顯示，6月份關稅收入淨減少256億美元，相較之下，5月僅減少4,200萬美元。6月份關稅退款為492億美元，而5月退還接近220億美元，累計退款占政府預計需償還的1,660億美元總額的一半以上。

title_en: Tariff refunds surge, U.S. federal budget deficit widens, soaring to $120 billion in June
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that the large amount of tariffs that began to be refunded after the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that it was illegal has caused the U.S. federal budget deficit to expand for the first time since the beginning of this fiscal year. Data released by the U.S. Treasury Department on Monday showed that the budget deficit in the first nine months of fiscal year 2026 was $1.37 trillion. This represents a 2% expansion compared to the same period in 2025. In June alone, the budget deficit reached $120 billion. In the past few months, the budget deficit has continued to narrow, driven by revenue growth, mainly due to the increase in tax revenue driven by solid employment and economic growth, as well as the growth in tariff revenue brought about by Trump's increase in tariffs. But the Supreme Court ruled in February that most of the government's tariffs were illegal, and tariff refunds have increased significantly in recent weeks. U.S. Treasury Department data showed a net decrease in tariff revenue of $25.6 billion in June, compared with a decrease of only $42 million in May. Tariff refunds in June were $49.2 billion, compared with nearly $22 billion in May, with cumulative refunds accounting for more than half of the total $166 billion the government expects to repay.

title: 聯準會本週購買百億美元國庫券，規模持平前兩個操作週期
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，美國聯準會週一表示，本週期將購買約100億美元國庫券，規模與此前兩個操作週期持平。目前政策制定者試圖充實銀行準備金，以因應未來幾個月可能出現的資金流失。網站訊息顯示，聯準會紐約分行公開市場交易部門計畫在截至8月13日的月度操作週期執行上述儲備購買管理，並且還計畫開展約176億美元的再投資操作。儘管聯準會認為融資市場運行平穩，但決策者仍保持謹慎，因為美國財政部預計將增加國庫券供給，並將現金餘額提升至逾1兆美元，這將消耗準備金。所有這些資金必然有其來源，而隨著銀行準備金從金融體系中被抽離，流動性的減少往往會推高融資成本。

title_en: The Fed purchased tens of billions of dollars in Treasury bills this week, the same scale as the previous two operating cycles
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that the U.S. Federal Reserve said on Monday that it would purchase approximately US$10 billion in treasury bills this cycle, the same scale as the previous two operating cycles. Policymakers are now trying to shore up bank reserves to prepare for possible capital outflows in the coming months. Website information shows that the open market trading department of the New York Branch of the Federal Reserve plans to implement the above-mentioned reserve purchase management in the monthly operating cycle ending on August 13, and also plans to carry out reinvestment operations of approximately US$17.6 billion. Although the Fed believes that funding markets are operating smoothly, policymakers remain cautious as the Treasury Department is expected to increase the supply of Treasury bills and lift cash balances to more than $1 trillion, which will consume reserves. All of this money must come from somewhere, and as bank reserves are withdrawn from the financial system, reduced liquidity tends to drive up funding costs.

title_en: SK Hynix's share price plummets 15% as financial forecasts are revised down and geopolitics impacts memory stocks
summary_en: Business Media | Fang Chengye/Comprehensive foreign news reports South Korean memory manufacturer SK Hynix suffered a heavy setback in the South Korean stock market yesterday. The stock price plummeted 15.4% in a single day, and the price of American Depositary Receipts (ADR) was also close to the issue price. This wave of decline has also dragged down global memory and semiconductor stocks. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index closed down more than 5% yesterday, and Taiwan Semiconductor Leader TSMC also fell nearly 3% during the session. The main reason for this wave of stock price fluctuations is that Korea Investment & Securities (KIS) lowered its second-quarter financial forecast for SK Hynix. Although KIS estimates that SK Hynix's second-quarter revenue will reach 80.9 trillion won, an annual increase of 264%, and operating profit is expected to reach 60.4 trillion won, an annual increase of 556%, this performance is still lower than the market consensus of about 8% operating profit consensus. The market generally believes that long-term supply contracts (LTAs) for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) lock in earlier prices, resulting in SK hynix failing to fully benefit from recent price increases in the spot market. However, KIS analysis pointed out that this is not a deterioration in fundamentals, but a short-term rhythm difference in profit recognition. In fact, the average selling price (ASP) of dynamic random access memory (DRAM) and NAND flash increased by about 30% and 50% respectively in the second quarter compared with the first quarter, indicating the supply and demand of the memory industry.

summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導美國聯邦準備理事會（Federal Reserve）理事克里斯多福·沃勒（Christopher Waller）近日警告，若通膨持續高於 2% 目標，美國央行可能考慮進一步升息，此言論為全球金融市場投下變數。加密貨幣市場隨之震盪，比特幣價格在沃勒發言後，從盤中高點約 64,500 美元滑落，跌破 62,000 美元關卡。 市場正嚴陣以待美國本週即將公布的關鍵通膨數據。6 月消費者物價指數（CPI）報告將於 7 月 14 日出爐，隨後是 7 月 15 日的生產者物價指數（PPI）數據。華爾街經濟學家普遍預期，6 月 CPI 月度通膨將從 5 月的 0.5% 趨緩至 0.2%，年通膨率預計從 4.2% 降至 3.8%。 然而，若實際數據超出預期，顯示通膨壓力未能有效緩解，市場對聯準會將長期維持高利率，甚至再度升息的預期將會增強。根據 CME FedWatch Tool 顯示，沃勒發言後，市場預期聯準會 9 月升息的機率已攀升至 51.3%。聯準會上次政策會議紀錄也指出，多位官員對通膨壓力仍感擔憂，包括人工智慧投資增加以及經濟活動表現強勁所帶來的影響。

title_en: Fed Waller warns that inflation may raise interest rates, Bitcoin faces test of U.S. data
summary_en: Picture / Our database Business Media | Wu Chengyue / Taipei report U.S. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller recently warned that if inflation continues to exceed the 2% target, the U.S. central bank may consider further raising interest rates. This comment has cast doubt on global financial markets. Cryptocurrency markets were shaken in response, with Bitcoin prices slipping from an intraday high of around $64,500 to fall below the $62,000 mark following Waller's remarks. The market is eagerly awaiting key U.S. inflation data due to be released this week. The June Consumer Price Index (CPI) report will be released on July 14, followed by the Producer Price Index (PPI) data on July 15. Wall Street economists generally expect monthly CPI inflation to moderate to 0.2% in June from 0.5% in May, with annual inflation expected to fall to 3.8% from 4.2%. However, if the actual data exceeds expectations and shows that inflationary pressures have not been effectively alleviated, market expectations that the Federal Reserve will maintain high interest rates for a long time or even raise interest rates again will increase. According to the CME FedWatch Tool, after Waller's speech, market expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates in September have climbed to 51.3%. Minutes of the Federal Reserve's last policy meeting also pointed out that many officials are still concerned about inflationary pressures, including the impact of increased investment in artificial intelligence and strong economic activity.

title_en: Trump proposes to impose 20% compensation on cargo passing through Hormuz, which may increase the cost of super large oil tankers by US$30 million
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that US President Trump has just made a request to charge 20% compensation for goods transported through the Strait of Hormuz. Based on this requirement, calculated on a very large tanker loaded with crude oil, it is equivalent to approximately US$30 million. This estimate is based on current oil prices of approximately $80 per barrel. Very large tankers can carry about 2 million barrels of crude oil. In contrast, people familiar with the matter have revealed that Iran has previously been charging up to US$2 million per voyage on an ad hoc basis. Trump on Monday reinstated a blockade on Iranian ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz and said the United States would be the "guardian" of the waterway. He also said that out of fairness considerations, the United States will receive compensation at a rate of 20% of all transported goods. At present, the White House has provided no other details about Trump’s fee proposal, including how it will be implemented or whether U.S. allies in the Gulf region have been informed. The shipping industry was surprised and treated with some skepticism. More than a dozen shipping industry insiders said they had received no prior warning about Trump’s announcement that he might impose fees on cargo passing through the waterway. Several of these individuals have had ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz in recent weeks. Given the lack of details, they said it was too early to tell how any plans would affect their access decisions. One captain, who asked not to be named, said such charges amounted to highway robbery. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said in a social media post that this is absolutely correct. Who provides safe passage for merchant ships through the Strait of Hormuz?

summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Jiajing (3016) announced consolidated revenue of 448 million yuan in June, a monthly increase of 3.33% and an annual increase of 41.17%; second quarter consolidated revenue was 1.309 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 23.58% and an annual increase of 37.08%; the cumulative consolidated revenue for the first six months was 2.368 billion yuan, an annual increase of 27.87%. The legal person expects that the operating performance in the second half of 2026 will be better than the first half of the year, and the overall growth trend is clear. Jiajing’s operational highlights in 2026 mainly focus on the optimization of product portfolio and the expansion of new applications. In the silicon epiwafer part, Jiajing is actively converting the production line specifications to 8-inch large sizes, because 8-inch products focus on medium and high-end products. In the pressing process, the gross profit is better than that of small-size products, and thanks to the significant increase in demand for power components in the server, industrial control and automotive fields, as well as the spillover effect from IDM factories, the current 8-inch epiwafer production capacity is approaching full capacity. title_en: South Korea and Japan's memory and passive components plummeted, and Taiwan stocks failed to challenge the monthly line
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Fang Yashen] Taiwan stocks were affected by the weakening of the Korean and Japanese stock markets. Passive components, diodes, and power semiconductor groups suffered heavy losses, and probe cards also performed poorly. Relying on the strong support of TSMC (2330), Formosa Plastics Sibao, ABF, and defense industry stocks, the weighted index ended up rising 25.91 points or 0.06% to close at 45,380.52 points, with a trading volume of 1.02762 billion yuan. Just as the U.S. is about to release its quarterly report, Korean and Japanese stocks have retreated, and the market's target has turned to TSMC. U.S. stocks are entering earnings season. It is generally expected that second-quarter profits will increase by about 25% year-on-year, which is higher than the 16% in the first quarter. In fact, in the past week, the market has begun to report that the growth rate of the seven popular technology companies this year has been relatively low or even declined. The PE has dropped from more than 35 times last year to about 25 times now, which has begun to cause funds to flow in. As long as the financial reports do not reveal landmines, it is easier to rise. The key point is whether the four major CSP manufacturers will reduce or increase their AI infrastructure spending, which will determine the future trend of AI-related stocks. But before that, Samsung, a major memory manufacturer that has made a lot of money, announced profits last week and was able to surpass Huida. Then, Hynix was listed in the United States on July 10, and its stock price also rose. This is bullish news. However, if we look at it on Monday, Samsung fell below the 300,000 yen price on the day of the financial report. After Hynix was listed overseas, the parent stock also fell sharply on Monday, and it seems that the bulls are not going to support it. This shows that electronic stocks that have surged this year should be careful. Compared with the seven major US stocks, the gains this year have been relatively low, and they seem to have gained favor again. Financial and manufacturing stocks also performed poorly.

title: 鋼價下跌＋需求低迷，中鋼8月鋼品盤價下跌800元/噸
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】中鋼(2002)開出8月盤價，考量國際原物料走勢及國內實際需求狀況，各項鋼品調降800元/噸。中鋼表示，國內流通行情隨亞洲鋼價走跌，終端需求低迷加劇買盤觀望氣氛，為順應行情並協助下游客戶爭取訂單，故8月份月盤產品全面調降價格，以因應短期鋼市調節週期。中國大陸鋼材消費需求放緩，加上鐵礦砂港口庫存走高及供應過剩壓力，國際鐵礦砂價格於每公噸98至100美元區間震盪，冶金煤價格維持在240美元左右，煉鋼成本維持高位。國際鋼價走勢分歧，美國熱軋鋼捲受關稅政策與內需支持，行情維持在每公噸1,250美元以上；歐盟削減進口鋼材免稅額度，供給限縮拉動當地鋼價正向發展。中鋼指出，亞洲進入傳統淡季需求疲軟，越南和發與河靜鋼廠相繼下調熱軋新盤價格。受歐盟、日本等貿易保護措施衝擊，國際鋼鐵貿易失序風險加劇，針對國外鋼廠之鋼品以非理性低價擴大轉銷台灣的行為，中鋼已持續密切關注並加速貿易救濟措施，以維護國內鋼鐵產業健全發展。中鋼8月熱軋鋼板、鋼捲(一般料)、熱軋鋼捲(軋延料)、冷軋鋼捲(一般料)、電鍍鋅鋼捲(抗指紋、建材)、熱浸鍍鋅鋼捲(建材、烤漆料)、熱浸鍍鋅鋼捲(家電、電腦、其他料)

title: 和泰車6月及上半年營收創同期最高，日本經銷商占集團營收13%
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】和泰車(2207)自結6月合併營收289.9億元，年增48.36%；累計上半年合併營收1575.9億元，年增13.06%，單月及累計合併營收皆創歷史同期最高。和泰車指出，旗下TOYOTA與LEXUS雙品牌6月分別登錄約1.26萬及2600台，共計達1.52萬台，創下單月歷史新高，奪下36.9%市佔率；累計上半年合計登錄7.65萬台，市佔率達37.8%。和泰車指出，6月進入車市銷售旺季，TOYOTA RAV4導入PHEV車型後市場反應良好，COROLLA CROSS維持穩定銷售表現；LEXUS則受惠於NX200及UX300h主力車款銷售帶動下，營收表現持續成長。此外，日本經銷商6月營收貢獻約37.8億元，占集團營收約13%。

summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】智冠(5478)自結6月合併營收5.43億元，月減3%，主係受廣宣檔期短期波動所致，年增2%；累計第二季單季合併營收16.66億元，年增6%，累計上半年合併營收35.96億元，年增13%，隨著集團各事業群營運穩健發展，推動營收持續成長。智冠指出，MyCard數位點數搶攻夏季暑期檔期，以「夏季課金」為主題推出大型會員行銷活動，以高吸引力的回饋持續擴大會員經濟效益，為暑假旺季營運成長增添動能。子公司中華網龍(3083)旗下《飄流幻境Re:星之方舟》、《女神Online》、《吞食天地2：誕生Reborn》、《吞食天地 多元宇宙》等同步帶來暑期任務，持續推動營運動能。藍新集團深化數位風險治理、與支付安全環境，積極推動「Passkey 無密碼支付驗證」提升支付安全機制，亦加入「數位信任推動工作小組（SIG）」，攜手政府共同推動數位信任生態系建置。藍新科技藉由技術防護與市場教育雙軌並進，持續提升商戶與消費者的交易安全，推動可信賴的數位金融環境發展。

title: 中租-KY上半年獲利逾百億元，年增3%，每股盈餘5.84元
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】中租-KY(5871)自結6月合併營收為79.8億元，較去年同期略減1%，月減5%，主要係台灣地區售電收入當月受日照減少影響；累計上半年每股稅後盈餘為5.84元。中租6月單月合併稅後淨利16.3億元，每股稅後盈餘為0.94元；累計上半年合併稅後淨利益已超過百億元、達108.3億元，年增3%，主要為今年整體成本費用率下降，及台灣及中國大陸地區預期信用減損損失金額減少。中租累計上半年營收為新台幣482.9億元，年減2%，分地區別來看，台灣及中國大陸地區營收分別年減3%及8%，東協地區則成長12%。中租指出，上半年東協地區營收以馬來西亞及柬埔寨成長較為顯著；若與前月相較，合併營收月減5%，主要係台灣地區售電收入當月受日照減少影響。獲利部分，中租累計計上半年每股稅後盈餘為5.84元，以營運地區別來看，台灣地區、中國大陸及東協地區分別較去年成長3%、2%及21%。中租日前公告訂7月29日為普通股及特別股除權息交易日，普通股每股配發5.8元現金股利及每股0.2元股票股利，特別股則每股配發4.1795元現金，現金股利發放日則為9月1日。

title: 颱風災損免緊張　「災損減免三步驟」報你知
summary: 巴威颱風雖已遠離，若民眾家中因颱風造成災害，宜蘭縣政府財政稅務局，特別發布防災減稅指南，叮嚀鄉親們在清理家園時，務必牢記「拍照存證、檢附文件、申請減免」三大黃金步驟。財稅局強調，地方稅的災害減免有法定期限，請民眾一定要在期限內提出申請，別讓自己的權益受損。如民眾車輛因颱風泡水致車輛毀損，倘車輛無法再使用，應儘速向監理機關辦理停駛或報廢，財政稅務局會據以辦理減免或退稅事宜;倘車輛一個月內可修復且未向監理機關辦理停駛或報廢手續者，請於災害發生之日起30日內，檢附村里長或警察局或公所開立之災害證明文件及進出修理廠時間相關證明或發票，向財政稅務局申請減免使用牌照稅事宜。宜蘭縣府財稅局進一步說明，受災民眾必須在期限內提出申請，民眾可多利用網路服務，於該局網站(網址:https://www.iltb.gov.tw/，首頁-專區服務-災害減免)或財政部稅務入口網(網址:https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/，首頁-線上服務-線上申辦-稅務線上申辦)，均可申請稅捐減免。如有任何疑義可撥打總局免費服務電話0800-396969、羅東分局0800-232234洽詢。更多新聞推薦 ● 20

title_en: Don’t be nervous about typhoon damage. “Three Steps to Disaster Damage Mitigation” will inform you
summary_en: Although Typhoon Bawei is far away, if the typhoon causes disasters in people's homes, the Finance and Taxation Bureau of the Yilan County Government has issued a special guide for disaster prevention and tax reduction, urging villagers to remember the three golden steps of "taking photos to save certificates, attaching documents, and applying for tax exemptions" when cleaning up their homes. The Finance and Taxation Bureau emphasized that there is a legal deadline for disaster reduction and exemption of local taxes. People are requested to apply within the deadline to avoid damaging their rights and interests. If public vehicles are damaged due to water damage due to typhoon, if the vehicle can no longer be used, they should report to the supervisory authority as soon as possible to suspend or scrap the vehicle, and the Finance and Taxation Bureau will handle tax exemption or tax refund accordingly; if the vehicle can be repaired within one month and has not been reported to the supervisory authority If the vehicle is suspended or scrapped, please apply to the Finance and Taxation Bureau for license tax exemption within 30 days from the date of the disaster, attaching the disaster certification document issued by the village chief or the police station or public office, as well as the relevant certificates or invoices for the time of entry and exit of the repair shop. The Yilan County Finance and Taxation Bureau further explained that people affected by the disaster must apply within the time limit. People can make use of online services and apply for tax relief on the bureau’s website (URL: https://www.iltb.gov.tw/, Home Page - Special Area Services - Disaster Relief) or the Ministry of Finance’s Taxation Portal (URL: https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/, Home Page - Online Services - Online Application - Tax Online Application). If you have any questions, you can call the toll-free service hotline of the General Administration at 0800-396969 or the Luodong Branch at 0800-232234. More news recommendations ● 20

title_en: Pulling the daily limit twice in a row is not enough! Global Crystal pulls silicon wafers to 6 levels
summary_en: The silicon wafer industry is ushering in a promising recovery! Global Crystal announced to deepen its strategic cooperation with Micron, received US$500 million to support the expansion of its new factory in Texas, and signed a 10-year long-term contract. Benefiting from the explosion in demand for AI and high-performance computing, the spot price of 12-inch silicon wafers has increased by 5% to 10%. With memory and logic chip factories actively locking in production capacity, the increase is expected to exceed expectations. The legal person pointed out that the AI ​​supply chain bottleneck has extended to upstream materials. With the support of long-term contracts, production expansion and price increases, Taiwanese factories such as Global Crystal, Taiwan Sembcorp, and Hechip will usher in a new round of business cycle, and the market outlook is optimistic. Investors should carefully assess market risks.

summary_en: The OTC Buying Center announced the latest list of disposal stocks yesterday (13th). Only one new stock, Titanium Sheng (8027), was added. It will be listed as a disposal stock from today (14th) to July 27, and the trading method will be divided and matched every 20 minutes. title_en: The Legislative Yuan loosens regulations and opens the door for the implementation of Starlink. The three telecom giants responded

The regulations are loosened, so that "satellite communications companies" are not restricted to telecommunications companies. The chairman must be a nationality of the Republic of China, and foreign direct and indirect shareholdings cannot exceed 60%. This is seen as opening the door for SpaceX. Global telecommunications companies are in a competitive and cooperative relationship with satellite companies such as SpaceX. To open the door to amending the law, the three telecommunications companies have responded!

title_en: Why is Yang Wenke not guilty in the Zhubei Tiankeng case? The key to the Hsinchu District Court’s ruling is here
summary_en: After a year and a half of investigation and trial, Hsinchu County Magistrate Yang Wenke was found not guilty by the Hsinchu District Court this afternoon in the "Fengcai 520" illegal resumption of work for profit. The court pointed out that the task force is not a statutory authority and is only for reference by the Public Works Department. The resumption of work is still subject to professional review and decision by the Public Works Department in accordance with its authority. In addition, whether the administrative agency abused its discretion should be judged based on the objective situation at the time when the administrative sanctions were made, and the subsequent results should not be used to infer that the decision at the time was illegal.

Hsinchu County Magistrate Yang Wenke was acquitted; Fengyi Organization Chairman Liu Shuju was sentenced to three years and six months in prison for violating architectural regulations and other crimes. Fengyi Construction expressed its respect for justice, but deeply regretted the judgment. After receiving the complete judgment and completing the legal assessment, it will file an appeal in accordance with the law to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of relevant personnel.

title: 楊文科天坑案一審無罪檢方評估上訴 縣府：縣政照常推動
summary: 新竹地院審理竹北「天坑案」，歷經1年多審理，今天下午4時宣判，新竹縣長楊文科涉違法復工圖利案獲判無罪。新竹縣府表示尊重司法判決，強調縣政運作不受影響；新竹地檢署則表示，待收到完整判決理由後，將依法評估是否提起上訴。

title_en: Yang Wenke’s Tiankeng case was acquitted in the first instance, prosecutors evaluated the appeal. County government: County government continues to promote the case as usual
summary_en: The Hsinchu District Court tried the Zhubei "tiankeng case". After more than a year of trial, the verdict was announced at 4 o'clock this afternoon. Hsinchu County Magistrate Yang Wenke was acquitted of the illegal resumption of work for profit. The Hsinchu County Government stated that it respects the judicial judgment and emphasized that county government operations will not be affected; the Hsinchu District Prosecutor's Office stated that it will evaluate whether to file an appeal in accordance with the law after receiving the complete reasons for the judgment.

title: 台積電協助改善「專科教室」照明 彰化縣政府成果發表兼感謝
summary: 教育部調查彰化縣國中學生和國小高年級學童，裸視視力不良率逾七成，縣政府今發表優化校園照明設備成果，感謝台積電慈善基金會專案協助，讓全縣最近4年內連同中央補助、縣政府自籌款，累計投入近5千萬元改善5011間教室照明設備，保護學童視力。

title_en: TSMC assists in improving lighting in "specialty classrooms" Changhua County Government announces results and expresses thanks
summary_en: According to a survey by the Ministry of Education of Changhua County's junior high school students and senior elementary school students, the rate of poor naked vision exceeds 70%. The county government today announced the results of optimizing campus lighting equipment. Thanks to the TSMC Charitable Foundation's assistance in the project, the county has invested a total of nearly 50 million yuan in the past four years, together with central subsidies and self-raised funds from the county government, to improve the lighting equipment of 5,011 classrooms and protect the eyesight of school children.

title: 離岸風機挺過巴威　最高瞬時發電相當6部台中電廠機組
summary: （中央社記者謝怡璇台北13日電）颱風巴威為台灣沿岸帶來強陣風。經濟部表示，全台500座離岸風機不僅平安挺過11級強風，同時測得最高瞬時發電量達3356MW，相當於6部台中電廠機組滿載的瞬時發電量，於颱風期間支撐全台約1成用電。

title: 巴威災後復原！新竹尖石後山5校、五峰全鄉學校明天停班停課
summary: 巴威颱風雖已遠離，但新竹山區仍持續進行災後復原作業。新竹縣政府今天晚間宣布，因應颱風後續影響，為維護民眾安全及利於災後復原，尖石鄉後山5校、五峰鄉全鄉學校（含幼兒園）明天停班停課1天。

title_en: Bawei recovers from the disaster! Hsinchu Jianshihoushan School 5 and Wufeng Township School will be closed tomorrow
summary_en: Although Typhoon Bavi has moved away, post-disaster recovery operations are still ongoing in the mountainous areas of Hsinchu. The Hsinchu County Government announced this evening that in response to the aftermath of the typhoon and in order to safeguard public safety and facilitate post-disaster recovery, 5 schools in Houshan, Jianshi Township, and all schools in Wufeng Township (including kindergartens) will be closed for one day tomorrow.

title: 南庄苗21線石壁橋恢復單線通車 東河村14日仍停班課
summary: 苗栗縣南庄鄉苗21線石壁往神仙谷、鹿場方向道路，因風災已無法通行，縣府今天派員會勘並初步搶修石壁橋頭淘空毀損的路面，恢復單線通車，但確切修復時程還得看天氣賞臉；另鹿場、鹿山、鹿湖部落有百餘人出入困難，公所考量道路中斷及安全起見，東河村14日仍停止上班、上課。

title_en: Nanzhuang Miao Line 21 Shibi Bridge resumes single-lane traffic, but classes in Donghe Village remain closed on the 14th
summary_en: The road from Shibi on Line 21 in Miaoli County, Nanzhuang Township, towards Shenxian Valley and Luchang has become impassable due to the wind disaster. Today, the county government sent personnel to conduct a survey and preliminary repairs on the damaged road at the head of Shibi Bridge, and restored it to single-lane traffic. However, the exact repair time will depend on the weather. In addition, more than 100 people from the Luchang, Lushan, and Luhu tribes have difficulty accessing the road. Considering the road interruption and safety reasons, Donghe Village will still suspend work and classes on the 14th.

title: 楊文科無罪 前工務處長、承辦人卻涉圖利判刑 法院認：默許停工期施工
summary: 歷經1年半調查與審理，新竹縣長楊文科涉「豐采520」違法復工圖利案，新竹地院今下午宣判楊文科無罪。不過，楊文科底下的時任工務處長江良淵和工務處建管科承辦人黃彧思都被判圖利罪等罪，江處6年6月、黃5年2月，主因在於默許已因坍塌遭勒令停工的「豐采520」建案持續施工，使該建案在停工期間違法施工77天，獲取3984萬801元不法利益。
title_zh: 楊文科無罪 前工務處長、承辦人卻涉圖利判刑 法院認：默許停工期施工

title_en: Yang Wenke was not guilty, but the former Director of Public Works and the contractor was sentenced for profiteering. The court found that he acquiesced to construction during the suspension period.
summary_en: After a year and a half of investigation and trial, Hsinchu County Magistrate Yang Wenke was found not guilty of illegal resumption of work for "Fengcai 520" for profit. The Hsinchu District Court this afternoon acquitted Yang Wenke. However, Jiang Liangyuan, the then director of the Public Works Department under Yang Wenke, and Huang Yusi, the director of the Construction Management Section of the Public Works Department, were both convicted of profiteering and other crimes. In June of 2016 and February of Huang in February of 2016, the main reason was that they acquiesced in the continued construction of the "Fengcai 520" construction project that had been ordered to stop due to collapse. The construction project was illegally constructed for 77 days during the suspension period, and illegal benefits of 39,840,801 yuan were obtained.

title: 苗栗三義都市計畫公設解編 化零為整增加1.11公頃住宅區、商業區
summary: 苗栗縣三義鄉都市計畫公共設施用地解編草案，檢討兒童遊樂場用地、體育場用地等公設，化零為整規畫2處整體開發範圍，全案新增約0.79公頃住宅區及0.32公頃商業區，估計省下6.78億元徵收費用，還地於民促進地方發展。

title_en: Miaoli Sanyi urban planning public facilities were deorganized and 1.11 hectares of residential and commercial areas were added.
summary_en: Miaoli County Sanyi Township Urban Plan Public Facilities Land Decomposition Draft, reviews children's playground land, stadium land and other public facilities, and transforms them into two overall development areas. The entire project adds about 0.79 hectares of residential area and 0.32 hectares of commercial area. It is estimated that 678 million yuan will be saved in collection fees, and the land will be returned to the people to promote local development.

title: 中聯油脂問題油擴大至第4、5批 中市持續追流向並更新業者名單
summary: 中聯油脂大豆沙拉油「苯駢芘」超標延燒，台中市食品藥物安全處今公布第4、5批超標中聯大豆沙拉油流向，包括福壽、福懋使用該等油品製成產品的品項、批號及第二層產品等，也同步更新台中市的第三層以下受影響業者名單。

title_en: The problematic oil of Zoomlion Oil and Fat has been expanded to the 4th and 5th batches. The central market continues to follow the flow and updates the list of operators.
summary_en: The Taichung City Food and Drug Safety Department announced today the flow of the 4th and 5th batches of Zoomlion Soybean Salad Oil that exceeded the standard, including the items, batch numbers and second-tier products of Fushou and Fumao using these oils. The Taichung City Food and Drug Safety Department also updated the list of affected businesses below the third tier in Taichung City.

title: 竹北天坑案竟釀8次塌陷 危及公共安全 豐邑高層2人各判3年6月
summary: 歷經1年半偵辦與審理，「豐采520」違法復工案今天一審宣判。新竹地院認定，豐邑建設實際負責人劉樹居、總經理邱崇喆未依圖施工、違反建築技術成規，導致工地及周邊道路多次塌陷，危及公共安全，案發後又教唆偽證、提出不實工程文件，因此依違反建築技術成規、行使業務登載不實文書及教唆偽證等罪，分別判刑3年6月。
title_zh: 竹北天坑案竟釀8次塌陷 危及公共安全 豐邑高層2人各判3年6月
summary_zh: 歷經1年半偵辦與審理，「豐采520」違法復工案今天一審宣判。新竹地院認定，豐邑建設實際負責人劉樹居、總經理邱崇喆未依圖施工、違反建築技術成規，導致工地及周邊道路多次塌陷，危及公共安全，案發後又教唆偽證、提出不實工程文件，因此依違反建築技術成規、行使業務登載不實文書及教唆偽證等罪，分別判刑3年6月。
title_en: The Zhubei tiankeng case actually caused eight collapses, endangering public safety. Two senior executives from Fengyi were each sentenced to 3 years and 6 months.
summary_en: After one and a half years of investigation and trial, the first instance verdict of the "Fengcai 520" illegal resumption of work case was announced today. The Hsinchu District Court found that Liu Shuju, the actual person in charge of Fengyi Construction, and Qiu Chongzhe, the general manager, failed to construct according to the plans and violated construction technical regulations, causing the construction site and surrounding roads to collapse multiple times, endangering public safety. After the incident, they instigated perjury and submitted false project documents. Therefore, they were sentenced to three years and six months in prison for violating construction technical regulations, publishing false documents in the exercise of business, and instigating perjury.

title: 衛福部長懷疑檢體造假 中聯油脂：報告內容公布網路大家都看得到
summary: 中聯油脂大豆沙拉油被驗出致癌物超標，衛福部長石崇良昨天懷疑中聯檢體造假。中聯蔣姓襄理今天表示，官網公布的報告內容就是檢驗結果，早已公告上網，大家都可看得到。

title_en: The Minister of Health and Welfare suspects that the specimens were falsified. China United Oils and Fats: The contents of the report are published online and can be seen by everyone.
summary_en: The soybean salad oil produced by China Federation of Oils and Fats was found to contain excessive levels of carcinogens. Minister of Health and Welfare Shi Chongliang yesterday suspected that China Federation of Oils had falsified the test results. Jiang Xiangli, surnamed Jiang of the China Federation of Industry and Commerce, said today that the content of the report published on the official website is the test results, which have been posted online for everyone to see.

title: 油品事件擴大 新北已下架2萬1000餘公斤
summary: 油品事件持續擴大，日前公布中聯315-1150404、313-1150512、315-1150510等3批問題油品批號，新北市截至今天止已下架2萬1000餘公斤。今日再度新增「福壽花生風味精華調合油2L(有效日期:2028.1.8)」及「福壽不飽和大豆沙拉油2L(有效日期:2028.4.10)」檢出苯駢芘超標，使用中聯油品批號分別為318-1150406及314-1150410，衛生局將持續追查受影響下游業者名單，並更新相關資訊。

title_en: Oil incident expands, more than 21,000 kilograms have been removed from shelves in New Taipei
summary_en: The oil product incident continues to expand. The batch numbers of three batches of problematic oil products, including Zoomlion 315-1150404, 313-1150512, and 315-1150510, were recently announced. As of today, New Taipei City has removed more than 21,000 kilograms of oil products from the shelves. Today, "Fu Shou Peanut Flavor Essence Blend Oil 2L (Expiration Date: 2028.1.8)" and "Fu Shou Unsaturated Soybean Salad Oil 2L (Expiration Date: 2028.4.10)" were found to exceed the legal limit for benzene and pyrene. The batch numbers of China United Oil Products used are 318-1150406 and 314-1150410 respectively. The Health Bureau will continue to trace the list of affected downstream operators and update relevant information.

title: 影／饒慶鈴公布海峽論壇完整影片 「別讓意識形態成為努力的阻礙」
summary: 台東縣長饒慶鈴上月以錄影方式參與海峽論壇，事後遭內政部點名查辦，引發鳳梨釋迦「仰中共鼻息」風波。饒慶鈴今天下午在個人臉書公布完整影片及針對此事件的回應，她強調「中央有中央的責任，地方有地方的承擔」，應該各自做好自己的工作，而不是讓意識形態成為努力的阻礙。

title_en: Video/Rao Qingling releases the full video of the Straits Forum "Don't let ideology hinder your efforts"
summary_en: Taitung County Magistrate Rao Qingling participated in the Taiwan Strait Forum last month via video recording, and was subsequently named and investigated by the Ministry of the Interior, triggering a controversy over Pineapple Sakya's "appreciation of the CCP." Rao Qingling released the full video and response to this incident on her personal Facebook this afternoon. She emphasized that "the central government has the responsibility of the central government, and the local governments have the responsibility of the local governments." They should each do their own work well, rather than letting ideology hinder their efforts.

title: 「2個要求+5個增訂」致癌油風暴 卓揆下令一周完成檢驗、提食安法修法
summary: 因應中聯油品致癌物苯駢芘超標，行政院要求4至6月油品食品於10日中午前全面預防性下架。行政院長卓榮泰13日舉行專案會議，要求一周內完成所有檢驗，檢驗合格後始得恢復上架；此外，他指示衛福部一周內提出食安法及子法修法，強化源頭和製程管理，並增訂業者自主檢驗、查廠頻率。
title_zh: 「2個要求+5個增訂」致癌油風暴 卓揆下令一周完成檢驗、提食安法修法
summary_zh: 因應中聯油品致癌物苯駢芘超標，行政院要求4至6月油品食品於10日中午前全面預防性下架。行政院長卓榮泰13日舉行專案會議，要求一周內完成所有檢驗，檢驗合格後始得恢復上架；此外，他指示衛福部一周內提出食安法及子法修法，強化源頭和製程管理，並增訂業者自主檢驗、查廠頻率。
title_en: "2 Requirements + 5 Updates" Carcinogenic Oil Storm Zhuo Kui Ordered to Complete Inspections in One Week and Mention Food Safety Laws and Amendments
summary_en: In response to the excessive levels of the carcinogen benzenepyrene in China United Oil Products, the Executive Yuan required all oil and food products from April to June to be taken off the shelves as a precaution before noon on the 10th. Executive Director Zhuo Yongtai held a special project meeting on the 13th, requiring that all inspections be completed within a week, and products can be resumed only after passing the inspection. In addition, he instructed the Ministry of Health and Welfare to propose amendments to the food safety law and sub-laws within a week, strengthen source and process management, and increase the frequency of independent inspections and factory inspections by the industry.

title: 毒油風波！南僑驗出新一批問題油品 下游流向胖老爹、錢櫃等近百店家

title_en: Organizing bag/Carcinogenic salad oil spreads! What oils and foods are affected? View the complete list of 257 companies at once
summary_en: What happened in the China United Oil Company case? Zoomlion Oils and Fats successively shipped approximately 1,300 metric tons of soybean salad oil to Fumao, Fushou and Taishan from April 8 to 10, 2026, and submitted the raw materials and products to SGS for inspection on April 13. The result on April 22 was 1.6 micrograms per kilogram, which did not exceed the legal standard. However, Nan Chiau Group conducted an independent inspection before using the oil supplied by Fu Shou in late April and found that the benzene and pyrene values ​​were abnormal. After receiving the notice on June 11, Zoomlion successively sent retained samples for inspection. The results on June 25 and 29 were 4.68 micrograms per kilogram and 8.1 micrograms per kilogram respectively, both of which were confirmed to exceed the standard. The company notified the competent authority on June 30. The Food and Drug Administration subsequently requested Zhonglian to suspend the production of soy salad oil. Related problematic products and processed foods were gradually removed from the shelves in early July, and the first list of affected products was announced on July 7. (For more details, please visit the official website of the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare) Extended reading Restoring the timing of the handling of the Zoomlion oil incident Government Yuan: There will be no delay or no cover-branding of 11 metric tons of oil products and downstream products of Zoomlion, which will be removed from the shelves at noon on the 10th. Food and Drug Administration: No timetable for re-listing Taishan was investigated and searched to cooperate with the investigation of the Zoomlion Oil case. Related products will be completely removed from the shelves from April to June. What is benzopyrene? Benzenepyrene (BaP) is a type of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons that may be produced when oils are processed at high temperatures, charcoal grilled, smoked or food is over-cooked, or may come from environmental pollution. title: AI點火台灣經濟！中研院估GDP衝10.16%　示警全球下半年4大變數
summary: 中央研究院經濟研究所今（13日）公布最新經濟預測，在人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算（HPC）及雲端基礎建設需求超乎預期的強勁帶動下，大幅上修2026年台灣全年經濟成長率（GDP）至10.16%。這項數據不僅較去年底預估的3.71%大幅飆升6.45個百分點，更是國內首家預測突破雙位數、表現最為樂觀的主要研究機構。中研院經濟所合聘研究員林常青以「旭日更升，峰谷分明」來形容當前的經濟情勢，強調這並非單純的景氣循環，而是全球建置雲端與高速運算投資所引發的長期結構性成長，讓台灣在全球科技供應鏈中的核心地位更加穩固。

title_en: AI ignites Taiwan’s economy! Academia Sinica estimates that GDP will surge by 10.16%, warning the world of four major variables in the second half of the year
summary_en: The Economic Research Institute of Academia Sinica released its latest economic forecast today (13th). Driven by stronger-than-expected demand for artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance computing (HPC), and cloud infrastructure, Taiwan's full-year economic growth rate (GDP) in 2026 has been significantly revised upward to 10.16%. This data not only soared 6.45 percentage points from the 3.71% estimated at the end of last year, but was also the first major domestic research institution to forecast double-digit growth and the most optimistic performance. Lin Changqing, a co-researcher at the Institute of Economics of Academia Sinica, describes the current economic situation as "the sun rises higher, with clear peaks and valleys." He emphasizes that this is not a simple business cycle, but a long-term structural growth triggered by global investment in cloud construction and high-speed computing, making Taiwan's core position in the global technology supply chain more stable.

title_en: Academia Sinica has revised up this year’s CPI to 1.95%. More than 60% of the people are worried about the sharp increase in the cost of living.
summary_en: People's expectations for inflation are continuing to deepen. The Institute of Economics of Academia Sinica released its latest economic forecast on the 13th, revising the annual growth rate of this year’s consumer price index (CPI) to 1.95%, approaching the 2% inflation warning line, and the annual growth rate of the producer price index (PPI) is also as high as 10.69%. The latest "Taiwan Consumer Expectations and Policy Response Survey" shows that as many as 92% of consumers expect inflation to continue to rise in one year, and more than 60% of people are worried about a sharp increase in the cost of living.

title: 立院提案修法 Starlink 來台卡關有解？ 數發部揭關鍵原因
summary: 立法院交通委員會13日審查《電信管理法》第36條修正草案，朝野立委主張有條件放寬衛星通訊業者外資持股及董事長國籍限制，被外界視為有助於馬斯克旗下低軌衛星服務Starlink（星鏈）未來來台布局。對此，數位發展部長林宜敬表示，數發部過去曾與Starlink接洽，但業者認為台灣4G、5G人口覆蓋率已逾99.9%，商業市場規模有限，因此目前對台灣市場興趣不高；政府推動低軌衛星的重點，也並非一般商業服務，而是在重大災害或緊急情況下，提升國家通訊韌性。
