title_en: The Legislative Yuan proposes to amend the law. Is there any solution to Starlink’s traffic jam when coming to Taiwan? Ministry of Digital Development reveals key reasons
summary_en: The Transportation Committee of the Legislative Yuan reviewed the draft amendment to Article 36 of the Telecommunications Management Act on the 13th. Legislators from both the ruling and opposition parties advocated conditional relaxation of restrictions on foreign shareholding and nationality of chairman of satellite communications companies. This is considered by the outside world to be helpful for the future deployment of Starlink, Musk's low-orbit satellite service, in Taiwan. In this regard, Digital Development Minister Lin Yijing said that the Ministry of Digital Development has contacted Starlink in the past, but industry players believe that Taiwan’s 4G and 5G population coverage has exceeded 99.9%, and the scale of the commercial market is limited, so there is currently little interest in the Taiwan market; the government’s focus in promoting low-orbit satellites is not general commercial services, but to enhance the country’s communications resilience in major disasters or emergencies.

title: 私募股權擁抱AI轉型 德勤建言採「自籌」模式降低風險
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜責任編輯／綜合外電報導全球私募股權（Private Equity, PE）組織正積極推動其被投資企業進行人工智慧（AI）及其他科技能力的轉型，以提升創新、服務、效率與韌性，確保在市場上的競爭力。然而，根據顧問公司德勤（Deloitte）於週日發布的報告指出，這類數位轉型往往伴隨著龐大的資本投入、時間心力與專業技能需求。 德勤強調，雖然 AI 帶來的變革潛力巨大，但企業在導入相關技術時，必須審慎平衡其成本與預期創造的價值。報告建議，為避免高昂的 AI 轉型成本阻礙進展，私募股權業者可採行一種「自籌」（self-funding）的路徑。這種分階段的策略，允許業者將早期的投資收益用於資助後續項目，藉此壓平支出曲線、降低前期投入，並使整體轉型過程更具永續性。 「收購、改善、出售」是私募股權的核心經營模式，而導入科技變革亦不例外。報告指出，例如代理式人工智慧（Agentic AI），意指能自主決策並執行任務以達成特定目標的人工智慧系統，以及其他進階功能，可在託管服務（managed services）期間獲得強化。待技術成熟後，再將管理權轉回內部，使其能更好地支援下游業務目標。

title_en: Jiawei's revenue in June increased by nearly 50% year-on-year, with an intraday increase of more than 5%. The outlook for the second half of the year is promising.
summary_en: Jiawei (3557)'s strong revenue in June spurred its stock price performance on the 13th, reaching an intraday high of 27 yuan, an increase of more than 5% at one time. Jiawei announced that its consolidated revenue in June reached 366 million yuan, a monthly increase of 9.7% and an annual increase of 47.8%, showing strong growth; the cumulative revenue in the first half of this year was 2.395 billion yuan, an annual decrease of 11.82%, and the annual decrease has significantly converged. Jiawei pointed out that the revenue momentum in June was mainly attributed to the successful transformation of the US subsidiary FDG. By directly participating in the local retail supply chain in the United States, FDG has significantly optimized warehousing and delivery efficiency, and the shipment volume of its own brand PREPARA has steadily rebounded.

title_en: Is it possible for Starlink to unravel? The Legislative Yuan continues to review the amendments to the Telecommunications Management Law today
summary_en: The Transportation Committee of the Legislative Yuan today reviewed the draft amendment to Article 36 of the "Telecommunications Management Act" to relax the standards for foreign low-orbit satellite companies to establish in Taiwan. The key points of this amendment include relaxing restrictions on foreign shareholdings, adjusting the requirements for setting up companies in Taiwan, and the nationality of the chairman. According to market interpretation, this case is expected to provide solutions for Starlink, a subsidiary of SpaceX, the world's leading low-orbit satellite, to establish in Taiwan.

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】台北外匯市場週一新台幣兌美元匯價走強，表現優於其他主要亞洲貨幣。由於台灣上週五因颱風停班停課、金融市場休市一天，週一恢復交易後，台幣出現補漲走勢。與此同時，台股相對其他亞股強勢，加權指數終場上漲0.06%，也對台幣匯價帶來支撐。新台幣兌美元匯率週一以32.170元作收，較前一交易日升值0.8分。銀行間新台幣兌美元最高成交價為32.075元，最低成交價為32.232元，成交量為20億2,800萬美元。一位外匯交易員表示，由於上週五休市，本土銀行累積較多美元部位待調節，因此週一出現較多美元賣盤，帶動台幣偏升；不過，目前外資尚未展現明確的操作方向。此外，也有分析認為，這波台幣反彈的延續性可能有限，主要受到美元走強等因素影響。紐約梅隆銀行資深亞太市場策略分析師張偉勤接受採訪時表示，台幣週一走勢主要反映上週除息相關賣壓後的「部分反轉」，並非單純跟隨其他亞洲貨幣補漲。未來台幣反彈空間可能受限，原因包括美元轉強、中東局勢再度升溫，以及油價上漲等因素。

title: 立邦再度出手收購未果，阿克蘇諾貝爾繼續推動與艾仕得合併計畫
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，荷蘭塗料巨頭阿克蘇諾貝爾(Akzo Nobel NV)董事會拒絕了立邦塗料對其裝飾塗料業務的收購提議，繼續建議推動與艾仕得塗料(Axalta Coating Systems Ltd)的合併計畫。這份新的75億歐元(86億美元)收購方案，是立邦在多次嘗試與阿克蘇諾貝爾達成交易之後提出的。阿克蘇諾貝爾週一表示，最新提議「嚴重低估」了其塗料業務部門的價值。阿克蘇諾貝爾表示，其管理層和監事會「繼續一致建議」與艾仕得的合併計畫。此次合併預計將締造出一家市值約250億美元的塗料生產商。在需求疲軟、原物料成本上漲的背景下，全球塗料行業正經歷一輪整合浪潮。立邦的最新收購提議是其又一次試圖阻撓擬議中的艾仕得交易。知情人士表示，阿克蘇諾貝爾的管理層未就立邦的最新收購提議與其進行接洽，也未傳達給股東。根據與艾仕得達成的合併協議，阿克蘇諾貝爾將持有合併後實體55%的股份，並將股票上市地從阿姆斯特丹遷至紐約。根據5月提交的一份文件，該交易仍需獲得美國聯邦貿易委員會批准，該監管機構已要求這兩家公司提供更多訊息。

title: 美軍協調約20艘商船通過荷姆茲，航道未全封但通航仍遠低於正常水準
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美國與伊朗持續爭奪荷姆茲海峽實際控制權之際，美國媒體週日(12日)引述一名美國官員表示，過去24小時約有20艘商船在美軍協調下通過海峽，另有數艘商船未經美軍協調自行通行。這項數據顯示，伊朗雖宣稱已關閉海峽，但航道並未遭到全面實體封鎖，美軍目前仍具備一定程度的護航與航運協調能力。美國總統川普先前也表示，荷姆茲海峽仍對商業航運開放，美方並否認伊朗擁有關閉國際水道的權力。美國中央司令部連日打擊伊朗沿岸飛彈、防空系統及革命衛隊高速快艇，目的之一正是壓低商船遭攻擊或攔截的風險，維持靠近阿曼一側航道的通行能力。不過，約20艘商船通過並不代表航運已恢復正常。美聯社報導，過去一週共有超過140艘船通過相關海域，但相較戰前荷姆茲海峽每日約百艘以上船舶往來，整體流量仍處偏低水準；船東、保險公司與能源交易商仍須評估飛彈、無人機、快艇攔截及誤擊風險。因此，最新進展較準確的解讀是，荷姆茲海峽目前處於「有限通航、軍事護航、風險極高」狀態，而非完全關閉或全面恢復。只要美伊互攻持續，商船即使能夠通行，保費、運費與繞航成本仍可能居高不下；若再有大型油輪或貨輪遭襲，市場對能源供應中斷的疑慮仍可能迅速升

title: 日圓交易員拒買單口頭干預，市場靜待GPIF投資框架實質變革
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，金融媒體分析顯示，隨著美國和伊朗再度衝突、美元/日圓重回162附近，外匯交易員對美債殖利率上升做出反應，上週五日本財務大臣片山皋月有關政府養老投資基金(GPIF)投資呼籲的影響消退。這對日本當局來說是個警示。養老基金資金流可能變化的談論或許能為日圓爭取一些時間，但不太可能起到根本性作用。市場猜測日本GPIF可能被迫將更多投資轉移回國內，這在上週打壓了美元兌日圓匯率。不過，中東最新緊張局勢已經暴露出這一走勢的脆弱性。下一次對GPIF投資框架的定期審查要到2030年才會進行。不過，首相高市早苗已經表明，當符合其政策目標時，她願意打破常規。因此，投資者將密切關注未來幾週GPIF是否會面臨更多的口頭施壓。然而，光靠空談無法讓外匯交易員抱有太高的期望。如果沒有切實行動，這可能只不過是日圓的短暫喘息窗口而已。

summary_en: The Ministry of Finance plans the Qing'an 3.0 plan and will report it to Executive Yuan Zhuo Rongtai again as soon as this week. summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電引述信報的報導指出，未具名知情人士披露，香港財資市場公會已向業界展開諮詢，就引進新的離岸人民幣利率基準(CNH HONIA)徵集意見。報導指稱，CNH HONIA將參考HONIA(港幣隔夜平均指數)，以實際成交為基礎。報導指出，一個更能反映實際成交情況的優化利率基準，是促進市場對沖及衍生工具交易、貸款以及發債定價的關鍵。

title: 經濟學家估中國第二季GDP年比增速4.5%，經濟凸顯「K型分化」格局
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電引述第一財經的報導指出，中國國家統計局將於7月15日發布第二季及上半年GDP增速、工業、消費、投資等主要經濟指標數據。參與第一財經首席調查研究的經濟專家對2026年第二季GDP年比增速的預測均值為4.5%。時序已來到2026年下半年，本輪中國經濟復甦的結構性特徵越發清晰，一方面，以AI產業鏈、高端製造、外貿出口等為代表的新動能持續擴容，景氣度穩步抬升。另一方面，消費、投資等內需指標仍然偏弱。新舊動能走勢的「K型分化」成為現階段經濟運行的核心特徵。經濟專家認為，中國經濟「K型分化」格局進一步凸顯，正處於新舊動能轉換時期，宏觀政策有望在下半年強化穩成長。但新動能釋放尚不足以彌補舊動能消退，不改中國經濟仍處於新舊動能轉換陣痛期的基本格局。

summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】消息人士向路透透露，社群媒體巨擘--Meta Platforms(美股代碼META)正加快降低對輝達與超微AI晶片的依賴，計畫自9月起量產代號「Iris」的自研AI晶片，並將其納入四代Meta訓練與推理加速器(MTIA)計畫。Iris由Meta自行設計，博通協助晶片開發，台積電(2330)負責製造，主要用於強化Facebook及Instagram背後的AI訓練與推理能力，顯示大型雲端業者自研ASIC的競爭正進一步升溫。內部備忘錄顯示，Iris除錯測試僅歷時六週，且未發現重大問題，量產進度明顯快於Meta過去逾五年的自研晶片計畫。公司今年規劃部署7GW算力，上半年已增加1GW，預計年底前再增2.5GW，並在2027年將總算力倍增至14GW。Meta今年AI基礎設施支出上看1,450億美元，占大型科技企業預估逾7,000億美元AI投資的重要部分。Iris並非完全取代GPU，而是作為輝達及超微AI加速器的補充，藉由針對Meta自身工作負載最佳化，降低每單位模型訓練與推理成本。備忘錄直言，大規模導入最新GPU對公司而言相當複雜，且已造成時間損失，因此Meta計畫至2027年

title: 摩根大通再上調智譜目標價20%，看好最新融資可望推動收入轉化
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，繼上週上調目標價後，摩根大通本週再次將智譜目標價上調20%。因需求已逼近其服務能力上限，因此新增推理資源可望在12個月內轉化為年度經常性收入，而最新的融資為這一已可見的轉化提供了資金支持。摩根大通分析師Olivia Xu在報告中表示，智譜融資加速了清晰的「需求到營收」轉化路徑，故將其目標價從2,000港幣上調至2,400港幣，並維持「增持」評級。Xu表示，風險在於，配售後的自由流通股比例僅為14%，因此對於這檔今年來已大漲14倍的股票來說，股價波動性將依然極高。此外，摩根大通則是將MiniMax的目標價從300港幣下調至240港幣，並維持「中性」評級。因商業轉化路徑尚未證實，而股權已被稀釋。若能看到模型改進的明確證據，以及與同業在商業化變現方面差距縮小的跡象，該行態度將會轉為更加積極。

title: 高盛看好香港軟體科技股表現數月內改善，縮小與A股「硬科技」差距
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，高盛集團方面表示，高盛的模型顯示，H股軟體股的表現可能在未來幾個月趨於改善，並有機會在基本面、估值及流動性等多個層面上縮小與A股硬科技類股之間的差距。Kinger Lau等高盛分析師在報告中指出，當前大型互聯網公司估值可能已經考慮到了其核心業務的進一步降級，及其人工智慧投資不佳的淨現值和投資回報率。整體而言，不認同中國AI股票整體存在泡沫的觀點，但也觀察到AI投資領域內部出現局部過熱跡象，主要集中在半導體類股，以及部分A股「硬科技」代表性標的。對於下半年，維持超配A股，主要因其在週期上更具優勢的盈利動能，以及對國際投資者而言尚未被充分重視的分散化配置價值。同時，也建議開始逐步增持部分港股大型互聯網公司股票。

title_en: Workers in the information electronics industry account for only 10%
summary_en: Strong global demand for AI has driven huge profit growth in Taiwan's information electronics industry. This year's economic growth rate is expected to exceed 10%. According to statistics from the Ministry of Economic Affairs, there are approximately 850,000 employees in the information electronics industry. One out of every three to four employees in the manufacturing industry is engaged in the information electronics industry. However, if we look at the 8.573 million employees nationwide, less than one out of every ten workers is engaged in the information electronics industry. Therefore, the economic fruits of the explosion of semiconductors and AI in recent years have not been felt by 90% of workers.

The company also integrates the export of OEM formula products from Japan to Southeast Asia, leveraging the competitiveness of Japanese manufacturing and tariff-free benefits, and increasing the growth momentum of the Southeast Asian market.

title: 海昌周三掛牌 每股32元
summary: 櫃買家族本周將再添新兵。海昌生技（7814）將在7月15日上櫃掛牌，是今年來第20家掛牌的公司。海昌生技承銷價為32元，9日興櫃均價收在36.92元，主辦承銷商為永豐金證券。

title_en: Haichang listed on Wednesday at 32 yuan per share
summary_en: The cabinet buying family will add another new member this week. Haichang Biotechnology (7814) will be listed on the OTC market on July 15, becoming the 20th company to be listed this year. The underwriting price of Haichang Biotechnology is 32 yuan, and the average price on the 9th closed at 36.92 yuan. The lead underwriter is SinoPac Securities.

title_en: Global stock funds attracted gold at a three-week high, and AI optimism and interest rate hike expectations cooled, igniting buying momentum.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] According to Reuters citing data from LSEG Lipper, global stock funds attracted a net inflow of US$49.23 billion in the week ending July 8, setting a record for the largest single-week net buying overhang since June 17. This strong wave of funding is mainly driven by strong demand for AI-related technology products and the cooling of market expectations for interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve (Fed), which in turn boosts risk appetite. The June manufacturing activity report released last week was impressive, generally indicating that demand for AI-related products such as chips and computers remains strong, and the market is full of expectations for the profit prospects of AI stocks in the upcoming second-quarter financial reports. LSEG data shows that according to the average analyst estimate, the technology industry’s second-quarter net profit is expected to achieve an annual growth rate of as high as 54.2%. This encouraged global technology stock funds to pour in US$11.49 billion that week, a nearly 30% increase from US$8.88 billion the previous week, while financial stock and industrial stock funds also received US$1.52 billion and US$789 million respectively. From a regional perspective, funds are blooming across the board. U.S. stock funds attracted US$24.97 billion that week, the largest inflow in three weeks; European stock funds and Asian stock funds also received US$13.67 billion and US$6.95 billion in capital injections respectively. In contrast, emerging market equity funds remained weak, losing about $500 million that week, marking the 11th consecutive week of net outflows. title_en: Trump threatens to bomb the U.S. military with unprecedented intensity if he is assassinated by Iran
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] As tensions between the United States and Iran are rising again, U.S. President Trump publicly warned that if Iran succeeds in instigating an assassination, the United States will launch an unprecedented military retaliation against Iran. Trump also revealed that he had left clear instructions in advance that if something unexpected happened to him, the U.S. military should launch an "unprecedented" violent bombing of Iran, inflicting an extremely heavy price on Tehran. In an interview with the New York Post on Friday (10th), Trump stated that he had long been at the top of Iran's assassination list and that Iran had been trying to get rid of him for many years. When asked about Israel's recent notification to the United States that Iran may be planning a new round of assassinations, Trump downplayed the so-called "new plan" but acknowledged that threats from Iran always exist and half-joked that he hoped the outside world would miss him when he is gone. Iran's threat of retaliation against Trump can be traced back to Trump's order to kill Qasem Soleimani, commander of the Iranian Revolutionary Guards' Quds Force, with a drone in 2020. The U.S. Department of Justice indicted an Iranian man in 2024, accusing him of planning to spy on and assassinate Trump under instructions from the Iranian Revolutionary Guards; Iran continued to deny involvement in related plots. Trump was shot and a bullet grazed his ear during a rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, in July 2024, but the case was not confirmed to be related to Iran. After Trump concluded his trip to the NATO summit in Turkey in the past week, he did not return to the United States on the new modified special plane donated by Qatar. Instead, he switched to an older version of Air Force One with more complete defense equipment.

title_en: U.S. stock funds have seen their largest inflows in three weeks, with earnings expectations for technology stocks and hopes of interest rate cuts boosting buying sentiment.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] According to Reuters citing data from LSEG Lipper, U.S. stock funds attracted a net inflow of US$24.97 billion in the week ending July 8, setting a record for the largest single-week net buying excess since June 17. This wave of buying sentiment was mainly boosted by strong profit expectations for the technology industry and easing concerns about the Federal Reserve (Fed) raising interest rates. As the second-quarter earnings season is about to begin, the market is showing optimistic expectations for the profit prospects of technology stocks. LSEG data shows that analysts estimate that the average annual profit growth rate of large and medium-sized U.S. technology companies will reach 40.8%. Driven by strong demand for AI products, analysts have raised the average profit forecast for the technology industry in the next 12 months by 4.2% in the past month. This prompted investors to frantically inject $9.71 billion into technology stock funds that week, setting the largest weekly net overbuying since June 16. Financial stocks and livelihood necessities stock funds also received inflows of $1.04 billion and $683 million respectively. In terms of market capitalization, U.S. large-cap and small-cap funds attracted weekly inflows of US$10.71 billion and US$1.87 billion respectively that week, while mid-cap funds bucked the trend and saw a net outflow of US$692 million. At the same time, demand for bond funds also ushered in a huge explosion, sucking in $1.682 billion that week, setting a record for the largest weekly inflow since at least 2019. title_en: Xiyu Technology’s share placement and bond issuance were oversubscribed several times, raising a total of HK$16.041 billion
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] According to foreign sources quoting people familiar with the matter, China's artificial intelligence (AI) unicorn MiniMax Technology (MiniMax, 00100.HK)'s latest share placement and convertible bond issuance has been enthusiastically pursued by investors. It has been successfully oversubscribed several times, showing that global capital's willingness to subscribe to AI cutting-edge technology entities is still strong. Xiyu Technology’s two-pronged financing plan includes the placement of 35.6 million new Class A shares and the issuance of zero-coupon guaranteed convertible bonds (CB) with a scale of HK$6.5 billion due in 2027. The two financing measures have attracted a total of HK$16.041 billion in the market. This huge capital injection will provide this large language model developer with an extremely abundant silver bullet to cope with the increasingly fierce computing power arms race. Sources pointed out that the subscription structure this time is quite solid, not only attracting the active participation of long-only institutional investors, but also the existing shareholders of Xiyu Technology. In addition, a number of specific investors who accepted the "Sounding Walls Arrangement" were also included. These investors agreed to strictly keep secrets and not conduct any market transactions before the official announcement of the transaction, in exchange for the opportunity to obtain sensitive non-public information in advance to further ensure the stability of the issuance. Analysts pointed out that the in-depth participation of Xiyu Technology’s management in the placement conveyed strong internal confidence to the market and was also the key to the case being able to buck the trend and obtain several times overbought status. in global AI capital

title: 韓台領跌新興市場，6月外資淨流出461億美元，韓股創26年最大失血
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，全球資金6月大幅撤出新興市場股票，其中科技股權重偏高的韓國與台灣成為主要提款市場，反映投資人正降低對高估值科技類股與廣泛股票風險的曝險。與此同時，新興市場債券仍持續吸引資金，顯示國際投資人並未全面撤離新興市場，而是由股票轉向收益較明確的債券資產。國際金融協會(IIF)數據顯示，外資6月自新興市場股票淨撤出461億美元，其中，韓國股市流出305億美元，創近26年最大單月撤資規模；台灣股市流出183億美元。新興市場債券同期吸引283億美元淨流入，使整體投資組合資金仍淨流出178億美元，為連續第二個月出現資金外流。區域表現分化明顯，新興亞洲6月整體資金淨流出270億美元，而拉丁美洲、新興歐洲、中東及北非則維持淨流入。中國股票資金由5月淨流入81億美元，急轉為6月淨流出140億美元，中國債券亦遭外資撤出37億美元，反映市場對中國經濟、企業獲利與政策前景的信心仍偏審慎。IIF首席經濟學家Jonathan Fortun指出，投資人仍願意向新興市場提供融資，但不願進一步承擔廣泛股票風險。華許領導下的聯準會(Fed)可能轉趨鷹派，加上油價波動、美元流動性收緊、全球折現率上

title_en: South Korea and Taiwan led the decline in emerging markets, with net foreign capital outflows of US$46.1 billion in June, and the Korean stock market suffered its largest loss in 26 years.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Reuters reported that global funds significantly withdrew from emerging market stocks in June, with South Korea and Taiwan, which have a heavy weight in technology stocks, becoming the main withdrawal markets, reflecting that investors are reducing their exposure to highly valued technology stocks and broad equity risks. At the same time, emerging market bonds continue to attract funds, indicating that international investors have not completely withdrawn from emerging markets, but are switching from stocks to bond assets with clearer returns. According to data from the Institute of International Finance (IIF), foreign capital withdrew a net US$46.1 billion from emerging market stocks in June. Among them, the South Korean stock market saw an outflow of US$30.5 billion, the largest single-month withdrawal in the past 26 years; the Taiwan stock market saw an outflow of US$18.3 billion. Emerging market bonds attracted a net inflow of US$28.3 billion during the same period, leaving the overall portfolio with a net outflow of US$17.8 billion, marking the second consecutive month of outflows. Regional performance is clearly differentiated. Emerging Asia saw overall net outflows of US$27 billion in June, while Latin America, emerging Europe, the Middle East and North Africa maintained net inflows. China's stock capital inflows sharply turned from a net inflow of US$8.1 billion in May to a net outflow of US$14 billion in June. Foreign capital also withdrew US$3.7 billion from Chinese bonds, reflecting that the market's confidence in China's economy, corporate profits and policy prospects is still cautious. IIF chief economist Jonathan Fortun pointed out that investors are still willing to provide financing to emerging markets, but are unwilling to further bear broad equity risks. The Federal Reserve (Fed) under the leadership of Washer may turn hawkish, coupled with oil price fluctuations, tightening of US dollar liquidity, and rising global discount rates.

title_en: OpenAI and Google AI models flow to overseas subsidiaries of Alibaba and Tencent, US regulatory loopholes attract attention
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] The Financial Times reported that OpenAI and Google continue to provide advanced artificial intelligence (AI) model services to subsidiaries of Alibaba (09988.HK), Baidu (09888.HK) and Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) through overseas bases such as Singapore. Since relevant Chinese companies are included in the 1260H list of suspected cooperation with the Chinese military by the U.S. Department of Defense, the list itself is not a comprehensive trade ban. Therefore, overseas subsidiaries can still legally obtain some U.S. AI services, highlighting the gray area in Washington's existing technology control. OpenAI confirmed that in the past, it had allowed some Chinese companies to use its tools in countries with security control capabilities, but it prohibited direct access to models in China. After inquiries from the Financial Times, the company stated that it had suspended API access rights for some users related to Alibaba in June due to concerns that the model could be illegally used or used for "distillation." The so-called distillation is to use the large output of advanced models to train smaller or competing models, which may allow users to copy part of the capabilities of the original model at a lower cost. Google said that its AI services can be used in Hong Kong and Singapore, but customers must comply with policies prohibiting unauthorized distillation and other uses. Google also admitted that regional sales restrictions alone are not enough to completely prevent abuse, because users with strong technical capabilities may still bypass regional restrictions through overseas companies, agency services, or other means. title_en: Tashan Technology completed Series B financing, and robot business is expected to become the main growth engine
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Chen Mengshuo] Chinese media reported that Tashan Technology, a Chinese developer of artificial intelligence (AI) tactile sensing chips and solutions, completed Series B financing, raising hundreds of millions of yuan. The company is a tactile simulation partner of Nvidia (US stock code NVDA) Isaac Sim. This round of funds will be used for tactile sensor and chip iteration, scenario-based solution implementation and tactile training platform construction to further expand its presence in the humanoid robot and smart car markets. Investors in this round include Joyson Electronics, Taiping Innovation, Oaks, Penngling Holdings, Lavender Hill Capital Partners and Hongshan Capital. Existing shareholders Dow Technology and Binfu Capital also made additional investments. Tashan Technology was established in 2017 and has established a full-stack tactile sensing technology system covering chips, sensors, algorithm models and scene applications. The core team members come from Tsinghua University, University of Manchester and other institutions. In terms of simulation training, Tashan Technology said that the company is the world's first tactile simulation partner of Huida Isaac Sim, and the self-developed tactile simulation system has been open sourced to MuJoCo and Huida platforms. Tactile perception allows robots to identify information such as pressure, friction, material, and object sliding. It is an important link for dexterous hands to perform grasping, assembly, and fine operations. As embodied intelligence accelerates commercialization, the demand for related sensors is rapidly increasing. The company said that as of the end of May this year, orders for tactile sensors on hand had reached four times last year's full-year turnover, and the overall turnover in the first five months also exceeded that of 2025.

title_en: Meituan and Xiaomi reported large-scale layoffs, but the two giants responded that it was normal business and team adjustments

title_en: China is rumored to be planning to tighten controls on top AI models, and overseas access to DeepSeek and others may be restricted
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] According to media reports, the Chinese government is reportedly considering tightening control over large local advanced artificial intelligence (AI) models, which may restrict the public release of some sensitive technologies and the access of overseas users. As Chinese models such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI have rapidly become popular in the U.S. technology industry with their low cost and close to first-line product capabilities, Beijing has begun to regard cutting-edge models as strategic assets with national security value. The policy direction may shift from encouraging open source output to placing more emphasis on technology protection. Sources pointed out that Chinese officials have recently discussed potential regulatory plans with major domestic AI laboratories and technology companies. Possible measures include adding more stringent technical and security reviews before the launch of new models; if the model contains sensitive capabilities, the competent authorities may require a delay in public release, restrict the use of foreign companies and specific levels of users, and strengthen prevention of the leakage of model weights, training methods and other proprietary technologies. The relevant plans are still in the discussion stage and may mainly apply to a new generation model that has not yet been released. Chinese models have recently become popular in Silicon Valley, mainly because the cost is significantly lower than OpenAI and Anthropic products, and they can already provide "good enough" performance in tasks such as programming, reasoning, and AI agents. U.S. users, including large enterprises and startups, are incorporating DeepSeek and Dark Side of the Moon models into their daily workflows as alternatives or supplements to high-priced U.S. models. This rapid proliferation has increased the international influence of China’s AI technology, but it has also deepened Beijing’s interest in the technology.

title: 以色列國會大選10/27舉行，執政聯盟確認維持法定期限不提前
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，以色列現任國防部長兼執政聯盟重要領袖伊斯雷爾．卡茲(Israel Katz)週日(12日)向國會委員會表示，以色列將於10月27日舉行全國大選。這是自2023年哈瑪斯襲擊以及隨後在加薩、黎巴嫩和伊朗引發的衝突以來，以色列首次舉行的全國性選舉。以色列國會曾於5月投票通過解散，一度引發外界猜測大選可能會提前舉行，如今執政聯盟表態將維持法律規定的原定日期。現任總理納坦雅胡(Benjamin Netanyah)是以色列歷史上執政時間最長的領導人，並多次在政治危機中展現強大的生存能力。不過，自2023年10月7日哈瑪斯發動突襲以來，其強調國家安全的執政信譽面臨嚴峻挑戰，近期多項民意調查也顯示，許多民眾對其在伊朗衝突中的表現感到不滿。在政治選情方面，近期連續多項民調皆顯示，由納坦雅胡領導的民族主義與宗教政黨執政聯盟，恐將在這次大選中失去多數優勢。然而，其政治對手目前同樣未能形成明確的奪權路徑，隨著距離大選投票還有數個月的時間，當地的政治版圖仍存在變數。在以色列政壇中，政府能夠做滿4年任期投票的情況相當罕見。納坦雅胡自2022年重返執政並組成以色列歷史上最右翼的政府以來

title_en: The Israeli parliamentary election will be held on October 27, and the ruling coalition confirms that the legal deadline will not be advanced
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Reuters reported that Israel’s current Defense Minister and important leader of the ruling coalition, Israel. Israel Katz told a congressional committee on Sunday (12th) that Israel will hold national elections on October 27. This is the first national election held in Israel since the 2023 Hamas attack and subsequent conflicts in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran. The Israeli Knesset voted to be dissolved in May, which once triggered speculation that the general election might be held early. Now the ruling coalition has stated that it will maintain the original date stipulated in the law. Current Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyah is the longest-serving leader in Israeli history and has repeatedly demonstrated his strong ability to survive political crises. However, since Hamas launched a raid on October 7, 2023, its governing credibility of emphasizing national security has faced severe challenges. Multiple recent opinion polls have also shown that many people are dissatisfied with its performance in the Iran conflict. In terms of political election conditions, recent polls have shown that the ruling coalition of nationalist and religious parties led by Natanyahu may lose its majority advantage in this election. However, its political opponents have also failed to form a clear path to seizing power. With the general election voting still months away, the local political landscape is still uncertain. In Israeli politics, it is quite rare for a government to be able to vote for a full four-year term. title_en: Iran vows retaliation against US and Israel, Trump says thousands of missiles are targeting Iran, threats escalate after ceasefire breaks
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Chen Mengshuo] The confrontation between the United States and Iran further escalated on Saturday (11th). Iran's Supreme Leader Mujtaba. Mojtaba Khamenei issued a statement naming the United States and Israel as former Supreme Leader Ali. Those responsible for the killings of Ali Khamenei and others stressed that Iran will continue to pursue responsibility and take retaliatory actions. U.S. President Trump claimed that 1,000 missiles have been targeted at Iran and that if Tehran attempts to assassinate him, the U.S. military will immediately launch more missiles to counterattack. Mujtaba said that Iran will continue Ali. Khamini's established political line is to safeguard the country's independence and sovereignty and will not change its policy direction due to changes in the top leadership. He also said that holding the United States and Israel accountable is a common demand of Iranian society. No matter what kind of diplomatic or military pressure Iran faces, it will not give up its goal of revenge, which shows that the new leadership is trying to consolidate domestic authority through tough statements. Trump posted a message on the social platform on the 10th that the United States has ordered its military to be prepared and has the ability to completely destroy Iran’s military capabilities within a year and to extend the operation if necessary. He also warned that if Iran assassinates or attempts to assassinate him, the United States will launch thousands of missiles in addition to the 1,000 missiles currently targeted at Iran. Although Trump agreed to Iran's request to continue negotiations, he clearly announced that the ceasefire has ended, showing that Washington still adopts a strategy of military pressure and diplomatic contact in parallel. On the 7th and 8th, the US military launched attacks on Iran for two consecutive days in response to Iran’s attack on merchant ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: 伊拉克總理13日出訪華盛頓，料簽署油氣合作協議，拓展多元出口管道
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，伊拉克總理柴迪將於週一(13日)訪問華盛頓，旨在深化與美國的戰略關係。雙方預計將簽署一系列油氣領域的合作協議，作為推動經濟、貿易和投資合作的一部分。在美伊軍事衝突持續升級的背景下，伊拉克政府正極力尋求在鄰國伊朗與美國這兩個敵對對手之間取得平衡。伊拉克政府發言人阿布迪表示，即將簽署的協議包括多項油氣領域的諒解備忘錄(MOU)。伊拉克準備引進多家美國公司，為提高本國的石油產能注入新動能。此外，伊拉克國家通訊社引述阿布迪的話指出，這些計畫中的油氣協議還將尋求建立替代性的出口管道，以降低伊拉克因荷姆茲海峽受阻而面臨的風險。受到美伊衝突導致關鍵航道荷姆茲海峽實質關閉的影響，伊拉克與其他海灣產油國一樣，因原油運輸受阻而遭遇石油收入下滑的衝擊。阿布迪透露，除了經濟與能源議題外，如何加強伊拉克武裝部隊的防衛實力，也將是本次華盛頓會談的核心議題之一。過去由於美國在伊拉克的駐軍問題、巴格達與德黑蘭的親密關係，以及美方施壓要求遏制境內伊朗支持的武裝團體，美伊關係曾多次陷入緊張。然而，自柴迪於4月獲得總理提名後，美國總統川普隨即表達祝賀，並表示期盼巴格達與華盛頓未來能展開更緊密的

title_en: The Prime Minister of Iraq will visit Washington on the 13th and is expected to sign an oil and gas cooperation agreement and expand diversified export pipelines.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Reuters reported that Iraqi Prime Minister Zaidi will visit Washington on Monday (13th) with the aim of deepening strategic relations with the United States. The two sides are expected to sign a series of cooperation agreements in the oil and gas field as part of promoting economic, trade and investment cooperation. As the military conflict between the United States and Iran continues to escalate, the Iraqi government is trying its best to strike a balance between its two hostile rivals, neighboring Iran and the United States. Iraqi government spokesman Abdi said that the agreement to be signed includes a number of memoranda of understanding (MOU) in the oil and gas field. Iraq is preparing to introduce a number of American companies to inject new impetus into increasing its oil production capacity. In addition, the Iraqi National News Agency quoted Abdi as saying that these planned oil and gas agreements will also seek to establish alternative export pipelines to reduce the risks faced by Iraq due to the obstruction of the Strait of Hormuz. Affected by the virtual closure of the key waterway Strait of Hormuz due to the conflict between the United States and Iran, Iraq, like other Gulf oil-producing countries, has suffered from a decline in oil revenue due to blocked crude oil transportation. Abdi revealed that in addition to economic and energy issues, how to strengthen the defense capabilities of the Iraqi armed forces will also be one of the core topics of the talks in Washington. In the past, U.S.-Iran relations have been strained many times due to the issue of U.S. troops stationed in Iraq, Baghdad's close relationship with Tehran, and U.S. pressure to curb Iranian-backed armed groups in the country. However, after Zaidi was nominated as prime minister in April, U.S. President Trump immediately expressed congratulations and expressed his hope that Baghdad and Washington would have closer cooperation in the future.

title_en: China Airlines' revenue in June, second quarter and first half of the year hit new highs, and Q3 bookings grew steadily
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Liu Juquan] China Airlines Group (2610) consolidated operating income in June was 21.761 billion yuan, an increase of 28.82% over the same period last year, continuing to hit a record high in a single month; of which, passenger revenue was 11.819 billion yuan, an increase of 14.84% over the same period last year, and cargo revenue was 8.085 billion yuan, an increase of 51.60% over the same period last year. Consolidated revenue in the second quarter of 2026 was 63.845 billion yuan, and consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 120.803 billion yuan, which also set a new high in history. In June, passenger demand was booming, driven by the Dragon Boat Festival holiday and the approaching summer travel season. The average passenger load factor in Europe and the United States, such as Los Angeles, San Francisco, Seattle, London, Rome, and Prague, reached over 85%. Overall, in the first half of the year, destinations such as Sydney, Brisbane, Tokyo, Fukuoka, and Kumamoto were the most popular among passengers. Looking forward to the third quarter, bookings are growing steadily, and passenger traffic performance continues to increase. Starting from July 24, Taoyuan-Busan will increase to 21 flights per week, providing passengers with diverse and flexible flight options. From now until July 22, China Airlines’ official website will launch the “2026 China Airlines Summer Online Travel Show” with preferential prices on selected routes, covering popular destinations such as Hong Kong, Kuala Lumpur, Takamatsu, Seattle, Sydney and Prague. In terms of freight, June coincides with the end of the second quarter, and the demand in the air cargo market remains strong. In addition to high-tech inherent supply sources such as Al servers and semiconductor equipment, seasonal fruits and high-priced temporary supply sources also injected revenue, making the overall freight performance stable. summary: 【財訊快報／記者陳浩寧報導】倍力(6874)受惠於企業持續推動數位治理等需求穩健成長，客戶需求增加，累計上半年營收達13.47億元，較去年同期增長51.17%，創歷年同期新高。倍力表示，公司今年積極推動ACE（AI、Cybersecurity、ESG）發展策略逐步展現成果，後續將推動整體營運穩健成長。展望下半年，倍力表示，隨著臺灣上市櫃公司今年起逐步接軌IFRS永續揭露準則（IFRS S1/S2），永續財務資訊揭露與管理需求可望持續升溫，預計推出全新永續財務揭露資訊管理解決方案-S管家，藉由AI技術協助企業建構符合IFRS永續揭露準則要求的資料蒐集、整合、管理及揭露流程，串聯財務與永續資訊，協助客戶提升揭露品質與管理效率。此外，倍力亦預計於下半年正式推出企業級AI應用平台，看準企業更加重視AI應用落地的實質效益，AI應用平台將有效協助企業快速建置安全且可管理的AI應用環境，加速AI融入日常營運流程。倍力表示，除了透過原先的自有產品與代理產品並進外，未來將以ACE（AI、Cybersecurity、ESG）為核心發展方向，擴大企業數位治理市場布局，審慎樂觀看待下半年及未來營運發展。

title: 中聯致癌油風暴再檢檢出超標！福壽涉延遲通報遭中市重罰600萬元

summary_en: Zoomlion Oil and Fats found that the level 1 carcinogen "benzopyrene" exceeded the standard. During the food safety crisis, another two batches of oil products were found to exceed the standard, which means a total of 5 batches of oil were found to have problems. The Taichung City Food Safety Department received a notification from Fu Shou Company this evening and independently sent for inspection on June 30 that the second batch of soybean oil produced by China United Oil and Fats on April 6 and 10 exceeded the standard. The Department of Food Safety stated that because Fu Shou failed to report the inspection report immediately after receiving it on July 6, the city government imposed a heavy fine of NT$6 million. In addition to the NT$3 million fine imposed recently due to the delay in reporting, Fu Shou has been fined a total of NT$9 million.

title_en: Financial sector underweights Taiwan stocks and pockets profits
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market has surged for two consecutive months, and the financial industry has shifted from offensive to harvesting in May. According to statistics from the Financial Supervisory Commission, in May, the three financial industries turned to reductions of NT$75.1 billion in Taiwan stocks, which was the largest in the past six months. Banks and securities firms pulled back, and the life insurance industry even cut their positions by NT$133.1 billion. Stock capital gains can be converted into retained earnings to increase dividend chips.

title_en: If the U.S. raises interest rates, spread income is expected to increase
summary_en: The market is paying close attention to the U.S. Federal Reserve's interest rate policy in the second half of the year. Judging from the recently released FOMC meeting minutes, the market believes that the probability of maintaining a high interest rate environment this year is still high, and it does not even rule out the possibility of raising interest rates. Domestic banks believe that if U.S. interest rates remain high or even rise again, the overall interest rate spread income and profits of banks will still grow by hundreds of millions of dollars, but they will continue to pay attention to the impact of rising capital costs and market fluctuations.

title_en: Workers in the information electronics industry account for only 10%
summary_en: Strong global demand for AI has driven huge profit growth in Taiwan's information electronics industry. This year's economic growth rate is expected to exceed 10%. According to statistics from the Ministry of Economic Affairs, there are approximately 850,000 employees in the information electronics industry. One out of every three to four employees in the manufacturing industry is engaged in the information electronics industry. However, if we look at the 8.573 million employees nationwide, less than one out of every ten workers is engaged in the information electronics industry. Therefore, the economic fruits of the explosion of semiconductors and AI in recent years have not been felt by 90% of workers.

title_en: Financial industry bond market layout turns conservative
summary_en: The financial industry's bond-buying surge froze. The net bond buying by the three financial industries in a single month was only 5.2 billion yuan, ending two consecutive months of hundreds of billions of bond purchases. title_en: Zhonglian poisonous oil affects School 881 Food Safety Office: Punish when necessary, announce when necessary, and remove from shelves when necessary
summary_en: The incident of Zoomlion Oil Soybean Oil exceeding the standard of benzene and pyrene has spread to schools. As of now, a total of 623 schools and 258 kindergartens have been affected in the campus inventory list in various counties and cities. The latest written report issued by the Food Safety Office of the Executive Yuan pointed out that it will continue to coordinate and supervise the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Education and other responsible agencies to promote food safety management to ensure that every link in the food supply chain meets health and safety standards, and food safety information is more transparent, so that Chinese people can eat with peace of mind.

title_en: There have been 20 complaints against Zoomlion’s carcinogenic oil. The political Yuan supports group lawsuits. 2 consumer protection groups are willing
summary_en: Zoomlion Oils and Fats soybean salad oil was found to be contaminated with the first-level carcinogen benzenepyrene, and many school group meals were also contaminated. The Education and Culture Committee of the Legislative Yuan explicitly invited the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Food Safety Office and the Consumer Protection Division of the Executive Yuan to attend the special report. The Consumer Protection Division of the Executive Yuan reported that as of 5 p.m. on the 9th, there were 20 consumer complaints, and it will assist in filing group lawsuits. The Consumer Protection Division has discussed with two consumer protection groups and the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and both groups have initially expressed their willingness to undertake the lawsuit.

title: 巴威颱風在尖石鄉強降雨　竹縣府：尖石鄉玉峰村、秀巒村明停班停課

title_en: Typhoon Bawei caused heavy rainfall in Jianshi Township. Zhu County Prefecture: Yufeng Village and Xiuluan Village in Jianshi Township will suspend classes tomorrow
summary_en: Typhoon Bawei dropped heavy rain in the mountainous area of Jianshi Township the day before yesterday, causing the Youluo River embankment section of County Road 120 next to the Yixing Bridge in Jianshi Township, Hsinchu County to be washed away, and part of the embankment and bridge was damaged. Due to road traffic obstruction and unstable circuits, Hsinchu County Government This morning, it was first announced that Xinguang Elementary School, Xiuluan Elementary School, Shilei Elementary School, Yufeng Elementary School in Jianshi Township, and Taoshan Elementary School in Wufeng Township will stop working and classes on the 13th; Wufeng Garden Elementary School Zhulin Branch will work normally and stop classes on the 13th. Earlier, the county government pointed out that classes in Yufeng Village, Xiuluan Village and Wufeng Township in Jianshi Township will be suspended tomorrow.

summary_en: Typhoon Bawei is far away, but the water vapor in the south will move northward tomorrow and after tomorrow. Zhang Chengchuan, a forecaster from the Central Meteorological Administration, said that there will be localized heavy rain or short-term heavy rain in the north, south and southeast of the central region in the next week. Pay attention to thunderstorms in the afternoon. In addition, starting today, summer weather patterns will resume in various places. The high temperature will be 36 degrees in the next week, and there will even be foehn winds in the southeast.

title_en: Market cap ETFs are king! The favorite of the stock deposit army, it’s up to him to advance to 50,000
summary_en: There has been a major structural shift in the investment trend of Taiwan stock ETFs, and retail investors have returned to market capitalization targets in large numbers. The number of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050) fixed-term quota accounts has officially exceeded the 1.2 million mark, and the total number of beneficiaries has reached 3.27 million, becoming the core of the market's "fourth legal person". Statistics show that the interest rate of 0050 in the past three years has been as high as 261.1%, which is significantly better than mainstream high-dividend ETFs, and its long-term asset appreciation potential has been favored by the market. As the Taiwan stock market sprints to new highs, 0050's asset size has exceeded 2.2 trillion yuan, and its manager fee has dropped to 0.07% with the expansion of scale, further improving its long-term holding cost advantage. Investors' concentration of funds in value stocks not only reflects their emphasis on long-term returns, but also makes 0050 a key escort fleet supporting the momentum of Taiwan stocks, continuing to reshape the structure of the Taiwan stock market.

title_en: 90% of workers are not aware of the explosion of semiconductors and AI, and only 10% of workers are employed in the information electronics industry
summary_en: Strong global demand for AI has driven huge profit growth in China's information electronics industry, pushing China's economic growth rate this year to more than 10%, but most workers are indifferent. According to statistics from the Ministry of Economic Affairs, there are approximately 850,000 employees in the information electronics industry. One out of every three to four employees in the manufacturing industry is engaged in the information electronics industry. However, if there are 8.567 million employees in the country, less than one out of every ten workers is engaged in the information electronics industry. Therefore, the economic fruits of the explosion of semiconductors and AI in recent years have not been felt by 90% of workers.

summary_en: The craze for AI server sales continues to heat up, and the three major ODM manufacturers, Hon Hai (2317), Quanta (2382), and Wistron (3231), are riding this supply chain wave and are expected to follow suit. summary_en: Semiconductors are now the largest growth engine for Taiwan's economy. my country's semiconductor industry originally started in the Taozhumiao area, which is also the main cluster. title_en: AI power management system shipments are booming! "This big factory" has three core operations in place, and revenue in June increased by 37% year-on-year
summary_en: The share price of Lite-On (2301) fell slightly by 0.5 yuan, or 0.23%, on the 9th, closing at 213.5 yuan. title_en: Doctors reveal that the "real peak" after typhoon occurs 2 or 3 days after the disaster, with the most patients suffering from cuts, strokes and chronic diseases
summary_en: Whenever a typhoon strikes, people often worry about whether hospital services will be affected. Emergency doctors point out that the actual situation is different from what most people imagine. During real storms and heavy rains, most people dare not go out due to inconvenient transportation, and the number of emergency calls may not increase dramatically. The real peak of medical treatment usually occurs 2 or 3 days after the storm, when people start to tidy up their homes, and the number of patients with various types of trauma, infection and chronic diseases continues to increase.

title_en: Hsinchu County Magistrate Yang Wenke inspected the disaster situation in Jianshi and Neiwan. The county government announced that five schools in the mountainous area will be closed tomorrow.
summary_en: Typhoon Bawei is gradually moving away from Taiwan. Hsinchu County Magistrate Yang Wenke is currently inspecting the washed-out section of the Youluo River Embankment on County Road 120 next to the Yixing Bridge in Jianshi Township. Due to heavy rains in the mountainous area of Jianshi Township yesterday, the intersection of County Road 120 and Yixing Embankment was hit. The embankments and bridges are damaged. Due to the blocked road traffic and unstable circuits, in order to take into account the safety of teachers and students, the county government also announced that four schools including Xinguang, Xiuluan, Shilei, Yufeng Elementary School in Jianshihoushan and Wufeng Taoshan Elementary School will stop working and classes tomorrow (13th).

title_en: On the first day after Typhoon Bawei, the arrival volume of vegetables in Taoyuan decreased, the wholesale price increased by 34%, and sporadic rice lodging occurred.
summary_en: After Typhoon Bawei, the average transaction price of Taoyuan vegetable wholesale market today was 46.5 yuan per kilogram, an increase of 34% from yesterday's 34.5 yuan, while the transaction volume dropped from 143 metric tons to 63 metric tons, a decrease of 56%. The Agriculture Bureau said that mainly due to the impact of typhoons and rainfall in producing areas, harvesting and transportation were blocked, and the arrival volume in the market was reduced, which led to a short-term rise in prices. It will continue to monitor the supply and price of vegetables and adjust supply and demand on a rolling basis.

However, medical staff still had to go out to work and even perform surgeries to save lives in order to take care of people's health. summary_en: Typhoon Bawei is far away and air transport is gradually recovering. In order to speed up the transportation of passengers, the Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transport coordinated with airlines. Routes to outlying islands such as Kinmen and Penghu have all overtime flights or enlarged aircraft types. International and regional routes have also enlarged aircraft types to transport passengers. title_en: 90% of workers are not aware of the explosion of semiconductors and AI, and only 10% of workers are employed in the information electronics industry
summary_en: Strong global demand for AI has driven huge profit growth in China's information electronics industry, pushing China's economic growth rate this year to more than 10%, but most workers are indifferent. According to statistics from the Ministry of Economic Affairs, there are approximately 850,000 employees in the information electronics industry. One out of every three to four employees in the manufacturing industry is engaged in the information electronics industry. However, if there are 8.567 million employees in the country, less than one out of every ten workers is engaged in the information electronics industry. Therefore, the economic fruits of the explosion of semiconductors and AI in recent years have not been felt by 90% of workers.

title_en: "One sentence" caused the account to be listed as a warning!  Police urge acquaintances not to agree to borrow accounts
summary_en: "One sentence" caused the account to be listed as a warning! The police warns acquaintances not to agree to borrow accounts. A tutor in Taichung City lent his post office account to his landlord to collect "payments for online sales" because he trusted his landlord. Unexpectedly, the account was used by a fraud group. Not only was it listed as a warning account, but he may also face subsequent legal liability. The Second Branch of the Taichung City Police Department reminds that in recent years, fraud groups have often used acquaintances such as relatives, friends, landlords, tenants, or colleagues to obtain financial accounts. People should not lend their bankbooks, ATM cards, or accounts out of temporary trust to avoid becoming criminal tools of fraud groups. The Wenzheng Police Station of the Second Branch of the Central City Police received a notification from the Wuquan Branch of Chunghwa Post at around 3 pm a few days ago. A man named Ke went to inquire because his account could not be used. Postal staff confirmed that the account had been listed as a warning account, and immediately notified the police to come to the scene to assist.

summary: 台玻（1802）6月營收月增7.3%、年增27%，上半年累計營收年增11.6%下，法人機構表示，正向看待台玻今、明年營運後市。分析師指出，台玻6月營收優於預期，主因受惠高階玻纖布如Low Dk1、Low Dk2等出貨提升，以當前玻纖布營收比重約40~45%，且高階玻纖布約占其中40%推算，預估6月高階玻纖布營收貢獻約6.7~7.6億元，月增7~8%。此外，第2季營收季增17.6%、年增16.7%，也是受到高階玻纖布出貨動能佳帶動。

title_en: Taiwan Glass’ revenue in June increased both monthly and year-on-year. Legal person: Positive outlook on operations this year and next year
summary_en: Taiwan Glass (1802)'s revenue in June increased by 7.3% month-on-month and 27% year-on-year. With the cumulative revenue in the first half of the year increasing by 11.6% year-on-year, the legal person stated that it is positive about Taiwan Glass's operating prospects this and next year. Analysts pointed out that Taiwan Glass' revenue in June was better than expected, mainly due to the increase in shipments of high-end fiberglass cloth such as Low Dk1 and Low Dk2. Based on the current revenue share of fiberglass cloth of about 40-45%, and high-end fiberglass cloth accounting for about 40% of it, it is estimated that the revenue of high-end fiberglass cloth in June will contribute about 670-760 million yuan, a monthly increase of 7-8%. In addition, revenue in the second quarter increased by 17.6% quarterly and 16.7% annually, which was also driven by the strong shipment momentum of high-end fiberglass cloth.

summary_en: The warning for Typhoon Bawei was lifted on the 12th, and my mother-in-law is worried that vegetable prices will become more expensive in the coming week. The Agricultural and Food Administration of the Ministry of Agriculture stated that the typhoon mainly affected the northern and northeastern regions such as Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu and Yilan, and only affected the harvest progress and transportation of some high-cold vegetables. The impact of intermittent rainfall in major vegetable producing areas such as central and southern China has been slight. Harvesting and supply have gradually resumed in the producing areas, and vegetable volume and prices have gradually stabilized. The Agricultural and Food Administration will continue to monitor market transactions and increase allocation and supply to meet people's livelihood needs.

summary_en: After the Zoomlion oil incident, the Ministry of Health and Welfare required that each batch of oil samples retained by Zoomlion be sent to a third-party certified laboratory for re-testing, but the test results have not been announced. Minister of Health and Welfare Shi Chongliang confirmed today that the test results were released on July 8 and 9, and the Ministry of Health and Welfare also received the report, but it was indeed not announced to the public. The reason is that there have been two inconsistencies in the inspection reports between Zoomlion Oil and Fat and downstream operators. It can be seen that the samples retained by Zoomlion Oil and Fat are "untrustworthy". The Ministry of Health and Welfare does not plan to release the relevant inspection report to the outside world, but will hand it over to the inspection team to clarify and identify the reasons.

title_en: Beirong ranks first in pancreas transplant cases and 5-year survival rate. Revitalization of specialized heart transplantation calls for increased organ donation.
summary_en: According to statistics from the National Health Insurance Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the organ transplant results of various hospitals from 100 to 113 years of the Republic of China, the cumulative number of pancreas transplant cases in Taipei Rongzong reached 109, and the patient's 5-year survival rate after transplantation reached 83%, ranking first in the country in both indicators. In addition, Zhenxing Hospital has been developing heart transplants for many years and has become an important medical center for heart transplants in the country. Over the past 14 years, the cumulative number of heart transplant cases has reached 219, and the five-year patient survival rate has reached 78%, ranking among the best.

title_en: Reminder to move the car! In Bei City, except for the red and yellow lines around Datong Wanhua Water Gate, parking will be resumed before 17:00.
summary_en: Typhoon Bawei is gradually moving away. Taipei Mayor Chiang Wanan presided over a post-disaster recovery meeting this morning, reminding vehicles parked on the red and yellow lines of roads in Taipei City's jurisdiction and other legally prohibited areas to drive away before 17:00. Those who violate the regulations will be towed and relocated and fined in accordance with the Road Traffic Management Penalty Regulations. At the same time, parking fees will resume.

title_en: Video/Fake preparations for Typhoon Bawei stir up controversy. Jiang Wanan: Putting the safety of citizens as the top priority
summary_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wanan hosted the sixth work briefing on Typhoon Bawei this morning. When asked about the controversy surrounding the typhoon preparation period, Chiang Wanan said that this time included the advance predictions of the meteorological team or the Central Meteorological Administration. Typhoon Bawei's invasion of the northern region may have a very serious impact. Therefore, based on the foreboding, the city government prioritizes the safety of citizens and hopes to make various typhoon prevention preparations in advance to cope with the largest typhoon in the storm circle in 25 years.

summary_en: Typhoon Bawei is gradually moving away. Beijing Mayor Jiang Wanan chaired a typhoon prevention meeting this morning and is still paying close attention to the post-disaster recovery of various bureaus. According to statistics, as of 7 a.m., there have been 584 disasters in Beishi City, with the largest number of collapsed road trees. summary_en: The poisonous oil carcinogen incident has spread. The 29 batches of oil products produced by Zoomlion before the suspension of production from April to June have completed third-party inspections. However, Minister of Health and Welfare Shi Chongliang said today that the report will not be made public. The main reason is that the inspection results are inconsistent with those of downstream manufacturers. There may be problems with the "sample sampling process" or "sample fraud", which we cannot clarify.

title_en: There will be more moisture in Taiwan in the coming week. Meteorological Administration: Irregular rain in the south and southeast, afternoon thundershowers in other areas
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi is far away from Taiwan, but there is still a lot of moisture. Zhang Chengchuan, a forecaster from the Central Meteorological Administration, pointed out in the morning that the Pacific high pressure has not completely extended to the vicinity of Taiwan in the coming week, and there will be more moisture. Affected by southwest to southerly winds, there will still be sporadic rainfall in the south and southeast. In other areas, afternoon thundershowers will be the main force, and there will still be heavy rain in some areas in the western half of the afternoon.

summary_en: Jiyashe (2937), a distributor of high-quality home appliances, announced that its consolidated revenue in June was NT$462 million, an annual increase of 20.64%; its cumulative consolidated revenue in the first half of 2026 was NT$2.624 billion, an annual increase of 11.63%. Jiyashe stated that revenue in June was mainly driven by commercial engineering cases. In addition to the stable sales of existing department store boutique home appliances and large home appliances, the recent increase in demand for commercial office, factory office and corporate space upgrades has driven the recognition of integrated orders for commercial air conditioners, commercial display equipment and audio-visual engineering, becoming an important driving force for increasing single-month revenue. Jiyashe said that its subsidiary Jisheng Electric has been deeply involved in the field of commercial engineering for a long time, and has the ability to integrate cross-brand equipment and project execution. It has recently completed an enterprise-factory integration project. The service scope covers commercial air-conditioning systems, commercial splicing video walls and projection equipment. title_en: Peli’s cumulative revenue in the first half of the year reached a new high for the same period
summary_en: Beili Information (6874) announced that its self-financed revenue in June was 145 million yuan. Thanks to the company's continued promotion of the steady growth of digital governance and other needs, as well as increased customer demand, the cumulative revenue in the first half of the year reached 1.347 billion yuan, an increase of 51.17% over the same period last year, a record high for the same period last year. Beili said that the company has actively promoted the ACE (AI, Cybersecurity, ESG) development strategy this year to gradually show results, and will subsequently promote steady growth in overall operations. Looking forward to the second half of the year, as Taiwan's listed companies will gradually adopt the IFRS sustainable disclosure standards (IFRSS1/S2) this year, the demand for sustainable financial information disclosure and management is expected to continue to increase. Peli is expected to launch a new sustainable financial disclosure information management solution - S Butler, which uses AI technology to help companies build data collection, integration, management and disclosure processes that meet the requirements of IFRS sustainable disclosure standards, connect financial and sustainable information, and help customers improve disclosure quality and management efficiency. summary_en: Chenhui (1271) announced that its consolidated revenue in June was NT$336 million, an annual increase of 356.81%. summary_en: Xibin Hospitality Group (7883) announced its consolidated revenue in June. The consolidated net revenue in a single month reached NT$1.112 billion, an increase of 25.41% over the same period last year; the cumulative consolidated net revenue from January to June this year Reaching NT$6.942 billion, an annual increase of 25.42%, of which consolidated revenue in the second quarter increased by 24.74% annually. Cumulative revenue in a single month, the second quarter and the first half of the year all hit record highs, and the operating performance was steady and upward. title_en: The unemployment rate decline is an illusion! Millions of people quit the workplace, experts reveal invisible black hole in U.S. economy
summary_en: The U.S. job market continues to experience labor losses. According to statistics from the U.S. Department of Labor, more than 1 million people have withdrawn from the labor market in the past year, and 720,000 people left the labor force in June alone, bringing the labor participation rate to 61.5%. Not only is it the lowest since March 2021, but if the COVID-19 epidemic period is excluded, it has reached a new low in nearly 50 years since 1976. Many economists pointed out that the continued shrinkage of the labor force may weaken the momentum of U.S. economic growth. Even if the unemployment rate drops to 4.2%, it may not mean a real improvement in the job market.

title: 土地交易留意8月31日基準日！高虹安市長提醒：地價稅納稅義務人依登記日認定

title: 兆豐 ETF 00911除息 7月15日前買進可參與收益分配
summary: 全球半導體產業迎來歷史性多頭盛宴！受惠於全球晶片景氣強勁回升，加上生成式AI技術正式從「創新想像」邁向「產業落地」，AI優質營運直接反映在美股表現上。兆豐洲際半導體（00911）所追蹤的「洲際半導體指數（NYSE Semiconductor Index）」，今年以來累計已逾一倍，績效不僅大幅領先大盤、更超越費城半導體指數，彰顯出頂尖晶片霸主的長線爆發力。兆豐洲際半導體ETF（00911）除息交易日定於7月16日，想要參與這次除息行情的投資人，最後買進日為7月15日。

title: 日銀升息不是利空 看懂三大訊號把握投資機會
summary: 日本央行6月中宣布升息一碼，將政策利率由0.75%調升至1.0%，創下1995年以來新高，正式告別長達數十年的超寬鬆貨幣政策。對此，「鉅亨買基金」表示，市場不應只聚焦升息，更重要的是升息背後代表日本經濟正逐步走出失落30年，未來影響日本基金表現的關鍵，將回歸經濟基本面。投資人可持續觀察薪資、消費及日圓三大訊號，並依不同經濟情境靈活調整日本基金布局策略。

title: 台灣美食展7月31日登場 預售票7月9日開賣
summary: 台灣美食展將於7月31日至8月3日在台北世貿一館登場！今年以「風土醞釀」為題，探索台灣各地、各族群佳餚與物產，呈現人文與風土交織的台灣味。展覽網羅全台在地食材、世界冠軍與金牌美食、伴手禮，以及12家米其林、必比登推薦料理，邀請名廚及職人展演，更有多家知名蔬食品牌參展。9折預售票於7月9日正式啟售。

title: 越南迎 Doi Moi 2.0新時代 富邦投信：下一個亞洲之虎正崛起
summary: 全球供應鏈重組持續推進，新興市場再度成為國際資金關注焦點。在關鍵評論網（TNL Mediagene）舉辦的「錢進越南新浪潮 掌握新興市場投資密碼」論壇中，富邦越南ETF（00885）經理人陳仲愷表示，越南正站在新一輪經濟轉型的重要起點，不僅正式邁入「Doi Moi 2.0」發展階段，更同步迎來產業升級、重大基礎建設及資本市場國際化等多項利多，未來有望複製亞洲四小龍崛起經驗，成為全球最具潛力的新興市場之一。

title: 施羅德投信：布局全球股債與可轉債分散波動
summary: 美國科技股近日震盪加劇，再度提醒投資人評價過高與市場過度集中的風險。隨著市場波動升溫，台灣投資人資金配置也悄悄出現轉變。根據碁石智庫統計境外基金2026年以來截至5月底的資金流向，台灣資金淨流入多元資產基金的金額已達78.67億美元（約新台幣2,500億元），相對5月股票及債券資產同步面臨資金流出，逆勢吸金的多元資產基金突顯投資人對分散風險及穩定收益需求升溫。

title: 匯豐投信：迎接 AI 人型機器人的高光時刻
summary: 面對全球人口結構老化的趨勢，加上缺工潮席捲多種行業，市場對自動化勞動力的需求已達到前所未有的高峰。「沒人想做的工作,就交給機器人吧！」這句話已從科幻電影的台詞，正式走入現實,成為全球產業的現實解決之道。匯豐投信表示，這股由結構性需求驅動的龐大商機，正宣告人型機器人將成為未來十年的投資新顯學，投資人可伺機提早布局，掌握下一個科技成長主軸。

title: 中鋼攜手中碳公司 舉辦中鋼全能智慧王育樂營

title: 新市場體制逐步成形 瑞銀資產管理：新興市場債券重返資產配置焦點
summary: 全球金融市場正邁入新的市場體制，投資人也面臨重新檢視資產配置策略的重要時刻。過去十多年來，由超低利率、低波動環境以及美國股市強勁表現所主導的投資格局，正逐步被新的市場環境所取代。瑞銀資產管理表示，當前市場面臨股市估值差異擴大、全球利率走勢分化、景氣循環更難預測，以及人工智慧等創新科技快速發展等變化，促使投資人重新思考投資組合中的風險與回報來源。在此背景下，新興市場債券憑藉具吸引力的收益水準、穩健的基本面以及分散投資效益，再度成為全球資產配置的重要焦點。

title: AI熱潮吸金加速OG退場 Dragonfly高層揭加密韌性與增長潛力
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜責任編輯／綜合外電報導近期，隨著人工智慧（AI）技術席捲全球並大量吸納資金，加密貨幣產業面臨前所未有的挑戰與機遇。Dragonfly Capital 合夥人 Haseeb Qureshi 在一次採訪中指出，加密貨幣市場正經歷早期參與者（OG）的退場潮，例如 Multicoin Capital 共同創辦人 Kyle Samani 的離職，便是一個顯著的例子。 Haseeb Qureshi 觀察到，在 AI 熱潮下，許多早期加密貨幣參與者正選擇離開，但他認為這僅是產業發展中的自然現象，如同過去「拓荒者」與「建設者」在歷史進程中扮演不同角色。他將這種現況比喻為加密貨幣市場從「蠻荒西部」過渡到「建設與擴張」的階段。儘管他感受到當前市場情緒比 FTX 破產事件後更為低迷，但他強調投資人應避免「現況偏誤」（status quo bias），亦即過於相信現有狀態會永遠持續下去，而忽略了市場變革的巨大潛力。 他認為，加密貨幣產業可從科技巨頭雲集的矽谷學習其成功模式，包括鼓勵創新、擁抱失敗、高度信任的環境，以及高效的資訊傳遞。在矽谷，人才流動自由且非競爭協議難以執行，促使知識加速流動。

title_en: The new system of labor retirement system will be reformed in January/August. Take a look at the 5 major changes: you can regret the monthly payment, but you can’t stop it if you withdraw it yourself.
summary_en: Starting from August, the labor pension system will undergo important adjustments in recent years. The "Detailed Implementation Rules of the Labor Pension Ordinance" have officially come into effect after being revised. Not only do they clearly stipulate that employers are not allowed to refuse workers' applications for voluntary pension contributions, but they also add the flexibility to re-elect monthly pensions every 30 days, and also strengthen the rights of survivors and the protection of pension claims. The Ministry of Labor stated that the new system is mainly in response to practical needs, making the retirement system more consistent with labor rights and providing more choices for retirement planning.

title: 勞退新制變革2／勞退≠勞保！月退休金不是領到老　30天猶豫期一次看懂
summary: 很多人以為勞退月領就像勞保年金，可以穩穩領一輩子；實際上，勞退新制是個人專戶制，月退休金是用帳戶本金與收益，依年金生命表、平均餘命及利率計算發放。這次新增30天猶豫期，正是補救「選錯領法」的最後窗口。只是這扇門是單向的，月領可改一次領，一次領卻不能再改回月領。
title_zh: 勞退新制變革2／勞退≠勞保！月退休金不是領到老　30天猶豫期一次看懂

title_en: Reform of the New Retirement System 2/Retirement ≠ Labor Insurance! The monthly pension is not the old age. The 30-day hesitation period can be understood once and for all.
summary_en: Many people think that the monthly pension after labor is like the labor insurance annuity, which can be received steadily for a lifetime; in fact, the new labor retirement system is an individual account system, and the monthly pension is calculated and paid based on the account principal and income, based on the annuity life table, average remaining life and interest rate. The new 30-day hesitation period this time is the last window to remedy the "wrong choice of claim method". It's just that this door is one-way. The moon collar can be changed once, but it can't be changed back to the moon collar again.

title: 勞退新制變革3／勞退月領、一次領怎麼選？　精算師試算：月領更省稅
summary: 勞退新制的退休金要一次拿到手、還是月領，沒有標準答案。一次領的優點是資金自主，月領的優點則是現金流穩定。除了資金運用的自由度外，勞工還需考慮稅負相關問題，若退休金金額龐大，一次領可能需要多繳稅；改為月領，有機會節稅。

title_en: Reform of the New Retirement System 3/How to Choose Between Monthly Retirement and One-time Retirement? Actuary's trial calculation: monthly payment saves tax
summary_en: There is no standard answer to whether the pension under the new labor-retirement system should be received in one lump sum or monthly. The advantage of one-time payment is financial independence, while the advantage of monthly payment is stable cash flow. In addition to the freedom to use funds, workers also need to consider issues related to tax burden. If the amount of pension is large, you may need to pay more tax in one lump sum; if you change to monthly payment, there is an opportunity to save taxes.

title_en: Taiwan’s old store/heirloom strength Meilin Fruit Store
summary_en: Meilin Fruit Store has been standing for half a century. The store’s signboard, wooden cabinets, and walls are all made of precious red cypress, which also implies that the fruit is of extraordinary value. The first generation Yuan Jingyue was forced by her husband's gambling debt to move north from Chiayi with her daughter to set up a stall. Later, he made a name for himself by selling a Japanese apple for a sky-high price of 250 yuan. The old shop has been passed down to the third generation and is now run by Yuan Mingda. Responsible for picking fruits from the market, her sister Yuan Jun and her sister Yuan Ziting jointly take care of everything in the store - from having no place to stay to establishing themselves in a golden store in Taipei's Boai District, Mei Lin wrote the most Taiwanese footnote for "hardship comes after hardship".

title_en: As Bawei hit Hsinchu, more than 10,000 households were without power today. Taipower went all out to make repairs, leaving 2,629 households in the mountainous area waiting to be restored at night.
summary_en: Under the attack of Typhoon Bavi, according to statistics from Taipower's Hsinchu District Office, the cumulative number of households without power in Hsinchu County and City has reached 12,933. The power outages are mainly concentrated in Baoshan, Zhudong, Hukou, Xinfeng, Xinpu, Xionglin, Guanxi, Jianshi, Wufeng Mountain and other areas. The reasons are mostly due to strong winds blowing down power lines and tree collapses causing poles to break. As of 10 o'clock tonight, only 2,629 households were without power, and the power restoration rate was nearly 80%. Emergency repairs in Jianshi, Wufeng and other areas were interrupted due to road collapse, which affected the progress of emergency repairs. Taipower stated tomorrow evening that it would continue to cooperate with the road opening tomorrow and send personnel to make full efforts to repair and restore power as soon as possible. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the power outage.

title_en: Bawei weakens, land and sea warnings will be lifted at the earliest in the early morning. Meteorological Administration: Beware of annual astronomical tides from the 13th
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi moved rapidly to the northwest, and its center position was 250 kilometers north-northeast of Matsu at 11 o'clock in the evening. Over the past period of time, the intensity of Bawei has continued to weaken, and the maximum wind speed near the center is only 35 meters per second, which has reached the lower limit of central and Taiwan. The radius of Category 7 storms has been further reduced to 300 kilometers, while the radius of Category 10 storms has remained at 100 kilometers. title_en: CITIC Chen Baizhou High Volatility Pattern

title: 永豐黃柏棠 盯 AI 供應鏈
summary: 全球算力競賽進入硬體落地期，各大科技巨頭競逐高效能運算與先進製程的有限產能，排擠成熟製程與非算力應用，帶動晶片價格全面走揚，市場稱之為「晶片通膨（Chipflation）」。永豐投顧黃柏棠總經理指出，本輪漲價與過去終端拉貨型的缺貨循環截然不同，而是由「產能策略性限制」、「成本轉嫁不可逆」與「產品規格大升級」三力共振支撐的結構性改變，抗震韌性更高。

title_en: Yongfeng Huang Baitang focuses on AI supply chain
summary_en: The global competition for computing power has entered the hardware implementation stage. Major technology giants are competing for the limited production capacity of high-performance computing and advanced processes, squeezing out mature processes and non-computing applications, driving chip prices to rise across the board. The market calls this "chipflation." Huang Baitang, general manager of Yongfeng Investment Consultants, pointed out that this round of price increases is completely different from the past shortage cycle of terminal pull-in products. Instead, it is a structural change supported by the resonance of the three forces of "strategic restrictions on production capacity", "irreversible cost transfer" and "major upgrade of product specifications", and has higher seismic resilience.

summary_en: Wedding expenses are rising every year. From wedding photography, wedding venue to wedding rings, plus honeymoon travel, the total budget often approaches one million yuan. Wu Yiye, an international certified financial planner (CFP) and CEO of Deye Financial Consultants, suggests that if prospective couples have already agreed to get married, it is best to start planning 2 to 3 years in advance. Through fixed allocation of income, proper management of funds and steady investment, they can gradually achieve their goals without excessively sacrificing the quality of life.

title_en: 【囍事 abacus 2】Is getting married a luxury? Weddings cost an average of 600,000 yuan this year. Experts reveal the biggest change
summary_en: Inflation is sweeping the world, and people's living expenses have been rising under the influence. The cost of holding a wedding has generally increased by about 20% to 30% in recent years. According to a survey by Taiwan's leading wedding platform WeddingDay, the average budget for a wedding this year is about 560,000 to 600,000 yuan (excluding honeymoon), which is about the same as last year. Experts revealed that in the past, wedding banquet expenses may account for 60 to 70% of the overall budget. Nowadays, couples are more willing to invest money in items related to the feelings and commemorative value of the two people, such as wedding dresses, wedding rings, honeymoons, and wedding cakes.

title: 勞退新制變革1／8月新制上路　5大改變一次看：月領可反悔、自提不得擋
summary: 8月起勞工退休金制度將迎來近年重要調整。《勞工退休金條例施行細則》修正後正式上路，不僅明定雇主不得拒絕勞工申請自願提繳退休金，新增月退休金30天改選一次領的彈性，也強化遺屬請領權益與退休金債權保障。勞動部表示，新制主要是因應實務需求，讓退休制度更符合勞工權益，也讓退休規劃擁有更多選擇。

title: 勞退新制變革2／勞退≠勞保！月退休金不是領到老　30天猶豫期一次看懂
summary: 很多人以為勞退月領就像勞保年金，可以穩穩領一輩子；實際上，勞退新制是個人專戶制，月退休金是用帳戶本金與收益，依年金生命表、平均餘命及利率計算發放。這次新增30天猶豫期，正是補救「選錯領法」的最後窗口。只是這扇門是單向的，月領可改一次領，一次領卻不能再改回月領。

title: 勞退新制變革3／勞退月領、一次領怎麼選？　精算師試算：月領更省稅
summary: 勞退新制的退休金要一次拿到手、還是月領，沒有標準答案。一次領的優點是資金自主，月領的優點則是現金流穩定。除了資金運用的自由度外，勞工還需考慮稅負相關問題，若退休金金額龐大，一次領可能需要多繳稅；改為月領，有機會節稅。

title_en: Financial Focus/Exclusive Interview! Terry Gou’s niece has been successful in the international film industry for 10 years. Guo Xiaoqing: Connecting resources from Taiwan and the United States to let the world see Taiwan
summary_en: The American movie "The Banquet" released in Taiwan last year attracted much attention. In addition to paying tribute to the masterpiece of great director Ang Lee 32 years ago, the Chinese female producer behind the scenes has a great background. She is Anita Gou, the eldest daughter of Terry Gou, the brother of Hon Hai Group founder Terry Gou. In late May, she returned to Taiwan to co-produce the new film "Dream" co-produced by Taiwan and the United States. She accepted an exclusive interview with this magazine and talked about how she has fulfilled her film dream in the 10 years since she started her business. Being accustomed to Chinese and Western cultures since she was a child, she hopes to connect Taiwan and the United States' film and television resources to let the world see Taiwan.

title_en: Taiwan’s old store/heirloom strength Meilin Fruit Store
summary_en: Meilin Fruit Store has been standing for half a century. The store's signboard, wooden cabinets, and walls are all decorated with precious red cypress, which also implies that the fruit is of extraordinary value. The first generation Yuan Jingyue was forced by her husband's gambling debt to move north from Chiayi with her daughter to set up a stall. Later, he made a name for himself by selling a Japanese apple for a sky-high price of 250 yuan. The old shop has been passed down to the third generation and is now run by Yuan Mingda. Responsible for picking fruits from the market, her sister Yuan Jun and her sister Yuan Ziting jointly take care of everything in the store - from having no place to stay to establishing themselves in a golden store in Taipei's Boai District, Mei Lin wrote the most Taiwanese footnote for "hardship comes after hardship".

title_en: There were 756 flights and 155,000 passengers from Bahrain to Taojiming.
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi is gradually moving away from Taiwan, and all airlines will operate flights normally tomorrow (12th). The airport company will invite airlines, ground handling companies and other relevant units to hold the 8th contingency meeting at 6:30 pm today (11th). Based on the forecast number of flights and passenger volume statistics after the typhoon, the number of passenger and cargo flights at Taoyuan Airport tomorrow is expected to be 756 (672 passenger aircraft and 84 cargo aircraft), and the passenger volume is estimated to reach 155,000. The airport company is in close contact with airlines, ground handling companies and CIQS units to prepare service manpower capacity for passenger check-in, security inspection, license inspection, animal and plant quarantine, fever screening and customs.

summary_en: People are crazy about Taiwanese stocks, and many investors are using all their leverage. They are afraid that they will not keep up with the rising trend of Taiwanese stocks due to their FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) mentality, which has gradually led to the emergence of the situation of "four loans under one roof" and "six loans under one roof". However, this is probably just the tip of the iceberg. What the financial industry is most worried about is that the three financial industries do not know each other's borrowing status of the same lender in the three major industries of banking, securities, and insurance. summary_en: The food safety crisis involving Zoomlion's carcinogenic oil has expanded. Three of the 29 batches of soybean oil produced by Zoomlion Oils and Fats from April to June were found to exceed the legal limit for benzene and pyrene. title_en: The procurement of MK-48 torpedoes has failed to produce a single bomb in 9 years. The Navy: The torpedo production capacity is unstable and will not be delivered until next year.
summary_en: The Naval Command began to prepare a budget in 2018 to purchase a new submarine-launched long-range heavy-duty wire torpedo for the Stegosaurus-class submarines. It is believed to be the MK-48 Mod 6 AT heavy-duty torpedo, including 24 war mines and 4 control mines. The total cost is 5.460586 million yuan. So far, no bomb has been obtained in 9 years, and the delivery schedule has been repeatedly delayed. Legislators recently questioned the unclear results of the purchase and proposed freezing the 80 million yuan budget for the case. The Navy Command explained that the United States has postponed torpedo delivery to 2027 to 2028 due to unstable production capacity due to torpedo supply chain issues.

title_en: 5.94 million workers do not earn the average salary. Educational support and other education are the lowest at 27K
summary_en: The average salary has been hitting new highs, but fewer and fewer people are actually on the average. Last year, about 5.94 million employees had lower-than-average wages, with an annual increase of about 370,000 in the past five years. During the same period, the average monthly salary of employees across Taiwan increased by less than NT$5,000 in the past five years. There may be a growing gap between the growth of average wages and the actual feelings of most salaried workers.

summary_en: The Legislative Yuan Transportation Committee will review the Telecommunications Management Law on Monday to relax standards for foreign low-orbit satellite companies to land in Taiwan. Huang Jianhao, convener of the Transportation Committee and KMT legislator, said that Taiwan is at the core of geopolitics and a belt area with frequent earthquakes, and submarine cables are at risk of being cut off or damaged at any time. This amendment to the law will "untie" Taiwan's digital defense and disaster preparedness, allowing key international technology services to be launched in Taiwan legally and compliantly.

title_en: Four loans under one roof are rampant, the Financial Supervisory Commission is concerned about banks with "too much credit growth"
summary_en: The situation of "four loans under one roof" is becoming more and more common. The Financial Supervisory Commission has clearly drawn two supervisory red lines in late June. Once it is found that a bank's credit and other business growth is abnormal and risk indicators such as over-lending have worsened significantly, the Financial Supervisory Commission will conduct special financial inspections at any time. Before starting a special financial inspection, the Financial Supervisory Commission's inspection bureau will first conduct routine financial inspections of banks, paying special attention to the growth of individual banks' credit, mortgage and wealth management working capital, and stock guarantees, and pay attention to abnormal risk conditions.
