title_en: The number of young people who failed to pay tens of thousands of yuan and defaulted on delivery increased sharply.
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market has been experiencing severe fluctuations recently, and cases of defaulted delivery have increased sharply. Brokerage executives said that in addition to the large billion-dollar cases seen in the market, the more obvious change on the front line is the increase in small-amount cases with only tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of dollars that are unable to fulfill delivery. Many of them are young traders who entered the market after the stock market rose sharply in the past two years and are accustomed to making small bets. They enter and exit every day when the market is going well. If they fail, they may not even be able to get out the delivery payment, which is not too high.

title_en: Benefiting from the shortage of high-end CCL AI servers and price increases, its revenue in June increased by 107% year-on-year and hit a record high. This year’s EPS is expected to be 33 yuan. Has the price-to-earnings ratio reached a high point?
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market has reversed and declined from the high point of 48218. I estimate that it will have to build two legs. The first leg fell to 44454 on June 26, which is consistent with the expected 44704~44300. From then on, it rebounded to 47395 as the first wave of rebound. After that, it will complete the two legs when it returns to 44704~44300. From the two legs of building two legs, low price-to-earnings ratios such as (A) Taiyao, Lianmao, Jiabiqi, Teng Fai, Liangwei, Zhibang, Delta, Jianding, Qihong, Lite-On, BusinessLink, Qincheng, Quanta, MiTAC, Gigabyte, SiG, Xinquan, Chaofeng, Realtek, Novatek, Elan, Avalue, Axiomtek, Sibon, Ni Kesen, Heshentang, Lidun, Xingqin, Dongjian, Qiqi, Vantech, Hulian, CommScope, Meqima, UMC, Xingqin, Lilong, Dazhong, Nexen, Yubang... will fluctuate and rise between trends. However, the weakness in the Japanese and Korean stock markets this time is due to DRAM manufacturers Samsung, Hynix, Kioxia, IBIDEN, and Taiyo Yuden rising too much for correction, which has also affected Taiwan's DRAM and some passive components. In addition, this wave in the United States and Taiwan also corrected stocks with ultra-high price-to-earnings ratios, which mainly corrected silicon photonics, heavy electronics, overvalued robots, fiberglass cloth, ABF, speculative stocks..., so this wave is a correction of artificially over-hyped stocks and DRAM with messy chips, which fell to 44704~44300. There will also be a preliminary rebound, but it is not ruled out that it will be corrected to 42006 before a more decent rise. But (A) note that if it pulls back to test 44704~44300, it will go on its own upward path. There are even some stocks with ultra-low price-to-earnings ratios that will rise at 45300~44900.

summary_en: In the first quarter of 2026, Taiwan Sembcorp was affected by weak demand for mature processes and depreciation pressure on new plants, and its single-quarter operations temporarily fell into a loss. summary_en: Typhoon Bavi hit Typhoon, and the typhoon and peripheral circulation affected power equipment. As of 8 pm on the 11th, more than 240,000 households across the country had experienced power outages. After more than 16,000 Taiwan Electric Power Crew personnel made emergency repairs, power has been restored to more than 230,000 households, with the power restoration rate exceeding 95%. Taipower stated that the current main power outage areas are concentrated in Taoyuan City, Hsinchu County, New Taipei City and other regions. Taipower will continue to send personnel to the disaster areas for emergency repairs while ensuring safety, with the goal of allowing most power outage users to have electricity.

title_en: [After Wanjiafu was renamed 2] Take a look at the 5 major opinions of new private brand netizens. Can you still buy French products? Wanjiafu responded
summary_en: After Carrefour changed its name to Macanjiafu, Uni-President Group's own brand UNIDESIGN took over simultaneously, and the first wave of 42 products was launched. However, the brand has just started, and there have been many discussions on social platforms. Some people think that "as long as the quality remains unchanged, they will continue to buy it." title_en: [After Wanjiafu’s name change 1] All 283 store signboards will be updated in the first quarter of next year, and 350 private brands will be launched one after another.
summary_en: Carrefour, which has been accompanying Taiwanese consumers for nearly 40 years, has officially changed its name to "Marcomcarfo". The market is concerned about the next step? Chen Yifang, director of Wanjiafu Public Affairs Department, said that all 62 mass merchandisers and 221 supermarkets in Taiwan, a total of 283 stores, are expected to completely change their signage in the first quarter of 2027! Among them, the private label products with high CP value have a large number of consumers, and they are also concerned about "when can they all be purchased?" In this regard, she said in an interview with "Yahoo Stock Market" that 350 of the private brand products have been renamed "UNIDESIGN" and the content remains unchanged. The remaining products will be put on the shelves when they are ready.

summary_en: The US military launched another air strike on Iran on the 9th in retaliation for an attack on a merchant ship in the Persian Gulf. title_en: Zhang Taxation Bureau: You can apply for tax deductions for typhoon damage
summary_en: With Typhoon Bawei approaching, the Changhua County Local Taxation Bureau yesterday (11th) called on the public to pay more attention to their own safety. If natural disasters cause property damage such as house damage, land loss, or vehicle damage, people can apply for reduction or exemption of relevant tax burdens in accordance with the law to protect their own rights and interests. The tax bureau explains that people can apply with photos of the disaster or other relevant supporting documents within 30 days from the date of the disaster. The reduction and exemption regulations are as follows: 1. House tax: Houses that have been damaged by major disasters accounting for more than 30% but less than 50% of the entire area will be levied at half the house tax; houses with more than 50% of the damaged area that must be repaired before they can be used are exempt from the house tax. 2. Use license tax: If a car or a motorcycle with a capacity of 151cc or above cannot be used due to a disaster, it should be reported to the supervisory authority for parking or scrap registration. According to the information notified by the supervisory authority, the license tax overpaid during the period when the vehicle cannot be used will be refunded. 3. title_en: Ba Wei attacks Taiwan! More than 150,000 households in Taiwan experienced power outages, and more than 16,000 Taiwanese electricians made emergency repairs.
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi hit land in the early morning of the 11th. Affected by the typhoon and peripheral circulation, wind and rain continued to intensify across Taiwan. As of 12:00 noon on the 11th, more than 150,000 households across the country had experienced power outages. Taipower has mobilized more than 16,000 people to make full efforts to repair the problem, and power has been restored to more than 110,000 households. Taipower stated that the main power outage areas are currently concentrated in Taoyuan City, Kaohsiung City, Taichung City and Yunlin County. On the premise of ensuring safety, Taipower has sent personnel to actively repair the power. In some areas with strong wind and rain, the repair progress will be adjusted on a rolling basis depending on the wind and rain conditions to restore power to the people as soon as possible.

According to Taipower’s latest statistics, as of 12 noon, the number of households in Taiwan that had experienced power outages reached 153,733, and power has been restored to 110,722 households. 37 households, with a power restoration rate of more than 76%, and 36,496 households have not yet had power restored, concentrated in Taoyuan, Kaohsiung and other places. Taipower has mobilized more than 16,000 people for emergency repairs and dispatched 14 work teams across districts to go northward for support.

title_en: Heavy rain in Bawei floods Shimen Reservoir, and spillway water is released again after 618 days
summary_en: Typhoon Bawei continues to pour water into the Shimen Reservoir. The Water Conservancy Department of the Ministry of Economic Affairs stated on the 11th that as of 10 a.m., the cumulative rainfall in the Shimen Reservoir catchment area had reached 209 millimeters, and the total inflow was approximately 19.92 million cubic meters. Due to continuous rainfall in the catchment area and the rapid increase in inflow, The North District Water Resources Branch has started releasing water from the spillway at 11 a.m. to control the rate of rise in water levels. This is also the first time that Shimen Reservoir has started releasing water from the spillway after Typhoon Kangrui on October 31, 2024.

title_en: Three heavy pressures gathered, and the New Taiwan dollar broke through 32 yuan. The TSMC law is the hope of the whole village.
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Pan Ziyu, Taipei, 11th) July has just begun, and the New Taiwan dollar has broken through the 32 yuan mark, and the depreciation has been sharp. In less than half a month, it has fallen by more than 3 cents. According to Huiyin analysts, the rising tensions in the Middle East, the correction of Taiwanese stocks, and the arrival of the peak season of dividend payments have put three pressures on the Taiwan dollar, making it difficult for the New Taiwan dollar to escape its downward trend in the short term. Next week, the focus will be on the TSMC legal meeting to see whether it can boost market confidence and drive the return of foreign investment.

title_en: Typhoon Bawei causes disaster! Nearly 45,000 households across Taiwan have had power outages yet to be restored. This county and city are the worst affected.
summary_en: Taipower is making every effort to repair power outages caused by Typhoon Bawei. According to Taipower statistics, as of 11 a.m. on the 11th, a total of 138,951 households across the country had experienced power outages, and 94,133 households had been restored to power. The power restoration rate exceeded 67%. Currently, 44,818 households still need to be repaired. Among them, Taoyuan City has the most power outages with 11,881 households, followed by Kaohsiung City, Taichung City and New Taipei City.

title_en: U.S. labor market shows resilience, inflation data becomes focus of market outlook
summary_en: The latest U.S. employment data showed the labor market remains resilient, but failed to provide further support for the dollar. According to the latest U.S. data, the number of people applying for unemployment benefits for the first time in the week as of July 4 dropped to 215,000, which was better than the revised 217,000 the previous week. The number of people applying for continuing unemployment benefits increased slightly by 8,000 to 1.81 million in the week of June 27, indicating that overall layoffs are still quite limited. Analysis by local banks pointed out that the above data are not enough to push up the dollar, and geopolitical risks and inflation data are the next focus.

title_en: The conflict in the Middle East has sent crude oil to US$80 again! Oil prices drop for three consecutive times, calling for stuck, 95 gasoline returns to prefix 2, wait a minute
summary_en: With the oil price falling for three consecutive times, car owners originally expected that 95 unleaded gasoline would fall back below 30 yuan per liter next week, but they did not expect that the situation in the Middle East would once again stage a vicious drama. The conflict between the United States and Iran escalated, the situation in the Strait of Hormuz became tense, and the international oil price fell from less than 70 US dollars per barrel to once exceeding 80 US dollars. PetroChina announced today (11th) that domestic gasoline and diesel prices will freeze and rise next week, with 92 unleaded gasoline remaining at 29.8 yuan per liter. As for when 95 unleaded gasoline will fall below 30 yuan, drivers may have to wait.

Domestic bank analysis pointed out that global stock markets have experienced revaluation this year due to the rise of the AI ​​boom, but there are obvious differences among markets. summary_en: The carcinogen "benzopyrene (BaP)" found in Zoomlion's soy salad oil exceeds the standard, raising concerns that the oil will be distributed across Taiwan and also affect fresh food in supermarkets. Uni-President Supermarket said today that it will cooperate with Lianhua Food to refund. If you purchase fresh food products with doubtful batch numbers from Lianhua Food at 7-ELEVEN from April 13 to 23, if you sign up as a uniopen member at checkout, Uni-President Supermarket will take the initiative to refund the money to the APP wallet starting from the 14th. Consumers who have not reported membership can go to the store for a refund if they provide invoices, etc. As for FamilyMart convenience stores, they are still working on a refund mechanism.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Jiang Mingyan, Taipei, 11th) In recent years, national airlines have aggressively expanded their U.S. flight networks, but they have not led to a simultaneous recovery in tourism to the United States. Some tourism industry insiders bluntly said that U.S. group tourists have dropped by 60% compared with before the epidemic. Taiwan’s tourism to the U.S. has shifted from the popular group passenger market in the past to mainly visiting relatives, business, and studying abroad. The demand for sightseeing groups has not yet recovered, and the doubled travel costs and limited group passenger flights have created obstacles.

title_en: Memory brother No. 1 earned 1 less than the daily limit during the typhoon holiday? Experts shout "Bawi will pay back the money": these three gears will take over to make up for the increase
summary_en: Affected by Typhoon "Bavi", the Taiwan stock market is facing a market shutdown. He called out "Bavi will pay back the money" and hoped that stocks after the typhoon could make up for the gains. He also pointed out that the legal person has called Nanya to reach a target price of 700 yuan. If it can break through the 500 yuan mark in the future, it will have a chance to reach the 700 yuan mark, and named three stocks that will take over to make up for the increase.

title_en: Typhoon Bavi still has 36,357 households whose power has not been restored, with Taoyuan and Chiayi the most
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zeng Yuting, Taipei, 11th) The storm circle of Typhoon Bavi is covering the northern half of Taichung, Nantou, and the eastern half of the land. According to Taipower statistics, as of 10 a.m. this morning, 104,896 households in Taiwan had experienced power outages, of which 68,539 households have been repaired and more than 65% have restored power. There are currently 36,357 households that have not had their power restored.

title_en: Lianhua Foods announces 7-ELEVEN refund method for fresh food with doubts. Refunds will be issued starting from July 14
summary_en: The incident of the carcinogen benzene pyrene (BaP) found in Zoomlion's soy salad oil exceeding the standard continues to spread. Because some rice balls, sandwiches and other fresh food products commissioned by 7-ELEVEN to be manufactured by Lianhua Food (1231) use relevant raw materials, they have been listed as products with doubtful batch numbers. In this regard, 7-ELEVEN stated that it has removed the relevant batch number products from the shelves as soon as possible; Lianhua Food has also announced refund methods. Qualified consumers can receive refunds as soon as July 14th.

title_en: To continue to prepare for Typhoon Bawei, major department stores such as Shin Kong Mitsukoshi and Far Eastern Department Store have released their operating arrangements for the 11th.
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi continued to affect Taiwan. Department stores and shopping malls across the country continued to adjust their operations on the 11th. Many shopping malls such as Shin Kong Mitsukoshi, Far Eastern, Mitsui and Global Mall announced that some of their locations would suspend operations. Most shopping malls in the northern and central parts of the country have suspended operations in compliance with the work and class suspension measures, while some southern and eastern locations have maintained normal operations or postponed store openings to take into account the safety of customers and employees.

title_en: Started business with two shelves, Canadian lighting manufacturer Matteo won the Golden Ship Award
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Cheng Aifen, Vancouver, 10th) Canadian lighting manufacturer Matteo Lighting won this year's National Chamber of Commerce's "Brand Gold Award". Founder Denny Yu, a Taiwanese entrepreneur, said that in the early days of the company's establishment, it was unable to pay employees' salaries. Fortunately, it took a year of hard work to lay the foundation and gained the trust of customers. He directly placed a large order, allowing his company to grow from just two shelves to become a benchmark enterprise with a 50,000-square-foot factory.

title: 颱風假少賺一根漲停？專家喊「巴威還錢來」記憶體一哥強攻帶動3檔接棒

title_en: Will you earn less than the daily limit during the typhoon holiday? Experts shouted "Bavi will pay back the money". The first memory brother stormed to drive the third gear to take over.
summary_en: The stock price of Nanya, a major memory manufacturer, was the first to hit the daily limit on Thursday (9th), closing at 435.5 yuan. Experts said that if the typhoon had not affected the transaction, Nanya would have had the opportunity to pull out the second daily limit, encouraged by the positive news. They joked that "Bawei will return the money to Nanya shareholders." At present, the local legal person has shouted out a target price of 700 yuan. If it can successfully break through the previous high of 505 yuan in the future, it is expected to challenge the 700 yuan mark.

title_en: Bawei attacks Taiwan! Almost all department stores in the northern part are closed, but Shin Kong Mitsukoshi, Far Mart, and Global Mall in the southern part are open as usual.
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi continued to bring strong winds and heavy rains. All 20 counties and cities in Taiwan suspended work and classes on the 11th, and the department store industry also significantly adjusted its operations. Among them, the northern department stores are almost completely closed, while Shin Kong Mitsukoshi, Far East Department Store and Global Mall have adopted the "stop in the north and open in the south" mode. Some central and southern locations will maintain normal operations or resume operations from noon, and will adjust on a rolling basis depending on wind and rain conditions.

title_en: 96-year-old grandfather left an inheritance of 200 million! The eldest grandson whom I love the most is "not worth a penny". The truth is revealed and the whole family remains silent.
summary_en: Many elders will arrange their property after death through a will, hoping to reduce family disputes. However, a 96-year-old Japanese man left an inheritance of about 200 million yen (approximately NT$40 million), but in his will, he excluded his most beloved grandson, who was also the elite in the family's eyes, from the inheritance list, which shocked his relatives and friends. However, when the last postscript of the will was exposed, everyone understood the intentions behind their grandfather.

summary_en: Moderate Typhoon Bavi hit Taiwan, causing strong winds and heavy rains, causing power outages in many places across Taiwan. According to Taipower statistics, as of 10 a.m. today (July 11), a total of 104,896 households across the country have experienced power outages, of which 68,539 households have completed repairs. title_en: Apply for local tax reduction or exemption within 30 days after the disaster in Bawei. Changhua announces the applicable conditions for four major taxes.
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi swept across Changhua with strong winds and rain, causing damage to houses and uprooting road trees. Most shops were forced to rest and were unable to do business. According to the forecast of the Central Meteorological Administration, today (11th) will be the most severe moment of wind and rain. Typhoon warnings for land and sea will be lifted from the early morning of tomorrow (12th) at the earliest. The Changhua County Local Taxation Bureau reminds people that if they face property losses, they must apply for local tax exemptions within 30 days from the date of the disaster.

summary: 地緣政治風險升高、極端氣候加劇、AI浪潮席捲全球，如何提升「韌性」成為各國共同課題，身處全球半導體與科技供應鏈核心的台灣，除須維持經濟競爭力，也須同步強化國防、能源、資通訊、資安與供應鏈等多面向韌性。上週二（7日）《鏡週刊》舉辦「2026韌性台灣高峰論壇」，邀集總統府祕書長潘孟安、經濟部長龔明鑫、數發部長林宜敬、中華電信董事長簡志誠、和碩董事長童子賢等產官領袖參與，從國家安全、數位資安、能源供給、無人機產業與全球供應鏈等面向，探討如何建立更長期、更穩固的國家、社會與產業韌性。

title_en: Industry Forum/Geopolitical Conflicts Heat Up 2026 Resilient Taiwan Summit Forum Industry and Government Leaders Discuss New Layout
summary_en: Geopolitical risks are rising, extreme weather is intensifying, and the AI ​​wave is sweeping the world. How to improve "resilience" has become a common topic for all countries. Taiwan, which is at the core of the global semiconductor and technology supply chain, must not only maintain economic competitiveness, but also simultaneously strengthen multi-faceted resilience such as national defense, energy, information communications, information security, and supply chains. Last Tuesday (7th), "Mirror Weekly" held the "2026 Resilient Taiwan Summit Forum", inviting Presidential Secretary-General Pan Meng'an, Economic Minister Gong Mingxin, Digital Development Minister Lin Yijing, Chunghwa Telecom Chairman Chien Chih-cheng, Pegatron Chairman Tong Zixian and other industry and government leaders to participate in the discussion from the aspects of national security, digital security, energy supply, drone industry and global supply chain, etc., to discuss how to build longer-term and more stable national, social and industrial resilience.

title_en: It’s not Huida who is the victim! DeepSeek is rumored to have made its own AI chip. Analyst: Other Chinese companies are in dire straits
summary_en: Recently, foreign media broke the news that DeepSeek, an emerging Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) company, plans to make its own AI chips. It is negotiating with foundries and recruiting designers, but there has been no official response. Analysts believe that if the news of DeepSeek's self-made AI chips is true, it will have a relatively small impact on NVIDIA, which has already lost its market share. Instead, other local Chinese chip manufacturers such as Huawei will face further market compression.

summary_en: The market has been in a state of rapid rotation of stocks recently. This week, we can see that funds are gradually transferring from the originally strong passive components and ABF carrier boards to power components and packaging and testing related stocks. Sealing and testing related stocks have been consolidating for a long time in June. With the return of funds, there is a good chance that they will be the key driver of the next wave of market conditions. As production capacity is tight and raw materials are increasing, the packaging and testing industry will also usher in a new price increase in the second half of the year, which may exceed 20%. The leading stock ASE (3711) hit a record high of 729 yuan in early July. Since the market rose at the end of April, it has more than doubled from about 350 yuan to the current level of about 700 yuan. Licheng (6239), which was named by AMD, also nearly doubled from its initial high of 387 yuan in June. Although it is now consolidating in the 350 yuan range, the overall increase is still considerable.

專業諮商心理師林萃芬在其著作《從肢體洞察人心》中指出，從心理學角度來看，「運氣」並非只是單純的機運，而是由心理因素與行為模式共同塑造出來。簡單來說，肢體語言不只影響別人對我們的印象，也可能改變我們的心理狀態，進而影響運氣好壞。

title_en: Are you struggling with your job search but don’t know why? Psychologist: The answer is written on your face
summary_en:
Why do some people have good academic qualifications, work seriously, and often help others, but promotions and opportunities always pass by them? Many people think that it is due to bad luck or simply not meeting a superior who appreciates them. However, the answer may not only lie in ability, but also in the way of speaking, eyes and expressions.

Professional counseling psychologist Lin Cuifen pointed out in her book "Insight into the Human Heart from the Body" that from a psychological perspective, "luck" is not just pure luck, but is shaped by psychological factors and behavioral patterns. Simply put, body language not only affects other people's impressions of us, but may also change our mental state, thereby affecting luck.

Lin Cuifen mentioned that a friend once asked her in a sad and angry tone why he was never promoted in a promotion even though her conditions were not bad. Based on long-term observations, she theorized there were two reasons. First, his way of speaking tends to be negative, and the content of his conversations always revolves around negative things. If he always narrates negative events when reporting things to his supervisor, over time, a negative impression will naturally be formed in the other person's mind, and it will be difficult to think of him first when there is a good opportunity. Second, his body language can easily trigger defensive psychology in others, especially if he looks at people too hard, which often makes people around him feel uncomfortable.

Among them, the most noteworthy is the first impression brought by facial expressions. A study published in the Journal of Personality and Social Psychology published by the American Psychological Association pointed out that people with "rich faces" are more likely to find jobs than people with "poor faces", and the difference lies in their facial expressions. title_en: Su Weiyuan: AI+ drone twin engines burst into flames, MiTAC’s June revenue hit a high, and it ate up non-red supplies
summary_en: Forum Center/Comprehensive Report AI servers and drones broke out at the same time. Senior analyst Su Weiyuan said in "Financial Sunday Party" that MiTAC's stock has long been reborn. MiTAC's June revenue of 15.6 billion yuan hit a record high, with a monthly increase of 1 4.99%, an annual increase of 80.93%, and the cumulative annual growth of 44.8% in the first six months ranks first among the group. Investment trusts have quietly built a large number of positions at the 10,000-lot level. At this stage, the stock price is still lower than the cost of investment trusts, which is a rare opportunity to "eat investment trusts". Su Weiyuan said that MiTAC, through its subsidiary Shenyun Technology, has deeply integrated the Huida MGX platform, AMD MI300 and Intel's three major AI server ecosystems, and has a full range of air-cooled, liquid-cooled and high-density water-cooled integrated solutions, which directly benefited from AMD's strong market price which surged 5.6% in a single day. Another subsidiary, Shenyao Technology, specializes in military drones. It has won more than 1.8 billion yuan in bids from the Ministry of Defense and the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and has officially cooperated with Lockheed Martin, the world's largest military factory, and Northrop, the leading radar manufacturer. The director of AIT visited in person in March this year, and the cooperation status of the non-red supply chain of Taiwan-US drones has been established. In terms of technical highlights, Su Weiyuan emphasized that the swarm drones independently developed by Shenyao have a decentralized control system. After a single drone is shot down, the entire formation can automatically reorganize to continue the mission. It can also achieve high-level swarm flight capabilities such as collision avoidance, alignment, divergence and convergence through AI algorithms, and has extremely high military application value. Comparing the price-to-earnings ratio of Leihu in the group to more than 300 times, China Optoelectronics's price-to-earnings ratio of 500 times, and Mitac's price-to-earnings ratio of only 16.93 times, the AI ​​server industry provides confidence, and the drone theme provides explosive power.

title: 陳建全：半導體大咖全是「銳澤」客戶 日本工程Q3入賬迎爆發期
summary: 論壇中心／綜合報導半導體建廠供應鏈話題持續發酵，資深分析師陳建全在《財經週日趴》分析聖暉集團三大關鍵股，其中負責二次配線與氣體供應的銳澤，客戶群涵蓋台積電、美光兩大半導體巨頭，並已在美國、日本布局設點，隨著下半年主系統營收挹注，股價可望挑戰歷史新高。陳建全以蓋房子比喻建廠三步驟：聖暉負責建廠、朋億負責設備、銳澤則負責二次配線與氣體供應，包含高純度二氧化碳、氦氣、氧氣等氣體。他指出，銳澤客戶群相當強大，主要為台積電與美光，而銳澤近期分別在美國、日本設立公司，正是因為台積電在兩地都有設廠計畫，美光則在美國設廠，布局邏輯十分明確。技術面上，陳建全表示銳澤股價目前仍處於箱型整理下緣，在手訂單已達20億元，下半年主工程即將認列。他建議，若在箱型整理下緣布局，搭配未來營收公布後的利多發酵，並突破整理區間上緣後續抱，配合台積電擴大資本支出的產業趨勢，後續漲幅值得期待。不過陳建全提醒，投資人仍應留意營收公告與技術面變化，審慎評估風險。

title_en: Chen Jianquan: Semiconductor giants are all customers of "Ruize". Japanese engineering Q3 revenue is expected to explode
summary_en: Forum Center/Comprehensive Report The topic of semiconductor factory construction supply chain continues to ferment. Senior analyst Chen Jianquan analyzed the three key stocks of Shenghui Group in "Financial Sunday Party". Among them, Ruize, which is responsible for secondary wiring and gas supply, has a customer base covering the two major semiconductor giants, TSMC and Micron, and has set up locations in the United States and Japan. With the main system revenue in the second half of the year, the stock price is expected to challenge a record high. Chen Jianquan compared building a house to the three steps of building a factory: Shenghui is responsible for building the factory, Pengyi is responsible for the equipment, and Ruize is responsible for secondary wiring and gas supply, including high-purity carbon dioxide, helium, oxygen and other gases. He pointed out that Ruize's customer base is quite strong, mainly TSMC and Micron, and Ruize has recently established companies in the United States and Japan respectively. This is precisely because TSMC has plans to build factories in both places, and Micron has set up factories in the United States. The layout logic is very clear. Technically, Chen Jianquan said that Ruize's stock price is still at the lower end of the box-shaped consolidation, orders on hand have reached 2 billion yuan, and the main project will be recognized in the second half of the year. He suggested that if the layout is at the lower edge of the box-shaped consolidation, combined with the bullish fermentation after the announcement of future revenue, and the follow-up embrace after breaking through the upper edge of the consolidation range, and in line with the industry trend of TSMC expanding capital expenditures, the subsequent growth is worth looking forward to. However, Chen Jianquan reminded that investors should still pay attention to revenue announcements and technical changes, and carefully assess risks.

title: 比大聲說話、講話太直接...更讓人想逃？心理師：4種無聲的肢體語言，正悄悄趕走你的人緣
summary:
我們常以為只有「大聲說話」或「講話太直接」才會讓人感到壓迫，卻忽略肢體語言雖然無聲，更可能傳遞出讓人「不舒服」、「想逃走」的訊息。相信很多人都有過這種經驗，跟某些人相處的時候，就會覺得特別緊張，想要立刻脫離對方的勢力範圍，逃得越遠越好。問題是，被逃離的那個人，往往毫不自覺。

專業諮商心理師林萃芬在其著作《從肢體洞察人心》中指出，有些人之所以人際關係緊繃，是因為他的行為舉止會讓別人產生「壓迫感」，大家看到他都不由自主地想要逃走，可是他自己卻毫不自覺。林萃芬從心理的角度拆解：哪些肢體語言會讓人感受到強大壓力，以及要如何調整眼神、表情、動作，讓人際關係更柔和舒服。現在，不妨自我覺察一下，有沒有下面這些「會讓別人產生壓迫感」的肢體動作？

title_en: Is it more likely that people will want to run away than speaking too loudly or speaking too directly? Psychologist: 4 silent body languages ​​that are quietly driving away your popularity
summary_en:
We often think that only "speaking loudly" or "speaking too directly" will make people feel oppressed, but we ignore that although body language is silent, it is more likely to send messages that make people "uncomfortable" and "want to run away". I believe many people have had this experience. When getting along with certain people, they will feel particularly nervous and want to immediately leave the other party's sphere of influence and escape as far away as possible. The problem is, the person being escaped is often unaware of it.

Professional counseling psychologist Lin Cuifen pointed out in her book "Insight into the Human Heart from the Body" that the reason why some people have tense interpersonal relationships is because their behavior will make others feel "oppressed". Everyone who sees him will involuntarily want to escape, but he himself is not aware of it. Lin Cuifen breaks down from a psychological perspective: Which body language will make people feel strong pressure, and how to adjust eyes, expressions, and movements to make interpersonal relationships softer and more comfortable. Now, you might as well be aware of yourself. Are there any of the following body movements that "make others feel oppressive"?

title_en: DRAM's counterattack among the four major stocks, with a price-to-earnings ratio of 18 times, is there a chance to make up for the increase? Will memory bulls rise again in July?
summary_en: The demand for AI servers and infrastructure continues to explode, driving the memory market to a severe shortage. Recently, it was reported that Samsung Electronics plans to increase the average selling price of DRAM by another 20% in the third quarter of this year. Among them, servers and mobile device memory, which are in tight supply, will increase by more than 20%. As quotations continue to rise, and with the successive announcements of June revenue, it is estimated that the performance of upstream, midstream and downstream memory companies will continue to explode, especially Nanya Technology (2408), a particle factory, and ADATA (3260), a module factory. They are two major indicators. Once the stock price rises, it will push up the bull trend of memory testing factory Licheng (6239) and Fumaoke (8131). These four stocks will play an important role in the memory bull resurgence in July.

title_en: Typhoon Bavi is so fierce that more than 170,000 households in Taiwan were without power
summary_en: Typhoon Bavi hit land in the early morning of the 11th. Affected by the typhoon and peripheral circulation, wind and rain continued to intensify across Taiwan. As of 14:00, more than 170,000 households across the country had experienced power outages. Taipower has mobilized more than 16,000 people to make emergency repairs, and power has been restored to more than 150,000 households. Taipower stated that the main power outage areas are currently concentrated in Taoyuan City, Kaohsiung City, Taichung City and Yunlin County. On the premise of ensuring safety, Taipower has sent personnel to actively repair the power. In some areas with strong wind and rain, the repair progress will be adjusted on a rolling basis depending on the wind and rain conditions to restore power to the people as soon as possible.

title_en: Typhoon caused damage, Zhang County Taxation Bureau: You can apply for tax relief
summary_en: With Typhoon Bawei approaching, the Changhua County Local Taxation Bureau today (November) called on the public to pay more attention to their own safety. If property damage such as house damage, land loss, or vehicle damage is caused by natural disasters, people can apply for reduction or exemption of relevant tax burdens in accordance with the law to protect their own rights and interests. The tax bureau explains that people can apply with photos of the disaster or other relevant supporting documents within 30 days from the date of the disaster. The reduction and exemption regulations are as follows: 1. House tax: Houses that have been damaged by major disasters accounting for more than 30% but less than 50% of the entire area will be levied at half the house tax; houses with more than 50% of the damaged area that must be repaired before they can be used are exempt from the house tax. 2. Use license tax: If a car or a motorcycle with a capacity of 151cc or above cannot be used due to a disaster, it should be reported to the supervisory authority for parking or scrap registration. According to the information notified by the supervisory authority, the license tax overpaid during the period when the vehicle cannot be used will be refunded. 3. Land value tax: Land value tax is exempted if the land cannot be used due to environmental restrictions such as landslides, subsidence, runoff, sand pressure, etc. or when it is technically unusable. 4. title: 企業獲利預期飆高 美股漲勢面臨挑戰恐提高波動性

title_en: Corporate profit expectations soar, challenges to U.S. stock market rally may increase volatility
summary_en: Picture/Our database Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei report Driven by optimistic corporate profit prospects, the U.S. stock market has repeatedly reached new highs in 2026. However, this also requires companies to meet higher profit standards. The market is worried that if they cannot be achieved, it may cause stock price fluctuations. Strong earnings reports from U.S. companies in the first quarter of this year, coupled with huge investments in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure and solid economic fundamentals, prompted analysts to significantly raise their profit forecasts for 2026. Market research firm Yardeni Research pointed out that the stronger-than-expected performance in the first quarter may lead analysts to be overly optimistic about the next three quarters. Chris Fasciano, chief market strategist at Commonwealth Financial Network, said: "Earnings growth and higher expectations are good for investors because it can push the market higher, but it does raise the bar." Joe Mazzola, trading and derivatives strategist at Charles Schwab, predicts that the second-quarter earnings season may be more volatile due to upward revisions to expectations. In the second quarter of this year, overall profits of S&P 500 companies are expected to increase 23.4% from the same period last year, much higher than the 15.2% expected at the beginning of the year. summary_en: Picture/Schematic Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei reports that geopolitical tensions in the Middle East have heated up again, driving up international oil prices. Market analysts pointed out that crude oil prices may return to the range of US$100 to US$110 per barrel. According to "Proactiveinvestors UK", this week US President Trump announced that the ceasefire agreement with Iran has expired due to another attack on commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz. The United States then launched air strikes against more than 80 targets in Iran. Reports suggest that Khark Island (Iran's main crude oil export channel) may become a military target in the future, further exacerbating market concerns about crude oil supply disruptions. International oil prices, currently around $70 a barrel, have all but erased recent conflict-driven gains, but history shows that when major conflicts threaten global oil supplies, crude prices tend to rise quickly toward $100 to $110 a barrel. Past examples include the 2008 commodities boom, the 2011-2012 Arab Spring and sanctions on Iran, and 2022 when Russia invaded Ukraine, all causing oil prices to surge. In addition, U.S. strategic oil reserves remain near their lowest levels since the early 1980s, while Russia continues to face challenges from refinery damage and attacks on energy infrastructure, all of which could add to supply pressures on global crude markets. title_en: Sprinting on AI infrastructure, Amazon issues $25 billion in huge bonds
summary_en: Business Media | Fang Chengye/Comprehensive foreign news reports Technology giant Amazon returned to the U.S. bond market today and issued at least US$25 billion in new bonds. The move is aimed at funding its growing artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, including building data centers and AI-related facilities for itself and its AWS cloud customers. According to Bloomberg, the bonds are being issued in as many as eight tranches with maturities ranging from three years to up to 40 years. The main purpose is to support Amazon’s huge capital expenditure plan. Although the proceeds from the bond issuance will be used for general corporate purposes, including repaying existing debt, financing and acquisitions, analysts generally believe that the main funds will be invested in the construction of AI-driven data centers. Among them, the interest rate on the 40-year bond, the longest term, is said to be about 1.25 percentage points higher than similar U.S. government bonds, reflecting strong investor demand for high-quality technology bonds despite market concerns about the growing scale of AI-related debt. The issuance underscores how critical the bond market is for big tech companies to realize their AI ambitions. These companies are raising hundreds of billions of dollars through the bond market to invest in infrastructure ranging from chips and servers to power and networks. According to data from Bloomberg, global AI-related corporate bond issuance has reached approximately US$335 billion this year, more than double that in 2025, and Amazon’s issuance is an important contributor. title_en: Well-known investors name three top technology stocks: Huida, Micron Technology, and Palantir are favored
summary_en: Picture/Schematic Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei Report Well-known American investor Louis Navellier recently named three top technology growth stocks that he is optimistic about, namely Nvidia, Micron Technology and Palantir Technologies. He pointed out that these companies' recent financial reports have been strong and show significant growth potential. As the leader in artificial intelligence (AI) chips, Huida's market value has exceeded the combined stock markets of France, Germany, and Italy, and even exceeded the entire British stock market. According to its first-quarter financial report, Huida's revenue increased by 85% year-on-year to US$81.6 billion, operating profits soared 139.7% to US$45.5 billion, and earnings per share (EPS, how much the company earned per share) reached US$1.87. Huida's revenue and profit in the quarter exceeded market expectations by 3.4% and 6.9% respectively. In addition, Huida raised its second-quarter revenue forecast to US$91 billion, higher than analysts' expectations of US$87.3 billion. The report pointed out that Huida's stock price is currently trading at a level lower than the 2027 estimated price-to-earnings ratio (how many times the stock price is EPS, the higher the number means the market is willing to pay more to buy its profits) of 15.4 times. Micron Technology, a major memory manufacturer, benefited from rising memory prices and achieved outstanding profit performance. The company’s fiscal 2026 third-quarter financial report released in June this year showed that revenue soared 346% to 41.46 billion.

title_en: Micron spends US$250 billion to expand U.S. investment and promote independent chip manufacturing
summary_en: Picture / Our database Business Media | Wu Chengyue / Taipei report Micron Technology, a major American memory manufacturer, announced on Thursday that it plans to invest more than US$250 billion in the United States by 2035, another significant increase compared to the US$200 billion plan announced in June last year. The move aims to expand domestic semiconductor manufacturing, strengthen the independence of the U.S. chip industry, and create more than 90,000 jobs. Huge investments target semiconductor independence. This huge investment from Micron Technology is mainly concentrated in the expansion of chip factories in New York State, Idaho and Virginia. Among them, the ultra-large dynamic random access memory (DRAM) fab located in Clay, New York, is ahead of schedule. Micron aims to produce 40% of its DRAM chips in the United States to reduce dependence on overseas supply chains. This strategy is in line with the policy priorities of the current President Trump administration to promote domestic chip manufacturing. Micron has also committed to investing US$250 million in the Trump Accounts program. Strengthening the supply chain and joining hands with Taiwanese partners In addition to chip manufacturing, Micron Technology will also invest an additional US$3 billion to strengthen the domestic semiconductor supply chain in the United States. Among them, US$500 million will be used to fund technology upgrades and production expansion at Taiwan’s Global Wafers’ 300mm silicon wafer manufacturing facility in Sherman, Texas. summary_en: [Reporter Zhao Xiaowen/Taipei Report] Acer announced its latest operating results. In June, consolidated revenue reached 27.818 billion yuan, a monthly increase of 6.3%; in the second quarter, self-consolidated revenue was 85.296 billion yuan, an annual increase of 28.2%, setting a new high for the same period in 13 years. summary_en: Picture/Schematic Shang Media | Fang Chengye/Comprehensive foreign news reports The U.S. stock market is experiencing a significant style rotation in 2026, ending the situation dominated by the "Big Seven" technology giants in the past few years. Small-cap growth stocks have significantly outperformed these tech leaders so far this year as investor sentiment shifts. The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS), which tracks equally weighted tech giants including Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com Inc., Apple, Meta Platforms, Microsoft, Huida and Tesla, is down 0.5% this year. In fact, the fund has underperformed the S&P 500 over the past 12 months, largely due to the huge divergence in performance within the Big Seven. For example, Alphabet's stock price has soared 101% in the past year, and Apple's stock price has also risen about 48%, mainly due to the strong performance of the monetization process of artificial intelligence (AI). However, Meta Platforms fell 15.9% over the same period and Microsoft fell 23.3%, indicating that investors are increasingly cautious about the payback period of huge AI capital expenditures. Market observers note that AI investment has shifted from the narrative-driven speculative rise of the past to a stage that is more focused on the delivery of substantial profits. summary_en: The edge of the wind circle of Typhoon Bawei touched the Yihua coast in the early morning. Wu Shengyu, a senior consultant at the weather risk company, said on the Facebook fan page "Weather Staff-Wu Shengyu" today that Typhoon Bawei rebuilt a new double-wall structure after the vertical wind shear in the environment decreased. There is also a very wide moat between the inner and outer eyes, and there are several spiral rainbands outside the outer eyewall. The east and south sides are better developed, while the rainbands on the west side are weaker. However, the airflow driven by the strong wind field encounters Taiwan's terrain, creating a persistent and lingering rainfall echo on the windward side, and rainfall continues to accumulate wherever the echo passes.

summary: 中聯油脂致癌油事件持續延燒，7-ELEVEN今（11）日公布疑慮批號鮮食商品退款方式。凡於2026年4月13日至4月23日期間，購買聯華食品代工生產的疑慮批號飯糰、手捲、三明治、漢堡、便當等近80款鮮食商品，若結帳時有報UniOpen會員，將自7月14日起陸續退費；未使用會員者，則可自7月15日起持消費證明至全台門市辦理退款。

title_en: Preview of five major financial events on July 11
summary_en:
The Economic Daily has compiled five must-know financial events so that readers can quickly grasp the most important financial events every morning.
1. Japan resists devaluation and seeks support from pension funds, hoping to reduce the structural selling pressure on the yen.
Japanese Finance Minister Katayama Satsuki said on the 10th that he would explore ways to encourage pension funds such as the Japanese Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) to increase investment in domestic financial assets, driving the yen exchange rate and Japanese long-term bond prices to rise intraday on the 10th. Strategists believe the policy will benefit domestic assets, but have mixed views on the long-term outlook for the yen...more

2. Taiwan stock market welcomes 817.6 billion yuan in dividends. Hon Hai is expected to issue the largest dividend of more than 100 billion yuan.
Taiwan stocks shrank and consolidated, and the wait-and-see atmosphere in the market became stronger. Experts pointed out that the ex-rights dividend season has recently entered, and 426 listed OTC companies, including major dividend payers such as Hon Hai and life insurance financial holding companies, are expected to pay cash dividends before the end of July, which will inject a total of approximately 817.6 billion yuan of capital into Taiwan stocks. Reinvestment of dividends will increase bullish momentum...more

title_en: SCFI freight index fell 4.3% on week
summary_en: The latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index (SCFI) was released yesterday (10th). The 10% temporary tariff imposed by the U.S. government on imported goods will expire on July 24. The previous "rush to ship" that drove the global supply chain to pull goods in advance has temporarily come to an end. The SCFI has retreated for the first time after rising for ten consecutive weeks. The index fell 4.3% on a weekly basis, and freight rates on the four major routes fell simultaneously.

summary_en: Recently, groups related to artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure have been significantly shaken. From GPUs, ASICs, AI servers, to cooling and data center supply chains, they are all under pressure to correct. The market's concerns are mainly focused on three things: Meta's plan to rent out AI computing power, the continued decline in H100 rental prices, and whether hyperscalers have invested heavily in AI capital expenditures ahead of actual demand.

title: 南亞科明年資本支出2,000億 應對先進製程及客製化記憶體需求
summary: 南亞科看好AI帶動記憶體產業進入新一波成長循環，啟動大規模投資布局。南亞科總經理李培瑛昨（10）日表示，因應新廠建置、先進製程及客製化記憶體需求，今年資本支出預估達500多億元，明年內部初步規劃進一步拉升至逾2,000億元。

title_en: Nanya plans to spend RMB 200 billion in capital expenditure next year to meet demand for advanced manufacturing processes and customized memory
summary_en: Nanya is optimistic that AI will drive the memory industry into a new growth cycle and launch a large-scale investment layout. Li Peiying, general manager of Nanya, said yesterday (10th) that in response to the demand for new factory construction, advanced processes and customized memory, capital expenditures this year are estimated to reach more than 50 billion yuan, and preliminary internal plans for next year will further increase to more than 200 billion yuan.

summary_en: DRAM giant Nanya announced its second quarter financial results yesterday (10th). Benefiting from the rising prices and volumes of the memory industry, the average selling price of DRAM increased by more than 60% quarter-to-quarter. The single-quarter gross profit margin shot up to 79.5%, a record high. A new high, a significant increase of 11.6 percentage points from the first quarter. Net profit after tax was 50.192 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 92.6%. It turned profit compared with the same period last year, rewriting the new record, with net profit per share (EPS) of 14.66 yuan.

summary: IC設計大廠聯發科昨（10）日公布今年6月合併營收580.12億元，月增22.3%、年增2.8%，推升第2季合併營收達1,521.83億元，季增2.03%、年增1.21%，不僅優於公司原先預估，更突破財測高標，為五季來最佳。

title_en: MediaTek's revenue in the last quarter exceeded high targets, mainly due to strong growth in smart edge platforms and good mobile phone chip shipments
summary_en: MediaTek, a major IC design company, announced yesterday (10th) that its consolidated revenue in June this year was 58.012 billion yuan, a monthly increase of 22.3% and an annual increase of 2.8%. It pushed the consolidated revenue in the second quarter to 152.183 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 2.03% and an annual increase of 1.21%. It was not only better than the company's original forecast, but also exceeded the high financial forecast, which was the best in five quarters.

It is said that he will join MediaTek's management team to continue to promote Taiwan's silicon photonics and co-packaged optics (CPO) optoelectronics integration to reach a new commercial milestone.

title_en: TSMC's 1.4nm technology is ahead of schedule
summary_en: The China Science and Technology Management Bureau stated yesterday (10th) that the construction of the much-anticipated TSMC China Science and Technology 1.4nm process new plant is ahead of schedule, and the factory building (FAB) projects have been completed and contracted. The first factory building is expected to be completed by April next year. According to the supply chain assessment, trial production operations will be carried out at the beginning of the third quarter of next year at the earliest, and there is a chance to achieve mass production in mid-2028.

summary_en: Uni-President Group reported good revenue, benefiting from the sales injection from its distribution businesses such as Uni-President Central Control, Uni-President Supermarket and Wanjiafu, which pushed Uni-President's revenue in June and the first half of the year to new highs in the same period. Uni-President announced yesterday (10th) that consolidated revenue in June was 58.3 billion yuan, an annual increase of 4.6%; cumulative revenue in the first half of the year was 349.97 billion yuan, an annual increase of 3.2%.

title: 華航高飛 業績年增28%
summary: 華航昨（10）日公布6月份合併營收，單月表現為217.61億元，較去年同期年增28.8%，持續創下歷年單月新高。其中，客運收入118.19億元，較去年同期成長14.8%；貨運收入80.85億元，較去年同期成長 51.6%。華航第2季合併營收638.45億元，上半年合併營收1,208.03億元，同樣刷新歷年新高。

title_en: China Airlines flies high, performance increases by 28% year-on-year
summary_en: China Airlines announced yesterday (10th) that its consolidated revenue for June was 21.761 billion yuan, an annual increase of 28.8% over the same period last year, continuing to set new monthly highs in the past. Among them, passenger transport revenue was 11.819 billion yuan, an increase of 14.8% over the same period last year; freight revenue was 8.085 billion yuan, an increase of 51.6% over the same period last year. China Airlines' consolidated revenue in the second quarter was 63.845 billion yuan, and consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 120.803 billion yuan, which also set a new high.

title: 中聯風暴擴大 遭無限期停工 食藥署要求還沒改善前不得恢復生產
summary: 中聯油脂致癌物苯駢芘超標風暴擴大，衛福部食藥署署長姜至剛昨（10）日說明，疑慮油品項從原先的二批號、2,600公噸，再增加一批號，為前一日接獲南僑通報，使用中聯油脂批號315-1150510大豆油，檢出苯駢芘每公斤2.9微克，超過法定上限的2微克。相關下游產品已於昨日中午全數下架，該署要求中聯公司無限期停工。

title_en: Zoomlion's storm expands and production is suspended indefinitely. The Food and Drug Administration requires that production not be resumed until improvements are made.
summary_en: The storm over the excessive levels of the carcinogen benzene pyrene in Zoomlion Oils and Fats has expanded. Jiang Zhigang, director of the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, stated yesterday (10th) that the suspected oil item has been increased from the original second batch number of 2,600 metric tons to an additional batch number. This is due to the notification received from Nanqiao the previous day that the soybean oil with batch number 315-1150510 of Zoomlion Oils and Fats was detected. 2.9 micrograms of benzene pyrene per kilogram, exceeding the legal limit of 2 micrograms. All relevant downstream products were removed from the shelves at noon yesterday, and the agency asked China United to suspend operations indefinitely.

summary: 中聯油脂公司1,300公噸大豆沙拉油驗出一級致癌物「苯駢芘」超標四倍，影響全台食安問題嚴重。台中地檢署昨動員13名檢察官大搜索、漏夜複訊，認定中聯等四間公司涉嫌違反食品安全衛生法、有延遲通報，聲押中聯總經理余凌沖、董事長蔡清松2,000萬元交保。

title_en: China United Federation of Trade Unions declares that the chairman of the board of directors posted a bail of RMB 20 million
summary_en: 1,300 metric tons of soybean salad oil from China United Oil Company were found to be four times higher than the level of the first-level carcinogen "benzopyrene", causing serious food safety problems across Taiwan. The Taichung District Prosecutor's Office yesterday mobilized 13 prosecutors to search and hold late-night retrials. They determined that four companies, including Zoomlion, were suspected of violating the Food Safety and Hygiene Law and delaying notifications. They ordered Zoomlion's general manager Yu Lingchong and chairman Cai Qingsong to post bail of NT$20 million.

title: 人口年減10萬人 連30月下滑
summary: 內政部昨（10）日公布最新戶籍統計顯示，台灣人口已連續30個月呈現負成長，截至今年6月底總人口為2,324萬3,565人，較去年同期減少10萬3,176人。除了人口持續下滑，今年上半年新生兒更比去年同期少了9,031人，少子化趨勢持續加劇，也使人口自然減少情況難以改善。

title_en: Population decreases by 100,000 annually, declining for 30 consecutive months
summary_en: The latest household registration statistics released by the Ministry of Interior yesterday (10th) show that Taiwan's population has shown negative growth for 30 consecutive months. As of the end of June this year, the total population was 23,243,565 people, a decrease of 103,176 people compared with the same period last year. In addition to the continued decline in population, there were 9,031 fewer newborns in the first half of this year than in the same period last year. The trend of low birthrate continues to intensify, making it difficult to improve the natural population decline.

title_en: Real salary in the first five months is the best in six years. Accounting General Office: AI dividend fermentation
summary_en: The Accounting and Accounting Office announced the latest salary statistics yesterday (10th). The average regular salary of all employees in the first five months was 48,907 yuan, an annual increase of 2.81%, the second highest in the same month in the past 27 years. After deducting price factors, the real regular salary averaged 44,128 yuan, an annual increase of 1.27%, which was also a new high for the same period in the past six years, indicating that labor wages continued to grow steadily.

title: 電子業加班工時上揚
summary: AI需求持續挹注製造業生產動能，帶動加班工時維持高檔。主計總處最新統計顯示，5月製造業平均加班工時18.2小時，雖較4月的18.5小時略減，仍寫下近16年來同月新高，也是2010年8月以來單月次高，電子零組件業加班工時更寫下近46年來同月新高，反映製造業接單與生產需求依舊熱絡。

title_en: Electronics industry overtime hours increase
summary_en: AI demand continues to drive production momentum in the manufacturing industry, driving overtime hours to remain high. The latest statistics from the General Accounting Office show that the average overtime hours in the manufacturing industry in May was 18.2 hours. Although it was slightly lower than the 18.5 hours in April, it still set a new high for the same month in the past 16 years. It was also the second highest in a single month since August 2010. The overtime hours of the electronic components industry set a new high for the same month in the past 46 years, reflecting that the manufacturing industry still has strong demand for orders and production.

summary_en: China Airlines announced its consolidated revenue for June yesterday (10th), which was 21.761 billion yuan in a single month, an increase of 28.8% compared with the same period last year, and continued to set new monthly highs in the past. Among them, passenger transport revenue was 11.819 billion yuan, an increase of 14.8% over the same period last year; freight revenue was 8.085 billion yuan, an increase of 51.6% over the same period last year. China Airlines' consolidated revenue in the second quarter was 63.845 billion yuan, and consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 120.803 billion yuan, which also set a new high.

title_en: Population decreases by 100,000 annually, declining for 30 consecutive months
summary_en: The latest household registration statistics released by the Ministry of Interior yesterday (10th) show that Taiwan's population has shown negative growth for 30 consecutive months. As of the end of June this year, the total population was 23,243,565 people, a decrease of 103,176 people compared with the same period last year. In addition to the continued decline in population, there were 9,031 fewer newborns in the first half of this year than in the same period last year. The trend of low birthrate continues to intensify, making it difficult to improve the natural population decline.

title_en: Demand for AI continues to strengthen, and overtime hours in the electronic components industry reach a new high in the same month in the past 46 years
summary_en: AI demand continues to drive production momentum in the manufacturing industry, driving overtime hours to remain high. The latest statistics from the General Accounting Office show that the average overtime hours in the manufacturing industry in May was 18.2 hours. Although it was slightly lower than the 18.5 hours in April, it still set a new high for the same month in the past 16 years and the second highest in a single month since August 2010. The overtime hours of the electronic components industry set a new high for the same month in the past 46 years, reflecting that the manufacturing industry continues to receive orders and production demand.

summary_en: Meilin Fruit Store has been standing for half a century. The store's signboard, wooden cabinets, and walls are all decorated with precious red cypress, which also implies that the fruit is of extraordinary value. The first generation, Yuan Jingyue, was forced by her husband's gambling debt to move north from Chiayi with her daughter to set up a stall. Later, she made a name for herself by selling Japanese apples, which were difficult to obtain during the martial law period. The old store has been passed down to the third generation. title_en: Hon Hai suddenly released heavy news late at night! Liu Yiru resigned from the board of directors in a flash after "only taking office for one year"
summary_en: Finance Center/Li Mingrong reported that Hon Hai (2317), the leading power value stock, dropped serious news without warning on the evening of the 10th. It announced that Liu Yiru, the legal person director representative and former Minister of Finance, had resigned from the board of directors. As soon as the news came out, it immediately aroused great attention and heated discussion in the financial circle. In response, Hon Hai quickly issued a clarification, emphasizing that this high-level personnel change was not due to operational factors. In fact, there was a behind-the-scenes operation to accurately control the number of seats in order to ensure "a majority of independent directors." Liu Yiru resigned in a flash without taking the overall situation into consideration, and successfully helped Hon Hai return to high international standards of corporate governance. It can be called a rare win-win bomb disposal operation in the financial world.

In addition to Xinxing (3037) and Jingshuo (3189), which hit highs of 14.897 billion yuan and 4.22 billion yuan respectively, Nanjing Electric (8046) also broke the record in the past three and a half years, with an annual increase of 50% to 4.68 billion yuan. title_en: Typhoon Bawei is approaching, 5 people have been injured, and 2,050 people have been evacuated as a precaution across Taiwan
summary_en: Moderate Typhoon Bavi will affect Taiwan from the 10th to the 12th. Due to the influence of the typhoon's peripheral circulation, eastern and northern Taiwan, the Hengchun Peninsula and the coastal areas of Matsu must pay attention to the impact of long waves. It is summer vacation, and people should not go to the beach to watch the waves. The north coast Regional ports must pay attention to storm surges. The main heavy rainfall areas are in the north, northeast and the entire Taishan District. They must pay attention to flooding caused by short-term heavy rainfall. The flood warning areas are Yilan County, Keelung City, Taipei City, New Taipei City, Taoyuan City, Hsinchu County, Miaoli County and other seven counties and cities including low-lying and flood-prone areas along the coast and estuaries must pay attention to flooding caused by heavy rainfall. Liu Shifang, commander of the Central Disaster Response Center, instructed the central and local governments to work together to prevent typhoon.

title: 當包裝寫「0克」，你真的沒吃進反式脂肪？揭開加工食品裡的數字騙局
summary:
一種能讓食品「保鮮」數年的成分，為何同時被證實與心臟病、癌症、糖尿病脫不了關係？當你在超市拿起標示「0克反式脂肪」的產品，是否想過那個數字可能是精心設計的假象？有「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，反式脂肪這種人工產物，之所以能為加工食品帶來誘人的延長保鮮期優勢，原因在於細菌難以消化其特殊的雙鍵結構。


然而不幸的是，我們自身的粒線體，這個細胞內的能量工廠，也同樣缺乏分解這種鍵結的酵素。因此反式脂肪一旦攝取，便容易在肝臟中累積，進而導致脂肪肝和心血管疾病。攝取反式脂肪，無異於讓身體攝取難以排出的毒素。


曾嶔元強調，反式脂肪的危害早已被證實，它與一系列嚴重疾病息息相關，包括心臟病、肥胖、癌症和糖尿病。更令人擔憂的是，反式脂肪的攝取並沒有所謂的「安全劑量」。研究數據顯示，每增加2％的反式脂肪熱量攝取，心臟病風險幾乎增加至2倍。

title_en: When the package says "0 grams", are you really not consuming trans fat? Uncovering the digital scam in processed foods
summary_en:
Why is an ingredient that can keep food fresh for several years also proven to be linked to heart disease, cancer, and diabetes? When you pick up a product in the supermarket that says "0 grams of trans fat," have you ever thought that that number might be a carefully designed illusion? In his new book "Precision Diet", Dr. Zeng Jiyuan, the "Medical Sherlock Holmes", pointed out that the reason why trans fat, an artificial product, can bring attractive advantages to extended shelf life of processed foods is that it is difficult for bacteria to digest its special double bond structure.


Unfortunately, our own mitochondria, the energy factories within our cells, also lack the enzymes to break down these bonds. Therefore, once trans fat is ingested, it is easy to accumulate in the liver, leading to fatty liver and cardiovascular disease. Consuming trans fats is tantamount to ingesting toxins that are difficult for the body to eliminate.


Zeng Jinyuan emphasized that the harm of trans fat has long been proven, and it is closely related to a series of serious diseases, including heart disease, obesity, cancer and diabetes. What’s even more worrying is that there is no so-called “safe dose” of trans fat intake. Research data shows that for every 2% increase in trans fat caloric intake, the risk of heart disease almost doubles.

title: 7月9日盤前／美伊紛爭推升油價 惟輝達傳好消息 指數月線附近整理
summary:
昨日盤勢
受美股走弱影響，加上主計總處公布6 月CPI年增率2.6%，創下 2025 年 2 月以來新高。此外，荷姆茲海峽傳出一連串油輪遇襲事件，推升國際原油報價重返七字頭。在多空交錯下，台股開盤以 45,524 點紅盤開出，盤中一度下探至 45,036 點。所幸護國神山台積電在尾盤展現神龍擺尾之姿，終場拉抬指數翻紅收在45,734 點，小漲 255 點，指數仍未站回月線；惟盤面上AI指標題材股轉強，包括聯亞、南亞、景碩及順達等，亮燈漲停。
權值股方面，台積電上漲1.02%，鴻海上漲0.21%，聯發科下跌0.86%，廣達上漲1.07%，台達電下跌0.26%。盤面強勢股，研華、禾伸堂、合晶、鑽石投資、麗臺、南亞、雷虎、精材、聯亞、景碩等漲停；GIS-KY、威宏-KY、聯電、台勝科、南電、上詮、昇達科等漲幅6%以上；盤面弱勢股，志聖、捷敏-KY、宏旭-KY、聖暉*等跌停；三晃、來億-KY、遠傳、富世達、奇鋐、大亞、大毅、致茂、華新科等跌幅5%以上。
終場台灣加權指數上漲 255.3 點，以45734.41點作收，成交量為9583.46億元。觀察盤面變化，三大類股全面上漲，電子上漲0.44%

title: 雙線戰法1／大盤崩千點照買　54歲宗哥靠「布林線」咬住波段滾6千萬

title: Meta、谷歌挺過三世代…芒果股誕生！MANGOS科技新帝國帶來什麼投資機會？
summary: 全球資本市場正經歷一場結構性的深度轉移。過去十年，主導華爾街與全球投資組合的核心力量，是建立在網際網路、軟體服務與消費性電子產品基礎上的科技七巨頭；然而，隨著生成式ＡＩ崛起，市場關注的焦點已逐漸從軟體應用與終端消費，轉向底層算力、能源基建以及低軌道衛星通訊的垂直整合。六月，SpaceX掛牌上市，一個全新的縮寫開始在華爾街與財經媒體圈流傳，由Meta、Anthropic、輝達、谷歌母公司Alphabet、OpenAI與SpaceX組成的「MANGOS」，被視為取代Mag 7的新代表。儘管FAANG、Mag 7等稱號過去熱度都相當高，卻始終不是官方認定的正式產業分類，亦不受交易所或監管機構承認，更深層的意涵其實是市場、法人與媒體描述當前資金高度集中的方式─市場更相信什麼故事，熱錢又會流向何方。
title_zh: Meta、谷歌挺過三世代…芒果股誕生！MANGOS科技新帝國帶來什麼投資機會？
summary_zh: 全球資本市場正經歷一場結構性的深度轉移。過去十年，主導華爾街與全球投資組合的核心力量，是建立在網際網路、軟體服務與消費性電子產品基礎上的科技七巨頭；然而，隨著生成式ＡＩ崛起，市場關注的焦點已逐漸從軟體應用與終端消費，轉向底層算力、能源基建以及低軌道衛星通訊的垂直整合。六月，SpaceX掛牌上市，一個全新的縮寫開始在華爾街與財經媒體圈流傳，由Meta、Anthropic、輝達、谷歌母公司Alphabet、OpenAI與SpaceX組成的「MANGOS」，被視為取代Mag 7的新代表。儘管FAANG、Mag 7等稱號過去熱度都相當高，卻始終不是官方認定的正式產業分類，亦不受交易所或監管機構承認，更深層的意涵其實是市場、法人與媒體描述當前資金高度集中的方式─市場更相信什麼故事，熱錢又會流向何方。
title_en: Meta and Google survive three generations...Mango stocks are born! What investment opportunities does the new MANGOS technology empire bring?
summary_en: The global capital market is undergoing a profound structural shift. In the past decade, the core forces that dominated Wall Street and global investment portfolios were the seven technology giants based on the Internet, software services, and consumer electronics. However, with the rise of generative AI, the focus of the market has gradually shifted from software applications and terminal consumption to the vertical integration of underlying computing power, energy infrastructure, and low-orbit satellite communications. In June, SpaceX went public, and a new abbreviation began to circulate on Wall Street and financial media circles. "MANGOS", composed of Meta, Anthropic, Huida, Google's parent company Alphabet, OpenAI and SpaceX, is regarded as a new representative to replace Mag 7. Although titles such as FAANG and Mag 7 have been quite popular in the past, they have never been officially recognized as a formal industry classification, nor are they recognized by exchanges or regulatory agencies. The deeper meaning is actually the way the market, legal persons and media describe the current high concentration of funds - which stories do the markets believe more and where will the hot money flow?

This year's Family Day is specially themed "2026 Yuanta Sustainable Living Festival - Green Life Party, invite you to have fun together", and takes local humanities, local creation, and sustainable environment as the core themes. It is hoped that through the connection of different urban areas, employees and their families can not only participate in joy, but also have a deeper understanding of the humanistic characteristics and urban stories of various parts of Taiwan.

title_en: I still have to work during the typhoon holiday! Five miserable industries exposed: more than 80% are forced to work
summary_en: As Typhoon Bavi approaches Taiwan, whether various places have a typhoon holiday has become the focus of public attention. However, for many office workers, even if the local government announces the suspension of work and classes, they may not be able to truly take a vacation. According to the latest "Survey on Typhoon Skyworkers and Enterprise Disaster Prevention" by yes123 job search website, about 80% of workers have attended work as usual during the typhoon holiday, and more than 60% of them have done so because their companies or supervisors required them to go to work. Analyzed by industry, five major industries, including mass communication and public relations and advertising, wholesale, retail and trade, medical care and biotechnology, catering, accommodation and leisure travel, as well as agriculture, forestry, fishery, animal husbandry, mining and environmental protection and ecology, have become the groups most difficult to take holidays during typhoon days. title_en: Exclusive/Taiwan stock market will undergo three major reforms next year! Qianjin stocks are priced at 1 yuan per round, regardless of fractions, and odd-lot matching is shortened to 1 second.
summary_en: High-priced thousand-dollar stocks have flourished in recent years. In order to lower investment thresholds, reduce retail investor price differences, and implement inclusive finance, the latest research directions of the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the Securities Dealers Association have been released. Taiwan stocks will usher in two major new heavyweight systems. The most watched "qianjin stocks (high-priced stocks above a thousand yuan)" will rise. "Reducing the unit (Tick) to 1 yuan" will be officially launched in July next year, and will be fully implemented simultaneously regardless of whole shares or odd lots; at the same time, the matching time for intraday odd lot transactions will also be significantly shortened from the current 5 seconds to 1 second, allowing petty bourgeoisie to trade high-priced stocks with a more "seismic-resistant" effect.

title_en: Whistleblowers who delay reporting will be fined. Nanqiao issued a serious message: Apply for administrative remedies in accordance with the law.
summary_en: The incident of Zoomlion Oil’s soybean salad oil being found to contain excessive levels of level 1 carcinogens continues to spread. In addition to Zoomlion Oil being fined NT$165.2 million by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, local governments are also simultaneously holding relevant operators accountable. Among them, Nan Qiao, who served as the whistleblower, was also fined NT$3 million by the Taipei City Health Bureau for delaying reporting. In response, Nan Chiau issued a major statement clarifying that the problematic samples were reserved samples, but the oil already in the tank tested normal and it was not notified to the competent authority at that time.

title_en: The low-level investment artifact of "Fourth Legal Person" is here! 10 Taiwanese stock ETFs Q3 stooping to pick up diamonds
summary_en: The weighted index was affected by the pressure on U.S. stocks, and the market fluctuated sideways. Looking forward to the third quarter, the investment trust legal person said that Taiwan stocks are diverging, financing balances are soaring, and the number of open short positions of foreign investors has hit a high. The market trend in July has become volatile, but it is not a systemic risk, but a verification period for the performance of individual companies. It is expected that blue chip stocks will still be bullish in 2027. Chapter 1 If the stock price pulls back in the third quarter, it will provide medium and long-term investors with a good opportunity to buy low. It is recommended that in addition to selecting blue-chip stocks, they can also target Taiwan stock ETFs with a scale of more than 10 billion yuan and a growing number of beneficial ownership units this year. Through the current market turmoil, they will be stuck in batches, which is equivalent to bending down to pick up diamonds. Holding them in the medium and long term will help increase the winning rate and increase investment returns.

For the first time, American foreign investors included Shunda as a tracking stock and gave it a buy rating with a target price of 800 yuan. After opening high on the 8th, the stock price quickly hit the upper limit of 427.5 yuan and was locked. More than 9,000 buy orders were queued up at the daily limit and market price. Among the BBU group, Xin Shengli also raised its daily limit.

title_en: Odd lot transactions will be carried out earlier and the matching time will be shortened! Lin Xiuming, chairman of the stock exchange, revealed the implementation time point
summary_en: There will be two major changes in odd lot trading! During the Legislative Yuan Finance Committee's inquiry today (8th), the ruling and opposition legislators were concerned about the progress of optimizing the intraday odd-lot trading system. Lin Xiuming, chairman of the Taiwan Stock Exchange, said that the adjustment to the opening time of intraday odd-lot trading will be completed by the end of this year. Odd-lot trading will be advanced from the current 9:10 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., synchronizing with the trading time of whole stocks, and the odd-lot buying and selling matching time will be shortened from 5 seconds to 1 second in July next year.

summary_en: Chenhui (1271) announced on the 8th that its June revenue was 336 million yuan, an annual increase of 356.81%. The company said that its revenue in May benefited from Costco's promotional activities in the United States, which boosted shipments and boosted the single-month base period. Although revenue in June fell from the previous month, the overall performance was still in line with the company's expectations. With the simultaneous advancement of health-care raw materials, brand products and channel business, future single-month revenue is expected to remain above 250 million yuan, and will gradually increase with the introduction of new products, international customers and the expansion of brand channels.

title_en: Pre-market on July 8/AI Noise lingers, the Middle East adds another variable, Taiwan stocks fluctuate and hold on to 45,000
summary_en:
Yesterday's market trend
The Feihan Index swept away the gloom of last week and rose by more than 2% on Monday, encouraging Taiwan stocks to open higher in early trading on Tuesday. However, the willingness to pursue high-end prices above the 5-day line was weak, coupled with the heavy decline of Korean stocks, and selling pressure emerged after 11 o'clock. Although financial stocks Kai Fund and Cathay Gold bucked the trend and tried to support the index, they were still defeated by the selling pressure in the end, and the weighted index showed an opening high and fell below the monthly line. Benefiting from next week's biotechnology exhibition, the biotech community has become a safe haven for market funds and performed well. In terms of value stocks, TSMC fell 0.81%, Hon Hai fell 2.07%, MediaTek fell 1.71%, Quanta fell 1.32%, and Delta fell 5.26%.
Strong stocks on the market, such as Kangpei*, Jimin-KY, Changsheng, Baihui, Aopen, Gongxin-KY, Taizong, Ruiqi Dentsu, Yuanxiang Biotechnology, Yingbang, Hankang-KY Chuang, Jinying Biotechnology, etc., rose by 6%; Weihuake, Herongke, Nengsu Netcom, Sichuang, Julong, etc. increased by 6 More than %; the weak stocks on the market, including Yageo*, Nanya, China Optoelectronics, Global Crystal, Xinchang Electronics, Jingshuo, Xinquan, and Sinochem, etc., fell by the limit in 46 levels; Jinghong, Changxing, KYEC Electronics, Silicon Power*-KY, Pengcheng, Titanium, Weiquan Electronics, Lishan, etc. fell more than 9%.
At the end, the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 1,077.28 points to close at 45,479.11 points, with a trading volume of 1.17 trillion yuan. Observing changes in the market, the three major categories of stocks had mixed gains and losses, with Electronics falling 2.59%, Transcendence falling 2.64%, and Financials rising 1.15%. Among sub-groups, biotech medical care and chemical biotech medical care performed better, with increases of 3.41% and 0.78 respectively.

title_en: Optimistic about the rigid demand for trade, CoinTop promotes stablecoin settlement services
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 7th) Optimizing that the receipt and payment of stablecoins will become a rigid demand for international trade in the future, Bito Group today announced the launch of a core brand of enterprise-level virtual assets and the launch of "Bito.ONE", a stablecoin settlement service specially created for financial institutions. Currently, Bito has launched pilot projects with 4 banks, and today called on 10 companies to participate in the first wave of trial plans, hoping to integrate into the global financial system.

title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission: The surgical financing mechanism will be discussed again after the Ministry of Health and Welfare provides data
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 7th) The Financial Supervisory Commission said today that insurance companies have mentioned that even if they have provided surgical financing mechanisms, they are still unable to determine whether most specific surgeries have been changed from inpatient surgeries to outpatient surgeries. At present, the industry is relatively certain that only cataract surgeries are covered. Whether there are other general surgeries, the Ministry of Health and Welfare needs to assist in providing data to clarify, so as to have a basis for continuous communication with the industry.

title: 韌性台灣論壇／維護資安韌性走在最前面　中華電信投入後量子密碼加密
